```md
# Changelog — NFS Carbon Android (`carbon-port`)

- Mobil tidak putih lagi pas PANTULAN MOBIL di OFF — pas OFF, muka cube refleksi tidak pernah digambar, jadi port tidak kenal lagi cube-nya dari target yang ada dan mobil jatuh ke langit siang bawaan game; sekarang port mengenali cube-nya dari objek teksturnya sendiri (live cube dan STATICENVMAP), jadi mobil dapat refleksi abu-abu gelap.
- Mobil tidak putih lagi pas PANTULAN MOBIL bukan FULL — kalau cube refleksi belum sempat digambar (habis loading, atau rate di bawah FULL), mobil sekarang dapat refleksi abu-abu gelap, bukan cube langit siang bawaan game; plus cube dipaksa digambar di awal balapan biar langsung normal.
- Vinyl di editor akhirnya bisa digeser — layarnya ternyata baca left stick, bukan sentuhan, jadi drag di vinyl sekarang diteruskan ke stick (D-pad atas/bawah juga gerak vertikal), dan swipe di layar itu tidak terbalik lagi.
- Mobil yang baru dibeli tidak hilang lagi dari car select pas cheat UNLOCK ALL mati — pas beli, game cuma masukin mobil ke database tapi tidak nandain mobil itu sebagai "dimiliki" di tabel unlock, jadi daftar mobil menyembunyikannya; sekarang tiap mobil dibeli langsung ditandai sebagai dimiliki, jadi tetap kelihatan walau cheat mati.
- Bersih-bersih sisa Most Wanted — label game sekarang "Carbon" (judul log tidak lagi dobel "Need for Speed: NFS Carbon"), kredit Java diperbaiki jadi "Port by Chizui" + "Base by Rangga Casper" dengan link Donate/GitHub/YouTube yang benar, caption tombol BLACK/WHITE jadi "CHANGE CAMERA"/"REAR VIEW", dan alamat-alamat MW yang basi di komen sudah dibersihkan; file XBE Most Wanted yang tidak terpakai (`ci/default.xbe.enc`) dihapus.
- EXPORT LOG sekarang selalu mendarat di Download — kalau log sedang di folder fallback (folder aplikasi sendiri), jalurnya diambil dari folder Carbon, bukan lagi nyasar ke dalam Android/data.
- DumpGuest sekarang memakai ukuran image Carbon yang benar (berakhir di 0x4DE7C0, bukan 0x508040).

- SKIP MOVIES dimatikan dulu — setelah dicek lebih dalam, alamat yang ditulis tiap frame ternyata belum terbukti sebagai flag skip-movies (tidak ada kaitannya sama movie player), jadi tulisannya dihapus biar tidak merusak opsi game; tombolnya tetap ada tapi belum ada efeknya sampai terbukti.
- Sun glare balik lagi — game ternyata memakai hasil tes visibilitas buat ngatur terang glare matahari, tapi port selalu jawab 0 sehingga glare mengecil sampai hilang; sekarang dijawab "matahari kelihatan penuh", jadi glare muncul lagi pas matahari di langit.
- Guard mobil career sekarang cuma jalan pas career beneran ke-load (GameFlowState==3, sama seperti game-nya) — log "car_db empty" yang spam pas career belum ke-load hilang; plus fallback guard tidak lagi milih mobil cuma berdasarkan flag yang belum terbukti artinya.
- Lubang crash di pemanggil guard stat mobil ditutup — fungsi pemanggilnya baca ulang pointer mobil sendiri setelah guard, jadi ditambah validasi di pemanggil itu supaya pointer rusak tidak bikin crash lagi.

- Log sesi sebelumnya tidak ketimpa lagi pas buka app — log lama disimpan jadi `carbon-prev.log`, dan EXPORT LOG ikut menyalinnya ke Download, jadi jejak crash tetap bisa dikirim walau app sudah dibuka lagi.

- Mobil di safe house tidak hilang lagi pas pilih car select — guard data mobil sekarang pakai patokan "dimiliki" yang sama seperti game (flag owned di database mobil), jadi mobil yang sudah dibeli tidak ketukar sama slot kosong; plus cheat MAX CASH tidak lagi nulis ke alamat yang salah kalau career belum ke-load.

- Auto-update dari GitHub release — app sekarang ngecek update sendiri tiap dibuka (ada juga tombol CHECK FOR UPDATES di settings); kalau ada versi baru, muncul changelog-nya sama tombol Download, jadi nggak perlu nunggu link manual lagi.
- Link Donate, GitHub, dan YouTube diupdate — Donate ke Sociabuzz Chizui, GitHub ke repo Carbon-Android, YouTube ke channel Sashachan.
- Overlay FPS sekarang cuma gaya GOverlay — panel gelap, bar load, sama grafik frame time; pilihan gaya lain dihapus. Ada metrik baru LATENCY (rata-rata frame time, misal "21.7 ms", warnanya hijau/kuning/merah); layout vertikal/horizontal tetap bisa dipilih.
- Overlay FPS dirombak — gaya AFTERBURNER / GOVERLAY / CARBON, layout vertikal atau horizontal, angka FPS dan suhu berubah warna (hijau/kuning/merah), GOverlay ada bar load sama grafik frame time; semua bisa diatur di Tampilan > OVERLAY PERFORMA.
- UI settings dirombak total — panel sidebar (Tampilan / Controller / Touch / Umum / Cheat / Kredit), halaman Controller ada tes input gamepad langsung dan rebind dikelompokkan, ada slider deadzone stick; editor layout touch tetap fullscreen, cuma tampilannya disesuaikan tema baru.
- Crash abis menang bos diperbaiki (lanjutan) — guard ditambah ke satu lagi fungsi baca stat mobil yang ikut crash karena data mobil di career kosong; plus log diagnosa buat nyari letak data mobil yang bener di career.
- Crash abis menang bos diperbaiki — game tidak lagi ketutup sendiri pas balik ke garasi, penyebabnya pointer mobil yang rusak karena data mobil di career kosong.
- Tap di menu tidak auto-confirm lagi — tap buat milih mobil bos atau huruf pas ketik nama cuma milih/highlight aja, confirm-nya pencet tombol A sendiri.
- Rebind trigger beneran tidak dobel lagi — bind lama bentuk tombol juga ikut dibersihkan, jadi R2 cuma gas, kamera tidak ikut ganti tiap tap gas.
- Rebind trigger tidak dobel lagi — pas ganti Right Trigger dari R1 ke R2, R2 cuma jalanin Right Trigger, tidak ikut kepencet fungsi lamanya.
- Analog tidak tembus lagi pas buka settings — stick menu depan disembunyikan selama panel settings terbuka.
- JOIN DISCORD ditambah di GENERAL, di sebelah EXPORT LOG — tap untuk buka invite Discord buat lapor bug.
- EXPORT LOG ditambah di GENERAL — sekali tap, log sesi ini disalin ke Download sebagai `carbon-log-<tanggal>-<jam>.log`, siap dikirim ke developer.
- YELLOW TINT dihapus dari menu Carbon — setting itu mati, tidak ada efek di Carbon.
- RENDER RESOLUTION menampilkan ukuran 3D yang benar (sebelumnya lebar dilebih-lebihkan 4/3x).
- BLOOM OFF sekarang mematikan seluruh rantai bloom, bukan cuma add-back — preset low-end lebih hemat GPU.
- Composite fullscreen di flare pass di-skip — sumber kabut putih saat LIGHT FLARES on.
- Preset MID dan HIGH ditambah di samping LOW-END (DISPLAY > PERFORMANCE).
- Preset LOW-END: sekali tap set render 50%, bloom off, motion blur off, reflections QUARTER, filter off.
- Present shader lebih murah: gamma pakai LUT, tidak ada pow() per piksel lagi.
- Reflection cube dibatasi ke skala efek — tidak render 6 view di resolusi penuh lagi.
- Jejak kotak hitam di HUD (minimap, EA Trax, race info, speedometer) dihilangkan — latar panel ikut terang.
- Guard giant-streak dan spotlight headlight dihapus — guard malah merusak pause blur dan fade.
- Fan dan trail flare di-skip — gambar statik di Vulkan hilang, layar bersih.
- Boss Bonus Cards tidak flicker disco lagi — host mengikuti buffer header title di Swap.
- Kotak hitam di HUD diperbaiki — mask kecerahan digate ke luma piksel.
- LIGHT FLARES digate ke setting (default OFF) — tidak ada efek kalau mati.
- Menu analog knob dan D-Pad diperbaiki, caption Carbon diperbarui.
```

`CLAUDE.md`:

```md
# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

## What this is

An unofficial Android (arm64) port of the original Xbox game *Need for Speed: Most Wanted* Black Edition (title 4541007B), built from the Android host of [Black-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/Black-Android) as [ShaolinMonks-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/ShaolinMonks-Android) carries it, and made with the [XboxXBE-Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp) SDK. The game's x86 code in `default.xbe` is statically recompiled to C++ on a Windows PC. That C++ is then built for Android together with the SDK's portable runtime and this repo's host code. Drawing goes through Vulkan 1.1, and windowing, input and audio through SDL3. The repo ships no game assets. `assets/`, `iso/` and `generated/` hold the user's own files or files derived from them, and all three are gitignored.

## Build

Everything runs on Windows. Requirements: Visual Studio 2022 C++ tools, plus Android SDK Platform 34, NDK `28.2.13676358` and CMake `3.31.6`. Java 17–21 is needed for Gradle 8.7 (`.vscode/settings.json` points to JDK 17). Python is used only to pull the xbe out of an ISO.

- `build.bat` runs the full pipeline:
  1. Checks the tools.
  2. Gets `assets/default.xbe`. If it is missing, `python -I tools/xdvdfs.py <iso> default.xbe assets/default.xbe` extracts it from `assets/*.iso` or `iso/*.iso`.
  3. Builds the recompiler (`tools/CMakeLists.txt` → `out/build/android-tools/xbe_recomp.exe` and `xbe_symbols.exe`) with clang-cl.
  4. Writes the `[symbols]` table into `config/game.toml` with `xbe_symbols`, only if the file doesn't have one yet.
  5. Runs `xbe_recomp config/game.toml --xdk <sdk>/xdk` → `generated/game/`.
  6. Runs `gradlew.bat assembleRelease`.
- To rebuild only the APK after editing host code (no re-recompile): `gradlew.bat assembleRelease`. Output: `app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`, signed with the debug key.
- After editing `config/game.toml` (hooks, symbols, ABI, partitions), the recompile step has to run again. Run `build.bat`, or run the two `out/build/android-tools` commands by hand.
- `gradlew.bat assembleDebug` still builds the native code as Release: unoptimized recompiled code is too slow to run.
- Install: `adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`. On the device, settings (`mostwanted.toml`, `android.toml`, `layout.toml`), saves (`hdd`) and the shader cache are in `Android/data/com.racas.mostwanted/files`; logs in `/storage/emulated/0/MostWanted/logs` when it can be written (all files access), else in `files/logs` (`LogDir` in `native/main.cpp`).
- The first native build compiles 128 partitions of recompiled code and takes 30–90 minutes.
- `-PxbeGenerated=<dir> -PxbeImage=<file>` makes Gradle build recompiled code from somewhere other than `generated/game`.

There are no tests or linters in this repo.

Performance: an empty file named `perf` in `Android/data/com.racas.mostwanted/files` turns on `XBE_PERF` (`native/main.cpp`). The log then gets a line a second from `D3DDevice_Swap` (`src/d3d/d3d8.cpp`, counters in `src/d3d/gpu_frame.h`): fps, the title thread's own time, the render thread's, GPU time from timestamps, draws and renderings; and every 600 frames the frame's renderings with the GPU time of each. `-Pdebuggable` makes `simpleperf record --app com.racas.mostwanted` work; symbolize with the unstripped `libmain.so` under `app/build/intermediates/cxx`.

## CI/CD

`.github/workflows/release-carbon.yml` runs on Windows on every push to `main`, and by hand (workflow_dispatch). It decrypts `ci/carbon.xbe.enc` with the `CARBON_XBE_KEY` secret (AES-256-CBC, PBKDF2, 200000 iterations), checks its SHA-1 (`c9c6f930c33909217a56894e8a51664404fd85b6`), runs `build_carbon.bat`, which sets `-PversionCode`/`-PversionName` from the UTC date-hour, and publishes a release with `ci/release-notes-carbon.md` and the commits since the previous tag. `app/build.gradle` signs with a release key from the `BLACK_KEYSTORE*` environment variables when they are set (the workflow sets them from the `KEYSTORE_BASE64`, `KEYSTORE_PASSWORD`, `KEY_ALIAS` and `KEY_PASSWORD` repository secrets), else the debug key. A different key breaks every installed copy's updates. `UpdateChecker.REPO` names the repository whose latest release the app checks (`Chizuui/Carbon-Android`). The old Most Wanted workflow (`.github/workflows/build.yml`, `ci/default.xbe.enc`, `build.bat`) was removed; Carbon builds only through `build_carbon.bat` / `release-carbon.yml`.

## Where the SDK comes from

The SDK is vendored in `sdk/` (upstream commit in `sdk/UPSTREAM_COMMIT`), changed in one place: `ExQueryNonVolatileSetting` takes XC_LANGUAGE from a weak `app::ConsoleLanguage()`, which `src/game/game.cpp` defines. Keep `kernel/objects.cpp` notifying every waiter on every signal: notifying only the waiters of the object that changed hung Most Wanted in loading screens (the title spun at 0x087AB5 walking a stream list another thread never filled). Both `CMakeLists.txt` files look for the SDK in this order: `sdk/` in the repo, then `../XboxXBE-Recomp` beside the repo. If neither exists, they FetchContent the SDK's `main` branch. A sibling checkout lets you read or change the runtime (`<sdk>/runtime/{app,core,kernel,xdk,gpu,audio}`), whose headers (`app/app.h`, `kernel/kernel.h`, `xdk/hle.h`, `core/input.h`, ...) the host code includes. Gradle's `fetchSDL` task shallow-clones SDL `release-3.4.16` into `third_party/SDL`. Its Java sources go into the APK and its C side becomes `libSDL3.so`. glslang, toml++ and imgui are fetched by CMake.

## Architecture

The root `CMakeLists.txt` builds one shared library, `libmain.so`, which SDL's activity loads. It is made from:

- **`generated/game/`**: recompiler output (`x86_recomp.N.cpp` for N < `partitions`, `x86_func_mapping.cpp`, `image_symbols.h`). Compiled with `-O2 -w`. Never edit it by hand. Change `config/game.toml` or the host code and recompile instead.
- **The SDK runtime** (`<sdk>/runtime/*/*.cpp`), without the Windows-only parts and the parts this repo replaces. The regex filter in `CMakeLists.txt` drops `app/`, `core/input.cpp`, `gpu/d3d12`, `gpu/render_thread`, `audio/xaudio2`, `xdk/dsound` and `xdk/d3d8`.
- **`src/`**, the game-specific host, organized as `src/<area>/*.cpp` and globbed by CMake:
  - `src/game/`: game hooks and patches. `game.cpp` has the language glue (`app::ConsoleLanguage`) and `WidenAspect` (the cameras' frame width at 0x427C00 set to the frame's aspect). `fe_mouse.cpp` makes the touch screen FEng's mouse (below; its interface is `src/common/fe_mouse.h`). `options_menu.cpp` puts the settings in the game's own OPTIONS menu (below). No `[[hook]]` yet. The code carried over from Black (weapon cheats, mouse look, walk key, FOV, typed names) and Shaolin Monks (cheats, menu and prompt taps found in what it drew) is gone.
  - `src/d3d/`: the title's Direct3D 8 (XDK 5849) entry points. `Direct3D_CreateDevice` also sets the device fields the library's init would (FVF shader, vertical blank event, display flags) and starts the vertical blank thread, which Black did from a hook. `render_thread.cpp` records D3D calls on the game's render thread and replays them on a dedicated Vulkan thread. Vertex, texture and surface memory is read at draw time, the way the console GPU reads it, so XDK fences, busy checks and locks wait on that replay.
  - `src/sound/`: DirectSound reimplemented (buffers, streams, ADPCM decode, mixer, reverb).
  - `src/common/`: `game_info.cpp` defines `app::kGame`, the struct that describes the game to the runtime (title, settings file, option bindings, load/save/init, pad and rumble filters, UI callback). Also here: the settings' rows (`menu.cpp`: `app::rows`, which the game's options menu shows, and the CHEATS page, which the game's menu does not show; the ImGui panel, on F10 and the touch gear, shows the CHEATS page alone, the gear pausing a race first (Start) and opening the panel once the press is out), `options.h` (`game::Options`, saved to `mostwanted.toml`) and translations.
- **`native/`**, the Android host. `main.cpp` runs SDL's window and event loop, the app lifecycle and foreground/surface handling. `vulkan.cpp` is the Vulkan backend, and `vk_shader.cpp` compiles the SDK's HLSL shader translations to SPIR-V with glslang. The rest: `touch.cpp` (touch controls and layout editor, plus keyboard and mouse), `gyro.cpp` (tilt steering), `input.cpp` (controllers, and the settings panel's CONTROLLER page bindings, saved as `[pad]` in `mostwanted.toml`, laid over SDL's mapping), `audio.cpp`, `ui.cpp` (ImGui), and `game_files.cpp`, which finds the game files or ISO and checks the xbe's SHA1 against `kImageSha1`. `host.h` declares the interfaces these parts share. `native/compat/crt.h` is force-included into all host sources (not the generated ones).
- **`app/`**: Gradle module. `MostWantedActivity.java` (package `com.racas.mostwanted`) extends `SDLActivity`. It asks for all-files access (the storage permission on Android 10) and creates `/storage/emulated/0/MostWanted` and `files/assets`, which are where the game files are looked for, along with a `MostWanted` folder at the top of each SD card. `UpdateChecker.java` asks `REPO` (RanggaCasper/MostWanted-Android) for its latest release; it is off while `REPO` is empty.

### How recompiled code reaches the host

`config/game.toml` is the recompiler's input:
- `[xbe]`: path, entry point, XDK version, output dir, `partitions` (CMake reads this number to list the generated sources), and code sections.
- `[symbols]` / `[data]`: addresses of library functions and globals in the image, 0 where the image has none. Host code refers to them through `SYM(Name)` from `image_symbols.h`.
- `[abi]`: register-argument conventions for link-time-code-generated XDK functions.
- `[[hook]]`: entries `at = <x86 address>`, `call = "<Name>"`. The recompiler emits a call at that address to a host function `void Name(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base)`, defined in `src/game/`. To add a hook, add the `[[hook]]` entry, define the function, and recompile.

Host code reads and writes guest memory through the kernel helpers (`HostPtr(va)`, `R32`, ...) and guest registers through `X86Context`.

### Supported game versions

Only the USA Black Edition disc: `default.xbe` SHA-1 `f636a16af04171089f879a4bed646e185c734233` (4,739,072 bytes, XDK 5849). The disc root holds `default.xbe`, `update.xbe`, `dashupdate.xbe` and `NFS/` (the game data: `ZDIR.BIN` and `ZZDATA*.BIN`).

### Notes on this image

- No `[abi]` entries: the D3D library is not link-time code generated.
- `xbe_symbols` finds 165 of 238 functions and all 12 data symbols. The other functions are not linked: the `.XTLID` table lists every library export the title uses, and the missing ones are not in it. Resolved by hand at the top of `[symbols]`, each with the code that proves it: `D3DDevice_Reset`, `SetPalette`, `BeginPush`/`EndPush`, `LoadVertexShaderProgram`, `IsBusy`, the three visibility test calls, and `IDirectSoundBuffer_Pause`/`SetEG` (`.XTLID` B0057 and B0067: the DSOUND exports are numbered in alphabetical order). `D3D_FvfShader` (0x384468) is loaded by `D3DDevice_SetVertexShader` at 0x373927.
- The stream exports `.XTLID` B0080, B0090, B0095 and B0096 are thunks to `CDirectSoundStream_FlushEx`, `SetHeadroom`, `SetMixBins` and `SetMixBinVolumes`, which are replaced; B00A3 is `XAudioCalculatePitch`, arithmetic left recompiled.
- Frame shape: 0x427C00 (853, 480 x 16/9 with the widescreen flag) is the front end's and HUD's screen transform (0x0D4888, 0x0D8330: 576 / width across, 448 / 480 down, times the profile's scale at 0x427BFC), set to 480 x the frame's aspect (`game::WidenAspect`). The 3D views' projection (0x0C7740, thiscall, ecx the view's matrices) takes the camera's 16 bit horizontal angle ([[eView + 0x40] + 0xC4]) for the x scale (+0x40) and that angle times 9/16 (3/4 without the flag) for the y scale (+0x54): wider than 16:9 the picture was stretched. `src/game/game.cpp` multiplies the x scale by (16/9) / aspect (Hor+) for the views drawn over the frame (types 1, 2, 4 to 7) inside the call, just before the view x projection product (0x2B91C4 at 0x0C7A04) the frustum's planes come from.
- Vertex programs: besides `SetVertexShader` the game loads programs into the NV2A's 136 program slots (`LoadVertexShaderProgram`, 4 callers) and runs them with `SelectVertexShaderDirect` (0x372F20, 9 callers), which copies a `D3DVERTEXATTRIBUTEFORMAT` to its static record (0x384350, the format at +0x14) and jumps to `SelectVertexShader`. `src/d3d/d3d8.cpp` keeps the slots and makes one `gpu::VertexShader` per inputs and program it is asked to select.
- The Vulkan backend counts no visibility test pixels; `GetVisibilityTestResult` gives 0, which the sun's glare (0x0D5AB0) reads without checking the result.
- 0x2CDBAA is SSE2 code (the recompiler leaves its `pxor`, `psraw`, ... unimplemented); nothing calls or points at it.
- Frame buffers: the present parameters give the title's own surfaces (`BufferSurfaces` 0x0047E1F4/0x0047E478, `DepthStencilSurface` 0x0047FFE8, a 1280x480 multisample depth). Like the library (0x3789D0), `src/d3d/d3d8.cpp` keeps copies of the buffer headers, sized as the present parameters say, and Swap turns the copies over; the title trades its own headers' memory itself before each Swap (0x0C8DA3) for the textures its visual treatment reads. Turning the title's headers too made every other frame black.
- Graphics switches in the QUALITY page, `src/game/game.cpp`: CAR REFLECTIONS (`car_reflections`: FULL, HALF, QUARTER, OFF): the cars' environment cube is drawn as views 0x12 on (0x0D7AD5, face 0's target at [0x48B4C0], the faces' views 0x70 apart) only while the byte at 0x4279D6 is set, one of a row of render switches at 0x4279CC (all 1) the game reads and never writes; HALF and QUARTER set it every 2nd or 4th frame. OFF: `native/vulkan.cpp` binds an opaque dark grey cube (matched by address too, `game::g_env_cube`), and the game still draws it every 512th frame: off from the start, a cube never drawn left the paint white whatever was bound. The faces cost about 3% of the GPU's frame. ROAD REFLECTIONS (`road_reflections`): the dword at 0x427A3C, read only at 0x0D787B, gates the wet road's reflection (views 4 and 5); the road still samples view 4's target, so off binds opaque black for it (`game::g_road_reflection`). SHADOWS (`shadows`): the dword at 0x469910, read only by a car's render (0x255490), gates the shadow under each car (0x24C0F0 with the CARSHADOW texture at CarRenderInfo +0xE0, 0x24BB90 with the one at +0xE4). The trees' and buildings' shadows on the road are the frame's one 2x multiply draw into the frame (blend DST_COLOR/SRC_COLOR); SHADOWS off skips it in `native/vulkan.cpp`. (A pale car once blamed on that skip was CAR REFLECTIONS off.) PARTICLE EFFECTS (`particles`): the byte at 0x4279CF, read only at 0x0D81FC, gates the particle system's draw (0x0CE8B0, the system at 0x482CC0). Not the master switch at 0x434130, which also stops spawning (0x0DA296 to 0x0DBEE4): loading a race with it at 0 corrupted the game's heap, a crash in the allocator 0x054DC0 under 0x1C0D50. The game's switches are written by `game::ApplyGraphicsSwitches` at each present. SCREEN RAINDROPS (`rain_drops`): 0x0CC530, the "Rain Drop" pass (20 drops, 40 renderings a frame), returns at once. FALLING RAIN (`rain`): 0x2527A0 draws a view's precipitation ([view + 0x68], views at 0x48ACF0, 0x70 each; 350 drops at +0x33D8, the RAINDROP texture at +0x3404) and returns at once; its caller 0x25E770 still works out the rain's strength (+0x290) that wets the road. YELLOW TINT (`yellow_tint`, off by default): the "Visual Look Pass" (0x0CDA40, pixel shader 0x17 of the effect table at 0x42A858) is lerp(luma, scene, +0x98), the scene times a curve of its alpha by +0x90, plus the scene times a tint ramp (texture 3, 256x1 at [this + 0x234]), plus the 320x240 copy by +0x170, times 1 + 4 x +0x174. 0x0C1BD0 builds the ramp from the curve at +0x50 and the RGB at +0xA0/+0xA4/+0xA8, the yellow; off, that colour is its luma while the ramp is built and is given back after. The pass is not skipped: it reads the scene (0x47FC2C) and draws to [this + 0x298], likely the frame itself. MOTION BLUR (`motion_blur`): the "Motion Blur" pass 0x0D1440 (cdecl, 4 args, from the "Visual Look Filters" 0x0D21D0 while the byte at 0x42F51D is set) returns whether it drew, and the "Radial Blur Mask Pass" (0x0CE1C0, nitrous and speedbreaker) runs only then; slow, it returns false having drawn nothing (0x0D1661), so off returns false at once.
- Cheats in the ImGui panel (its only page), not the game's options menu (`src/game/game.cpp` `ApplyCheats`, at each present): INFINITE NITROUS and INFINITE SPEEDBREAKER set debug bytes the game reads and never writes, 0x49A61C (the NOS drain at 0x1E6A9A is 0, every car's) and 0x4B9694 (LocalPlayer's speedbreaker drain at 0x20E663). MAX CASH keeps CareerSettings::CurrentCash, `[[0x48EDD4] + 0x10] + 0xB4` (the FEDatabase's first profile), at 9,999,999; it ends up in the save. NO POLICE sets the cop manager's byte at +0x60 (`[0x494E40]`, ICopMgr vtable 0x3CB4D0), which the scripts' NoNewPursuitsOrCops sets (0x0130E0) and VehicleSpawningEnabled (0x01A370) reads: no new cops or pursuits; a pursuit already on goes on. Off gives the byte back. UNLOCK ALL holds UnlockAllThings, the byte at 0x493D00 (SkipFE 0x493C40 + 0xC0, as on the PC), which every unlock test ors in; the game sets it itself in one menu (0x1049FA), so off gives it back too. NFSPluginSDK (berkayylmao) has the PC's class layouts, the same as the Xbox's.
- SKIP MOVIES (`skip_movies`, `src/game/game.cpp`): the movie screens' NotificationMessage (FEAnyMovie 0x116230, InGameAnyMovie 0x131A30, the boot's EA logo/PSA/intro/attract 0x1311B0, whose byte +0x2C allows the skip) stop on A/START (0x406415E3/0xB5AF2461) and post the movie's end (0xC3960EB9); the 10th per-frame tick (0xC98356BA) of each screen is taken for A, once a screen (forgotten in its destructor); the boot's screen only once its byte allows (forcing it hung the attract movie), and a player's press after the skip is taken for a tick, as a second end hung the attract movie on its frame. The engine's own cutscenes (NIS: rival intros, the career's opening) are not movies and still play: NISActivity is the class at vtable 0x3E60C0 (GetName 0x21A7F0), the counter at 0x4C8800 is above 0 while one plays (0x214399/0x215E10), and HUDACTION_SKIPNIS (0x32) maps to category 2, bit 0x80000 in 0x21DD60; what reads that bit is not found yet.
- The ImGui panel draws with the game's body font (`src/game/game_font.cpp`, `ui::ApplyGameFont` in `native/ui.cpp`): once FONT_MW_BODY is loaded (cFEng's font list at 0x48F2F0, the node's name hash at +0x14 = bStringHash("FONT_MW_BODY") 0x545570C6, its TextureInfo at +8, its FNTX resource at +0xC), its glyphs (16 bytes each: Unicode +0, width +2, height +3, texture x/y +4/+6, x offset +9, y offset from the line's top +0xA, advance +0xE) are cut out of its 256x256 linear DXT3 texture and laid into ImGui's atlas as custom glyphs over ProggyClean at the game's line height (+0x24, 23), which stays for what the game's font lacks; the renderer uploads the atlas again (`ImGui_ImplVulkan_CreateFontsTexture`, which waits for the queue). Until then (the first seconds of the boot) the panel is ProggyClean. `FontGlobalScale` brings the taller font to the 13 px the panel was laid out for.
- The retail build's PIX marker stub 0x377A70 (`xor eax, eax; ret`) is called with each pass's name ("World Render", "Car Render", "Rain Drop", "EnvMap %d", ...) and each loose model group's (0x0D62A0): wrapping it to log names maps the renderer. It is shared by other empty functions, so check the name pointer with `mem::IsCommitted` before reading it.
- Sound: EA's software mixer plays through one 6 channel PCM buffer (0x2DF96E, mix bins 0 to 5), so `src/sound/mixer.cpp` mixes up to 6 channels a voice; dropping the centre and back channels silenced cutscene dialogue and the engines.
- On Adreno `native/vulkan.cpp` uses render passes (cached, clears as load ops) instead of dynamic rendering: `vkCmdBeginRendering` allocated on every call, a sixth of the render thread in the rain, where the screen drops ping-pong 20 times a frame between the frame and a 32x32 target. Command pools are reset on a thread of their own (the driver's reset frees and remaps the buffers' GPU memory).
- SHADER PRELOADING (`shader_preload`, PERFORMANCE page, off by default): `native/vulkan.cpp` lists every shader (its key, vkey or pkey ^ kPixelKeySalt, to its HLSL's hash) and pipeline (its PsoKey, values only) the first time it is made, in `shadercache/preload.bin`, whether the option is on or not. On, a detached thread makes them all from the cached SPIR-V (`vkshader::Cached`) and `BuildPipeline`, the render passes made first on the render thread; `EnsurePipeline` and the shaders take them under `pre_lock_`, and a pipeline the render thread makes first is claimed so the thread skips it. A race and the menus are about 50 shaders and 50 pipelines; with the driver's pipeline cache they preload in well under a second.
- `native/vulkan.cpp` keeps a depth buffer larger than the target (the zeta has its own pitch); it used to drop it, and the scene drew with no depth test (the car's interior over its body).
- Pixel combiners are read from the combiner registers (`MakePixelKey`, `sdk/runtime/gpu/shaders.cpp`), which the render thread now copies (`src/d3d/render_thread.cpp`): Most Wanted sets them with pixel shader render states after `SetPixelShader`, over a definition that is all but empty.
- The scratch push buffer walker applies the inline `SetVertexShaderConstant` (NV097 0x1EA4/0x0B80) and raw program loads (0x1E9C/0x0B00), and every draw walks it first (`SyncDeferred`).
- Fog with table mode NONE is vertex fog: a program's `oFog` is the factor (`fogp.w == 4`); Most Wanted's final combiner blends by the fog alpha.
- `D3DDevice_IsBusy` reports idle (the title spins on it at 0x0BEB30).
- Kernel exports added to the SDK: 76 `IoQueryVolumeInformation` (fails; the disc position of a file becomes 0, 0x2BE8EE) and 8 `DbgPrint`.
- Settings in the game's menu (`src/game/options_menu.cpp`, host functions replacing recompiled ones with `X86_FUNC`, no `[[hook]]`): UIOptionsMain (0x104C70, the title's OPTIONS and the pause menu's) shows the sections when opened as ANDROID OPTIONS, an icon of the main menu beside its OPTIONS (the main menu's Setup calls 0x128AB0 back to 0x104C0F; OPTIONS is its last icon, vtable 0x3D534C). That icon's React sets the FEDatabase flag 0x10 (+0x12C) as OPTIONS' does (0x0E3F30), so the main menu's fade opens MainMenu_Sub.fng's UIOptionsMain (0x11697E), whose Setup (0x128AB0 called back to 0xED82C) then gets GRAPHICS, CONTROLS (touch, keyboard, controller) and GENERAL (general, credits), categories 0x20 to 0x22, in place of the game's icons: those are deleted as Setup adds them (0x12A120 from 0xED5FC to 0xED81E). Ours are told by their vtable, not their address: a game icon is often new where one of ours was freed, and taken for ours it stayed in the list. A section's options screen leaving for the options (SwitchPackage returning to 0x105479) comes back to the sections, on the one left (0x128AB0's answer, the package's last icon, is replaced). The pause menu gets ANDROID OPTIONS too, beside its OPTIONS (Setup 0x105A00, its 0x128AB0 back to 0x105A5B; OPTIONS vtable 0x3D537C, React 0x0EEC30, which opens Pause_Main.fng's UIOptionsMain on 0x33195CF0, 0x10F12A): ANDROID OPTIONS' React calls OPTIONS' own, and takes its byte +0x45, which the pause menu's icons set (0x0EEEC1) and without which the scroller calls no React on Accept (0x139884). The game's OPTIONS keeps its own icons only. The pause options screen's header title is a language string (type 5): it is set with 0xEAB30 to a hash of ours (0x52430100 + section) that SearchForString answers (`SetOwnString`, src/game/prompts.cpp). FEPrintf cuts a text to its string's room (0xE11B3, the header's 14 letters), so `Print` reserves it first (0x15D680). Its scroller has a slot object an icon (`option_1` on, ten in Options.fng, seven the game's), so the panel's six pages are three sections. Accept's fade opens Options.fng/Pause_Options.fng for them (0x104D40), and UIOptionsScreen::Setup's default case (0x153080 called back to 0x105758) gets toggle widgets (0x5C, ctor 0x13A800, added by 0x139D40) whose Act, Draw and Position are `dispatch::HostThunk`s writing with FEPrintf (0xE11F0, Latin-1 text). A string's place is justified through its font when set (0xEA970), so a row is placed again after its text changes, its title's middle half the font's measured width (0x138060) before the arrow; without the widescreen flag the letters are narrower than the stretched layout (x 640 / (480 x aspect)). The screen has row objects (`OPTION_NAME_n`) for nine rows: a longer section scrolls its rows through nine widgets on Up/Down (0x155D50). Y's defaults are 0xEE570. The icons are made by `tools/option_icons.py` (`src/game/option_icons.inc`, drawn as the game's: gears and a subject, white) and handed out by GetTextureInfo (0xC5900) as copies of OPTIONS_ICON_AUDIO's TextureInfo with an A8R8G8B8 swizzled D3D texture.
- The touch controls (`native/touch.cpp`) are a whole Xbox pad in one layout, a racing game's (gas and brake pedals, Black the camera, the right stick the gear lever), which the editor moves and resets. Its STEERING setting (`steering` in `layout.toml`) picks the steering: arrows, a wheel dragged round, or the phone tilted (`native/gyro.cpp`, the accelerometer's up in the screen's plane; `tilt_angle` in `android.toml` is the tilt for a full lock).
- Menus by touch (`src/game/fe_mouse.cpp`): FEng kept the PC's mouse. cFEng at [0x48E94C], its first field the FEngine: `bMouseActive` +1, first package +0xE0, interface +0x108 (vtable +0x44 `GetMouseInfo`, an empty `ret 4` shared at 0x19BC0, so the slot is pointed at a `dispatch::HostThunk`). FEPackage: next +4, control mask +0x20, input +0x28, current button +0x8C, mouse states +0xAC/count +0xB0 (0x10 each, bit 0 of +0xC over). The mouse is on only around a touch in a package with regions. FEng's screen is centred, 480 high and 480 x aspect wide: the layout is that wide with the widescreen flag, and without it (under 3:2) the 640 wide layout is stretched, but its hit tests still take 480 x aspect. The console's screens dropped the PC's mouse code: package scripts still answer clicks (MainMenu's arrows, a dialog's OK), a tap on the highlighted button presses A (hit test `FEngTestForIntersection` 0x10CF20, called with `CallGuest`), swipes step the dpad, and an A/B/X/Y diamond stays in menus for screens no tap reaches. Out of a race, a package that takes input with no regions but shows a pad prompt (a tutorial's "Press (A) To Continue") is a menu too, its mouse off, and a tap anywhere on one prompting A is its A. The prompts' textures are named for the PS2's buttons (A CROSS, B TRIANGLE, X SQUARE, Y CIRCLE, the triggers L1/R1, the right stick RIGHT_ANALOG): a menu prompting the triggers (Showcase.fng's zoom, the world map's) gets LT/RT pills above X and Y, labelled ZOOM OUT/ZOOM IN where the game's label is no action (the map's "ZOOM 1.5X"); one prompting RIGHT_ANALOG (the showcase turning the car, the map's cursor) takes a drag as the right stick, and gives FEng's pointer a touch only once it ends as a tap (pressed at once, the drag's release clicked the map's GPS). The game's keyboard (Keyboard.fng, a profile's name) is a 15 column grid of FEng buttons (flag bit 28; Space's, Lowercase's, Backspace's and Done's cells too) with no mouse regions: FEng's mouse is turned on for it, and a tap makes the key under it the package's current button (FEPackage::SetCurrentButton 0x15CB30, thiscall, the object and 1 to send the highlight messages) and presses A. FEngTestForIntersection tests an object's own place only, leaving its groups out, so a key is tested by its cached render object (+0x58: size +0x30/+0x44, middle +0x60/+0x64 in the front end's 640x480), which is drawn into the middle 576x450 of FEng's screen (0.9 across, 0.9375 down, measured off the frame). Its X, Y, L and R prompts' pills are not shown (their labels are not theirs).
- HUD layout (`src/game/hud_layout.cpp`, `src/common/hud_layout.h`): the layout editor moves the speedometer, the minimap, the race information (top right: RaceInformationGroup, LeaderBoardGroup, 0x9AFCE2B8, 0x2269D232) and EA_TRAX.fng's song banner (group 0xA1341735, in the front end too) (boxes under the controls, `[hud]` in `layout.toml`, FEng units). HUD_SingleRace.fng's groups are found by name hash (FEHashUpper 0x157E40; FEObject: hash +0x10, type +0x18, data +0x2C with x/y at +0x1C/+0x20; FEGroup children count +0x60, first +0x64; FEPackage name +0xC, objects +0x4C) and moved after FEngine::Update (0x165B20, wrapped): Hud_Minimap writes TRACK_MAP's place every frame, so moved at the present its roads stayed behind. Speedometer: GaugeCluster, SpeedometerGroup, TURBO_GROUP, the speedbreaker's and nitrous' gauges (in group 0x5D0101F1 with the race information). Minimap: TRACK_MAP, the icons' group 0x00A1A862, TRACKMAPTARGETRING, the roads 0xB0F63386 and the rim with the heat level 0xC46A80A9. Drag races' HUD_Drag.fng is not moved.
- Prompts for the touch screen (`src/game/prompts.cpp`): every string lookup goes through SearchForString (0x124B50, hash in edx, the table at [0x48EDC4], Latin-1 text); the "Press START" strings and the tutorials' "Press" are answered with "Tap anywhere" and the like, per language. The hashes are the same in every language's table (chunk 0x39000 in ZZDATA). Indonesian, which no disc has, answers the rest of the table too, from `src/game/strings_id.inc` (generated: the English table read off the disc, 4466 strings, translated; names, cars and places stay English).

## Conventions

- Native code is C++20 and is compiled with `-fsigned-char -fno-strict-aliasing`, matching x86 semantics.
- Only arm64-v8a is built, minSdk 29 (`native/compat/crt.h` supplies `memfd_create`, which bionic has from API 30). Libraries are linked with 16 KB page alignment.
- Comment style is terse, lowercase, and explains *why*, as in the existing files.

```

`CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
# Need for Speed: Most Wanted (original Xbox), statically recompiled, as an Android library: libmain.so, loaded by SDL's activity.
# The x86 code is recompiled on the PC first (build.bat): this build takes generated/game as it is, with the SDK's
# portable runtime, the game's sources in src and the Android host in native.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(mostwanted_android LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(REPO ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(NATIVE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/native)
set(GAME ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)  # the game's hooks, sound, Direct3D 8 and settings

# the SDK: sdk/ in the repo, a checkout beside it, else downloaded
include(FetchContent)
if(EXISTS ${REPO}/sdk/cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake)
    set(SDK ${REPO}/sdk)
elseif(EXISTS ${REPO}/../XboxXBE-Recomp/cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake)
    get_filename_component(SDK ${REPO}/../XboxXBE-Recomp ABSOLUTE)
else()
    FetchContent_Declare(xbe_sdk GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp.git GIT_TAG main)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(xbe_sdk)
    set(SDK ${xbe_sdk_SOURCE_DIR})
endif()

# the recompiled code and the xbe it came from
set(XBE_GENERATED ${REPO}/generated/game CACHE PATH "the recompiled code of default.xbe")
set(XBE_IMAGE ${REPO}/assets/default.xbe CACHE FILEPATH "the xbe it was recompiled from")
set(XBE_CONFIG ${REPO}/config/game.toml CACHE FILEPATH "the recompiler input used to make XBE_GENERATED")
set(XBE_CONFIG ${XBE_CONFIG} CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(GEN ${XBE_GENERATED})
set(XBE ${XBE_IMAGE})
if(NOT EXISTS ${GEN}/x86_func_mapping.cpp OR NOT EXISTS ${XBE})
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No recompiled code: put the game in assets/ or iso/ and run build.bat, it writes generated/game")
endif()
file(STRINGS ${XBE_CONFIG} GAME_PARTITIONS REGEX "^partitions *=")
string(REGEX MATCH "[0-9]+" GAME_PARTITIONS "${GAME_PARTITIONS}")
math(EXPR last "${GAME_PARTITIONS} - 1")
set(GEN_SOURCES ${GEN}/x86_func_mapping.cpp)
foreach(i RANGE ${last})
    list(APPEND GEN_SOURCES ${GEN}/x86_recomp.${i}.cpp)
endforeach()
file(SHA1 ${XBE} xbe_sha1)
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/image_sha1.cpp CONTENT "extern const char kImageSha1[] = \"${xbe_sha1}\";\n")
# the build's version for the log: the commit when the project is in git, else unknown
set(BUILD_COMMIT "unknown")
find_package(Git QUIET)
if(GIT_EXECUTABLE)
    execute_process(COMMAND ${GIT_EXECUTABLE} rev-parse --short HEAD WORKING_DIRECTORY ${REPO}
                    OUTPUT_VARIABLE head OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE ERROR_QUIET RESULT_VARIABLE failed)
    if(NOT failed AND head)
        set(BUILD_COMMIT ${head})
    endif()
endif()
file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/build_info.h CONTENT "#define BUILD_COMMIT \"${BUILD_COMMIT}\"\n")

# dependencies: SDL3 from the checkout Gradle makes (its Java side goes into the APK), the rest fetched
set(SDL_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/SDL)
if(NOT EXISTS ${SDL_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "SDL3 is missing from ${SDL_DIR}: the Gradle build clones it")
endif()
set(SDL_SHARED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_RENDER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_GPU OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_CAMERA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${SDL_DIR} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/SDL EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(ENABLE_OPT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_HLSL ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_GLSLANG_BINARIES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_SPVREMAPPER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLSLANG_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(GLSLANG_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_EXTERNAL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(glslang GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang.git GIT_TAG 16.0.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_Declare(tomlplusplus GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus.git GIT_TAG v3.4.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_Declare(imgui GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git GIT_TAG v1.91.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glslang tomlplusplus imgui)

# the SDK's runtime but its Windows parts, and those the game replaces (src/sound, src/d3d)
file(GLOB RUNTIME_SOURCES ${SDK}/runtime/*/*.cpp)
list(FILTER RUNTIME_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX
     "/runtime/app/|/core/input\\.cpp$|/gpu/(d3d12|render_thread)\\.cpp$|/audio/xaudio2\\.cpp$|/xdk/(dsound|d3d8)\\.cpp$")
# the game's sources: Direct3D 8, sound and settings, plus the per-game hooks in src/<XBE_GAME_DIR> (game: Most Wanted)
set(XBE_GAME_DIR game CACHE STRING "the per-game hook directory under src")
# and the HUD layout when the game folder has one (Most Wanted's stays its own, unbuilt: its FEng is not hooked)
file(GLOB GAME_HOST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${GAME}/d3d/*.cpp ${GAME}/sound/*.cpp ${GAME}/common/*.cpp ${GAME}/${XBE_GAME_DIR}/*.cpp)
if(EXISTS ${GAME}/${XBE_GAME_DIR}/dump.h)
    list(APPEND GAME_HOST_SOURCES ${GAME}/${XBE_GAME_DIR}/hud_layout.cpp)
endif()
file(GLOB ANDROID_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${NATIVE}/*.cpp)
set(IMGUI_SOURCES ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui.cpp ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_vulkan.cpp)

add_library(main SHARED ${RUNTIME_SOURCES} ${GAME_HOST_SOURCES} ${ANDROID_SOURCES} ${GEN_SOURCES} ${IMGUI_SOURCES}
            ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/image_sha1.cpp)
# compat/ for the SDK's x86 header, the SDK harness's for the Winsock and DXGI names its portable runtime uses
target_include_directories(main PRIVATE ${NATIVE}/compat ${SDK}/harness/compat ${NATIVE} ${GAME} ${SDK}/runtime ${GEN}
                           ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${glslang_SOURCE_DIR})
target_include_directories(main SYSTEM PRIVATE ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR})
# x86 chars are signed, as the game's code and the runtime were written for
target_compile_options(main PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing -fsigned-char)
set(HOST_SOURCES ${RUNTIME_SOURCES} ${GAME_HOST_SOURCES} ${ANDROID_SOURCES})
set_source_files_properties(${HOST_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-include;${NATIVE}/compat/crt.h")
set_source_files_properties(${GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-w;-fno-strict-aliasing;-fsigned-char")
set_source_files_properties(${NATIVE}/vk_shader.cpp PROPERTIES COMPILE_DEFINITIONS ENABLE_HLSL)
target_link_libraries(main PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3 tomlplusplus::tomlplusplus glslang glslang-default-resource-limits
                      vulkan android log)
# -PverboseLog: the info lines in the log of a release build too
option(XBE_VERBOSE_LOG "log info lines in a release build" OFF)
if(XBE_VERBOSE_LOG)
    target_compile_definitions(main PRIVATE XBE_VERBOSE_LOG)
endif()
# the game's folder, name, settings file and log prefix (app/build.gradle's -Pgame); without them Most Wanted's
if(XBE_SHARED_DIR)
    target_compile_definitions(main PRIVATE XBE_SHARED_DIR="${XBE_SHARED_DIR}" XBE_GAME_LABEL="${XBE_GAME_LABEL}"
                               XBE_SETTINGS="${XBE_SETTINGS}" XBE_LOG="${XBE_LOG}")
endif()
# 16 KB pages, as Android 15 devices may have
target_link_options(main PRIVATE -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384)
```

`README.md`:

```md
# Need for Speed: Carbon for Android
An unofficial native Android port of the original Xbox version of *Need for Speed: Carbon*, with touch controls, controller and keyboard support and extended graphics options.

The game's x86 code is statically recompiled ahead of time to C++ with [XboxXBE-Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp), then built for arm64. Drawing goes through Vulkan, and windowing, input and audio through SDL3. No emulator is involved.

Forked from [MostWanted-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/MostWanted-Android) by RanggaCasper. The Android host (Vulkan renderer, DirectSound, touch controls, settings panel) comes from [Black-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/Black-Android), as [ShaolinMonks-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/ShaolinMonks-Android) carries it.

> [!NOTE]
> This project does not include any game assets. You must provide the files from your own legally acquired copy of the game to install or build.

> [!WARNING]
> Work in progress. See [Status](#status).

## Installation
1. Install the APK.
2. Open **NFS Carbon** and allow **all files access** when it asks (on Android 10, the **storage** permission).
3. Copy the game into `/storage/emulated/0/Carbon`, or into a `Carbon` folder at the top of your SD card: either the disc image (`.iso`) or `default.xbe` with the disc's `NFS` folder beside it. The app creates the folder on the phone's storage once access is allowed, and starts the game as soon as it finds the files.

If you don't grant that access, `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files/assets` works too.

Settings (`carbon.toml`, `android.toml`, `layout.toml`), saves (`hdd`) and the shader cache are stored in `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files`. Logs go in `/storage/emulated/0/Carbon/logs` (in `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files/logs` without all files access).

The supported disc is the Xbox version of *Need for Speed: Carbon* (`default.xbe` SHA-1 `c9c6f930c33909217a56894e8a51664404fd85b6`).

## Features
The settings panel opens from the gear at the top left of the screen (or F10 on a keyboard). Android's back button is the controller's Start, which pauses the game.

### Graphics
- **Render Resolution**: 20% to 200% of the screen's height, instead of the original 640x480.
- **V-Sync**, **Max Frame Rate** (unlimited, the display's refresh rate or a custom cap) and an **FPS Counter**.
- **Anisotropic Filtering**, **Anti-Aliasing** (FXAA, SSAA 2x) and **Screen Filters**.
- **Performance presets**: LOW-END, MID and HIGH (DISPLAY > PERFORMANCE) set the render resolution, bloom, motion blur and car reflections in one tap.
- **Brightness**: 50% to 200%, applied to the 3D world while the HUD stays normal.
- **Light Flares**: the headlight glow pass, off by default.

### Touch Controls
A full Xbox controller on the screen:
- The left side of the screen is the **left stick**, wherever your thumb comes down. A drag on the right side of the screen is the **right stick**.
- **A**, **B**, **X**, **Y** in the controller's diamond and colours, **Black** and **White**, the **triggers** (RT gas, LT brake); the face buttons show the game's own controls (A E-brake, B nitrous, X speedbreaker, Y crew skill), **Start**, **Back** and a **D-pad**.
- **Controls Layout**: *Default* (triggers at the top corners) or *Low Triggers*, with the controls' opacity and overall size.
- **Edit Controls Position**: drag each control where you want it. To resize one, select it and tap **−** or **+**, or pinch it with a second finger.

### Other Input
- **Controller**: any controller SDL3 supports, with rumble. The touch controls hide while a controller is in use.
- **Keyboard**, with every controller button and both sticks rebindable.

### General
- **Language**: English, French, German, Italian or Spanish. The game takes it from the console's language setting, which this sets; it applies at the next start. Indonesian translates the settings panel and plays the game in English.
- **Audio Output**: automatic, mono, stereo or 5.1 surround.
- **Background Pause**: the game and its sound pause while the app is in the background.
- **Export Log** (GENERAL > EXPORT LOG): copies the current run's log to the phone's Download folder as `carbon-log-<date>-<time>.log`, ready to send when reporting a problem.
- **Join Discord** (GENERAL > JOIN DISCORD): opens the PotatoRecomp Discord server for bug reports: https://discord.gg/4DTA7nVfh7

## Status
Tested on phones: boot, the menus, the career intro and races play. Canyon and drift races are dark by design (night mountain roads with no street lights, only the car's headlights); use DISPLAY > BRIGHTNESS 130–150% if they are too dark.

Logs are in `/storage/emulated/0/Carbon/logs` (or `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files/logs` without all files access). Please include the log when reporting a problem — GENERAL > EXPORT LOG puts a copy in Download. Report bugs on the PotatoRecomp Discord: https://discord.gg/4DTA7nVfh7

## System Requirements
- **Android** 10 or newer, arm64.
- **GPU** with a Vulkan 1.1 driver, for example Adreno 6xx or newer, Mali-G7x or newer, or Xclipse.
- **Memory**: 4 GB.
- **Storage**: 4 GB for the game files and saves.

## Building
Building requires a Windows PC.

### 1. Clone this repository

### 2. Add the game files
Put `default.xbe` in `assets/`, or put the disc image (`.iso`) in `assets/` or `iso/`. The build extracts `default.xbe` from the image.

### 3. Install the dependencies
- [Visual Studio 2022](https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/) with *Desktop development with C++*. The recompiler runs on the PC.
- [Android Studio](https://developer.android.com/studio). In its SDK Manager, install Android SDK Platform 34, NDK `28.2.13676358` and CMake `3.31.6`. Gradle needs Java 17 to 21 (`JAVA_HOME`).
- [Python](https://www.python.org/), needed only to extract `default.xbe` from a disc image.

### 4. Build
Run `build_carbon.bat`. It builds the recompiler, recompiles the xbe into `generated/carbon`, then builds `app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk` with Gradle. The first build compiles the whole game for arm64 and takes 30 to 90 minutes.

Install the APK with:
```
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
```

The SDK is vendored in `sdk/`, at the upstream commit in `sdk/UPSTREAM_COMMIT`, with one change: the console's language comes from `app::ConsoleLanguage()` (`sdk/runtime/kernel/xboxkrnl.cpp`).

## Credits
- [XboxXBE-Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp) by TGP482: the static recompiler and the portable runtime (Xbox kernel, XDK libraries and Direct3D 8) this port is built on.
- [MostWanted-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/MostWanted-Android) by RanggaCasper: the base this Carbon port is forked from.
- [Black-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/Black-Android) and [ShaolinMonks-Android](https://github.com/RanggaCasper/ShaolinMonks-Android) by RanggaCasper: the Android host this port is built from.
- Chizui: the *Need for Speed: Carbon* port.
- Zukiru: the HDR screen filter.
- [bagasromadon](https://github.com/bagasromadon): Button Design.
- [SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL), [glslang](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glslang), [toml++](https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus) and [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui).
- [xemu](https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu) and [Cxbx-Reloaded](https://github.com/Cxbx-Reloaded/Cxbx-Reloaded), which XboxXBE-Recomp used as references for Xbox hardware and API behavior.

*Need for Speed* is a trademark of Electronic Arts Inc. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

```

`app/build.gradle`:

```gradle
plugins {
    id "com.android.application"
}

// SDL3 at the version the SDK's Windows build uses: its Java side goes into the APK, its C side into libSDL3.so
def sdlDir = file("../third_party/SDL")
def sdlTag = "release-3.4.16"
tasks.register("fetchSDL") {
    onlyIf { !new File(sdlDir, "CMakeLists.txt").exists() }
    doLast {
        exec {
            commandLine "git", "clone", "--depth", "1", "--branch", sdlTag, "https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git",
                        sdlDir.absolutePath
        }
    }
}
preBuild.dependsOn "fetchSDL"

// -Pgame=carbon: its own folder, name, settings and log beside Most Wanted's; the shared one is the default
def gameName = project.hasProperty("game") ? project.game : "mostwanted"
def games = [
    mostwanted: [dir: "MostWanted", label: "Most Wanted", settings: "mostwanted.toml", log: "mostwanted", repo: "RanggaCasper/MostWanted-Android"],
    carbon    : [dir: "Carbon",     label: "Carbon",      settings: "carbon.toml",     log: "carbon",     repo: "Chizuui/Carbon-Android"],
]
def game = games[gameName]

android {
    namespace "com.racas.mostwanted"
    compileSdk 34
    ndkVersion "28.2.13676358"

    buildFeatures {
        buildConfig true
    }

    defaultConfig {
        // -PappId=<id>: another game's build installs beside this one
        applicationId project.hasProperty("appId") ? project.appId : "com.racas.mostwanted"
        buildConfigField "String", "SHARED_DIR", "\"${game.dir}\""
        buildConfigField "String", "UPDATE_REPO", "\"${game.repo}\""
        resValue "string", "app_name", game.label
        minSdk 29
        targetSdk 34
        // -PversionCode=<n> -PversionName=<name>: the release workflow sets them from the tag
        versionCode project.hasProperty("versionCode") ? project.versionCode.toInteger() : 1
        versionName project.hasProperty("versionName") ? project.versionName : "1.0"
        ndk {
            abiFilters "arm64-v8a"
        }
        externalNativeBuild {
            cmake {
                arguments "-DANDROID_STL=c++_shared"
                // -PxbeGenerated=<dir> -PxbeImage=<file>: recompiled code from somewhere else than generated/game
                if (project.hasProperty("xbeGenerated")) arguments "-DXBE_GENERATED=${project.file("../" + project.xbeGenerated).absolutePath}"
                if (project.hasProperty("xbeImage")) arguments "-DXBE_IMAGE=${project.file("../" + project.xbeImage).absolutePath}"
                if (project.hasProperty("xbeConfig")) arguments "-DXBE_CONFIG=${project.file("../" + project.xbeConfig).absolutePath}"
                if (project.hasProperty("xbeGameDir")) arguments "-DXBE_GAME_DIR=${project.xbeGameDir}"
                arguments "-DXBE_SHARED_DIR=${game.dir}", "-DXBE_GAME_LABEL=${game.label}", "-DXBE_SETTINGS=${game.settings}", "-DXBE_LOG=${game.log}"
                if (project.hasProperty("verboseLog")) arguments "-DXBE_VERBOSE_LOG=ON"
            }
        }
    }

    // the release key from BLACK_KEYSTORE (a .jks path) and its passwords, as the release workflow sets them
    def keystore = System.getenv("BLACK_KEYSTORE")
    signingConfigs {
        if (keystore) {
            release {
                storeFile file(keystore)
                storePassword System.getenv("BLACK_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD")
                keyAlias System.getenv("BLACK_KEY_ALIAS")
                keyPassword System.getenv("BLACK_KEY_PASSWORD")
            }
        }
    }

    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
            // without the release key a debug signature, so the release APK installs as it is
            signingConfig keystore ? signingConfigs.release : signingConfigs.debug
            // -Pdebuggable: run-as and simpleperf on a device that is not rooted
            debuggable project.hasProperty("debuggable")
        }
        debug {
            // the recompiled code is far too slow unoptimized
            externalNativeBuild {
                cmake {
                    arguments "-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release"
                }
            }
        }
    }

    externalNativeBuild {
        cmake {
            path "../CMakeLists.txt"
            version "3.31.6"
        }
    }

    sourceSets {
        main {
            java.srcDirs += new File(sdlDir, "android-project/app/src/main/java")
        }
    }

    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
        targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_17
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/racas/mostwanted/GameImporter.java`:

```java
package com.racas.mostwanted;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.database.Cursor;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor;
import android.provider.OpenableColumns;
import android.util.Log;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import android.widget.LinearLayout;
import android.widget.ProgressBar;
import android.widget.TextView;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.channels.FileChannel;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

// Copies a disc image (.iso) the player picks with Android's file picker (Downloads, a cloud drive, a USB stick)
// into the folder the game is read from. The copy is written as .part and renamed at the end: the game looks for
// any .iso there every second and would open a half written one.
final class GameImporter {
    static final int REQUEST = 0x8A11;
    private static final String TAG = "MostWantedImport";
    private static final byte[] MAGIC = "MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA".getBytes();
    // where the volume descriptor sits: the game partition alone, redump, XGD3, XGD1 video offsets
    private static final long[] PARTITIONS = {0, 0x18300000L, 0xFD90000L, 0x2080000L};
    private static final int BUFFER = 4 << 20;

    private final Activity activity;
    private final Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
    private volatile boolean cancelled;

    GameImporter(Activity activity) {
        this.activity = activity;
    }

    // the picker; any file type, since phones rarely know a type for .iso
    boolean pick() {
        Intent i = new Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT);
        i.addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE);
        i.setType("*/*");
        try {
            activity.startActivityForResult(i, REQUEST);
            return true;
        } catch (ActivityNotFoundException e) {
            message(R.string.import_game, activity.getString(R.string.no_file_picker), null);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // the picked file into dir; done runs on the main thread with true once the image is in place
    void copy(Uri uri, File dir, Consumer<Boolean> done) {
        String name = displayName(uri);
        long size = size(uri);
        if (name == null || !name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".iso")) {
            message(R.string.import_game, activity.getString(R.string.choose_iso), () -> done.accept(false));
            return;
        }
        dir.mkdirs();
        if (size > 0 && dir.getUsableSpace() < size + (64L << 20)) {
            message(R.string.not_enough_space, activity.getString(R.string.space_needed, size / 1e9,
                    dir.getUsableSpace() / 1e9), () -> done.accept(false));
            return;
        }

        ProgressBar bar = new ProgressBar(activity, null, android.R.attr.progressBarStyleHorizontal);
        bar.setMax(1000);
        bar.setIndeterminate(size <= 0);
        TextView text = new TextView(activity);
        text.setText(R.string.import_starting);
        LinearLayout box = new LinearLayout(activity);
        box.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
        int pad = Math.round(20 * activity.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
        box.setPadding(pad, pad / 2, pad, 0);
        box.addView(bar);
        box.addView(text);
        cancelled = false;
        AlertDialog progress = new AlertDialog.Builder(activity)
                .setTitle(activity.getString(R.string.importing, name))
                .setView(box)
                .setCancelable(false)
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, (d, w) -> cancelled = true)
                .show();
        progress.getWindow().addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON);

        File part = new File(dir, name + ".part");
        File iso = new File(dir, name);
        new Thread(() -> {
            String error = null;
            try (ParcelFileDescriptor pfd = activity.getContentResolver().openFileDescriptor(uri, "r");
                 FileInputStream in = new FileInputStream(pfd.getFileDescriptor());
                 FileChannel src = in.getChannel()) {
                if (isXboxImage(src) == Boolean.FALSE) {
                    error = activity.getString(R.string.not_xbox_image, name);
                } else {
                    try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(part); FileChannel dst = out.getChannel()) {
                        ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.allocateDirect(BUFFER);
                        long copied = 0, shown = 0;
                        while (!cancelled && src.read(buf) > 0) {
                            buf.flip();
                            while (buf.hasRemaining()) copied += dst.write(buf);
                            buf.clear();
                            if (copied - shown >= (16L << 20)) {
                                shown = copied;
                                long c = copied;
                                main.post(() -> show(bar, text, c, size));
                            }
                        }
                        out.getFD().sync();
                        if (!cancelled && size > 0 && copied != size) error = activity.getString(R.string.copy_stopped);
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.w(TAG, "import failed", e);
                error = activity.getString(R.string.copy_failed, e.getMessage());
            }
            boolean ok = error == null && !cancelled && part.renameTo(iso);
            if (!ok) {
                part.delete();
                if (error == null && !cancelled) error = activity.getString(R.string.not_in_place);
            }
            String why = error;
            main.post(() -> {
                progress.dismiss();
                if (ok) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "imported " + iso);
                    message(R.string.game_imported, activity.getString(R.string.game_imported_text, name),
                            () -> done.accept(true));
                } else if (why != null) {
                    message(R.string.import_failed, why, () -> done.accept(false));
                } else {
                    done.accept(false);  // cancelled
                }
            });
        }, "GameImport").start();
    }

    private void show(ProgressBar bar, TextView text, long copied, long size) {
        if (size > 0) {
            bar.setProgress((int) (copied * 1000 / size));
            text.setText(activity.getString(R.string.import_progress, copied / 1e9, size / 1e9));
        } else {
            text.setText(String.format("%.2f GB", copied / 1e9));
        }
    }

    // null when the file cannot be read out of order (some cloud drives stream it): copied unchecked then, the game
    // tells of a wrong image itself. Positional reads leave the channel at the start for the copy.
    private static Boolean isXboxImage(FileChannel ch) {
        ByteBuffer b = ByteBuffer.allocate(MAGIC.length);
        try {
            for (long part : PARTITIONS) {
                b.clear();
                if (ch.read(b, part + 32 * 2048) == MAGIC.length && Arrays.equals(b.array(), MAGIC)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.i(TAG, "image not checked, no seeking: " + e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private String displayName(Uri uri) {
        try (Cursor c = activity.getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[] {OpenableColumns.DISPLAY_NAME}, null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst() && !c.isNull(0)) return new File(c.getString(0)).getName();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // fall back on the path
        }
        String last = uri.getLastPathSegment();
        return last == null ? null : new File(last).getName();
    }

    private long size(Uri uri) {
        try (Cursor c = activity.getContentResolver().query(uri, new String[] {OpenableColumns.SIZE}, null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst() && !c.isNull(0)) return c.getLong(0);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // unknown: the progress has no end then
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private void message(int title, String text, Runnable after) {
        new AlertDialog.Builder(activity)
                .setTitle(title)
                .setMessage(text)
                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                .setOnDismissListener(d -> {
                    if (after != null) after.run();
                })
                .show();
    }
}
```

```java
package com.racas.mostwanted;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.AlertDialog;
import android.content.ActivityNotFoundException;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.IntentFilter;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.net.Uri;

import android.os.Build;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.Environment;
import android.os.storage.StorageManager;
import android.os.storage.StorageVolume;
import android.provider.Settings;
import android.view.InputDevice;
import android.view.InputEvent;
import android.view.KeyEvent;
import android.view.MotionEvent;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.WindowInsets;
import android.view.WindowInsetsController;
import android.widget.Toast;

import java.io.File;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

import org.libsdl.app.SDLActivity;
import org.libsdl.app.SDLControllerManager;

// SDL's activity running libmain.so. The game goes in the MostWanted folder on the phone's storage
// (/storage/emulated/0/MostWanted) or at the top of an SD card. Reading it needs all files access, a special access Android grants on a settings page
// of its own, never among the app's ordinary permissions. This asks for it and says where the game goes, each time
// the app comes back without them; the game itself waits and starts as soon as it finds the files.
// At launch it also asks GitHub for a newer release (UpdateChecker) and tells of it once nothing else is asked.
public class MostWantedActivity extends SDLActivity {
    static final String SHARED = BuildConfig.SHARED_DIR;

    private AlertDialog dialog;  // the one up, at most one at a time
    private boolean notNow;      // the player turned the access down this run
    private boolean resumed;
    private UpdateChecker.Release update;  // a newer release not shown yet
    private final GameImporter importer = new GameImporter(this);
    private boolean importing;  // the file picker or the copy is up: nothing else is asked meanwhile
    private boolean checking;   // a check asked from the menu is under way

    @Override
    protected String[] getLibraries() {
        return new String[] {"SDL3", "main"};
    }

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        for (View v : new View[] {mSurface, mLayout})
            if (v != null) v.setOnCapturedPointerListener(MostWantedActivity::onCapturedPointer);
        File own = getExternalFilesDir(null);
        if (own != null) new File(own, "assets").mkdirs();
        // every launch: a newer release is shown once nothing else is asked
        UpdateChecker.check(this, false, (r, failed) -> {
            if (r == null) return;
            update = r;
            tellOfUpdate();
        });
    }

    // A controller some phones' game services pass on as a virtual device (MIUI's took a DualShock 4 on a Redmi Note
    // 8 Pro): SDL sees no controller in it and drops its input. Its buttons and sticks go to the game as port 0's
    // here (native/input.cpp); a controller SDL has goes its own way as before.
    private static native void nativeLooseKey(int keyCode, boolean down);
    private static native void nativeLooseAxes(float lx, float ly, float rx, float ry, float lt, float rt, float hx,
                                               float hy);
    private static native void nativeLooseRelease();

    private static boolean loose(InputEvent e, int sources) {
        return !mBrokenLibraries && (e.getSource() & sources) != 0
                && !SDLControllerManager.isDeviceSDLJoystick(e.getDeviceId());
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchKeyEvent(KeyEvent e) {
        boolean pad = KeyEvent.isGamepadButton(e.getKeyCode()) || (e.getKeyCode() >= KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_UP
                && e.getKeyCode() <= KeyEvent.KEYCODE_DPAD_RIGHT);
        if (pad && loose(e, InputDevice.SOURCE_GAMEPAD | InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK)) {
            if (e.getRepeatCount() == 0) nativeLooseKey(e.getKeyCode(), e.getAction() == KeyEvent.ACTION_DOWN);
            return true;
        }
        return super.dispatchKeyEvent(e);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean dispatchGenericMotionEvent(MotionEvent e) {
        if (loose(e, InputDevice.SOURCE_JOYSTICK) && e.getActionMasked() == MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE) {
            // the right stick on Z and RZ, the triggers on LTRIGGER and RTRIGGER or BRAKE and GAS, as Android has them
            nativeLooseAxes(e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_X), e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_Y),
                    e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_Z), e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_RZ),
                    Math.max(e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_LTRIGGER), e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_BRAKE)),
                    Math.max(e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_RTRIGGER), e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_GAS)),
                    e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_HAT_X), e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_HAT_Y));
            return true;
        }
        return super.dispatchGenericMotionEvent(e);
    }

    // The mouse while the game holds it (SDL's relative mode, Android's pointer capture). SDL's own handler passes on
    // only moves with no button held and the wheel: clicks and the moves while firing were lost. Each sample of a
    // batch is a move of its own, as SDL's C side takes them.
    private static boolean onCapturedPointer(View view, MotionEvent e) {
        switch (e.getActionMasked()) {
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE:
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_MOVE:
                for (int h = 0; h < e.getHistorySize(); h++)
                    onNativeMouse(0, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, e.getHistoricalX(h), e.getHistoricalY(h), true);
                onNativeMouse(0, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, e.getX(), e.getY(), true);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_BUTTON_PRESS:
                onNativeMouse(e.getButtonState(), MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, 0, 0, true);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_BUTTON_RELEASE:
                onNativeMouse(e.getButtonState(), MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, 0, 0, true);
                return true;
            case MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL:
                onNativeMouse(0, MotionEvent.ACTION_SCROLL, e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_HSCROLL),
                        e.getAxisValue(MotionEvent.AXIS_VSCROLL), false);
                return true;
            default:
                // the down and up a press brings with it: the button events above carry it
                return true;
        }
    }

    // CHECK FOR UPDATES in the options menu, from the game's thread: the answer always shows, up to date or offline
    public void checkForUpdates() {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (checking) return;
            checking = true;
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.checking_updates, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            UpdateChecker.check(this, true, (r, failed) -> {
                checking = false;
                if (r != null) {
                    update = r;
                    tellOfUpdate();
                    return;
                }
                if (isFinishing() || (dialog != null && dialog.isShowing())) return;
                String msg = failed ? getString(R.string.update_unreachable)
                                    : getString(R.string.latest_version, UpdateChecker.installedVersion(this));
                dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                        .setTitle(failed ? R.string.update_check_failed : R.string.no_update)
                        .setMessage(msg)
                        .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                        .show();
            });
        });
    }

    // SHOW CREDITS from the options menu, from the game's thread
    public void showCredits() {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (isFinishing() || (dialog != null && dialog.isShowing())) return;

            android.view.LayoutInflater inflater = android.view.LayoutInflater.from(this);
            android.view.View view = inflater.inflate(android.R.layout.list_content, null);

            android.widget.LinearLayout layout = new android.widget.LinearLayout(this);
            layout.setOrientation(android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
            layout.setPadding(16, 16, 16, 16);
```
