```java
    // OPEN DONATION LINK from the options menu, from the game's thread
    public void openDonation() {
        runOnUiThread(() -> {
            if (isFinishing()) return;
            open(getString(R.string.donate_url));
        });
    }

    // the performance overlay's fallback temperature, in tenths of a degree, -1 unknown: an app may not read the
    // thermal zones, the battery's sticky broadcast it always may
    public int batteryTemperature() {
        Intent i = registerReceiver(null, new IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED));
        return i != null ? i.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_TEMPERATURE, -1) : -1;
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        resumed = true;
        askForGame();
        tellOfUpdate();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onPause() {
        resumed = false;
        super.onPause();
    }

    // SDL's older immersive flags don't always come back after a dialog (MIUI on Android 11 kept the status bar):
    // the bars are hidden again each time the game has the focus, a swipe shows them for a moment
    @Override
    public void onWindowFocusChanged(boolean hasFocus) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus);
        if (hasFocus) hideSystemBars();
        else if (!mBrokenLibraries) nativeLooseRelease();  // its ups go elsewhere while the game is not in front
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private void hideSystemBars() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < 30) {
            // Android 10: the older immersive flags
            getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
                    | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                    | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION
                    | View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE);
            return;
        }
        WindowInsetsController c = getWindow().getInsetsController();
        if (c == null) return;
        c.hide(WindowInsets.Type.systemBars());
        c.setSystemBarsBehavior(WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE);
    }

    // Android 11 on has all files access, a page of its own in the settings; Android 10 the storage permission, with
    // the legacy storage the manifest asks for
    private static final boolean ALL_FILES_ACCESS = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 30;
    private static final int STORAGE_REQUEST = 0x426C;
    private boolean storageAsked;  // the permission was asked for this run

    private boolean hasStorageAccess() {
        if (ALL_FILES_ACCESS) return Environment.isExternalStorageManager();
        return checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
                && checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED;
    }

    private void askForGame() {
        if (importing || (dialog != null && dialog.isShowing())) return;
        File own = getExternalFilesDir(null);
        if (own != null && hasGame(new File(own, "assets"))) return;
        if (!hasStorageAccess()) {
            if (!notNow) askAllFilesAccess();
            return;
        }
        File shared = new File(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), SHARED);
        shared.mkdirs();
        if (hasGame(shared) || hasGame(new File(shared, "assets"))) return;
        for (File card : cardFolders())
            if (hasGame(card) || hasGame(new File(card, "assets"))) return;
        tellWhereTheGameGoes();
    }

    // the MostWanted folder on each SD card or USB stick mounted, as native/game_files.cpp looks in them
    private List<File> cardFolders() {
        List<File> out = new ArrayList<>();
        if (!ALL_FILES_ACCESS) {
            // Android 10: each card's root above the app's own folder on it, <root>/Android/data/<package>/files
            File[] own = getExternalFilesDirs(null);
            for (int i = 1; i < own.length; i++) {
                File root = own[i];
                for (int up = 0; root != null && up < 4; up++) root = root.getParentFile();
                if (root != null) out.add(new File(root, SHARED));
            }
            return out;
        }
        StorageManager sm = getSystemService(StorageManager.class);
        if (sm == null) return out;
        for (StorageVolume v : sm.getStorageVolumes()) {
            File root = v.getDirectory();
            if (v.isPrimary() || root == null || !Environment.MEDIA_MOUNTED.equals(v.getState())) continue;
            out.add(new File(root, SHARED));
        }
        return out;
    }

    // the same folders for native/game_files.cpp, from the game's thread: some phones (a Sony on Android 11) don't let
    // the app list /storage, though each card's folder opens
    public String[] cardFolderPaths() {
        List<File> cards = cardFolders();
        String[] out = new String[cards.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = cards.get(i).getPath();
        return out;
    }

    // the newer release, once the app is in front with no other dialog up; shown once a run
    private void tellOfUpdate() {
        if (update == null || importing || !resumed || isFinishing() || (dialog != null && dialog.isShowing())) return;
        UpdateChecker.Release r = update;
        update = null;
        String installed = "";
        try {
            installed = getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(getPackageName(), 0).versionName;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            // only for the message
        }
        StringBuilder msg = new StringBuilder(getString(R.string.update_is_available, r.name));
        if (!installed.isEmpty()) msg.append(' ').append(getString(R.string.update_installed, installed));
        msg.append('.');
        if (!r.changes.isEmpty()) msg.append("\n\n").append(getString(R.string.update_whats_new)).append('\n').append(r.changes);
        msg.append("\n\n").append(getString(R.string.update_install_over));
        dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.update_available)
                .setMessage(msg)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.download, (d, w) -> open(r.apk != null ? r.apk : r.page))
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.skip_version, (d, w) -> UpdateChecker.skip(this, r.tag))
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.later, null)
                .show();
    }

    private void open(String url) {
        try {
            startActivity(new Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(url)));
        } catch (ActivityNotFoundException e) {
            // no browser: nothing to open it with
        }
    }

    // default.xbe or a disc image in the folder
    private static boolean hasGame(File dir) {
        if (new File(dir, "default.xbe").exists()) return true;
        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
        if (files == null) return false;
        for (File f : files)
            if (f.getName().toLowerCase().endsWith(".iso")) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private void askAllFilesAccess() {
        dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.storage_access)
                .setMessage(getString(R.string.storage_text, "/storage/emulated/0/" + SHARED,
                        getString(ALL_FILES_ACCESS ? R.string.storage_all_files : R.string.storage_permission, getString(R.string.app_name)),
                        getString(R.string.app_name), SHARED))
                .setCancelable(false)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.allow_access, (d, w) -> openAccessSettings())
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.not_now, (d, w) -> notNow = true)
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.import_game, (d, w) -> startImport())
                .setOnDismissListener(d -> tellOfUpdate())
                .show();
    }

    private void tellWhereTheGameGoes() {
        dialog = new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.game_files)
                .setMessage(getString(R.string.game_files_text, "/storage/emulated/0/" + SHARED, SHARED))
                .setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null)
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.import_game, (d, w) -> startImport())
                .setOnDismissListener(d -> tellOfUpdate())
                .show();
    }

    // the disc image the player picks, copied where the game looks: the MostWanted folder with all files access, else the
    // app's own assets folder, which needs none
    private void startImport() {
        importing = importer.pick();
    }

    @Override
    protected void onActivityResult(int requestCode, int resultCode, Intent data) {
        if (requestCode != GameImporter.REQUEST) {
            super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data);
            return;
        }
        Uri uri = resultCode == RESULT_OK && data != null ? data.getData() : null;
        if (uri == null) {
            importing = false;  // the picker was closed: onResume asks again
            return;
        }
        File dir = hasStorageAccess()
                ? new File(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), SHARED)
                : new File(getExternalFilesDir(null), "assets");
        importer.copy(uri, dir, ok -> {
            importing = false;
            if (!ok) askForGame();
            tellOfUpdate();
        });
    }

    // the app's own page of the access, or the list of every app's where a phone has no such page. Android 10 asks
    // for the storage permission, or opens the app's details once the player has turned it down for good
    private void openAccessSettings() {
        if (!ALL_FILES_ACCESS) {
            boolean ask = !storageAsked || shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE);
            if (ask) {
                storageAsked = true;
                requestPermissions(new String[] {Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE,
                        Manifest.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE}, STORAGE_REQUEST);
            } else {
                startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS,
                        Uri.parse("package:" + getPackageName())));
            }
            return;
        }
        try {
            startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_APP_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION,
                    Uri.parse("package:" + getPackageName())));
        } catch (ActivityNotFoundException e) {
            try {
                startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_ALL_FILES_ACCESS_PERMISSION));
            } catch (ActivityNotFoundException e2) {
                startActivity(new Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS,
                        Uri.parse("package:" + getPackageName())));
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`app/src/main/java/com/racas/mostwanted/UpdateChecker.java`:

```java
package com.racas.mostwanted;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.SharedPreferences;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Handler;
import android.os.Looper;
import android.util.Log;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.HttpURLConnection;
import java.net.URL;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

// Asks GitHub for the newest release of this app, off the main thread: at each launch, handing it over when it is
// newer than the one installed and the player has not skipped it, and from the options menu, where the answer is
// given whatever it is.
final class UpdateChecker {
    // owner/name of the GitHub repository that publishes this port's releases; empty asks nothing
    static final String REPO = BuildConfig.UPDATE_REPO;
    private static final String LATEST = "https://api.github.com/repos/" + REPO + "/releases/latest";
    private static final String TAG = "MostWantedUpdate";
    private static final int TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

    private static final String PREFS = "updates";
    private static final String SKIPPED = "skipped_tag";

    static final class Release {
        String tag;      // v1.2.3
        String name;     // Most Wanted for Android v1.2.3
        String page;     // the release on GitHub
        String apk;      // the APK's download, or null
        String changes;  // the "What's Changed" list as plain text, or ""
    }

    interface Listener {
        // the newer release or null; failed when GitHub could not be asked
        void onResult(Release newer, boolean failed);
    }

    private UpdateChecker() {}

    // manual: asked from the menu, a skipped release counts too; the listener runs on the main thread
    static void check(Context context, boolean manual, Listener listener) {
        if (REPO.isEmpty()) return;
        Context app = context.getApplicationContext();
        SharedPreferences prefs = app.getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        String installed = installedVersion(app);
        Handler main = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
        new Thread(() -> {
            Release newer = null;
            boolean failed = false;
            try {
                Release r = fetch();
                boolean skipped = r != null && !manual && r.tag.equals(prefs.getString(SKIPPED, null));
                if (r != null && !skipped && compare(r.tag, installed) > 0) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "update " + r.tag + " over " + installed);
                    newer = r;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                Log.w(TAG, "no update check: " + e);  // offline, rate limited: try again next launch
                failed = true;
            }
            Release found = newer;
            boolean f = failed;
            main.post(() -> listener.onResult(found, f));
        }, "UpdateCheck").start();
    }

    static void skip(Context context, String tag) {
        context.getApplicationContext().getSharedPreferences(PREFS, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().putString(SKIPPED, tag).apply();
    }

    static String installedVersion(Context app) {
        try {
            return app.getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(app.getPackageName(), 0).versionName;
        } catch (PackageManager.NameNotFoundException e) {
            return "0";
        }
    }

    private static Release fetch() throws Exception {
        HttpURLConnection c = (HttpURLConnection) new URL(LATEST).openConnection();
        c.setConnectTimeout(TIMEOUT_MS);
        c.setReadTimeout(TIMEOUT_MS);
        c.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json");
        c.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "MostWanted-Android");
        try {
            if (c.getResponseCode() != 200) return null;  // 404 when there is no release yet
            JSONObject j = new JSONObject(read(c.getInputStream()));
            Release r = new Release();
            r.tag = j.getString("tag_name");
            r.name = j.optString("name", r.tag);
            if (r.name.isEmpty()) r.name = r.tag;
            r.page = j.optString("html_url", "https://github.com/" + REPO + "/releases/latest");
            JSONArray assets = j.optJSONArray("assets");
            for (int i = 0; assets != null && i < assets.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject a = assets.getJSONObject(i);
                if (a.optString("name").toLowerCase().endsWith(".apk")) {
                    r.apk = a.optString("browser_download_url", null);
                    break;
                }
            }
            r.changes = changes(j.optString("body", ""));
            return r;
        } finally {
            c.disconnect();
        }
    }

    private static String read(InputStream in) throws Exception {
        try (in) {
            ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
            for (int n; (n = in.read(buf)) > 0;) out.write(buf, 0, n);
            return out.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8.name());
        }
    }

    // GitHub's generated "What's Changed" list, without the authors' links: "* fix: x by @a in https://…" → "• fix: x"
    private static String changes(String body) {
        int at = body.indexOf("## What's Changed");
        if (at < 0) return "";
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        int lines = 0;
        for (String line : body.substring(at).split("\r?\n")) {
            line = line.trim();
            if (line.startsWith("**Full Changelog**") || (line.startsWith("## ") && sb.length() > 0)) break;
            if (!line.startsWith("* ") && !line.startsWith("- ")) continue;
            line = line.substring(2).replaceAll(" by @\\S+ in https://\\S+$", "").replaceAll(" in https://\\S+$", "");
            if (++lines > 10) {
                sb.append("• …\n");
                break;
            }
            sb.append("• ").append(line).append('\n');
        }
        return sb.toString().trim();
    }

    // dotted numbers, "v" and anything after "-" left out: v1.2.10 > 1.2.9, 1.0 == 1.0.0
    static int compare(String a, String b) {
        int[] x = parts(a), y = parts(b);
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(x.length, y.length); i++) {
            int p = i < x.length ? x[i] : 0, q = i < y.length ? y[i] : 0;
            if (p != q) return Integer.compare(p, q);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    private static int[] parts(String v) {
        if (v == null) return new int[0];
        v = v.trim();
        if (v.startsWith("v") || v.startsWith("V")) v = v.substring(1);
        int dash = v.indexOf('-');
        if (dash >= 0) v = v.substring(0, dash);
        String[] s = v.split("\\.");
        int[] n = new int[s.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            try {
                n[i] = Integer.parseInt(s[i].replaceAll("\\D.*", ""));
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                n[i] = 0;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }
}
```

`build.bat`:

```bat
@echo off
setlocal
set "GAME_TITLE=Need for Speed Most Wanted"
set "GAME_XBE=default.xbe"
title %GAME_TITLE% - Build
cd /d "%~dp0"
echo.
echo   %GAME_TITLE%
echo   ================================
echo.

set "PF86=%ProgramFiles(x86)%"
set "VSWHERE=%PF86%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
set "TOOLS=%CD%\out\build\android-tools"
if not defined ANDROID_HOME set "ANDROID_HOME=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Android\Sdk"
set "NDK=%ANDROID_HOME%\ndk\28.2.13676358"
set "SDKCMAKE=%ANDROID_HOME%\cmake\3.31.6\bin"

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools
echo [1/5] Tools
if not exist "%ANDROID_HOME%\platforms" goto :nosdk
if not exist "%NDK%\toolchains\llvm\prebuilt\windows-x86_64\bin\clang-cl.exe" goto :nosdk
if not exist "%SDKCMAKE%\cmake.exe" goto :nosdk
for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%i in (`"%VSWHERE%" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath`) do set "VSDIR=%%i"
if not defined VSDIR (
    echo       Visual Studio with "Desktop development with C++" was not found: the recompiler links with its tools.
    goto :fail
)
call "%VSDIR%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=amd64 -host_arch=amd64 >nul
set "PATH=%SDKCMAKE%;%PATH%"
rem Visual Studio's own Clang when it has it, else the NDK's: both build the recompiler for Windows
set "CLANGCL=%VSDIR%\VC\Tools\Llvm\x64\bin\clang-cl.exe"
if not exist "%CLANGCL%" set "CLANGCL=%NDK%\toolchains\llvm\prebuilt\windows-x86_64\bin\clang-cl.exe"
where git >nul 2>nul || (echo       git is missing: https://git-scm.com/download/win & goto :fail)
if not defined JAVA_HOME (
    for %%j in ("%ProgramFiles%\Android\Android Studio\jbr" "%ProgramFiles%\Android\Android Studio1\jbr") do (
        if exist "%%~j\lib\jvm.cfg" if not defined JAVA_HOME set "JAVA_HOME=%%~j"
    )
)
if not defined JAVA_HOME (
    echo       No Java 17 or newer: install Android Studio, or set JAVA_HOME.
    goto :fail
)

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- the xbe
echo [2/5] %GAME_XBE%
if exist assets\%GAME_XBE% goto :havexbe
set "ISO="
for %%f in (assets\*.iso iso\*.iso) do if not defined ISO set "ISO=%%f"
if not defined ISO goto :nogame
where python >nul 2>nul || (echo       %GAME_XBE% is not in assets and Python is missing to take it from %ISO%. & goto :nogame)
if not exist assets mkdir assets
echo       taking it from %ISO%
python -I tools\xdvdfs.py "%ISO%" %GAME_XBE% assets\%GAME_XBE% || goto :fail
:havexbe

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- recompiler
echo [3/5] Recompiler
cmake -S tools -B "%TOOLS%" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=%CLANGCL%" "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=%CLANGCL%" >nul || goto :fail
cmake --build "%TOOLS%" >nul || goto :fail
set /p SDK=<"%TOOLS%\sdk_dir.txt"
set "SDK=%SDK:/=\%"
findstr /b /l /c:"[symbols]" config\game.toml >nul 2>nul && goto :recompile
"%TOOLS%\xbe_symbols.exe" assets\%GAME_XBE% "%SDK%\xdk" --out config\game.toml || goto :fail

:recompile
echo [4/5] Recompiling %GAME_XBE% into generated\game
"%TOOLS%\xbe_recomp.exe" config\game.toml --xdk "%SDK%\xdk" >nul || goto :fail

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- Android
echo [5/5] APK: the game code for arm64, 30 to 90 minutes the first time
if not exist local.properties echo sdk.dir=%ANDROID_HOME:\=/%> local.properties
rem GRADLE_ARGS: more for Gradle, as the release workflow's -PversionCode and -PversionName
call gradlew.bat assembleRelease %GRADLE_ARGS% || goto :fail

echo.
echo   %GAME_TITLE% for Android built.
echo   app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk
echo.
echo   Install it with: adb install -r app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk
echo   Then copy the game files to the phone, see README.md.
echo.
if not defined CI pause
exit /b 0

:nosdk
echo       The Android SDK was not found complete. Install Android Studio, then in its SDK Manager:
echo       Android SDK Platform 34, NDK 28.2.13676358 and CMake 3.31.6.
goto :fail

:nogame
echo   Put the game in the assets folder first: %GAME_XBE% from the USA release, or its disc image (.iso)
echo     %CD%\assets
goto :fail

:fail
echo.
echo   BUILD FAILED. Read the last message above.
echo.
if not defined CI pause
exit /b 1
```

`build_carbon.bat`:

```bat
@echo off
setlocal
set "GAME_TITLE=Need for Speed Carbon"
set "GAME_XBE=default.xbe"
set "GAME_TOML=config/carbon.toml"
set "GEN_DIR=generated/carbon"
title %GAME_TITLE% - Build
cd /d "%~dp0"
echo.
echo   %GAME_TITLE%
echo   ================================
echo.

set "PF86=%ProgramFiles(x86)%"
set "VSWHERE=%PF86%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
set "TOOLS=%CD%\out\build\android-tools-carbon"
if not defined ANDROID_HOME set "ANDROID_HOME=D:\DevTools\Android_Studio_Sdk"
set "NDK=%ANDROID_HOME%\ndk\28.2.13676358"
rem CMake 3.31.6 is what the release workflow installs; 3.22.1 stays as a fallback for a PC that only has that
set "SDKCMAKE=%ANDROID_HOME%\cmake\3.31.6\bin"
if not exist "%SDKCMAKE%\cmake.exe" set "SDKCMAKE=%ANDROID_HOME%\cmake\3.22.1\bin"

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- tools
echo [1/5] Tools
if not exist "%ANDROID_HOME%\platforms" goto :nosdk
if not exist "%NDK%\toolchains\llvm\prebuilt\windows-x86_64\bin\clang-cl.exe" goto :nosdk
if not exist "%SDKCMAKE%\cmake.exe" goto :nosdk
for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%i in (`"%VSWHERE%" -latest -products * -requires Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Tools.x86.x64 -property installationPath`) do set "VSDIR=%%i"
if not defined VSDIR set "VSDIR=D:\VisualStudioAPP\VisualStudio"
if not exist "%VSDIR%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" (
    echo       Visual Studio with "Desktop development with C++" was not found: the recompiler links with its tools.
    goto :fail
)
rem -vcvars_ver is this PC's toolset; the release workflow's Visual Studio takes the default one
if defined CI ( call "%VSDIR%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=amd64 -host_arch=amd64 >nul ) else ( call "%VSDIR%\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=amd64 -host_arch=amd64 -vcvars_ver=14.44 >nul )
set "PATH=%SDKCMAKE%;%PATH%"
rem Visual Studio's own Clang when it has it, else the NDK's: both build the recompiler for Windows
set "CLANGCL=%VSDIR%/VC/Tools/Llvm/x64/bin/clang-cl.exe"
if not exist "%CLANGCL%" set "CLANGCL=%NDK%/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/windows-x86_64/bin/clang-cl.exe"
where git >nul 2>nul || (echo       git is missing: https://git-scm.com/download/win & goto :fail)
rem the release workflow's setup-java provides JAVA_HOME already; only fall back to the local JDK otherwise
if not defined JAVA_HOME set "JAVA_HOME=C:\Program Files\Eclipse Adoptium\jdk-21.0.11.10-hotspot"

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- the xbe
echo [2/5] %GAME_XBE%
if exist assets\%GAME_XBE% goto :havexbe
set "ISO="
for %%f in (assets\*.iso iso\*.iso) do if not defined ISO set "ISO=%%f"
if not defined ISO goto :nogame
where python >nul 2>nul || (echo       %GAME_XBE% is not in assets and Python is missing to take it from %ISO%. & goto :nogame)
if not exist assets mkdir assets
echo       taking it from %ISO%
python -I tools\xdvdfs.py "%ISO%" %GAME_XBE% assets\%GAME_XBE% || goto :fail
:havexbe

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- recompiler
echo [3/5] Recompiler
set "CLANGCL_CMAKE=%CLANGCL:\=/%"
set "MSVC_LINK=%VCToolsInstallDir%bin\Hostx64\x64\link.exe"
set "MSVC_LINK=%MSVC_LINK:\=/%"
cmake -S tools -B "%TOOLS%" -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release "-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=%CLANGCL_CMAKE%" "-DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=%CLANGCL_CMAKE%" "-DCMAKE_LINKER=%MSVC_LINK%" >nul || goto :fail
cmake --build "%TOOLS%" >nul || goto :fail
set /p SDK=<"%TOOLS%\sdk_dir.txt"
set "SDK=%SDK:/=\%"
findstr /b /l /c:"[symbols]" config\carbon.toml >nul 2>nul && goto :recompile
"%TOOLS%\xbe_symbols.exe" assets\%GAME_XBE% "%SDK%\xdk" --out %GAME_TOML% || goto :fail
echo       run build_carbon.bat again to recompile with the new symbols

:recompile
echo [4/5] Recompiling %GAME_XBE% into %GEN_DIR%
"%TOOLS%\xbe_recomp.exe" %GAME_TOML% --xdk "%SDK%\xdk" >nul || goto :fail

rem ---------------------------------------------------------------- Android
echo [5/5] APK: the game code for arm64, 30 to 90 minutes the first time
if not exist local.properties echo sdk.dir=%ANDROID_HOME:\=/%> local.properties
rem version: UTC date-hour, the same scheme the release workflow and the server build script use, so
rem GoFile, PC and CI builds share one version space; the workflow passes its own through GRADLE_ARGS
echo %GRADLE_ARGS% | findstr /C:"-PversionCode" >nul
if %ERRORLEVEL%==0 goto :haveversion
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Date -AsUTC -Format yyyyMMddHH"') do set "VCODE=%%i"
for /f %%i in ('powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-Date -AsUTC -Format yyyy.MM.dd.HH"') do set "VNAME=%%i"
set "GRADLE_ARGS=%GRADLE_ARGS% -PversionCode=%VCODE% -PversionName=%VNAME%"
:haveversion
call gradlew.bat assembleRelease -Pgame=carbon -PxbeGenerated="%GEN_DIR%" -PxbeImage=assets/%GAME_XBE% -PxbeConfig=%GAME_TOML% -PxbeGameDir=carbon -PappId=com.racas.carbon %GRADLE_ARGS% || goto :fail

echo.
echo   %GAME_TITLE% for Android built.
echo   app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk
echo.
echo   Install it with: adb install -r app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk
echo   Then copy the game files to the phone, see README.md.
echo.
if not defined CI pause
exit /b 0

:nosdk
echo       The Android SDK was not found complete. Install Android Studio, then in its SDK Manager:
echo       Android SDK Platform 34, NDK 28.2.13676358 and CMake 3.31.6.
goto :fail

:nogame
echo   Put the game in the assets folder first: %GAME_XBE% from the USA release, or its disc image (.iso)
echo     %CD%\assets
goto :fail

:fail
echo.
echo   BUILD FAILED. Read the last message above.
echo.
if not defined CI pause
exit /b 1
```

```md
<h1 align="center">NFS Carbon for Android {{VERSION}}</h1>

<p align="center">
  An unofficial native Android port of the original Xbox version of <b>Need for Speed: Carbon</b>,<br>
  statically recompiled with <a href="https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp">XboxXBE-Recomp</a> and drawn with Vulkan.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release contains **no game assets**. You need the files from your own legally acquired copy of *Need for Speed: Carbon* (Xbox, USA release).

## 📦 Download

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`{{APK}}`](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/releases/download/{{TAG}}/{{APK}}) | {{SIZE}} | `{{SHA256}}` |

## 🚀 Installation

1. Install **`{{APK}}`** on your phone.
2. Open **NFS Carbon** and allow **all files access** when it asks.
3. Copy the game into **`/storage/emulated/0/Carbon`**, or into a `Carbon` folder on your SD card: the disc image (`.iso`), or `default.xbe` with the disc's `NFS` folder beside it.
4. The game starts as soon as it finds the files.

> [!TIP]
> If you don't grant all files access, put the game in `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files/assets` instead. Settings and saves are stored in `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files`; logs go in `Carbon/logs` (in `Android/data/com.racas.carbon/files/logs` without all files access).

> [!TIP]
> Updating from an older build installs right over it — your saves and settings are kept. The app also checks for new releases itself: open the settings panel and tap **CHECK FOR UPDATES**.

## ✨ Features

| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🖥️ **Graphics** | Render resolution 20–200%, LOW / MID / HIGH presets, brightness 50–200%, bloom, motion blur, light flares, road reflections, shadows, FXAA / SSAA 2x, sharpen, vivid, scanline and CRT filters, unlocked frame rate, V-Sync, FPS counter with latency (GOverlay style, vertical or horizontal), anisotropic filtering |
| 👆 **Touch Controls** | A full Xbox pad on screen, a layout editor to move and resize each control, stick mode and tilt steering |
| 🎮 **Other Input** | SDL3 controllers with rumble and rebindable controls (with a live input test), stick deadzone, keyboard with rebindable controls |
| ⚙️ **General** | Language (with Indonesian), audio output, update check, export log, pause while in the background |

The settings panel opens from the gear at the top of the screen. Android's back button is the controller's Start.

## 📱 Requirements

- **Android** 10 or newer, arm64
- **GPU** with a Vulkan 1.1 driver (Adreno 6xx+, Mali-G7x+, Xclipse)
- **4 GB** RAM, **4 GB** free storage
```

`config/game.toml`:

```toml
# Recompiler input for default.xbe (Need for Speed: Most Wanted Black Edition, original Xbox, title 4541007B),
# written by xbe_symbols, the names it missed resolved by hand at the top of [symbols]

[xbe]
path = "assets/default.xbe"
title = 0x4541007B
entry = 0x2B3916
xdk = 5849
out = "generated/game"
partitions = 128
code_sections = [".text", "D3D", "XGRPH", "XNET", "XONLINE", "DSOUND", "XPP"]

# extra entry points
[functions]

# functions the host replaces or calls by name, 0 where the image has none
[symbols]
# not in the SDK's signatures: waits for idle, frees the frame buffers (0x378750) and makes them again (0x378880)
D3DDevice_Reset                                      = 0x374890
# stores [stage] at CDevice + 0xF98 (CDevice_Palettes) with the references the library keeps
D3DDevice_SetPalette                                 = 0x375340
# the title's raw pushes (0x0D1392, 0x0D6615): BeginPush flushes the lazy state (0x37B430) and makes room for
# count + 1 dwords, EndPush stores the end at CDevice + 0
D3DDevice_BeginPush                                  = 0x373E10
D3DDevice_EndPush                                    = 0x373E30
# copies a program (word count at +2) to the device's mirror at +0x10A8 + address * 16 and pushes NV097 0x1E9C/0x0B00
D3DDevice_LoadVertexShaderProgram                    = 0x373560
# the FIFO's get and put of the miniport (CDevice + 0x934) differ: the GPU is busy
D3DDevice_IsBusy                                     = 0x375460
# the sun's visibility test (0x0D5AB0): begin pushes NV097 0x17C8, end makes the report slot (0x3754C0) at
# CDevice + 0x7D4 and pushes 0x17D0, the result reads the slot the GPU would have written
D3DDevice_BeginVisibilityTest                        = 0x375490
D3DDevice_EndVisibilityTest                          = 0x375530
D3DDevice_GetVisibilityTestResult                    = 0x374620
# DirectSound exports the signatures lack, named by their .XTLID ids in the library's alphabetical export order
IDirectSoundBuffer_Pause                             = 0x3B7961
IDirectSoundBuffer_SetEG                             = 0x3B78AD
_CIacos                                              = 0x316DBC
_CIasin                                              = 0x316E88
accept                                               = 0x384B67
bind                                                 = 0x384B46
BinkDoFrame                                          = 0
BinkGetSummary                                       = 0
BinkNextFrame                                        = 0
BinkWait                                             = 0
CDevice_KickOff                                      = 0x373E40
CDirectSoundStream_AddRef                            = 0x3B70BC
CDirectSoundStream_Discontinuity                     = 0x3B71B8
CDirectSoundStream_Flush                             = 0x3B7205
```

```
#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/subprojects/plugins/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && pwd -P ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

```

```bat
@rem
@rem Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.

@rem Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
@rem you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
@rem You may obtain a copy of the License at

@rem      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

@rem Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
@rem distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
@rem WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
@rem See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
@rem limitations under the License.
@rem

@if "%DEBUG%"=="" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%"=="" set DIRNAME=.
@rem This is normally unused
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH. 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo. 1>&2
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME% 1>&2
echo. 1>&2
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the 1>&2
echo location of your Java installation. 1>&2

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
set EXIT_CODE=%ERRORLEVEL%
if %EXIT_CODE% equ 0 set EXIT_CODE=1
if not ""=="%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit %EXIT_CODE%
exit /b %EXIT_CODE%

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega
```

`native/audio.cpp`:

```cpp
// mixer output through an SDL audio stream (AAudio underneath): the 5.1 mix folded to the stereo pair Android plays
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

#include "audio/output.h"
#include "core/log.h"

namespace audio {

namespace {

constexpr float kCentreFold = 0.707f;
constexpr uint32_t kBlock = kRate / 100;  // frames the mixer renders a call: 10 ms

std::atomic<uint32_t> g_mode{kOutputAuto};
std::atomic<bool> g_paused{false};
SDL_AudioStream* g_stream = nullptr;

struct Pump {
    std::function<void(float*, uint32_t)> render;
    std::vector<float> mix = std::vector<float>(kBlock * kChannels);
    std::vector<float> out;  // stereo frames rendered, not yet handed to SDL
};

// L = FL + kCentreFold C + BL and R = FR + kCentreFold C + BR without the sub; mono hears the average of the two
void Fold(const float* in, uint32_t frames, bool mono, std::vector<float>& out) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
        const float* f = in + size_t(i) * kChannels;
        float c = f[Centre] * kCentreFold;
        float l = f[FrontLeft] + c + f[BackLeft];
        float r = f[FrontRight] + c + f[BackRight];
        if (mono) l = r = (l + r) * 0.5f;
        out.push_back(l);
        out.push_back(r);
    }
}

void SDLCALL Feed(void* user, SDL_AudioStream* stream, int additional, int) {
    auto& p = *static_cast<Pump*>(user);
    constexpr int kFrameBytes = 2 * sizeof(float);
    size_t want = size_t(std::max(additional, 0) / kFrameBytes) * 2;
    while (p.out.size() < want) {
        p.render(p.mix.data(), kBlock);
        Fold(p.mix.data(), kBlock, g_mode == kOutputMono, p.out);
    }
    if (!want) return;
    SDL_PutAudioStreamData(stream, p.out.data(), int(want * sizeof(float)));
    p.out.erase(p.out.begin(), p.out.begin() + std::ptrdiff_t(want));
}

}  // namespace

// a 5.1 mix only when the player asks for it: phones and tablets play stereo
bool IsSurround() { return g_mode == kOutputSurround; }

bool IsMono() { return g_mode == kOutputMono; }

void SetOutputMode(uint32_t mode) {
    if (g_mode.exchange(mode) != mode) LOGI("audio: output %u", mode);
}

void SetPaused(bool paused) {
    if (g_paused.exchange(paused) == paused || !g_stream) return;
    if (paused) SDL_PauseAudioStreamDevice(g_stream);
    else SDL_ResumeAudioStreamDevice(g_stream);
}

void StartOutput(std::function<void(float*, uint32_t)> render) {
    if (!SDL_WasInit(SDL_INIT_AUDIO) && !SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_AUDIO)) {
        LOGE("audio: SDL audio unavailable, no sound: %s", SDL_GetError());
        return;
    }
    SDL_AudioSpec spec{SDL_AUDIO_F32, 2, int(kRate)};
    auto* pump = new Pump{std::move(render)};
    g_stream = SDL_OpenAudioDeviceStream(SDL_AUDIO_DEVICE_DEFAULT_PLAYBACK, &spec, Feed, pump);
    if (!g_stream) {
        LOGE("audio: no output device, no sound: %s", SDL_GetError());
        delete pump;
        return;
    }
    LOGI("audio: %s output through %s", IsSurround() ? "5.1 folded to stereo" : "stereo", SDL_GetCurrentAudioDriver());
    if (!g_paused) SDL_ResumeAudioStreamDevice(g_stream);
}

}  // namespace audio
```

`native/game_files.cpp`:

```cpp
// The game on Android: its files or a disc image (.iso) in the MostWanted folder on the phone's storage or on an SD
// card (all files access granted) or in the app's own assets folder. The xbe must be the one this build was recompiled
// from: the disc's USA and Europe releases share it.
#include <jni.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_system.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <fstream>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "common/translations.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "host.h"
#include "image_symbols.h"
#include "kernel/crypto.h"
#include "kernel/disc.h"

extern const char kImageSha1[];  // the xbe recompiled into this library, written by CMake

namespace app {

namespace {

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

// host::kShared: the files or the image in it, or in its assets folder
using host::kShared;
constexpr const char* kVolumes = "/storage";

// the MostWanted folders MostWantedActivity has from Android's storage volumes, which some phones don't show in
// /storage
std::vector<fs::path> ActivityCardFolders() {
    std::vector<fs::path> out;
    auto* env = static_cast<JNIEnv*>(SDL_GetAndroidJNIEnv());
    auto activity = static_cast<jobject>(SDL_GetAndroidActivity());
    if (!env || !activity) return out;
    jclass cls = env->GetObjectClass(activity);
    jmethodID m = env->GetMethodID(cls, "cardFolderPaths", "()[Ljava/lang/String;");
    auto paths = m ? static_cast<jobjectArray>(env->CallObjectMethod(activity, m)) : nullptr;
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        paths = nullptr;
    }
    for (jsize i = 0, n = paths ? env->GetArrayLength(paths) : 0; i < n; i++) {
        auto s = static_cast<jstring>(env->GetObjectArrayElement(paths, i));
        if (!s) continue;
        const char* c = env->GetStringUTFChars(s, nullptr);
        if (c) {
            out.emplace_back(c);
            env->ReleaseStringUTFChars(s, c);
        }
        env->DeleteLocalRef(s);
    }
    if (paths) env->DeleteLocalRef(paths);
    env->DeleteLocalRef(cls);
    env->DeleteLocalRef(activity);
    return out;
}

// the MostWanted folder on each SD card or USB stick Android has mounted, /storage/<volume id>/MostWanted; all
// files access reads them as it does the phone's own storage
std::vector<fs::path> RemovableFolders() {
    std::vector<fs::path> out = ActivityCardFolders();
    // an entry's own error apart from the listing's: one that is no folder must not end the walk
    std::error_code ec, dir_ec;
    for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(kVolumes, ec)) {
        std::string name = e.path().filename().string();
        if (name == "emulated" || name == "self" || !e.is_directory(dir_ec)) continue;
        out.push_back(e.path() / XBE_SHARED_DIR);
    }
    static bool logged = false;
    if (ec && !logged) {
        LOGW("game: %s cannot be listed: %s", kVolumes, ec.message().c_str());
        logged = true;
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    out.erase(std::unique(out.begin(), out.end()), out.end());
    return out;
}

std::vector<fs::path> AssetFolders() {
    std::vector<fs::path> out = {fs::path(kShared), fs::path(kShared) / "assets"};
    for (const fs::path& card : RemovableFolders()) {
        out.push_back(card);
        out.push_back(card / "assets");
    }
    out.push_back(ExeDir() / "assets");
    return out;
}

std::string Sha1(const std::vector<uint8_t>& data) {
    alignas(8) uint8_t ctx[128];
    uint8_t digest[20];
    crypto::ShaInit(ctx);
    crypto::ShaUpdate(ctx, data.data(), data.size());
    crypto::ShaFinal(ctx, digest);
    std::string hex;
    for (uint8_t b : digest) {
        hex += "0123456789abcdef"[b >> 4];
        hex += "0123456789abcdef"[b & 15];
    }
    return hex;
}

bool ReadHostFile(const fs::path& path, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    out.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
    return true;
}

std::string Utf8(const wchar_t* w) {
    std::string s;
    for (; w && *w; w++) s += *w < 0x80 ? char(*w) : '?';
    return s;
}

// an image cut short (a copy that stopped, a bad download) still opens, its folders being near the start; the game
// then fails a read later and shows its dirty disc screen. Its files are checked against its size, for the log
void CheckImage(const kernel::Disc& disc, const fs::path& iso) {
    std::error_code ec;
    uint64_t size = fs::file_size(iso, ec);
    if (ec) {
        LOGE("game: %s: its size cannot be read: %s", iso.string().c_str(), ec.message().c_str());
        return;
    }
    uint64_t end = 0;
    size_t files = 0, past = 0;
    std::string first;
    std::vector<std::pair<const kernel::Disc::Entry*, std::string>> todo{{disc.Find(std::string_view()), ""}};
    while (!todo.empty()) {
        auto [dir, path] = todo.back();
        todo.pop_back();
        if (!dir) continue;
        for (const kernel::Disc::Entry& e : dir->children) {
            std::string name = path.empty() ? e.name : path + "\\" + e.name;
            if (e.dir) {
                todo.push_back({&e, name});
                continue;
            }
            files++;
            uint64_t file_end = e.offset + e.size;
            end = std::max(end, file_end);
            if (file_end > size && past++ == 0) first = name;
        }
    }
    LOGR("Game: image %llu bytes, %zu files up to byte %llu", (unsigned long long)size, files, (unsigned long long)end);
    if (past)
        LOGE("game: %s is cut short: %zu of its files end past its %llu bytes, %s the first; copy the image again",
             iso.string().c_str(), past, (unsigned long long)size, first.c_str());
}

// no game yet: the activity's dialog tells the player where it goes and asks for the access; this waits a moment
// before looking again, keeping SDL's events moving
void WaitForGame() {
    static bool logged = false;
    if (!logged) {
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::is_directory(kShared, ec);
        std::string cards;
        for (const fs::path& card : RemovableFolders()) cards += ", " + card.string();
        LOGE("game: no game files in %s%s or %s%s, waiting for them", kShared, cards.c_str(),
             (ExeDir() / "assets").c_str(), ec == std::errc::permission_denied ? ", no access to the first" : "");
        logged = true;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
        SDL_Event e;
        while (SDL_PollEvent(&e))
            if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_QUIT || e.type == SDL_EVENT_TERMINATING) {
                logx::Flush();
                std::_Exit(0);
            }
        SDL_Delay(100);
    }
}

bool AskOtherRelease(const fs::path& name) {
    std::string text = name.filename().string() + " " +
                       app::Ui("is a different release of the game than this build was made from, and will most "
                               "likely crash.\n\nStart it anyway?",
                               false);
    std::string no = app::Ui("No", false), yes = app::Ui("Yes", false);
    const SDL_MessageBoxButtonData buttons[] = {
        {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT | SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, 0, no.c_str()},
        {0, 1, yes.c_str()},
    };
    std::string title = Utf8(kGame.short_title);
    SDL_MessageBoxData box{SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING, nullptr, title.c_str(), text.c_str(), 2, buttons, nullptr};
    int answer = 0;
    return SDL_ShowMessageBox(&box, &answer) && answer == 1;
}

// 1 found, 0 none there, -1 the player turned down another release
int Search(GameFiles& game) {
    // the first copy with this xbe wins, the extracted files before any image; another release is kept to offer
    GameFiles other;
    std::unique_ptr<kernel::Disc> other_disc;
    fs::path other_name;
    auto consider = [&](const fs::path& assets, const fs::path& name, std::vector<uint8_t> xbe,
                        std::unique_ptr<kernel::Disc> disc) {
        std::string sha = Sha1(xbe);
        bool match = sha == kImageSha1;
        LOGR("Game: %s in %s, sha1 %s%s", IMAGE_XBE, name.string().c_str(), sha.c_str(),
             match ? "" : ", another release");
        if (match) {
            game = {assets, std::move(xbe)};
            kernel::MountDisc(std::move(disc));
            return true;
        }
        if (other_name.empty()) {
            other = {assets, std::move(xbe)};
            other_disc = std::move(disc);
            other_name = name;
        }
        return false;
    };

    std::error_code ec;
    for (const fs::path& assets : AssetFolders()) {
        if (!fs::is_directory(assets, ec)) continue;
        std::vector<uint8_t> xbe;
        if (ReadHostFile(assets / IMAGE_XBE, xbe) && consider(assets, assets, std::move(xbe), nullptr)) return 1;
        std::vector<fs::path> isos;
        for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(assets, ec)) {
            std::string ext = e.path().extension().string();
            std::transform(ext.begin(), ext.end(), ext.begin(), [](unsigned char c) { return char(std::tolower(c)); });
            if (ext == ".iso" && e.is_regular_file(ec)) isos.push_back(e.path());
        }
        std::sort(isos.begin(), isos.end());
        for (const fs::path& iso : isos) {
            auto disc = std::make_unique<kernel::Disc>();
            std::string error;
            if (!disc->Open(iso, error)) {
                LOGW("game: %s: %s", iso.string().c_str(), error.c_str());
                continue;
            }
            if (!disc->Load(IMAGE_XBE, xbe)) {
                LOGW("game: %s has no %s", iso.string().c_str(), IMAGE_XBE);
                continue;
            }
            CheckImage(*disc, iso);
            if (consider(assets, iso, std::move(xbe), std::move(disc))) return 1;
        }
    }

    if (other_name.empty()) return 0;
    if (!AskOtherRelease(other_name)) return -1;
    game = std::move(other);
    kernel::MountDisc(std::move(other_disc));
    return 1;
}

}  // namespace

bool FindGame(GameFiles& game) {
    for (;;) {
        int found = Search(game);
        if (found) return found > 0;
        WaitForGame();
    }
}

}  // namespace app
```

`native/gyro.cpp`:

```cpp
// Steering by tilting the phone, as mobile racing games have it: the phone held in landscape is the wheel, turned
// clockwise to steer right. The accelerometer gives the world's up in the phone's axes; its angle in the screen's
// plane against the screen's own up is the wheel's turn, whatever way the phone leans back. On while the touch
// controls' STEERING is TILT (touch.cpp) and the app is in front; the angle for a full lock is set in the settings
// panel and kept in android.toml beside the game's settings.
#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <cmath>
#include <fstream>

#include <toml++/toml.hpp>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "host.h"

namespace gyro {

namespace {

constexpr float kDeadZone = 2.0f;    // degrees of a hand held level
constexpr float kSmoothing = 0.35f;  // of the way to a new reading taken at once: the sensor's jitter evened out
constexpr uint32_t kMinAngle = 10, kMaxAngle = 60, kAngleStep = 5;

std::atomic<uint32_t> g_angle{30};  // degrees of tilt for a full lock
bool g_loaded = false;
SDL_Sensor* g_sensor = nullptr;
bool g_no_sensor = false;  // the phone has no accelerometer
std::atomic<float> g_steer{0};

std::filesystem::path File() { return app::ExeDir() / "android.toml"; }

void Load() {
    g_loaded = true;
    try {
        toml::table t = toml::parse_file(File().string());
        g_angle = std::clamp<uint32_t>(t["tilt_angle"].value_or(g_angle.load()), kMinAngle, kMaxAngle);
    } catch (...) {
    }
}

void Save() {
    toml::table t{{"tilt_angle", int64_t(g_angle.load())}};
    std::ofstream(File()) << t << "\n";
}

SDL_SensorID FindAccelerometer() {
    int n = 0;
    SDL_SensorID found = 0;
    if (SDL_SensorID* ids = SDL_GetSensors(&n)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n && !found; i++)
            if (SDL_GetSensorTypeForID(ids[i]) == SDL_SENSOR_ACCEL) found = ids[i];
        SDL_free(ids);
    }
    return found;
}

}  // namespace

uint32_t TiltAngle() {
    if (!g_loaded) Load();
    return g_angle;
}

// the settings panel (src/common/menu.cpp); saved at once
void StepTiltAngle(int step) {
    if (!g_loaded) Load();
    int a = int(g_angle) + step * int(kAngleStep);
    g_angle = uint32_t(std::clamp(a, int(kMinAngle), int(kMaxAngle)));
    Save();
}

float Steer() { return g_sensor ? g_steer.load() : 0.0f; }

void Pump() {
    if (!g_loaded) Load();
    bool want = touch::TiltSteering() && host::Foreground();
    if (want == (g_sensor != nullptr) || g_no_sensor) return;
    if (!want) {
        SDL_CloseSensor(g_sensor);
        g_sensor = nullptr;
        g_steer = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (!SDL_WasInit(SDL_INIT_SENSOR) && !SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_SENSOR)) return;
    SDL_SensorID id = FindAccelerometer();
    g_sensor = id ? SDL_OpenSensor(id) : nullptr;
    if (!g_sensor) {
        LOGW("gyro: no accelerometer on this device");
        g_no_sensor = true;
    }
}

// The accelerometer reads in the phone's natural (portrait) axes: x right, y up, z out of the screen, the world's up
// at rest. In landscape with the right side up the screen's up is the phone's x and its right the phone's -y; turned
// clockwise by a, the world's up lies a anticlockwise of the screen's: x = cos a, y = sin a. With the left side up
// both axes are the other way round
void OnEvent(const SDL_Event& e) {
    if (e.type != SDL_EVENT_SENSOR_UPDATE || !g_sensor || e.sensor.which != SDL_GetSensorID(g_sensor)) return;
    float ax = e.sensor.data[0], ay = e.sensor.data[1];
    if (std::hypot(ax, ay) < 2.0f) return;  // lying flat: no up in the screen's plane to steer by
    SDL_Window* w = host::Window();
    bool flipped = w && SDL_GetCurrentDisplayOrientation(SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(w)) == SDL_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE_FLIPPED;
    float turn = (flipped ? std::atan2(-ay, -ax) : std::atan2(ay, ax)) * (180.0f / 3.14159265f);
    float full = float(g_angle.load());
    float target = std::fabs(turn) <= kDeadZone ? 0.0f
                                                : std::clamp((turn - std::copysign(kDeadZone, turn)) / (full - kDeadZone), -1.0f, 1.0f);
    g_steer = g_steer + (target - g_steer) * kSmoothing;
}

}  // namespace gyro

```
