`native/input.cpp`:

```cpp
// controllers through SDL on Android: as the SDK's runtime/core/input.cpp reads them, but the plug events come from
// the main thread's event loop (Android's input reaches SDL there), and port 0 also takes the touch controls. The
// CONTROLLER page's bindings (common/pad_binds.h) go over SDL's mapping.
#include "core/input.h"

#include <jni.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <bitset>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iterator>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "common/options.h"
#include "common/pad_binds.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "host.h"

namespace input {

namespace {

// a controller takes the lowest free port when it is plugged in and keeps it until it is unplugged
std::mutex g_lock;
SDL_Gamepad* g_pads[4] = {};

// ---- the bindings: an action of the Xbox pad, what presses it. Codes as the keyboard's (native/touch.cpp): 0-7
// analog A B X Y black white LT RT, 8-15 the buttons bits, 16-19 the left stick up down left right, 20-23 the right's
constexpr int kFirstBit = 8;
constexpr int kFirstStick = 16;
// what each code is on a controller as SDL maps it; L1 / R1 the game's LT / RT, L2 / R2 its White / Black
constexpr const char* kCodeNames[] = {
    "A", "B", "X", "Y", "R2", "L2", "L1", "R1", "DPAD UP", "DPAD DOWN", "DPAD LEFT", "DPAD RIGHT", "START", "SELECT",
    "L3", "R3", "LEFT STICK UP", "LEFT STICK DOWN", "LEFT STICK LEFT", "LEFT STICK RIGHT", "RIGHT STICK UP",
    "RIGHT STICK DOWN", "RIGHT STICK LEFT", "RIGHT STICK RIGHT"};
struct PadTarget {
    Action action;
    int code;
};
constexpr PadTarget kPadActions[] = {
    {{"button_a", "A", "A"}, 0},
    {{"button_b", "B", "B"}, 1},
    {{"button_x", "X", "X"}, 2},
    {{"button_y", "Y", "Y"}, 3},
    {{"button_black", "BLACK", "R2"}, 4},
    {{"button_white", "WHITE", "L2"}, 5},
    {{"trigger_left", "LEFT TRIGGER", "L1"}, 6},
    {{"trigger_right", "RIGHT TRIGGER", "R1"}, 7},
    {{"dpad_up", "DPAD UP", "DPAD UP"}, 8},
    {{"dpad_down", "DPAD DOWN", "DPAD DOWN"}, 9},
    {{"dpad_left", "DPAD LEFT", "DPAD LEFT"}, 10},
    {{"dpad_right", "DPAD RIGHT", "DPAD RIGHT"}, 11},
    {{"start", "START", "START"}, 12},
    {{"back", "BACK", "SELECT"}, 13},
    {{"thumb_left", "LEFT THUMB", "L3"}, 14},
    {{"thumb_right", "RIGHT THUMB", "R3"}, 15},
    {{"move_up", "LEFT STICK UP", "LEFT STICK UP"}, 16},
    {{"move_down", "LEFT STICK DOWN", "LEFT STICK DOWN"}, 17},
    {{"move_left", "LEFT STICK LEFT", "LEFT STICK LEFT"}, 18},
    {{"move_right", "LEFT STICK RIGHT", "LEFT STICK RIGHT"}, 19},
    {{"look_up", "RIGHT STICK UP", "RIGHT STICK UP"}, 20},
    {{"look_down", "RIGHT STICK DOWN", "RIGHT STICK DOWN"}, 21},
    {{"look_left", "RIGHT STICK LEFT", "RIGHT STICK LEFT"}, 22},
    {{"look_right", "RIGHT STICK RIGHT", "RIGHT STICK RIGHT"}, 23},
};
constexpr size_t kPadCount = std::size(kPadActions);

// an input of a controller: SDL's joystick button, hat direction or axis side, or Android's key code of a controller
// SDL does not have (the loose one below); kind 0 for none. Saved as "button 3", "hat 0 up", "axis 2+", "key 188"
struct Source {
    char kind = 0;  // 'b' 'h' 'a' 'k'
    int index = 0;
    int dir = 0;  // a hat's SDL_HAT_ bit, an axis's side +1 or -1
};
using PadBinds = std::array<Source, kPadCount>;
std::mutex g_pad_bind_lock;
PadBinds g_pad_binds;

struct HatDir {
    int bit;
    const char* name;
};
constexpr HatDir kHatDirs[] = {{SDL_HAT_UP, "up"}, {SDL_HAT_DOWN, "down"}, {SDL_HAT_LEFT, "left"}, {SDL_HAT_RIGHT, "right"}};

Source ParseSource(const std::string& text) {
    Source s;
    char word[8] = "", sign = 0;
    if (std::sscanf(text.c_str(), "button %d", &s.index) == 1) s.kind = 'b';
    else if (std::sscanf(text.c_str(), "key %d", &s.index) == 1) s.kind = 'k';
    else if (std::sscanf(text.c_str(), "axis %d%c", &s.index, &sign) == 2 && (sign == '+' || sign == '-'))
        s.kind = 'a', s.dir = sign == '+' ? 1 : -1;
    else if (std::sscanf(text.c_str(), "hat %d %7s", &s.index, word) == 2)
        for (const HatDir& d : kHatDirs)
            if (std::string(word) == d.name) s.kind = 'h', s.dir = d.bit;
    if (s.index < 0) s.kind = 0;
    return s;
}

std::string SourceText(const Source& s) {
    char text[32] = "";
    if (s.kind == 'b') std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "button %d", s.index);
    else if (s.kind == 'k') std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "key %d", s.index);
    else if (s.kind == 'a') std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "axis %d%c", s.index, s.dir > 0 ? '+' : '-');
    else if (s.kind == 'h')
        for (const HatDir& d : kHatDirs)
            if (d.bit == s.dir) std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "hat %d %s", s.index, d.name);
    return text;
}

PadBinds PadBindsNow() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_pad_bind_lock);
    return g_pad_binds;
}

bool Matches(const SDL_GamepadBinding& b, const Source& s) {
    switch (s.kind) {
        case 'b': return b.input_type == SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_BUTTON && b.input.button == s.index;
        case 'h':
            return b.input_type == SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_HAT && b.input.hat.hat == s.index && b.input.hat.hat_mask == s.dir;
        case 'a': {
            if (b.input_type != SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_AXIS || b.input.axis.axis != s.index) return false;
            int lo = std::min(b.input.axis.axis_min, b.input.axis.axis_max);
            int hi = std::max(b.input.axis.axis_min, b.input.axis.axis_max);
            return s.dir > 0 ? hi > 0 : lo < 0;
        }
        default: return false;
    }
}

// the code the mapping gives an input it maps, the input fully pressed; -1 for none of the Xbox pad's
int OutputCode(const SDL_GamepadBinding& b, const Source& s) {
    if (b.output_type == SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_BUTTON) {
        switch (b.output.button) {
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH: return 0;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST: return 1;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST: return 2;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH: return 3;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER: return 6;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER: return 7;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP: return 8;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN: return 9;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT: return 10;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT: return 11;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START: return 12;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK: return 13;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK: return 14;
            case SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK: return 15;
            default: return -1;
        }
    }
    if (b.output_type != SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_AXIS) return -1;
    // the output's side: a button or hat gives the range's far end, an axis its side's end mapped across
    float t = 1;
    if (b.input_type == SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_AXIS && b.input.axis.axis_max != b.input.axis.axis_min) {
        float v = s.dir > 0 ? 32767.0f : -32768.0f;
        t = std::clamp((v - float(b.input.axis.axis_min)) / float(b.input.axis.axis_max - b.input.axis.axis_min), 0.0f, 1.0f);
    }
    float out = float(b.output.axis.axis_min) + t * float(b.output.axis.axis_max - b.output.axis.axis_min);
    bool plus = out >= 0;
    switch (b.output.axis.axis) {
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX: return plus ? 19 : 18;
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY: return plus ? 17 : 16;  // SDL's y is down
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX: return plus ? 23 : 22;
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY: return plus ? 21 : 20;
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER: return 5;
        case SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER: return 4;
        default: return -1;
    }
}

// what the mapping read for a code let go: a stick's whole axis
void Clear(Pad& p, int code) {
    if (code < 0) return;
    if (code < kFirstBit) p.analog[code] = 0;
    else if (code < kFirstStick) p.buttons &= uint16_t(~(1u << (code - kFirstBit)));
    else if (code < 18) p.ly = 0;
    else if (code < 20) p.lx = 0;
    else if (code < 22) p.ry = 0;
    else p.rx = 0;
}

// an input's press, 0 to 1
float Value(SDL_Joystick* joy, const Source& s) {
    switch (s.kind) {
        case 'b': return SDL_GetJoystickButton(joy, s.index) ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        case 'h': return SDL_GetJoystickHat(joy, s.index) & s.dir ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        case 'a': {
            float v = SDL_GetJoystickAxis(joy, s.index);
            // a trigger resting at one end runs the whole range
            Sint16 rest = 0;
            SDL_GetJoystickAxisInitialState(joy, s.index, &rest);
            if (s.dir > 0) return rest < -16000 ? (v + 32768.0f) / 65535.0f : std::max(v, 0.0f) / 32767.0f;
            return rest > 16000 ? (32767.0f - v) / 65535.0f : std::max(-v, 0.0f) / 32768.0f;
        }
        default: return 0;
    }
}

// a bound input's press onto its action; the sticks' directions gathered in dirs
void Press(Pad& p, float (&dirs)[8], int code, float v) {
    if (v <= 0) return;
    if (code < kFirstBit) p.analog[code] = std::max(p.analog[code], uint8_t(std::min(v, 1.0f) * 255.0f));
    else if (code < kFirstStick) p.buttons |= uint16_t((v >= 0.5f) << (code - kFirstBit));
    else dirs[code - kFirstStick] = std::max(dirs[code - kFirstStick], std::min(v, 1.0f));
}

void PressSticks(Pad& p, const float (&dirs)[8]) {
    auto add = [](int16_t& axis, float v) {
        if (v) axis = int16_t(std::clamp(float(axis) + v * 32767.0f, -32768.0f, 32767.0f));
    };
    add(p.ly, dirs[0] - dirs[1]);
    add(p.lx, dirs[3] - dirs[2]);
    add(p.ry, dirs[4] - dirs[5]);
    add(p.rx, dirs[7] - dirs[6]);
}

// a bound input presses its action alone, no longer what the mapping gave it
void ApplyBinds(SDL_Gamepad* pad, Pad& p, const PadBinds& binds) {
    int n = 0;
    SDL_GamepadBinding** list = SDL_GetGamepadBindings(pad, &n);
    for (const Source& s : binds) {
        if (!s.kind || s.kind == 'k') continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (Matches(*list[i], s)) Clear(p, OutputCode(*list[i], s));
    }
    // A trigger is both a button and an axis on some controllers, and a bind captured as the button leaves
    // the axis-mapped default (black / white) firing, so the old button-form bind still double-fires. A
    // bound button with no gamepad mapping of its own, held while a trigger axis is pulled, is that
    // trigger's button form: clear the trigger's default too.
    SDL_Joystick* joy = SDL_GetGamepadJoystick(pad);
    for (const Source& s : binds) {
        if (s.kind != 'b' || !SDL_GetJoystickButton(joy, s.index)) continue;
        bool mapped = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            if (list[i]->input_type == SDL_GAMEPAD_BINDTYPE_BUTTON && list[i]->input.button == s.index) mapped = true;
        if (mapped) continue;
        if (SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER) > 8000) Clear(p, 4);  // black
        if (SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER) > 8000) Clear(p, 5);   // white
    }
    SDL_free(list);
    float dirs[8] = {};
    for (size_t a = 0; a < kPadCount; a++)
        if (binds[a].kind && binds[a].kind != 'k') Press(p, dirs, kPadActions[a].code, Value(joy, binds[a]));
    PressSticks(p, dirs);
}

void AddPad(SDL_JoystickID id) {
    for (SDL_Gamepad* pad : g_pads)
        if (pad && SDL_GetGamepadID(pad) == id) return;
    SDL_Gamepad** slot = std::find(std::begin(g_pads), std::end(g_pads), nullptr);
    if (slot == std::end(g_pads)) return;
    *slot = SDL_OpenGamepad(id);
    const char* name = *slot ? SDL_GetGamepadName(*slot) : SDL_GetError();
    LOGI("input: controller %d %s: %s", int(slot - g_pads) + 1, *slot ? "plugged in" : "failed to open", name ? name : "");
}

void RemovePad(SDL_JoystickID id) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (!g_pads[i] || SDL_GetGamepadID(g_pads[i]) != id) continue;
        SDL_CloseGamepad(g_pads[i]);
        g_pads[i] = nullptr;
        LOGI("input: controller %d unplugged", i + 1);
    }
}

void Read(SDL_Gamepad* pad, Pad& p) {
    p.connected = true;
    constexpr SDL_GamepadButton kButtons[] = {
        SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP,    SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT,
        SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START,     SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK,
        SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK};
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) p.buttons |= uint16_t(SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, kButtons[i]) << i);
    // A B X Y
    constexpr SDL_GamepadButton kAnalog[] = {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST,
                                             SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH};
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) p.analog[i] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, kAnalog[i]) ? 0xFF : 0;
    auto axis = [&](SDL_GamepadAxis a) { return int(SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, a)); };
    // the shoulders the game's LT / RT, the triggers its White / Black; the triggers' 0 to 32767 into 0 to 255
    p.analog[4] = uint8_t(std::max(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER), 0) >> 7);  // black
    p.analog[5] = uint8_t(std::max(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER), 0) >> 7);   // white
    p.analog[6] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER) ? 0xFF : 0;   // LT
    p.analog[7] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER) ? 0xFF : 0;  // RT
    // SDL's sticks have y down; not plain negation: -32768 has no positive
    p.lx = int16_t(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX));
    p.ly = int16_t(-1 - axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY));
    p.rx = int16_t(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX));
    p.ry = int16_t(-1 - axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY));
}

// A controller Android hands over without its device: some phones' game services (MIUI's on a Redmi Note 8 Pro)
// take a DualShock 4 and pass its buttons and sticks on as a virtual device, which SDL takes for no controller.
// MostWantedActivity sends those here as Android's key codes and axes; they play port 0.
constexpr int kLooseCodes = 512;  // Android's key codes held, the controller's all under 320
struct Loose {
    std::bitset<kLooseCodes> keys;
    float lx = 0, ly = 0, rx = 0, ry = 0, lt = 0, rt = 0, hx = 0, hy = 0;
    bool seen = false;
};
std::mutex g_loose_lock;
Loose g_loose;

// Android's key code as the pad's: a button bit (dpad, start, back, thumbs) or an analog button, -1 for neither
void LooseKey(int code, int& bit, int& analog) {
    bit = analog = -1;
    switch (code) {
        case 19: bit = 0; break;    // DPAD_UP
        case 20: bit = 1; break;    // DPAD_DOWN
        case 21: bit = 2; break;    // DPAD_LEFT
        case 22: bit = 3; break;    // DPAD_RIGHT
        case 108: bit = 4; break;   // BUTTON_START (Options)
        case 109: bit = 5; break;   // BUTTON_SELECT (Share)
        case 106: bit = 6; break;   // BUTTON_THUMBL
        case 107: bit = 7; break;   // BUTTON_THUMBR
        case 96: analog = 0; break;   // BUTTON_A (cross)
        case 97: analog = 1; break;   // BUTTON_B (circle)
        case 99: analog = 2; break;   // BUTTON_X (square)
        case 100: analog = 3; break;  // BUTTON_Y (triangle)
        case 102: analog = 6; break;  // BUTTON_L1: LT
        case 103: analog = 7; break;  // BUTTON_R1: RT
        case 104: analog = 5; break;  // BUTTON_L2: white
        case 105: analog = 4; break;  // BUTTON_R2: black
        default: break;
    }
}

int16_t Axis(float v) { return int16_t(std::clamp(v, -1.0f, 1.0f) * 32767.0f); }
uint8_t Trigger(float v) { return uint8_t(std::clamp(v, 0.0f, 1.0f) * 255.0f); }

// the loose controller's state on top of what SDL read: buttons added, the stick pushed further taken; a key bound
// on the CONTROLLER page presses its action alone
void MergeLoose(Pad& p, const PadBinds& binds) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    const Loose& l = g_loose;
    if (!l.seen) return;
    p.connected = true;
    float dirs[8] = {};
    for (int code = 0; code < kLooseCodes; code++) {
        if (!l.keys[code]) continue;
        bool bound = false;
        for (size_t a = 0; a < kPadCount; a++) {
            if (binds[a].kind != 'k' || binds[a].index != code) continue;
            bound = true;
            Press(p, dirs, kPadActions[a].code, 1);
        }
        int bit, analog;
        LooseKey(code, bit, analog);
        if (bound) continue;
        if (bit >= 0) p.buttons |= uint16_t(1u << bit);
        if (analog >= 0) p.analog[analog] = 0xFF;
    }
    PressSticks(p, dirs);
    // the hat as the dpad: x left -1 right 1, y up -1 down 1
    if (l.hy < -0.5f) p.buttons |= 1 << 0;
    if (l.hy > 0.5f) p.buttons |= 1 << 1;
    if (l.hx < -0.5f) p.buttons |= 1 << 2;
    if (l.hx > 0.5f) p.buttons |= 1 << 3;
    // the triggers' axes are L2 / R2: white and black, unless that trigger is bound to another action, in
    // which case the key's bind already presses it and the axis must not also fire its default
    bool l2_bound = false, r2_bound = false;
    for (size_t a = 0; a < kPadCount; a++) {
        if (binds[a].kind != 'k') continue;
        if (binds[a].index == 104) l2_bound = true;  // BUTTON_L2
        if (binds[a].index == 105) r2_bound = true;  // BUTTON_R2
    }
    if (!l2_bound) p.analog[5] = std::max(p.analog[5], Trigger(l.lt));
    if (!r2_bound) p.analog[4] = std::max(p.analog[4], Trigger(l.rt));
    // Android's y is down, the pad's up
    auto further = [](int16_t& to, int16_t v) { if (std::abs(int(v)) > std::abs(int(to))) to = v; };
    further(p.lx, Axis(l.lx));
    further(p.ly, Axis(-l.ly));
    further(p.rx, Axis(l.rx));
    further(p.ry, Axis(-l.ry));
}

}  // namespace

// MostWantedActivity: the loose controller's buttons, sticks and triggers, and its letting go when the app loses the focus
extern "C" JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_com_racas_mostwanted_MostWantedActivity_nativeLooseKey(JNIEnv*, jclass, jint code,
                                                                                     jboolean down) {
    // every button kept, a generic controller's BUTTON_1 to 16 too: the CONTROLLER page can bind them
    if (code < 0 || code >= kLooseCodes) return;
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    g_loose.seen = true;
    g_loose.keys[size_t(code)] = down;
}

extern "C" JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_com_racas_mostwanted_MostWantedActivity_nativeLooseAxes(JNIEnv*, jclass, jfloat lx,
                                                                                      jfloat ly, jfloat rx, jfloat ry,
                                                                                      jfloat lt, jfloat rt, jfloat hx,
                                                                                      jfloat hy) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    g_loose.seen = true;
    g_loose.lx = lx, g_loose.ly = ly, g_loose.rx = rx, g_loose.ry = ry;
    g_loose.lt = lt, g_loose.rt = rt, g_loose.hx = hx, g_loose.hy = hy;
}

extern "C" JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_com_racas_mostwanted_MostWantedActivity_nativeLooseRelease(JNIEnv*, jclass) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    bool seen = g_loose.seen;
    g_loose = {};
    g_loose.seen = seen;
}

void Init() {
    int v = SDL_GetVersion();
    LOGI("input: SDL %d.%d.%d", SDL_VERSIONNUM_MAJOR(v), SDL_VERSIONNUM_MINOR(v), SDL_VERSIONNUM_MICRO(v));
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    int count = 0;
    if (SDL_JoystickID* ids = SDL_GetGamepads(&count)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) AddPad(ids[i]);
        SDL_free(ids);
    }
}

void OnPadEvent(const SDL_Event& e) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_ADDED) AddPad(e.gdevice.which);
    else if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_REMOVED) RemovePad(e.gdevice.which);
}

Pad Poll(int port) {
    Pad p;
    PadBinds binds = PadBindsNow();
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
        if (SDL_Gamepad* pad = port >= 0 && port < 4 ? g_pads[port] : nullptr) {
            Read(pad, p);
            ApplyBinds(pad, p, binds);
        }
    }
    // a controller pushed past a rest, not just plugged in
    constexpr int16_t kStickPushed = 16000;
    auto pushed = [](int16_t v) { return v > kStickPushed || v < -kStickPushed; };
    if (port == 0) MergeLoose(p, binds);
    // the sticks' dead zone: a small deflection reads as none, so a worn stick does not steer on its own
    uint32_t dz = app::Get().deadzone;
    if (dz) {
        int16_t t = int16_t(std::min<uint32_t>(dz, 50) * 32767 / 100);
        auto dead = [&](int16_t& v) { if (v > -t && v < t) v = 0; };
        dead(p.lx); dead(p.ly); dead(p.rx); dead(p.ry);
    }
    bool analog = std::any_of(std::begin(p.analog), std::end(p.analog), [](uint8_t a) { return a > 0x20; });
    if (p.buttons || analog || pushed(p.lx) || pushed(p.ly) || pushed(p.rx) || pushed(p.ry)) touch::PadUsed();
    touch::Apply(port, p);
    if (app::kGame.pad) app::kGame.pad(port, p);
    return p;
}

// the motors run until set again
void Rumble(int port, uint16_t left, uint16_t right) {
    if (app::kGame.rumble) app::kGame.rumble(port, left, right);
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    if (port >= 0 && port < 4 && g_pads[port]) SDL_RumbleGamepad(g_pads[port], left, right, 0);
}

namespace {

// Android's name of a controller's key code
std::string KeyName(int code) {
    switch (code) {
        case 19: return "DPAD UP";
        case 20: return "DPAD DOWN";
        case 21: return "DPAD LEFT";
        case 22: return "DPAD RIGHT";
        case 96: return "A";
        case 97: return "B";
        case 98: return "C";
        case 99: return "X";
        case 100: return "Y";
        case 101: return "Z";
        case 102: return "L1";
        case 103: return "R1";
        case 104: return "L2";
        case 105: return "R2";
        case 106: return "L3";
        case 107: return "R3";
        case 108: return "START";
        case 109: return "SELECT";
        case 110: return "MODE";
        default: break;
    }
    if (code >= 188 && code <= 203) return "BUTTON " + std::to_string(code - 187);  // BUTTON_1 to 16
    return "KEY " + std::to_string(code);
}

// an input's name: what the first controller's mapping makes it, else its number; under g_lock
std::string SourceName(const Source& s) {
    if (s.kind == 'k') return KeyName(s.index);
    for (SDL_Gamepad* pad : g_pads) {
        if (!pad) continue;
        int n = 0, code = -1;
        SDL_GamepadBinding** list = SDL_GetGamepadBindings(pad, &n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n && code < 0; i++)
            if (Matches(*list[i], s)) code = OutputCode(*list[i], s);
        SDL_free(list);
        if (code >= 0) return kCodeNames[code];
        break;
    }
    char text[32] = "";
    if (s.kind == 'b') std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "BUTTON %d", s.index + 1);
    else if (s.kind == 'a') std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "AXIS %d%c", s.index + 1, s.dir > 0 ? '+' : '-');
    else if (s.kind == 'h') {
        std::string dir = SourceText(s).substr(SourceText(s).rfind(' ') + 1);
        for (char& c : dir) c = char(std::toupper(uint8_t(c)));
        if (s.index) std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "HAT %d %s", s.index + 1, dir.c_str());
        else std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "HAT %s", dir.c_str());
    }
    return text;
}

}  // namespace

const Action* PadActions(size_t* count) {
    static const auto list = [] {
        std::array<Action, kPadCount> a{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < kPadCount; i++) a[i] = kPadActions[i].action;
        return a;
    }();
    *count = kPadCount;
    return list.data();
}

std::string PadBinding(size_t action) {
    if (action >= kPadCount) return {};
    Source s = PadBindsNow()[action];
    if (!s.kind) return {};
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    return SourceName(s);
}

void PadBind(size_t action, const std::string& source) {
    if (action >= kPadCount) return;
    Source s = ParseSource(source);
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_pad_bind_lock);
        g_pad_binds[action] = s;
        auto& saved = game::Opt().pad;
        if (s.kind) saved[kPadActions[action].action.id] = SourceText(s);
        else saved.erase(kPadActions[action].action.id);
    }
    app::Save();
}

void ResetPadBindings() {
    game::Opt().pad.clear();
    LoadPadBindings();
    app::Save();
}

void LoadPadBindings() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_pad_bind_lock);
    const auto& saved = game::Opt().pad;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < kPadCount; i++) {
        auto it = saved.find(kPadActions[i].action.id);
        g_pad_binds[i] = it != saved.end() ? ParseSource(it->second) : Source{};
    }
}

std::string PressedPadInput() {
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
        for (SDL_Gamepad* pad : g_pads) {
            SDL_Joystick* joy = pad ? SDL_GetGamepadJoystick(pad) : nullptr;
            if (!joy) continue;
            // an axis well away from where it rested: a stick pushed or a trigger pulled. Axes first: a
            // trigger is both a button and an axis on some controllers, but SDL maps it as an axis, so
            // capturing the button form would leave its default (black / white) firing alongside the bind
            for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GetNumJoystickAxes(joy); i++) {
                Sint16 rest = 0;
                SDL_GetJoystickAxisInitialState(joy, i, &rest);
                int moved = int(SDL_GetJoystickAxis(joy, i)) - int(rest);
                if (std::abs(moved) > 20000) return SourceText({'a', i, moved > 0 ? 1 : -1});
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GetNumJoystickButtons(joy); i++)
                if (SDL_GetJoystickButton(joy, i)) return SourceText({'b', i});
            for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GetNumJoystickHats(joy); i++)
                for (const HatDir& d : kHatDirs)
                    if (SDL_GetJoystickHat(joy, i) & d.bit) return SourceText({'h', i, d.bit});
        }
    }
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    for (int code = 0; code < kLooseCodes; code++)
        if (g_loose.keys[size_t(code)]) return SourceText({'k', code});
    return {};
}

bool PadBindingIsAxis(size_t action) {
    if (action >= kPadCount) return false;
    return PadBindsNow()[action].kind == 'a';
}

// the first connected gamepad's live state, for the CONTROLLER page's input test: SDL's gamepad first,
// else the loose controller Android hands over without its device
bool PadLiveState(PadLive& out) {
    out = {};
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
        for (SDL_Gamepad* pad : g_pads) {
            if (!pad) continue;
            out.connected = true;
            if (const char* name = SDL_GetGamepadName(pad)) out.name = name;
            auto btn = [&](SDL_GamepadButton b) { return SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, b) != 0; };
            out.south = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH);
            out.east = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST);
            out.west = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST);
            out.north = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH);
            out.lb = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER);
            out.rb = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER);
            out.start = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START);
            out.back = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK);
            out.ls = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK);
            out.rs = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK);
            out.dpad_up = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP);
            out.dpad_down = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN);
            out.dpad_left = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT);
            out.dpad_right = btn(SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT);
            auto axis = [&](SDL_GamepadAxis a) { return SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, a) / 32768.0f; };
            out.lx = axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX);
            out.ly = -axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY);
            out.rx = axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX);
            out.ry = -axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY);
            out.lt = std::clamp(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER), 0.0f, 1.0f);
            out.rt = std::clamp(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER), 0.0f, 1.0f);
            return true;
        }
    }
    std::lock_guard lock(g_loose_lock);
    const Loose& l = g_loose;
    if (!l.seen) return false;
    out.connected = true;
    out.name = "Android controller";
    for (int code = 0; code < kLooseCodes; code++) {
        if (!l.keys[size_t(code)]) continue;
        int bit, analog;
        LooseKey(code, bit, analog);
        if (bit == 0) out.dpad_up = true;
        else if (bit == 1) out.dpad_down = true;
        else if (bit == 2) out.dpad_left = true;
        else if (bit == 3) out.dpad_right = true;
        else if (bit == 4) out.start = true;
        else if (bit == 5) out.back = true;
        else if (bit == 6) out.ls = true;
        else if (bit == 7) out.rs = true;
        else if (analog == 0) out.south = true;
        else if (analog == 1) out.east = true;
        else if (analog == 2) out.west = true;
        else if (analog == 3) out.north = true;
        else if (analog == 4) out.rt = 1.0f;  // BUTTON_R2: black
        else if (analog == 5) out.lt = 1.0f;  // BUTTON_L2: white
        else if (analog == 6) out.lb = true;  // BUTTON_L1
        else if (analog == 7) out.rb = true;  // BUTTON_R1
    }
    if (l.hy < -0.5f) out.dpad_up = true;
    if (l.hy > 0.5f) out.dpad_down = true;
    if (l.hx < -0.5f) out.dpad_left = true;
    if (l.hx > 0.5f) out.dpad_right = true;
    out.lx = l.lx;
    out.ly = -l.ly;
    out.rx = l.rx;
    out.ry = -l.ry;
    out.lt = std::max(out.lt, l.lt);
    out.rt = std::max(out.rt, l.rt);
    return true;
}

}  // namespace input

```

namespace {

SDL_Window* g_window = nullptr;
std::atomic<bool> g_foreground{true};
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_surface_epoch{0};
std::mutex g_foreground_lock;
std::condition_variable g_foreground_cv;
char g_crash_log_path[512] = {};

void CrashAppendStr(char* dst, size_t& pos, size_t cap, const char* s) {
    if (!s) return;
    while (*s && pos + 1 < cap) dst[pos++] = *s++;
}

void CrashAppendHex(char* dst, size_t& pos, size_t cap, uintptr_t v) {
    CrashAppendStr(dst, pos, cap, "0x");
    char tmp[2 * sizeof(uintptr_t)];
    int n = 0;
    do {
        unsigned d = unsigned(v & 0xFu);
        tmp[n++] = char(d < 10 ? '0' + d : 'a' + d - 10);
        v >>= 4;
    } while (v && n < int(sizeof(tmp)));
    while (n-- > 0 && pos + 1 < cap) dst[pos++] = tmp[n];
}

void CrashAppendInt(char* dst, size_t& pos, size_t cap, int v) {
    if (v < 0) {
        CrashAppendStr(dst, pos, cap, "-");
        v = -v;
    }
    char tmp[16];
    int n = 0;
    do {
        tmp[n++] = char('0' + (v % 10));
        v /= 10;
    } while (v && n < int(sizeof(tmp)));
    while (n-- > 0 && pos + 1 < cap) dst[pos++] = tmp[n];
}

const char* SignalName(int sig) {
    switch (sig) {
        case SIGSEGV: return "SIGSEGV";
        case SIGABRT: return "SIGABRT";
        case SIGBUS: return "SIGBUS";
        case SIGILL: return "SIGILL";
        case SIGFPE: return "SIGFPE";
        default: return "SIG";
    }
}

void WriteAll(int fd, const char* buf, size_t len) {
    while (len > 0) {
        ssize_t n = write(fd, buf, len);
        if (n <= 0) break;
        buf += n;
        len -= size_t(n);
    }
}

void CrashWriteModule(int fd, char* buf, size_t cap, const char* tag, uintptr_t addr) {
    Dl_info dl{};
    if (!addr || !dladdr(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(addr), &dl)) return;
    size_t pos = 0;
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, "error: crash ");
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, tag);
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, " module=");
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, dl.dli_fname ? dl.dli_fname : "?");
    if (dl.dli_fbase) {
        CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, "+");
        CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, cap, addr - uintptr_t(dl.dli_fbase));
    }
    if (dl.dli_sname) {
        CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, " sym=");
        CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, dl.dli_sname);
        if (dl.dli_saddr) {
            CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, "+");
            CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, cap, addr - uintptr_t(dl.dli_saddr));
        }
    }
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, cap, "\n");
    if (fd >= 0) WriteAll(fd, buf, pos);
    WriteAll(STDERR_FILENO, buf, pos);
}

constexpr int kCrashSigs[] = {SIGSEGV, SIGABRT, SIGBUS, SIGILL, SIGFPE};
struct sigaction g_prev_sa[5]{};

void CrashHandler(int sig, siginfo_t* info, void* ctx) {
    uintptr_t pc = 0, lr = 0, sp = 0;
#if defined(__aarch64__)
    if (ctx) {
        const auto* uc = static_cast<const ucontext_t*>(ctx);
        pc = uintptr_t(uc->uc_mcontext.pc);
        lr = uintptr_t(uc->uc_mcontext.regs[30]);
        sp = uintptr_t(uc->uc_mcontext.sp);
    }
#elif defined(__x86_64__)
    if (ctx) {
        const auto* uc = static_cast<const ucontext_t*>(ctx);
        pc = uintptr_t(uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RIP]);
        sp = uintptr_t(uc->uc_mcontext.gregs[REG_RSP]);
    }
#endif
    char buf[512];
    size_t pos = 0;
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), "error: crash ");
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), SignalName(sig));
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " sig=");
    CrashAppendInt(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), sig);
    if (info) {
        CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " code=");
        CrashAppendInt(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), info->si_code);
        CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " addr=");
        CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), uintptr_t(info->si_addr));
    }
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " pc=");
    CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), pc);
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " lr=");
    CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), lr);
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), " sp=");
    CrashAppendHex(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), sp);
    CrashAppendStr(buf, pos, sizeof(buf), "\n");

    int fd = g_crash_log_path[0] ? open(g_crash_log_path, O_WRONLY | O_APPEND) : -1;
    if (fd >= 0) WriteAll(fd, buf, pos);
    WriteAll(STDERR_FILENO, buf, pos);

    CrashWriteModule(fd, buf, sizeof(buf), "pc", pc);
    if (lr && lr != pc) CrashWriteModule(fd, buf, sizeof(buf), "lr", lr);
    if (fd >= 0) close(fd);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(kCrashSigs) / sizeof(kCrashSigs[0]); i++) {
        if (kCrashSigs[i] == sig) {
            sigaction(sig, &g_prev_sa[i], nullptr);
            break;
        }
    }
    raise(sig);
}

void InstallCrashHandlers(const std::string& path) {
    std::snprintf(g_crash_log_path, sizeof(g_crash_log_path), "%s", path.c_str());
    struct sigaction sa{};
    sa.sa_sigaction = CrashHandler;
    sigemptyset(&sa.sa_mask);
    sa.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESETHAND;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(kCrashSigs) / sizeof(kCrashSigs[0]); i++) {
        sigaction(kCrashSigs[i], &sa, &g_prev_sa[i]);
    }
}

std::string Utf8(const wchar_t* w) {
    std::string s;
    for (; w && *w; w++) s += *w < 0x80 ? char(*w) : '?';
    return s;
}

// the log's lines to logcat as well: stderr is read on a thread of its own
void LogToLogcat() {
    int fds[2];
    if (pipe(fds)) return;
    dup2(fds[1], STDERR_FILENO);
    close(fds[1]);
    std::thread([fd = fds[0]] {
        char buf[1024];
        std::string line;
        for (ssize_t n; (n = read(fd, buf, sizeof(buf))) > 0;) {
            line.append(buf, size_t(n));
            for (size_t nl; (nl = line.find('\n')) != std::string::npos; line.erase(0, nl + 1))
                __android_log_write(ANDROID_LOG_INFO, "BLACK", line.substr(0, nl).c_str());
        }
    }).detach();
}

std::string Property(const char* name) {
    char v[PROP_VALUE_MAX] = {};
    __system_property_get(name, v);
    return v;
}

void SetForeground(bool on) {
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_foreground_lock);
        if (on && !g_foreground) g_surface_epoch++;
        g_foreground = on;
    }
    g_foreground_cv.notify_all();
    LOGI("app: %s", on ? "in front" : "in the background");
}

// SDL's display mode in landscape: the window is not up yet when the settings load
app::Mode ScreenMode() {
    if (g_window) {
        int w = 0, h = 0;
        host::WindowPixels(w, h);
        if (w > 0 && h > 0) return {uint32_t(w), uint32_t(h)};
    }
    const SDL_DisplayMode* m = SDL_GetCurrentDisplayMode(SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay());
    if (!m) return {1920, 1080};
    uint32_t w = uint32_t(m->w * m->pixel_density), h = uint32_t(m->h * m->pixel_density);
    return {std::max(w, h), std::min(w, h)};
}

float RefreshRate() {
    SDL_DisplayID d = g_window ? SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(g_window) : SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay();
    const SDL_DisplayMode* m = SDL_GetCurrentDisplayMode(d);
    return m && m->refresh_rate > 1 ? m->refresh_rate : 60.0f;
}

namespace {

const char* kModes[] = {"fullscreen", "borderless", "windowed"};
// the defaults a settings file was written under: 3 has the frame rate capped at 60 and vsync off, which a file from
// before takes once, its player's own choices kept from then on
constexpr int kDefaults = 3;

std::filesystem::path File() { return ExeDir() / kGame.settings; }

toml::table Table() {
    const Settings& s = Get();
    toml::table t{{"display_mode", kModes[uint32_t(s.display_mode)]},
                  {"width", int64_t(s.width)},
                  {"height", int64_t(s.height)},
                  {"render_percent", int64_t(s.render_percent)},
                  {"fps_cap", int64_t(s.fps_cap)},
                  {"vsync", s.vsync},
                  {"anisotropic_filtering", int64_t(s.aniso)},
                  {"deadzone", int64_t(s.deadzone)},
                  {"join_ip", s.join_ip},
                  {"defaults", int64_t(kDefaults)}};
    for (const Option& o : kGame.options) {
        if (o.flag) t.insert(o.key, *o.flag);
        else t.insert(o.key, int64_t(*o.value));
    }
    if (kGame.save) kGame.save(&t);
    return t;
}

// a phone renders the console's frame at about 720p unless the settings say otherwise
constexpr uint32_t kFirstRunRenderPercent = 67;

// the console's 60: what a title steps once a frame (menus, their key repeat, films) runs at the console's speed
void PhoneFrameDefaults(Settings& s) {
    s.fps_cap = 60;
    s.vsync = false;
}

}  // namespace

// the settings as a phone starts with them, for a first run and the options' restore
Settings DefaultSettings() {
    Settings s;
    s.render_percent = kFirstRunRenderPercent;
    PhoneFrameDefaults(s);
    return s;
}

Settings& Get() {
    static Settings s = DefaultSettings();
    return s;
}

void Load() {
    Settings& s = Get();
    toml::table t;
    try {
        t = toml::parse_file(File().string());
    } catch (...) {
        return;
    }
    std::string mode = t["display_mode"].value_or(std::string(kModes[uint32_t(s.display_mode)]));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        if (mode == kModes[i]) s.display_mode = DisplayMode(i);
    s.width = t["width"].value_or(s.width);
    s.height = t["height"].value_or(s.height);
    s.render_percent = t["render_percent"].value_or(s.render_percent);
    s.fps_cap = t["fps_cap"].value_or(s.fps_cap);
    s.vsync = t["vsync"].value_or(s.vsync);
    s.aniso = t["anisotropic_filtering"].value_or(s.aniso);
    s.deadzone = t["deadzone"].value_or(s.deadzone);
    if (s.deadzone > 50) s.deadzone = 50;
    s.join_ip = t["join_ip"].value_or(s.join_ip);
    if (t["defaults"].value_or(int64_t(0)) < kDefaults) PhoneFrameDefaults(s);
    for (const Option& o : kGame.options) {
        if (o.flag) *o.flag = t[o.key].value_or(*o.flag);
        else *o.value = t[o.key].value_or(*o.value);
    }
    if (kGame.load) kGame.load(&t);
}

void Save() {
    std::ofstream f(File());
    f << Table() << "\n";
}

void LogSettings() {
    std::ostringstream text;
    text << Table();
    std::istringstream lines(text.str());
    LOGR("Settings:");
    for (std::string line; std::getline(lines, line);)
        if (!line.empty()) LOGR("  %s", line.c_str());
}

void LogSystem() {
    std::time_t now = std::time(nullptr);
    char date[32] = {};
    std::strftime(date, sizeof(date), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::localtime(&now));
    LOGR("%ls (%s), %s, build %s", kGame.title, IMAGE_XBE, date, BUILD_COMMIT);
    LOGR("Path: %s", ExeDir().c_str());
    LOGR("Device: %s %s, Android %s (API %d)", Property("ro.product.manufacturer").c_str(),
         Property("ro.product.model").c_str(), Property("ro.build.version.release").c_str(), SDL_GetAndroidSDKVersion());
    LOGR("CPU: %s (%d threads)", Property("ro.soc.model").c_str(), SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores());
    LOGR("RAM: %.1f GB", SDL_GetSystemRAM() / 1024.0);
    Mode desk = Desktop();
    LOGR("Display: %ux%u, %.0f Hz", desk.width, desk.height, RefreshRate());
    LogSettings();
}

Mode Desktop() { return ScreenMode(); }

Mode Output() {
    // the window is the screen: the resolution setting is the screen's own
    return Desktop();
}

bool Widescreen() {
    // the frame's shape as the aspect ratio setting has it: the game reads this at boot
    return game::Aspect() >= 1.5f;  // 3:2 or wider
}

float RenderScale(uint32_t guest_height) {
    float h = Output().height * (Get().render_percent / 100.0f);
    if (game::Opt().anti_aliasing == game::kAaSsaa) h *= 2.0f;  // the presenter averages it back down
    return guest_height ? std::max(h / guest_height, 0.1f) : 1.0f;
}

// app-specific external storage: the player can reach the logs, saves and settings over USB
std::filesystem::path ExeDir() {
    static const std::filesystem::path dir = [] {
        const char* p = nullptr;
        if (SDL_GetAndroidExternalStorageState() & SDL_ANDROID_EXTERNAL_STORAGE_WRITE) p = SDL_GetAndroidExternalStoragePath();
        if (!p) p = SDL_GetAndroidInternalStoragePath();
        return std::filesystem::path(p ? p : ".");
    }();
    return dir;
}

void Pace() {
    using clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    static clock::time_point next = clock::now();
    uint32_t cap = Get().fps_cap;
    auto now = clock::now();
    if (!cap) {
        next = now;
        return;
    }
    auto period = std::chrono::nanoseconds(1000000000ull / cap);
    next += period;
    if (next < now - period) next = now;
    while (clock::now() + std::chrono::milliseconds(2) < next) std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
    while (clock::now() < next) std::this_thread::yield();
}

}  // namespace app

namespace {

void InitUi() {
    IMGUI_CHECKVERSION();
    ImGui::CreateContext();
    ImGuiIO& io = ImGui::GetIO();
    io.IniFilename = nullptr;
    io.ConfigFlags |= ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard | ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad | ImGuiConfigFlags_IsTouchScreen;
    io.BackendPlatformName = "android_sdl3";
    touch::LoadArt();
}

// The logs go in the Carbon folder beside the game, where the player finds them without Android/data (which
// Android 11 on hides from file managers); without all files access yet (the first run asks for it), in the app's own
// folder as before
std::filesystem::path LogDir() {
    std::filesystem::path shared = std::filesystem::path(host::kShared) / "logs";
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::create_directories(shared, ec);
    std::filesystem::path probe = shared / ".write";
    if (std::FILE* f = std::fopen(probe.c_str(), "w")) {
        std::fclose(f);
        std::filesystem::remove(probe, ec);
        return shared;
    }
    return app::ExeDir() / "logs";
}

void Dispatch(const SDL_Event& e) {
    switch (e.type) {
        case SDL_EVENT_QUIT:
        case SDL_EVENT_TERMINATING:
            logx::Flush();
            kernel::Shutdown(0);
            break;
        case SDL_EVENT_WILL_ENTER_BACKGROUND:
            SetForeground(false);
            break;
        case SDL_EVENT_DID_ENTER_FOREGROUND:
            SetForeground(true);
            break;
        case SDL_EVENT_LOW_MEMORY:
            LOGW("app: Android is low on memory");
            break;
        case SDL_EVENT_SENSOR_UPDATE:
        case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_SENSOR_UPDATE:
            gyro::OnEvent(e);
            return;
        case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_ADDED:
        case SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_REMOVED:
            input::OnPadEvent(e);
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
    if (touch::OnEvent(e)) return;
    std::lock_guard lock(app::UiLock());
    ui::OnEvent(e);
}

}  // namespace

int main(int, char**) {
    LogToLogcat();
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_ORIENTATIONS, "LandscapeLeft LandscapeRight");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_TOUCH_MOUSE_EVENTS, "0");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_MOUSE_TOUCH_EVENTS, "0");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_ANDROID_TRAP_BACK_BUTTON, "1");
    // no poll sentinel: on Android each pump inside SDL_WaitEventTimeout pushes a new one, which wakes the wait at once,
    // and the event loop spun a whole core until the timeout (SDL 3.4)
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_POLL_SENTINEL, "0");
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_EVENTS | SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD | SDL_INIT_AUDIO | SDL_INIT_SENSOR)) {
        __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_ERROR, "BLACK", "SDL_Init: %s", SDL_GetError());
        return 1;
    }
    // a file named perf in the app's folder: the perf log lines, as XBE_PERF gives them on a PC
    if (std::error_code ec; std::filesystem::exists(app::ExeDir() / "perf", ec)) setenv("XBE_PERF", "1", 1);
    logx::Init(LogDir().string(), app::kGame.log);
    InstallCrashHandlers(logx::Path());
    LOGR("app: log %s", logx::Path().c_str());
    if (!logx::PrevPath().empty()) LOGR("app: previous log %s", logx::PrevPath().c_str());
    app::Load();
    if (app::kGame.init) app::kGame.init();
    app::LogSystem();

    std::string title = Utf8(app::kGame.title);
    g_window = SDL_CreateWindow(title.c_str(), 0, 0, SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN | SDL_WINDOW_VULKAN | SDL_WINDOW_HIGH_PIXEL_DENSITY);
    if (!g_window) {
        LOGE("app: no window: %s", SDL_GetError());
        return 1;
    }

    app::GameFiles game;
    if (!app::FindGame(game)) {
        logx::Flush();
        return 1;
    }

    InitUi();
    input::Init();
    if (app::kGame.window) app::kGame.window(g_window);
    if (!kernel::Boot(std::move(game.xbe), IMAGE_XBE, game.dir.string(), (app::ExeDir() / "hdd").string())) {
        SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, Utf8(app::kGame.short_title).c_str(),
                                 app::Ui("The game failed to start, see the log in the logs folder.", false).c_str(),
                                 g_window);
        return 1;
    }

    for (;;) {
        SDL_Event e;
        // a few milliseconds: a HIDAPI controller is read in the pump, which events from Java do not wake
        if (SDL_WaitEventTimeout(&e, 4)) {
            Dispatch(e);
            while (SDL_PollEvent(&e)) Dispatch(e);
        }
        touch::Pump();
    }
}

`native/stats.cpp`:

```cpp
// The performance overlay's numbers (src/common/menu.cpp): CPU and GPU load and the temperatures. An app may not
// read every source Android has, and which it may differs by maker and version: each number falls back to what it
// can read, and is -1 when nothing tells it
#include <jni.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <SDL3/SDL_system.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "core/log.h"

namespace host {

float VulkanGpuLoad();  // native/vulkan.cpp: the frames' GPU time, from timestamps

namespace {

std::atomic<float> g_cpu{-1}, g_gpu{-1}, g_cpu_temp{-1}, g_gpu_temp{-1}, g_battery_temp{-1};

bool ReadFile(const char* path, char* buf, size_t n) {
    FILE* f = std::fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return false;
    size_t got = std::fread(buf, 1, n - 1, f);
    std::fclose(f);
    buf[got] = 0;
    return got > 0;
}

// ---- CPU load: the whole device's from /proc/stat, which Android 8 and later deny apps; else this process's share
// of all the cores, from its own /proc/self/stat

struct CpuSample {
    uint64_t busy = 0, total = 0;
};

bool SystemCpu(CpuSample& s) {
    char buf[256];
    if (!ReadFile("/proc/stat", buf, sizeof(buf))) return false;
    unsigned long long v[8] = {};
    if (std::sscanf(buf, "cpu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu", &v[0], &v[1], &v[2], &v[3], &v[4], &v[5],
                    &v[6], &v[7]) < 4)
        return false;
    s.total = 0;
    for (unsigned long long x : v) s.total += x;
    s.busy = s.total - v[3] - v[4];  // idle and iowait
    return true;
}

// in clock ticks; total is the wall time in ticks times the cores
bool ProcessCpu(CpuSample& s) {
    char buf[1024];
    if (!ReadFile("/proc/self/stat", buf, sizeof(buf))) return false;
    // the name in parentheses may hold spaces: the fields count from its closing one, utime and stime are 14 and 15
    const char* p = std::strrchr(buf, ')');
    if (!p) return false;
    unsigned long long utime = 0, stime = 0;
    if (std::sscanf(p + 2, "%*c %*d %*d %*d %*d %*d %*u %*u %*u %*u %*u %llu %llu", &utime, &stime) != 2) return false;
    static const long ticks = sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK);
    static const long cores = std::max(1L, sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_CONF));
    double now = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    s.busy = utime + stime;
    s.total = uint64_t(now * double(ticks) * double(cores));
    return true;
}

// ---- GPU load: Adreno's own counter when the app may read it, else the frames' time from Vulkan's timestamps

float AdrenoBusy() {
    char buf[32];
    if (!ReadFile("/sys/class/kgsl/kgsl-3d0/gpu_busy_percentage", buf, sizeof(buf))) return -1;
    int v = 0;
    return std::sscanf(buf, "%d", &v) == 1 ? float(std::clamp(v, 0, 100)) : -1;
}

// ---- temperatures: the hottest CPU and GPU sensors of the thermal zones, which newer Android versions deny apps;
// the battery's from the activity always

struct Zones {
    std::vector<std::string> cpu, gpu;
};

Zones FindZones() {
    Zones z;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) {
        char path[64], type[64];
        std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone%d/type", i);
        if (!ReadFile(path, type, sizeof(type))) continue;
        std::string t = type;
        std::snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone%d/temp", i);
        // Qualcomm's cpu-1-0-0 and cpuss-0, gpuss-0; MediaTek's and Exynos' cpu and gpu zones by those names
        if (t.rfind("cpu", 0) == 0 || t.find("cpu_") != std::string::npos) z.cpu.push_back(path);
        else if (t.find("gpu") != std::string::npos) z.gpu.push_back(path);
    }
    return z;
}

// degrees, -1 when none reads; zones give millidegrees, a few whole degrees
float Hottest(const std::vector<std::string>& paths) {
    float hot = -1;
    char buf[32];
    for (const std::string& p : paths) {
        if (!ReadFile(p.c_str(), buf, sizeof(buf))) continue;
        long v = std::strtol(buf, nullptr, 10);
        float c = std::abs(v) >= 1000 ? float(v) / 1000.0f : float(v);
        if (c > 0 && c < 150) hot = std::max(hot, c);
    }
    return hot;
}

float BatteryTemperature() {
    auto* env = static_cast<JNIEnv*>(SDL_GetAndroidJNIEnv());
    auto activity = static_cast<jobject>(SDL_GetAndroidActivity());
    if (!env || !activity) return -1;
    jclass cls = env->GetObjectClass(activity);
    jmethodID m = env->GetMethodID(cls, "batteryTemperature", "()I");
    jint tenths = m ? env->CallIntMethod(activity, m) : -1;
    if (env->ExceptionCheck()) {
        env->ExceptionClear();
        tenths = -1;
    }
    env->DeleteLocalRef(cls);
    env->DeleteLocalRef(activity);
    return tenths > 0 ? float(tenths) / 10.0f : -1;
}

}  // namespace

// once a second at most, from the overlay's thread
void SamplePerf() {
    using clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    static clock::time_point last;
    static CpuSample prev;
    static bool system_cpu = SystemCpu(prev) || !ProcessCpu(prev);
    static Zones zones = FindZones();
    // tried once: a denied read is logged by SELinux each time
    static bool kgsl = AdrenoBusy() >= 0;
    static bool logged = false;
    auto now = clock::now();
    if (now - last < std::chrono::seconds(1)) return;
    last = now;

    CpuSample s;
    if (system_cpu ? SystemCpu(s) : ProcessCpu(s)) {
        if (s.total > prev.total)
            g_cpu = std::clamp(100.0f * float(s.busy - prev.busy) / float(s.total - prev.total), 0.0f, 100.0f);
        prev = s;
    }
    float adreno = kgsl ? AdrenoBusy() : -1;
    g_gpu = adreno >= 0 ? adreno : VulkanGpuLoad();
    g_cpu_temp = Hottest(zones.cpu);
    g_gpu_temp = Hottest(zones.gpu);
    g_battery_temp = BatteryTemperature();
    if (!logged) {
        logged = true;
        LOGR("perf: CPU load from %s, GPU load from %s, %zu CPU and %zu GPU thermal zones (%s), battery %.1f C",
             system_cpu ? "/proc/stat" : "this process", kgsl ? "kgsl" : "Vulkan timestamps", zones.cpu.size(),
             zones.gpu.size(), g_cpu_temp >= 0 ? "readable" : "unreadable", g_battery_temp.load());
    }
}

float CpuLoad() { return g_cpu; }
float GpuLoad() { return g_gpu; }
float CpuTemp() { return g_cpu_temp; }
float GpuTemp() { return g_gpu_temp; }
float BatteryTemp() { return g_battery_temp; }

}  // namespace host

```

constexpr uint64_t kTapMs = 80;
constexpr uint64_t kCaptureMs = 250;  // PressedKey asked this recently: a key capture is up
// The wheel binds as two keys, codes no key has. A notch holds what is bound to it for one tap.

constexpr int kWheelDown = 0x0F;

uint64_t NowMs() {
    auto since = std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch();
    return uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(since).count()) + 1;
}

// what an action presses: 0-7 analog A B X Y black white LT RT, 8-15 the buttons bits, 16-19 the move keys,
// 20-23 the look keys
struct Target {

    size_t i = 0;
    while (kActions[i].action.id != id) i++;

constexpr size_t kPanelAction = HostAction("settings_panel");
struct Name {

// held from before the game had the input, these wait for release as the bound keys do
constexpr int kFixed[] = {VK_UP, VK_DOWN, VK_LEFT, VK_RIGHT, VK_RETURN, VK_BACK};

using Binds = std::array<std::vector<int>, kCount>;
std::mutex g_bind_lock;
Binds g_binds;

int Vk(const std::string& name) {
    for (const Name& n : kNames)
        if (strcasecmp(n.name, name.c_str()) == 0) return n.vk;
    return 0;
}

const char* NameOf(int vk) {
    for (const Name& n : kNames)
        if (n.vk == vk) return n.name;
    return nullptr;
}

std::vector<int> Parse(const std::string& list) {
    std::vector<int> out;
    size_t start = 0;
    while (start <= list.size()) {
        size_t comma = list.find(',', start);
        if (comma == std::string::npos) comma = list.size();
        if (int vk = Vk(list.substr(start, comma - start))) out.push_back(vk);
        start = comma + 1;
    }
    return out;
}

std::string Join(const std::vector<int>& vks) {
    std::string s;
    for (int vk : vks) {
        if (!s.empty()) s += ',';
        s += NameOf(vk);
    }
    return s;
}

bool Active() { return host::Foreground() && !app::MenuOpen(); }
bool Wheel(int vk) { return vk == kWheelUp || vk == kWheelDown; }
bool Down(int vk) {
    if (Wheel(vk)) return NowMs() - g_wheel_ms[vk == kWheelDown] < kTapMs;
    return vk > 0 && vk < 256 && g_down[size_t(vk)];
}
bool Mouse(int vk) {
    bool button = vk == VK_LBUTTON || vk == VK_RBUTTON || vk == VK_MBUTTON || vk == VK_XBUTTON1 || vk == VK_XBUTTON2;
    return button || Wheel(vk);
}
bool KeyCaptureUp() { return NowMs() - g_capture_ms <= kCaptureMs; }

bool HostKeyBound(size_t action, int vk) {
    if (KeyCaptureUp()) return false;
    std::lock_guard lock(g_bind_lock);
    const auto& b = g_binds[action];
    return std::find(b.begin(), b.end(), vk) != b.end();
}

// keys held from before the game had the input wait for release; true once none is held
bool UpdateSettle(const Binds& binds) {
    if (!g_settle) return true;
    for (auto& b : binds)
        for (int vk : b)
            if (Down(vk)) return false;
    for (int vk : kFixed)
        if (Down(vk)) return false;
    g_settle = false;
    return true;
}

struct Held {
    bool used = false;
    int stick[8] = {};  // move forward back left right, look up down left right
};

Held PressActions(const Binds& binds, Pad& p) {
    Held held;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < kCount; i++) {
        int b = kActions[i].button;
        if (b == kHostKey || !std::any_of(binds[i].begin(), binds[i].end(), Down)) continue;
        held.used = true;
        if (b >= kFirstMoveKey) held.stick[b - kFirstMoveKey] = 1;
        else if (b < kFirstButtonBit) p.analog[b] = 0xFF;
        else p.buttons |= uint16_t(1u << (b - kFirstButtonBit));
    }
    return held;
}

// SDL's scancodes as the virtual keys (common/keys.h) the bindings name, by position as on a US keyboard
int VkOf(SDL_Scancode s) {
    if (s >= SDL_SCANCODE_A && s <= SDL_SCANCODE_Z) return 'A' + (s - SDL_SCANCODE_A);
    if (s >= SDL_SCANCODE_1 && s <= SDL_SCANCODE_9) return '1' + (s - SDL_SCANCODE_1);
    if (s >= SDL_SCANCODE_F1 && s <= SDL_SCANCODE_F12) return VK_F1 + (s - SDL_SCANCODE_F1);
    if (s >= SDL_SCANCODE_KP_1 && s <= SDL_SCANCODE_KP_9) return VK_NUMPAD1 + (s - SDL_SCANCODE_KP_1);
    switch (s) {
        case SDL_SCANCODE_0: return '0';
        case SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN: case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_ENTER: return VK_RETURN;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_ESCAPE: return VK_ESCAPE;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSPACE: return VK_BACK;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_TAB: return VK_TAB;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_SPACE: return VK_SPACE;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_LSHIFT: case SDL_SCANCODE_RSHIFT: return VK_SHIFT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_LCTRL: case SDL_SCANCODE_RCTRL: return VK_CONTROL;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_LALT: case SDL_SCANCODE_RALT: return VK_MENU;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_CAPSLOCK: return VK_CAPITAL;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_UP: return VK_UP;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_DOWN: return VK_DOWN;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_LEFT: return VK_LEFT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHT: return VK_RIGHT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_INSERT: return VK_INSERT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_DELETE: return VK_DELETE;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_HOME: return VK_HOME;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_END: return VK_END;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_PAGEUP: return VK_PRIOR;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_PAGEDOWN: return VK_NEXT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_0: return VK_NUMPAD0;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_PLUS: return VK_ADD;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_MINUS: return VK_SUBTRACT;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_MULTIPLY: return VK_MULTIPLY;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_DIVIDE: return VK_DIVIDE;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_KP_PERIOD: return VK_DECIMAL;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_GRAVE: return VK_OEM_3;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_MINUS: return VK_OEM_MINUS;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_EQUALS: return VK_OEM_PLUS;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_LEFTBRACKET: return VK_OEM_4;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_RIGHTBRACKET: return VK_OEM_6;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_BACKSLASH: return VK_OEM_5;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_SEMICOLON: return VK_OEM_1;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_APOSTROPHE: return VK_OEM_7;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_COMMA: return VK_OEM_COMMA;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_PERIOD: return VK_OEM_PERIOD;
        case SDL_SCANCODE_SLASH: return VK_OEM_2;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

int VkOfButton(uint8_t b) {
    switch (b) {
        case SDL_BUTTON_LEFT: return VK_LBUTTON;
        case SDL_BUTTON_RIGHT: return VK_RBUTTON;
        case SDL_BUTTON_MIDDLE: return VK_MBUTTON;
        case SDL_BUTTON_X1: return VK_XBUTTON1;
        case SDL_BUTTON_X2: return VK_XBUTTON2;
        default: return 0;
    }
}

}  // namespace

void ReleaseCursor() { g_settle = true; }

void Keyboard(Pad& p) {
    if (!Active()) {
        g_settle = true;
        return;
    }
    Binds binds;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_bind_lock);
        binds = g_binds;
    }
    if (!UpdateSettle(binds)) return;
    bool fixed_down = std::any_of(std::begin(kFixed), std::end(kFixed), Down);
    Held held = PressActions(binds, p);
    const int* stick = held.stick;
    if (int x = stick[3] - stick[2]) p.lx = int16_t(x * kStickMax);
    if (int y = stick[0] - stick[1]) p.ly = int16_t(y * kStickMax);
    if (int x = stick[7] - stick[6]) p.rx = int16_t(x * kStickMax);
    if (int y = stick[4] - stick[5]) p.ry = int16_t(y * kStickMax);
    if (fixed_down || held.used) g_keyboard = true;
}

void SeenPad(const Pad& p) {
    constexpr int16_t kStickPushed = 16000;
    constexpr uint8_t kAnalogPushed = 0x20;
    auto pushed = [](int16_t v) { return v > kStickPushed || v < -kStickPushed; };
    auto pressed = [](uint8_t a) { return a > kAnalogPushed; };
    bool analog = std::any_of(std::begin(p.analog), std::end(p.analog), pressed);
    bool sticks = pushed(p.lx) || pushed(p.ly) || pushed(p.rx) || pushed(p.ry);
    if (p.buttons || analog || sticks) g_keyboard = false;
}

bool KeyboardActive() { return g_keyboard; }

const Action* Actions(size_t* count) {
    static const auto list = [] {
        std::array<Action, kCount> a{};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < kCount; i++) a[i] = kActions[i].action;
        return a;
    }();
    *count = kCount;
    return list.data();
}

std::string Binding(size_t action) {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_bind_lock);
    return action < kCount ? Join(g_binds[action]) : std::string();
}

void Bind(size_t action, int vk, int slot) {
    if (action >= kCount || slot < 0 || slot > 1 || (vk && !NameOf(vk))) return;
    if (kActions[action].button == kHostKey && Mouse(vk)) return;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_bind_lock);
        std::vector<int>& keys = g_binds[action];
        int slots[2] = {0, 0};
        for (size_t i = 0; i < keys.size() && i < 2; i++) slots[i] = keys[i];
        if (vk && slots[1 - slot] == vk) slots[1 - slot] = 0;
        slots[slot] = vk;
        if (!slots[0] && !slots[1] && action == kPanelAction) return;
        keys.clear();
        for (int k : slots) {
            if (k) keys.push_back(k);
        }
        game::Opt().keys[kActions[action].action.id] = Join(keys);
    }
    app::Save();
}

void ResetBindings() {
    game::Opt().keys.clear();
    LoadBindings();
    app::Save();
}

void LoadBindings() {
    std::lock_guard lock(g_bind_lock);
    const auto& keys = game::Opt().keys;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < kCount; i++) {
        auto it = keys.find(kActions[i].action.id);
        g_binds[i] = Parse(it != keys.end() ? it->second : kActions[i].action.defaults);
    }
}

int PressedKey() {
    g_capture_ms = NowMs();
    for (const Name& n : kNames)
        if (Down(n.vk)) return n.vk;
    return 0;
}

bool PanelKey(int vk) { return HostKeyBound(kPanelAction, vk); }

// the touch controls

using input::NowMs;

// what a finger on the screen does
// FeTap: a finger in a menu prompting the right stick, FEng's pointer not given yet: a tap or the stick
enum class Role : uint8_t { None, Stick, Look, Button, Drag, Pinch, FeMouse, Wheel, HudDrag, FeTap };

// a control of the touch layout: what it shows and presses, on the controller (analog 0-7, button bits from 8) or on
// the host. Where it sits is the layout's, which the player edits
enum : int { kSteerWheel = -5, kSteerRight = -4, kSteerLeft = -3, kPanel = -1, kAnalogA = 0, kAnalogB = 1, kAnalogX = 2, kAnalogY = 3, kAnalogLT = 6, kAnalogRT = 7 };
constexpr int kBit = 8;  // kBit + n: buttons bit n (dpad up down left right, start, back, left thumb, right thumb)
enum class Icon : uint8_t { Text, Pause, Gear, Back, Gyro, Up, Down, Left, Right, Wheel };
// how a control is drawn and touched: a circle, a shoulder's tab, a small pill, the dpad's rounded square, a racing
// game's tall pedal (the triggers). Its place's r is a circle's radius, the others' half height
enum class Shape : uint8_t { Round, Tab, Pill, Square, Pedal };
struct Button {
    const char* id;     // its key in layout.toml
    const char* label;  // in the layout editor
    Icon icon;
    int press;
    Shape shape = Shape::Round;
    const char* caption = nullptr;  // what it does in the game, under a face button
    bool keep = false;  // never hidden: the way back out of the menus
};
// the layout is set in the settings panel (TOUCH CONTROLS): its steering, opacity, size, and the editor that moves the
// controls, see the functions at the end. A Text control shows its label.
// the face buttons' captions are Carbon's controls (Y: Crew Member, A: Handbrake, B: Nitrous, X: Speedbreaker, Black: Change Camera, White: Rear View)
constexpr Button kButtons[] = {
    {"a", "A", Icon::Text, kAnalogA, Shape::Round, "E-BRAKE"},
    {"b", "B", Icon::Text, kAnalogB, Shape::Round, "NITROUS"},
    {"x", "X", Icon::Text, kAnalogX, Shape::Round, "SPEEDBREAKER"},
    {"y", "Y", Icon::Text, kAnalogY, Shape::Round, "CREW MEMBER"},
    {"black", "BLACK", Icon::Text, 4, Shape::Tab, "CHANGE CAMERA"},
    {"white", "WHITE", Icon::Text, 5, Shape::Round, "REAR VIEW"},
    {"lt", "LT", Icon::Text, kAnalogLT, Shape::Tab},
    {"rt", "RT", Icon::Text, kAnalogRT, Shape::Tab},
    {"start", "START", Icon::Text, kBit + 4, Shape::Pill},
    {"back", "BACK", Icon::Text, kBit + 5, Shape::Pill},
    {"panel", "Settings", Icon::Gear, kPanel, Shape::Round, nullptr, true},
    {"dpad_up", "Up", Icon::Up, kBit + 0, Shape::Square},
    {"dpad_down", "Down", Icon::Down, kBit + 1, Shape::Square},
    {"dpad_left", "Left", Icon::Left, kBit + 2, Shape::Square},
    {"dpad_right", "Right", Icon::Right, kBit + 3, Shape::Square},
    // the left stick pushed to a side, as a racing game's arrows steer; shown when STEERING is ARROWS
    {"steer_left", "Steer left", Icon::Left, kSteerLeft, Shape::Square},
    {"steer_right", "Steer right", Icon::Right, kSteerRight, Shape::Square},
    // a steering wheel turned by a finger dragged round it; shown when STEERING is WHEEL
    {"wheel", "Wheel", Icon::Wheel, kSteerWheel, Shape::Round},
};
constexpr size_t kButtonCount = std::size(kButtons);
constexpr size_t kStick = kButtonCount;  // the sticks' places, after the buttons'
constexpr size_t kRStick = kButtonCount + 1;
constexpr size_t kPlaces = kButtonCount + 2;
bool IsStick(size_t i) { return i >= kStick; }
const char* PlaceId(size_t i) { return i == kStick ? "stick" : i == kRStick ? "rstick" : kButtons[i].id; }

// a control the layout may hide: a button but the settings gear, the way back out of the menus, and the sticks (their
// drags then move nothing; the layout steers with arrows instead)
bool Hideable(int i) {
    if (i < 0) return false;
    return IsStick(size_t(i)) || !kButtons[size_t(i)].keep;
}

// where a control sits: its centre as shares of the screen's width and height, its radius in screen heights
struct Place {
    float x, y, r;
    bool hidden = false;
};
using Layout = std::array<Place, kPlaces>;
// The layout's places, as the editor's reset puts them: a b x y, black white, lt rt, start back, the settings, the
// dpad's up down left right, the steering arrows, the wheel, the left stick and the right stick.
// As a mobile racing game: steering arrows under the left thumb, the gas and brake pedals (RT, LT) under the right,
// Nitrous over the gas, the e-brake over the brake, Speedbreaker and Look Back near them; a small dpad for the menus
// high on the left, Back, the settings and Start along the top, Black (the camera) in the top right corner, the gear
// lever (the right stick) low in the middle. No left stick, no other shoulders
constexpr Layout kRacing = {{
    {0.80f, 0.50f, 0.06f}, {0.92f, 0.38f, 0.068f}, {0.665f, 0.60f, 0.052f}, {0.80f, 0.24f, 0.045f},
    {0.932f, 0.085f, 0.048f}, {0.068f, 0.085f, 0.048f},
    {0.765f, 0.85f, 0.085f}, {0.915f, 0.74f, 0.17f},
    {0.585f, 0.075f, 0.036f}, {0.415f, 0.075f, 0.036f}, {0.50f, 0.075f, 0.045f},
    {0.07f, 0.28f, 0.038f}, {0.07f, 0.46f, 0.038f}, {0.03f, 0.37f, 0.038f}, {0.11f, 0.37f, 0.038f},
    {0.065f, 0.82f, 0.095f}, {0.195f, 0.82f, 0.095f}, {0.13f, 0.78f, 0.16f},
    {0.13f, 0.82f, 0.10f, true}, {0.55f, 0.80f, 0.10f},
}};

constexpr float kStickZone = 0.42f;    // share of the width from the left a touch takes the stick in
constexpr float kFixedReach = 1.5f;    // FIXED sticks: their radii from the centre a touch takes them in
constexpr uint64_t kShownMs = 8000;     // the controls hide this long after the last touch while a pad is plugged in

struct Finger {
    SDL_FingerID id = 0;
    Role role = Role::None;
    size_t button = 0;     // or kStick, dragged in the editor
    float x0 = 0, y0 = 0;  // where it went down, pixels; in the editor, its offset from the control's centre
    float x = 0, y = 0;    // where it is
    uint64_t down_ms = 0;
    float angle = 0;    // Wheel: the finger's angle round the wheel's centre at its last move, degrees
};

std::mutex g_lock;
std::vector<Finger> g_fingers;

float g_stick_x = 0, g_stick_y = 0;  // -1 to 1, y up
float g_vinyl_x = 0, g_vinyl_y = 0;  // the vinyl screen's drag, as a left-stick deflection, -1 to 1, y up
float g_rstick_x = 0, g_rstick_y = 0;  // the right stick, a drag on the right of the screen
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_touch_ms{0};
std::atomic<uint64_t> g_back_until{0};  // the back key's tap of Start or B lasts until then
constexpr uint64_t kBackTapMs = 120;

// the layout in use, under g_lock
Layout g_layout = kRacing;
float g_opacity = 0.85f;
float g_scale = 1.0f;  // every control's size, on top of its own
// STICK MODE: floating, the left stick's side of the screen the left stick and a drag on the other the right stick
// from wherever the thumb lands; fixed, each stick where it is drawn alone, so a stray touch elsewhere moves nothing
bool g_fixed_sticks = false;
// STEERING, what steers in the RACING layout: its arrows, its wheel, or the phone tilted (gyro.cpp), neither shown
enum class Steering : uint8_t { Arrows, Wheel, Tilt };
constexpr const char* kSteeringIds[] = {"arrows", "wheel", "tilt"};
constexpr const char* kSteeringNames[] = {"ARROWS", "WHEEL", "TILT"};
std::atomic<Steering> g_steering{Steering::Arrows};
// the wheel's turn, degrees clockwise, and whether a finger holds it; let go it comes back to the middle
constexpr float kWheelLock = 90.0f;  // degrees for a full lock
float g_wheel_turn = 0;
bool g_wheel_held = false;
bool g_loaded = false;
// the editor: the layout before it opened (for Cancel), the control picked
enum class EditCategory : uint8_t { Race, Menu };
EditCategory g_edit_cat = EditCategory::Race;
std::atomic<bool> g_editing{false};
Layout g_before = kRacing;

};
Place g_menu_before[15];
constexpr Place kFeXbox[15] = {
    {0.885f, 0.745f, 0.055f},  // A (bottom)
    {0.943f, 0.620f, 0.055f},  // B (right)
    {0.827f, 0.620f, 0.055f},  // X (left)
    {0.885f, 0.495f, 0.055f},  // Y (top)
    {0.115f, 0.515f, 0.050f},  // dpad_up
    {0.115f, 0.765f, 0.050f},  // dpad_down
