        vkCmdBindIndexBuffer(Cb(), ib.buf, ib.off, a.index16 ? VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT16 : VK_INDEX_TYPE_UINT32);
        vkCmdDrawIndexed(Cb(), a.index_count, 1, 0, a.base_vertex, 0);
    } else {
        vkCmdDraw(Cb(), a.draw_count, 1, 0, 0);
    }
}

VkRect2D ScaledRect(const Target& t, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1) {
    float sc = float(t.w) / t.gw;
    int32_t l = std::clamp(int32_t(x0 * sc), 0, int32_t(t.w)), tp = std::clamp(int32_t(y0 * sc), 0, int32_t(t.h));
    int32_t r = std::clamp(int32_t(x1 * sc), 0, int32_t(t.w)), b = std::clamp(int32_t(y1 * sc), 0, int32_t(t.h));
    return {{l, tp}, {uint32_t(std::max(r - l, 0)), uint32_t(std::max(b - tp, 0))}};
}

void VulkanBackend::ClearTarget(Target& t, const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags,
                                uint32_t color, float z, uint32_t stencil) {
    std::vector<VkClearRect> rs;
    auto add = [&](const VkRect2D& r) {
        if (r.extent.width && r.extent.height) rs.push_back({r, 0, 1});
    };
    if (count && rects) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int32_t r[4];
            std::memcpy(r, rects + size_t(i) * sizeof(r), sizeof(r));
            add(ScaledRect(t, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3]));
        }
    } else {
        const auto& v = s.viewport;
        add(ScaledRect(t, int(v.x), int(v.y), int(v.x + v.w), int(v.y + v.h)));
    }
    t.drawn = true, t.writes++;
    if (rs.empty()) return;
    VkClearAttachment ca{};
    if (t.depth) {
        ca.aspectMask = ((flags & kClearZ) ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT : 0) |
                        ((flags & kClearStencil) && t.img.stencil ? VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT : 0);
        if (!ca.aspectMask) return;
        ca.clearValue.depthStencil = {std::clamp(z, 0.0f, 1.0f), stencil & 0xFF};
    } else {
        // pixels the CPU wrote before this clear go in first, a later upload would paint over the clear
        if (LatchCpuWrite(t)) UploadTarget(t, s.rt);
        ca.aspectMask = VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT;
        Color(color, ca.clearValue.color.float32);
    }
    // each rendering loads and stores its attachments whole, which on a tiled GPU costs about as much as drawing over
    // them: a clear goes into the rendering under way when that has the image, or, when it is all of it, is left for
    // the next rendering on it to load as cleared (the load ops of dynamic rendering or of a render pass)
    bool inside = rendering_ && (&t.img == rend_color_ || &t.img == rend_depth_);
    for (const VkClearRect& r : rs)
        inside = inside && r.rect.offset.x + r.rect.extent.width <= rend_w_ && r.rect.offset.y + r.rect.extent.height <= rend_h_;
    if (!inside) {
        const VkRect2D& r = rs[0].rect;
        if (rs.size() == 1 && !r.offset.x && !r.offset.y && r.extent.width == t.w && r.extent.height == t.h) {
            if (!t.depth) t.img.clear = ca.clearValue;
            if (ca.aspectMask & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT) t.img.clear.depthStencil.depth = ca.clearValue.depthStencil.depth;
            if (ca.aspectMask & VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_STENCIL_BIT) t.img.clear.depthStencil.stencil = ca.clearValue.depthStencil.stencil;
            t.img.pending |= ca.aspectMask;
            return;
        }
        if (t.depth) BeginRender(nullptr, &t.img);
        else BeginRender(&t.img, nullptr);
    }
    vkCmdClearAttachments(Cb(), 1, &ca, uint32_t(rs.size()), rs.data());
}

void VulkanBackend::Clear(const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color,
                          float z, uint32_t stencil) {
    Target* rt = (flags & kClearTarget) ? EnsureTarget(s.rt, false) : nullptr;
    Target* ds = (flags & (kClearZ | kClearStencil)) ? EnsureTarget(s.zs, true) : nullptr;
    for (Target* t : {rt, ds})
        if (t) ClearTarget(*t, s, count, rects, flags, color, z, stencil);
}

void VulkanBackend::Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t src_rects,
                         uint32_t dst_points) {
    Target* src_t = FindTarget(src, false);
    // pixels the CPU made: the copy happens in memory, textures and targets pick it up from there
    if (!src_t || !src_t->drawn) {
        if (!CopySurfaceMemory(src, dst, count, src_rects, dst_points)) {
            LOG_FIRST(8, "vulkan: CopyRects %08X to %08X skipped", src.data, dst.data);
        } else if (Target* dst_t = FindTarget(dst, false)) {
            UploadTarget(*dst_t, dst);
        }
        return;
    }
    Target* dst_t = EnsureTarget(dst, false);
    src_t = FindTarget(src, false);
    if (!dst_t || !src_t || src_t == dst_t) return;
    float dst_scale = float(dst_t->w) / dst_t->gw;
    bool listed = count && src_rects;
    // of different scales (an effect sized target, TargetScale): drawn over, in guest coordinates
    float src_scale = float(src_t->w) / src_t->gw;
    if (std::fabs(src_scale - dst_scale) > 0.01f) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0, n = listed ? count : 1; i < n; i++) {
            int32_t l = 0, t = 0, r = int32_t(src_t->gw), b = int32_t(src_t->gh), dx = 0, dy = 0;
            if (listed) {
                GuestRect g = ReadGuestRect(src_rects, i);
                l = g.left, t = g.top, r = g.right, b = g.bottom, dx = l, dy = t;
                if (dst_points) ReadGuestPoint(dst_points, i, dx, dy);
            }
            if (r <= l || b <= t) continue;
            float uv[4] = {float(l) / src_t->gw, float(t) / src_t->gh, float(r - l) / src_t->gw, float(b - t) / src_t->gh};
            VkRect2D to = ScaledRect(*dst_t, dx, dy, dx + r - l, dy + b - t);
            if (!to.extent.width || !to.extent.height) continue;
            uint32_t taps = uint32_t(std::max(1.0f, std::ceil(src_scale / dst_scale - 1e-3f)));
            Blit(dst_t->img, to, src_t->img, uv, {.alpha = true, .taps = taps});
        }
        dst_t->drawn = true, dst_t->writes++;
        return;
    }
    Transition(src_t->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);
    Transition(dst_t->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    uint32_t n = listed ? count : 1;
    std::vector<VkImageCopy> regions;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t l = 0, t = 0, r = std::min(src_t->w, dst_t->w), b = std::min(src_t->h, dst_t->h), dx = 0, dy = 0;
        if (listed) {
            GuestRect g = ReadGuestRect(src_rects, i);
            l = ScaleUnsigned(g.left, dst_scale);
            t = ScaleUnsigned(g.top, dst_scale);
            r = std::min(ScaleUnsigned(g.right, dst_scale), src_t->w);
            b = std::min(ScaleUnsigned(g.bottom, dst_scale), src_t->h);
            dx = l;
            dy = t;
            if (dst_points) {
                int32_t px, py;
                ReadGuestPoint(dst_points, i, px, py);
                dx = ScaleUnsigned(px, dst_scale);
                dy = ScaleUnsigned(py, dst_scale);
            }
        }
        if (r <= l || b <= t || dx >= dst_t->w || dy >= dst_t->h) continue;
        r = std::min(r, l + dst_t->w - dx);
        b = std::min(b, t + dst_t->h - dy);
        regions.push_back({{VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                           {int32_t(l), int32_t(t), 0},
                           {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1},
                           {int32_t(dx), int32_t(dy), 0},
                           {r - l, b - t, 1}});
    }
    if (!regions.empty())
        vkCmdCopyImage(Cb(), src_t->img.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, dst_t->img.image,
                       VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, uint32_t(regions.size()), regions.data());
    dst_t->drawn = true, dst_t->writes++;
}

// ---- read-backs

void VulkanBackend::Sync(uint32_t data, uint32_t) {
    auto it = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(data, false));
    if (it == targets_.end() || !it->second.drawn) return;
    Target& t = it->second;
    Image down;
    Image* src = CopySource(t, down);
    std::vector<uint8_t> px;
    bool ok = src && ReadBack(*src, t.gw, t.gh, px);
    Destroy(down);  // ReadBack waited for the GPU
    if (!ok) return;
    uint32_t pitch = GuestPitch(t.gw);
    uint8_t* guest = static_cast<uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(data));
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < t.gh; y++) std::memcpy(guest + size_t(y) * pitch, &px[size_t(y) * t.gw * 4], t.gw * 4);
    t.read = std::move(px);
    t.drawn = false;
    t.sig = MemSig(t.data, t.bytes);
}

void VulkanBackend::SyncLate(uint32_t data) {
    if (!DeliverLate(data)) Sync(data, 0);
    RecordLate(data);
}

bool VulkanBackend::DeliverLate(uint32_t data) {
    std::lock_guard lock(late_lock_);
    auto it = late_.find(data);
    if (it == late_.end()) return false;
    Late& l = it->second;
    uint64_t done = Completed(), now = presents_seen_.load();
    int best = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < kFrames; i++) {
        bool finished = l.fence[i] && l.fence[i] <= done;
        bool recent = now - l.frame[i] <= uint64_t(kFrames) + 1;
        if (finished && recent && (best < 0 || l.fence[i] > l.fence[best])) best = i;
    }
    if (best < 0) return false;
    if (l.fence[best] > l.delivered) {
        const uint8_t* p = l.rb[best].mem.map;
        uint32_t pitch = GuestPitch(l.gw);
        uint8_t* dst = static_cast<uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(data));
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < l.gh; y++) std::memcpy(dst + size_t(y) * pitch, p + size_t(y) * l.gw * 4, l.gw * 4);
        l.delivered = l.fence[best];
    }
    return true;
}

void VulkanBackend::RecordLate(uint32_t data) {
    auto it = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(data, false));
    if (it == targets_.end()) return;
    Target& t = it->second;
    t.sig = MemSig(t.data, t.bytes);
    t.read.clear();
    std::lock_guard lock(late_lock_);
    Late& l = late_[data];
    if (l.gw != t.gw || l.gh != t.gh) {
        for (Buffer& b : l.rb) Retire(b);
        Retire(l.down);
        l = Late{};
        l.gw = t.gw;
        l.gh = t.gh;
    }
    uint32_t slot = l.next;
    if (l.fence[slot] > Completed()) return;
    Image* src = CopySource(t, l.down);
    if (!src) return;
    if (!l.rb[slot].buf && !CreateBuffer(l.rb[slot], VkDeviceSize(t.gw) * t.gh * 4, VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT, true))
        return;
    EndRender();
    VkBufferImageCopy c{0, 0, 0, {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, {0, 0, 0}, {t.gw, t.gh, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(Cb(), src->image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, l.rb[slot].buf, 1, &c);
    VkMemoryBarrier mb{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    mb.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    mb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_HOST_READ_BIT;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(Cb(), VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_HOST_BIT, 0, 1, &mb, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr);
    l.fence[slot] = value_ + 1;  // the next Submit carries it
    l.frame[slot] = presents_;
    l.next = (slot + 1) % kFrames;
}

// ---- present

// the swap chain made again when Android gave a new window, the size or vsync changed; the surface too when the
// window is new, lost, or could not be made last time. false: nothing to show on, the frame is dropped
bool VulkanBackend::AcquireImage(uint32_t& index) {
    if (!host::Foreground()) return false;
    if (!surface_ || surface_lost_ || host::SurfaceEpoch() != surface_epoch_) {
        if (surface_) LOGI("vulkan: new surface (%s)", surface_lost_ ? "lost" : "new window");
        DestroySwapchain();
        if (surface_) vkDestroySurfaceKHR(instance_, surface_, nullptr);
        surface_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        if (!CreateSurface()) return false;
        swap_stale_ = true;
    }
    int w, h;
    host::WindowPixels(w, h);
    if (!swap_ || swap_stale_ || uint32_t(w) != swap_extent_.width || uint32_t(h) != swap_extent_.height ||
        app::Get().vsync != vsync_) {
        if (!CreateSwapchain()) return false;
    }
    // a bounded wait: a window Android is taking away may never hand an image back
    constexpr uint64_t kAcquireTimeout = 500'000'000;
    for (int tries = 0; tries < 2; tries++) {
        VkResult r = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(dev_, swap_, kAcquireTimeout, CurrentFrame().acquire, VK_NULL_HANDLE, &index);
        // suboptimal is left alone: Android says so every frame on a turned screen, where only the compositor's
        // rotation differs, and making the chain again each frame freed images the GPU was still drawing (Mali)
        if (r == VK_SUCCESS || r == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) return true;
        if (r == VK_TIMEOUT || r == VK_NOT_READY) return false;
        if (r == VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR) {
            surface_lost_ = true;
            return false;
        }
        if (r != VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || !CreateSwapchain()) return false;
    }
    return false;
}

void VulkanBackend::DrawFrame(Target* t, uint32_t index) {
    EndRender();
    VkCommandBuffer cb = Cb();
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER};
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = swap_images_[index];
    b.subresourceRange = {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1};
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT,
                         0, 0, nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &b);
    // the frame letterboxed to the game's aspect over black
    float aspect = game::Aspect();
    float w = float(swap_extent_.width), h = float(swap_extent_.height);
    float vw = std::min(w, h * aspect), vh = vw / aspect;
    float c[32] = {0, 0, 1, 1, gamma_ ? 1.0f : 0.0f, 0, 1, 1};
    // the screen filter and anti-aliasing, off unless the player picks them: the plain blit then
    uint32_t filter = game::Opt().screen_filter, aa = game::Opt().anti_aliasing;
    float brightness = float(std::clamp<uint32_t>(game::Opt().brightness, 50, 200)) / 100.0f;
    bool post = t && (filter || aa || brightness != 1.0f);
    if (post) {
        c[8] = 1.0f / float(std::max(t->w, 1u));
        c[9] = 1.0f / float(std::max(t->h, 1u));
        c[10] = float(t->gh ? t->gh : guest_h_);
        c[12] = float(filter);
        c[13] = aa == game::kAaFxaa ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
        c[14] = brightness;
        // HUD bounding boxes protection: keep HUD normal brightness while racing
        int hud_n = 0;
        if (game::Racing()) {
            hud_n = touch::GetHudBoxesUv(&c[16]);
        }
        c[15] = float(hud_n);
        // supersampled: the texels each screen pixel covers, averaged
        if (aa == game::kAaSsaa) c[6] = std::clamp(std::round(float(t->h) / std::max(vh, 1.0f)), 1.0f, 4.0f);
    }
    Alloc cbuf = Constants(c, sizeof(c));
    VkPipeline pipe = t ? FullScreenPipeline(post ? kPresentHlsl : kBlitHlsl, "psmain", swap_fmt_, VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED, false)
                        : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkDescriptorSet set = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (pipe) {
        Transition(t->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        Transition(lut_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
        const VkImageView views[4] = {t->img.view, lut_.view, VK_NULL_HANDLE, VK_NULL_HANDLE};
        const VkSampler samplers[4] = {linear_, point_, point_, point_};
        set = Set(views, samplers);
    }
    VkRenderingAttachmentInfoKHR ca{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_ATTACHMENT_INFO_KHR};
    ca.imageView = swap_views_[index];
    ca.imageLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    ca.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
    ca.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    ca.clearValue.color = {{0, 0, 0, 1}};
    VkRenderingInfoKHR ri{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDERING_INFO_KHR};
    ri.renderArea = {{0, 0}, swap_extent_};
    ri.layerCount = 1;
    ri.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
    ri.pColorAttachments = &ca;
    if (dynamic_) {
        begin_rendering_(cb, &ri);
    } else {
        VkRenderPassBeginInfo bi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO};
        bi.renderPass = Pass(swap_fmt_, VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED, VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT);
        bi.framebuffer = Framebuffer(swap_fmt_, VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED, swap_views_[index], VK_NULL_HANDLE,
                                     swap_extent_.width, swap_extent_.height);
        bi.renderArea = ri.renderArea;
        bi.clearValueCount = 1;
        bi.pClearValues = &ca.clearValue;
        vkCmdBeginRenderPass(cb, &bi, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    }
    if (pipe) {
        vkCmdBindPipeline(cb, VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS, pipe);
        BindSet(set, cbuf.off, cbuf.off);
        SetViewport((w - vw) / 2, (h - vh) / 2, vw, vh);
        SetScissor(0, 0, int32_t(w), int32_t(h));
        vkCmdDraw(cb, 3, 1, 0, 0);
    }
    RenderUi();
    if (dynamic_)
        end_rendering_(cb);
    else
        vkCmdEndRenderPass(cb);
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    b.dstAccessMask = 0;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, 0, 0,
                         nullptr, 0, nullptr, 1, &b);
}

void VulkanBackend::RenderUi() {
    if (!ui_) return;
    std::lock_guard lock(app::UiLock());
    if (ui::ApplyGameFont()) ImGui_ImplVulkan_CreateFontsTexture();  // waits for the queue before it swaps the texture
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_NewFrame();
    ui::NewFrame(float(swap_extent_.width), float(swap_extent_.height));
    ImGui::NewFrame();
    if (app::kGame.ui) app::kGame.ui(fps_);
    touch::Draw();
    ImGui::Render();
    ImGui_ImplVulkan_RenderDrawData(ImGui::GetDrawData(), Cb());
}

// the gamma LUT, two rows: row 0 the game's own gamma ramp, row 1 the player's brightness curve. The present
// shader used to apply the brightness as a per-pixel pow() (2.6M of them a frame on a 1080p phone); a lookup
// into the second row is the same curve for a texture fetch, and the HUD mask lerps back to the plain colour
void VulkanBackend::UploadGammaRamp() {
    ramp_dirty_ = false;
    float brightness = float(std::clamp<uint32_t>(game::Opt().brightness, 50, 200)) / 100.0f;
    Alloc a = Upload(256 * 2 * 4, 16);
    bool identity = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        uint8_t* p0 = a.cpu + i * 4;
        p0[0] = ramp_[512 + i];
        p0[1] = ramp_[256 + i];
        p0[2] = ramp_[i];
        p0[3] = 255;
        uint8_t* p1 = a.cpu + (256 + i) * 4;
        uint8_t b = uint8_t(std::lround(std::pow(float(i) / 255.0f, 1.0f / brightness) * 255.0f));
        p1[0] = p1[1] = p1[2] = b;
        p1[3] = 255;
        identity &= ramp_[i] == i && ramp_[256 + i] == i && ramp_[512 + i] == i;
    }
    gamma_ = !identity;
    lut_brightness_ = brightness;
    Transition(lut_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
    VkBufferImageCopy c{a.off, 0, 0, {VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1}, {0, 0, 0}, {256, 2, 1}};
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(Cb(), a.buf, lut_.image, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &c);
    Transition(lut_, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
}

// textures kept by count and by bytes: without BC (PowerVR, Mali) DXT is decoded to BGRA, 4 to 8 times its size, and a
// thousand of those ran a phone out of memory within minutes (#17)
void VulkanBackend::ReleaseOldTextures() {
    constexpr uint64_t kSweepEvery = 60;
    constexpr size_t kTexturesKept = 1024;  // a phone has less memory than a PC: fewer kept
    constexpr uint64_t kIdleFrames = 600;
    constexpr VkDeviceSize kTextureBytes = 384ull << 20;
    if (presents_ % kSweepEvery != 0) return;
    VkDeviceSize bytes = 0;
    for (const auto& [key, t] : textures_) bytes += t.img.mem.size;
    if (textures_.size() <= kTexturesKept && bytes <= kTextureBytes) return;
    std::vector<std::pair<uint64_t, uint64_t>> lru;  // last frame drawn, key
    for (auto it = textures_.begin(); it != textures_.end();) {
        if (it->second.frame + kIdleFrames < presents_) {
            bytes -= it->second.img.mem.size;
            Retire(it->second.img);
            it = textures_.erase(it);
        } else {
            lru.push_back({it->second.frame, it->first});
            ++it;
        }
    }
    if (bytes <= kTextureBytes) return;
    // still over: the least recently drawn go, but none drawn in the last second; those are made again when drawn
    std::sort(lru.begin(), lru.end());
    for (const auto& [frame, key] : lru) {
        if (bytes <= kTextureBytes || frame + kSweepEvery >= presents_) break;
        auto it = textures_.find(key);
        bytes -= it->second.img.mem.size;
        Retire(it->second.img);
        textures_.erase(it);
    }
}

void VulkanBackend::ApplySettings() {
    float want = app::RenderScale(guest_h_);
    if (std::fabs(want - scale_) <= 1e-4f) return;
    Submit(true, false);
    for (auto& [key, t] : targets_) {
        Retire(t.img);
        Retire(t.fb);
    }
    targets_.clear();
    for (auto& [data, c] : cubes_) Retire(c.img);
    cubes_.clear();
    full_scale_.clear();
    draw_rt_ = draw_ds_ = nullptr;
    scale_ = want;
    LOGI("vulkan: render scale %.3f", scale_);
}

void VulkanBackend::SavePipelineCache() {
    size_t size = 0;
    if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(dev_, cache_, &size, nullptr) != VK_SUCCESS || size == cache_saved_) return;
    std::vector<char> blob(size);
    if (vkGetPipelineCacheData(dev_, cache_, &size, blob.data()) != VK_SUCCESS) return;
    std::filesystem::path p = app::ExeDir() / "shadercache" / "pipelines.bin", tmp = p;
    tmp += ".tmp";
    {
        std::ofstream f(tmp, std::ios::binary);
        f.write(blob.data(), std::streamsize(size));
    }
    std::error_code ec;
    std::filesystem::rename(tmp, p, ec);
    cache_saved_ = size;
}

void VulkanBackend::Present(const Surface& front) {
    Target* t = EnsureTarget(front, false);
    if (t && LatchCpuWrite(*t)) UploadTarget(*t, front);
    // the brightness curve lives in the LUT's second row, so a changed brightness re-bakes it
    float brightness = float(std::clamp<uint32_t>(game::Opt().brightness, 50, 200)) / 100.0f;
    if (ramp_dirty_ || brightness != lut_brightness_) UploadGammaRamp();
    uint32_t index = 0;
    auto at = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    bool shown = AcquireImage(index);
    g_perf.acquire_ns += SinceNs(at);
    if (shown) {
        present_index_ = index;
        DrawFrame(t, index);
    }
    bool timed = pass_log_ && pass_times_ && pass_stamps_;
    if (timed) vkCmdWriteTimestamp(Cb(), VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_BOTTOM_OF_PIPE_BIT, pass_times_, pass_stamps_++);
    Submit(false, shown);
    if (timeline_ok_) QueuePoolReset(CurrentFrame());
    present_value_[presents_ % (kFrames + 1)].store(value_);
    if (pass_log_) {
        // a stall every ten seconds, for the diagnostic only
        std::string out;
        std::vector<uint64_t> t(pass_stamps_);
        WaitValue(value_);
        if (timed && vkGetQueryPoolResults(dev_, pass_times_, 0, pass_stamps_, t.size() * 8, t.data(), 8,
                                           VK_QUERY_RESULT_64_BIT) == VK_SUCCESS) {
            uint64_t mask = time_bits_ >= 64 ? ~0ull : (1ull << time_bits_) - 1;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < pass_list_.size() && i + 1 < t.size(); i++) {
                char ms[32];
                std::snprintf(ms, sizeof(ms), " %.2f", double((t[i + 1] - t[i]) & mask) * props_.limits.timestampPeriod / 1e6);
                out += " [" + pass_list_[i] + ms + "]";
            }
        }
        LOGR("perf: frame %llu renderings (GPU ms to the next):%s", (unsigned long long)presents_, out.c_str());
    }
    if (shown) {
        VkPresentInfoKHR pi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR};
        pi.waitSemaphoreCount = 1;
        pi.pWaitSemaphores = &swap_done_[index];
        pi.swapchainCount = 1;
        pi.pSwapchains = &swap_;
        pi.pImageIndices = &index;
        VkResult r = vkQueuePresentKHR(queue_, &pi);
        if (r == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) swap_stale_ = true;
        if (r == VK_ERROR_SURFACE_LOST_KHR) surface_lost_ = true;
    }
    pass_list_.clear();
    pass_stamps_ = 0;
    pass_log_ = diag::Perf() && time_bits_ && presents_ % 600 == 599;
    presents_++;
    presents_seen_.store(presents_);
    frame_++;
    Frame& next = CurrentFrame();
    auto wt = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    ResetFrame(next);
    if (timeline_ok_) AwaitPoolReset(next);
    else vkResetCommandPool(dev_, next.pool, 0);
    g_perf.frame_wait_ns += SinceNs(wt);
    Begin();
    if (pass_log_) {
        if (!pass_times_) {
            VkQueryPoolCreateInfo qi{VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_QUERY_POOL_CREATE_INFO};
            qi.queryType = VK_QUERY_TYPE_TIMESTAMP;
            qi.queryCount = kPassStamps;
            if (vkCreateQueryPool(dev_, &qi, nullptr, &pass_times_) != VK_SUCCESS) pass_times_ = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }
        if (pass_times_) vkCmdResetQueryPool(Cb(), pass_times_, 0, kPassStamps);
    }
    ReleaseOldTextures();
    fps_n_++;
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    double el = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - fps_t_).count();
    if (el >= 0.5) {
        fps_ = fps_n_ / el;
        fps_n_ = 0;
        fps_t_ = now;
        if (time_bits_) g_gpu_load = float(std::min(100.0, gpu_ns_ / (el * 1e7)));
        gpu_ns_ = 0;
    }
    if (presents_ % 600 == 0) SavePipelineCache();
    if (!preload_started_ && game::Opt().shader_preload) StartPreload();
    ApplySettings();
}

// the slot is not reused before the caller's wait: the title runs at most one present ahead
void VulkanBackend::WaitGpuFrame(uint64_t n) { WaitValue(present_value_[n % (kFrames + 1)].load()); }

VulkanBackend* g_vulkan = nullptr;

}  // namespace

std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateBackend() {
    auto backend = std::make_unique<VulkanBackend>();
    g_vulkan = backend.get();
    return backend;
}

void WaitGpuFrame(uint64_t n) {
    if (g_vulkan) g_vulkan->WaitGpuFrame(n);
}

// DXT1, 3 or 5 blocks as BGRA texels, for src/game/prompts.cpp's icons
void DecodeBlocks(Host host, const std::vector<uint8_t>& in, uint32_t row_pitch, uint32_t w, uint32_t h,
                  std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    DecodeDxt(host, in, row_pitch, w, h, 1, out);
}

}  // namespace gpu

namespace host {
float VulkanGpuLoad() { return gpu::g_gpu_load.load(std::memory_order_relaxed); }
}  // namespace host

`sdk/README.md`:

```md
# Xbox XBE Recomp

A tool for creating unofficial native PC ports of original Xbox games. Games are statically recompiled from their x86 XBE into native 64 bit Windows executables. The game's x86 code is translated to C++ ahead of time. The Xbox kernel and the XDK libraries (Direct3D 8, DirectSound, XAPI, XNet) are implemented at the API level on Windows. Everything is drawn with a native Direct3D 12 renderer and played through XAudio2.

This tool was originally created for porting [Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell: Double Agent](https://github.com/TGP482/SCDoubleAgent-XBERecomp) and later used to port [BLACK](https://github.com/TGP482/BLACK-XBERecomp)

> [!NOTE]
> This project does not include any game assets. You must provide the files from your own legally acquired copy of the game to install or build.

## Installation

- Put this repository in your game repository as `sdk/`. This can be a copy or a submodule.
- In the game's `CMakeLists.txt`:
   ```cmake
   include(sdk/cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake)
   file(GLOB XBE_HOST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*/*.cpp)
   list(FILTER XBE_HOST_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/game/")
   add_xbe_image(MyGame default.xbe game.toml 128 game)
   ```
- Build with Clang and Ninja (`clang++`, `-fuse-ld=lld`). Zydis, toml++, Dear ImGui and SDL3 are fetched by CMake.

## Game Setup

1. Copy `templates/game` to a new repository and put this SDK in it as `sdk/`. Set `GAME_TITLE`, `GAME_XBE` and `GAME_EXE` at the top of `build.bat` (`GAME_EXE` in `release.bat` too), and the target and xbe in `add_xbe_image` in `CMakeLists.txt`.
2. Put the game's XBE and its data folders in the `assets` folder. No game files, keys or generated code belong in any repository.
3. Run `xbe_symbols`, which `build.bat` does on the first build:
   ```
   xbe_symbols assets\default.xbe sdk\xdk --library MyGame.dll --out config\game.toml
   ```
   This prints the XBE's library versions, picks `xdk/<build>/signatures.toml` and finds the XDK functions and data the host replaces, then writes the config: `[xbe]` with a partition count and the code sections, the `layout.toml` include, `[symbols]` and `[data]`. Misses and ambiguous names are listed and left at 0, which become trapping stubs. It stops when no `signatures.toml` exists for the XBE's build.
4. Fill in `app::kGame` in `src/common/game_info.cpp`: title, window name, log and settings file names, splash, the xbe to exe table, game options, and the hooks for loading, the window, drawing and the pads.
5. Game hooks go in `src/game`. Define `X86_FUNC(sub_XXXXXXXX)` to replace a recompiled function, and call `__imp__sub_XXXXXXXX` to reach the original. `python sdk/tools/symbols/xbe2pe.py config/game.toml game.exe` writes a flat PE with the recompiled functions as exports for Ghidra.
6. Run `build.bat`. One game repo can build several images, one config and `add_xbe_image` each; `--name` sets the config's `generated/<name>`, which is the folder argument of `add_xbe_image`.

A new XDK build needs `xdk/<build>/layout.toml` and signatures made from titles whose configs are complete: `xbe_symbols --sign config/a.toml [config/b.toml] --out sdk/xdk/<build>/signatures.toml`. Signatures are lengths and hashes of the functions with addresses masked, never library code.

## Features

### Recompiler
- **Function Discovery** - Finds every function in the XBE by following direct calls, code pointers and the gaps between known functions.
- **Jump Tables** - Resolves switch tables of every form the Xbox compiler writes, including byte indexed and backwards tables, memcpy tables and copy sleds.
- **C++ Exceptions** - Supports C++ exceptions, with try and catch blocks working as on the Xbox.
- **x87, SSE and MMX** - Translates x87, SSE and MMX instructions, with the x87 register stack tracked at run time.
- **Overridable Functions** - Makes every recompiled function replaceable, allowing a game to override any of them without editing generated code.
- **Instruction Hooks** - Adds `[[hook]]`, which calls a game function before or after any instruction, and can return from or jump within the function.
- **Analysis Overrides** - Adds `[[function]]`, `[[switch]]` and `[xbe] data_ranges` to add functions, set switch targets and mark data the analysis gets wrong.
- **Incremental Builds** - Only rewrites generated files when their content changes, keeping rebuilds fast.
- **Game Code on the Player's PC** - Builds the recompiled code into `<exe>.dll` on the first start of a release, from the player's own XBE, with the bundled recompiler, Clang and LLD behind a progress window. A release ships no game code.
- **XDK Signatures** - Finds the XDK functions and data in a new game automatically and writes its config.
- **LTCG Libraries** - Supports games built with link time code generation, where library functions take their arguments in registers.

### CPU and Kernel
- **Guest Calls** - Adds indirect calls and host calls into game code, with the Xbox's 733 MHz timer and Pentium III CPUID.
- **x87 Precision** - Follows the game's x87 precision setting, giving the same results as on the Xbox.
- **CRT Math** - Computes the game's math functions on the host, fixing math that returned invalid results at random.
- **Kernel** - Implements threads, waits, files, memory, crypto and EEPROM settings, with game files read from host folders or a disc image.
- **Image Switching** - Relaunches into the matching executable when the game loads another XBE, keeping the window on screen without a gap.

### Graphics
- **Direct3D 8** - Implements Direct3D 8 as the XDK does it, including immediate mode draws, palettes, gamma ramps and Direct3D code built into the game.
- **Native Direct3D 12 Renderer** - Translates the Xbox's vertex programs, pixel combiners and fixed function pipeline to HLSL, with rendering on its own thread.
- **Renderer Extensions** - Allows a game to change render targets, add passes and add to the generated shaders through `gpu::Extension`, set with `gpu::SetExtension` from `GameInfo::init`.

### Audio
- **DirectSound** - Mixes sound in software through XAudio2, with Xbox ADPCM, streams, mix bins and the effects image.

### Input
- **Controller** - Supports Xbox, PlayStation and Switch controllers through SDL3, with hot plugging and rumble.

### General
- **Disc Images** - Runs the game from an ISO in the `assets` folder, either a whole disc dump or the game partition, or from the extracted data files.
- **System Link** - System Link can be played over LAN, or by directly connecting to a friend's IP address.
- **Bink Movies** - Fixes Bink movies playing too fast above 30 FPS and crashing on fast reads, for games that use Bink.
- **Crash Dumps** - Writes crash dumps to a `CrashDumps` folder beside the exe.

### Miscellaneous
- **Boot Splash** - Place a `splash.png` (or `.bmp`) beside the exe to display a splash screen at launch.
- **Diagnostics** - Logs frame timing with `XBE_PERF`, captures a frame with F3 when `XBE_CAPTURE_DIR` is set and enables the Direct3D 12 debug layer with `XBE_D3D12_DEBUG`.
- **Headless Harness** - Builds and runs a game on Linux without a window, GPU, audio or controller, for testing.
- **SDK Sync** - Keeps the `sdk/` copies in game repositories in step with this repository.

## Credits

- [XenonRecomp](https://github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp) for the overridable function layout and instruction hooks this follows.
- [Zydis](https://github.com/zyantific/zydis) for decoding x86 instructions, [toml++](https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus) for the configs, [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) for the settings overlay and [SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL) for the window, input and controllers.
- [xemu](https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu) and [Cxbx-Reloaded](https://github.com/Cxbx-Reloaded/Cxbx-Reloaded) as references for the Xbox's hardware and API behaviour. This project does not use emulation or any emulator code.

`sdk/cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake`:

```cmake
# Original Xbox static recompilation: xbe_recomp, the host runtime and add_xbe_image()
include_guard(GLOBAL)

get_filename_component(XBE_SDK_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/.. ABSOLUTE)
# build scripts find the SDK's xdk folder and THIRD_PARTY.txt through this
file(TO_NATIVE_PATH "${XBE_SDK_DIR}" XBE_SDK_DIR_NATIVE)
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk_dir.txt "${XBE_SDK_DIR_NATIVE}\n")

include(FetchContent)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ZYDIS_BUILD_DOXYGEN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(zydis GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/zyantific/zydis.git GIT_TAG v4.1.1 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_Declare(tomlplusplus GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus.git GIT_TAG v3.4.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_Declare(imgui GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git GIT_TAG v1.91.0 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
# SDL3 for controllers, static so it links into the exe
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_RENDER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_GPU OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_CAMERA OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(SDL3 GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git GIT_TAG release-3.4.16 GIT_SHALLOW TRUE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(zydis tomlplusplus imgui SDL3)

# x86 to C++ recompiler
file(GLOB XBE_RECOMP_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/tools/recomp/*.cpp)
add_executable(xbe_recomp ${XBE_RECOMP_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(xbe_recomp PRIVATE ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/runtime ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/tools/recomp)
target_compile_definitions(xbe_recomp PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_link_libraries(xbe_recomp PRIVATE Zydis tomlplusplus::tomlplusplus)

# XDK signature scanner that writes a new title's config
add_executable(xbe_symbols ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/tools/symbols/main.cpp)
target_include_directories(xbe_symbols PRIVATE ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/runtime)
target_compile_definitions(xbe_symbols PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
target_link_libraries(xbe_symbols PRIVATE Zydis tomlplusplus::tomlplusplus)

set(XBE_IMGUI_SOURCES
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_dx12.cpp)

file(GLOB XBE_RUNTIME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/runtime/*/*.cpp)
# SDL's headers go to the input code alone (it is linked LINK_ONLY), so the generated sources' compile line stays the same
set_source_files_properties(${XBE_SDK_DIR}/runtime/core/input.cpp PROPERTIES INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${sdl3_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

# One executable per recompiled image: its code from config/<config> (partitions as that config sets them),
# the SDK runtime, XBE_HOST_SOURCES shared by every image of the game, and src/<game_dir> hooks only this image has.
# Expects assets/<xbe> and the config's out = "generated/<game_dir>". At run time the game may be a disc image instead.
function(add_xbe_image target xbe config partitions game_dir)
    set(GEN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/${game_dir})
    set(GEN_SOURCES ${GEN}/x86_func_mapping.cpp)
    math(EXPR last "${partitions} - 1")
    foreach(i RANGE ${last})
        list(APPEND GEN_SOURCES ${GEN}/x86_recomp.${i}.cpp)
    endforeach()
    file(GLOB configs CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/config/*.toml ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/xdk/*/*.toml)
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT ${GEN}/codegen.stamp
        BYPRODUCTS ${GEN_SOURCES} ${GEN}/x86_recomp_shared.h ${GEN}/image_symbols.h
        COMMAND xbe_recomp config/${config} --xdk ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/xdk
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch ${GEN}/codegen.stamp
        DEPENDS xbe_recomp ${configs} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/${xbe}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Recompiling ${xbe}"
        VERBATIM)
    add_custom_target(recompile_${target} DEPENDS ${GEN}/codegen.stamp)
    set_source_files_properties(${GEN_SOURCES} PROPERTIES GENERATED TRUE
        COMPILE_OPTIONS "-O2;-fno-strict-aliasing;-Wno-unused-label;-Wno-parentheses-equality;-Wno-unused-variable")
    file(GLOB GAME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/${game_dir}/*.cpp)
    # the xbe's SHA-1: the executable checks the game it finds is the release it was made from
    set(xbe_file ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/${xbe})
    set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${xbe_file})
    file(SHA1 ${xbe_file} xbe_sha1)
    set(XBE_HASH ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${target}_xbe.cpp)
    file(CONFIGURE OUTPUT ${XBE_HASH} CONTENT "extern const char kImageSha1[] = \"${xbe_sha1}\";\n")
    add_executable(${target} WIN32 ${XBE_RUNTIME_SOURCES} ${XBE_HOST_SOURCES} ${GAME_SOURCES} ${GEN_SOURCES} ${XBE_IMGUI_SOURCES} ${XBE_HASH})
    add_dependencies(${target} recompile_${target})
    target_include_directories(${target} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src ${XBE_SDK_DIR}/runtime ${GEN})
    target_include_directories(${target} SYSTEM PRIVATE ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR})
    target_compile_options(${target} PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing)
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE tomlplusplus::tomlplusplus $<LINK_ONLY:SDL3::SDL3-static> d3d12 dxgi dxguid d3dcompiler xaudio2 ole32 windowscodecs dbghelp winmm dwmapi ws2_32)
    # lld keeps the recompiled weak functions overridable by the host ones
    target_link_options(${target} PRIVATE -fuse-ld=lld -g)
endfunction()

```

`sdk/harness/README.md`:

```md
# Headless harness

Builds and runs one image of a game on Linux without a window, GPU, audio device or pad: the recompiled code and
the SDK runtime as they are, with these stand ins.

- `app_headless.cpp` the app side: default settings, the run folder as the exe folder, no splash or handover
- `pad_script.cpp` port 0 from a script, then `GameInfo::pad` as on Windows
- `null_audio.cpp` the mixer pulled every 10 ms, output dropped
- `null_backend.cpp` counts frames, lists draws, draws chosen frames with `reference_renderer.cpp` (CPU, into guest memory)
- `main_test.cpp` runs `GameInfo::init` and `window` (with no window), then boots the image
- `compat/` the few Win32, Winsock and DXGI names portable sources use

Needs clang and the game's generated code. The game repo supplies stand ins for its own Windows only sources.

## Build

```
sdk/harness/build.sh -r <repo> -g <generated/image> -o <out> [-n exe] [-x regex]... [-e source]... [-G gen objects]
```

`-x` leaves sources out, `-e` adds sources, `-G` shares the generated objects between builds.

## Run

```
sdk/harness/run.sh -x <exe> -g <game folder> -o <out> [-t seconds] [-s script]... [-n instances] [-d seconds]
```

Instance k runs in `<out>/k` with its own `logs`, `hdd` and `cap`. With more than one instance each gets
`INSTANCE=k` and they find each other over system link on 127.0.0.k. The exe alone: `<exe> <game folder> [--instance N]`.

Environment:

- `SCRIPT` pad script: lines of `frame buttons [frames held]` (default 8), `#` comments, buttons joined with `+`:
  `UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT START BACK A B X Y LT RT LS LSD LSL LSR`. Frames are presented frames.
- `cmd` file in the run folder: `buttons [frames held]`, pressed once when read
- `REF=N` every Nth frame drawn by the reference renderer into `cap/ref_<frame>.tga`
- `snap` file in the run folder: the next two frames drawn into `snap_1.tga` and `snap_2.tga`
- `CAP=N` every Nth frame's draws listed in `cap/draws_<frame>.txt`
- `PROBES="x,y x,y"` log every colour the reference renderer writes at those pixels of linear `PROBE_WIDTH` (640) wide
  targets; `TRACE="x,y"` logs the combiner registers there
- `XBE_PERF` as on Windows

A frame drawn by the reference renderer takes long; a button held across one can auto repeat in the game's menus.

```

`sdk/harness/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# build.sh: the headless harness exe of one image, on Linux with clang
#   -r repo (holding sdk/ and src/)   -g generated folder of the image   -o out folder
#   -n exe name (default: the generated folder's name)
#   -x regex of sources to leave out (repeatable)   -e extra source file (repeatable)
#   -G folder for the generated objects (default <out>/gen), shared between builds of the same generated code
# env: CXX (clang++), JOBS (nproc)
# Leaves out the window, SDL input, XAudio2 and D3D12 parts of the runtime and the sources of the repo's other images
# (src/<name> for each other folder beside the generated one); the harness supplies their stand ins.
set -e
EXCL=(); EXTRA=()
while getopts r:g:o:n:x:e:G: opt; do
    case $opt in
        r) REPO=$OPTARG ;; g) GEN=$OPTARG ;; o) OUT=$OPTARG ;; n) EXE=$OPTARG ;;
        x) EXCL+=("$OPTARG") ;; e) EXTRA+=("$(realpath "$OPTARG")") ;; G) GEN_OBJ=$OPTARG ;;
        *) sed -n 2,8p "$0"; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done
[ -n "$REPO" ] && [ -n "$GEN" ] && [ -n "$OUT" ] || { sed -n 2,8p "$0"; exit 2; }
REPO=$(realpath "$REPO"); GEN=$(realpath "$GEN"); mkdir -p "$OUT"; OUT=$(realpath "$OUT")
EXE=${EXE:-$(basename "$GEN")}; GEN_OBJ=${GEN_OBJ:-$OUT/gen}; mkdir -p "$GEN_OBJ" "$OUT/host"
H=$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")"); RT=$REPO/sdk/runtime
CXX=${CXX:-clang++}; JOBS=${JOBS:-$(nproc)}
BASE="-std=c++20 -march=x86-64-v2 -fno-strict-aliasing"
HOST="$BASE -O1 -g -I$REPO/src -I$RT -I$GEN -I$H -I$H/compat -DXBE_RAW_VERTICES=0 -DXBE_RENDER_THREAD=0"

# generated code, an object rebuilt only when its partition is newer
export CXX BASE RT GEN GEN_OBJ
ls "$GEN"/x86_recomp.*.cpp "$GEN"/x86_func_mapping.cpp | xargs -P "$JOBS" -I{} sh -c '
    o="$GEN_OBJ/$(basename {} .cpp).o"; [ "$o" -nt {} ] && exit 0
    $CXX $BASE -O1 -g0 -w -I"$RT" -I"$GEN" -c {} -o "$o.tmp" && mv "$o.tmp" "$o"'

others=$(ls "$GEN/.." | grep -vx "$(basename "$GEN")" | paste -sd'|' -)
SRC=$(ls "$RT"/*/*.cpp | grep -Ev "/runtime/app/|/core/input.cpp|/gpu/d3d12.cpp|/audio/xaudio2.cpp")
SRC="$SRC $(ls "$REPO"/src/*/*.cpp | grep -Ev "/src/(${others:-^$})/" || true)"
SRC="$SRC $(ls "$H"/*.cpp) ${EXTRA[*]}"
for x in "${EXCL[@]}"; do SRC=$(echo $SRC | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -Ev -- "$x"); done

# host objects, keyed by the flags; rebuilt when the source or any header of the repo, harness or image is newer
stamp=$(echo "$HOST" | md5sum | cut -c1-8)
newest=$(find "$RT" "$REPO/src" "$H" "$GEN/image_symbols.h" -name '*.h' -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -n | tail -1 | cut -d' ' -f2)
objs=()
for f in $SRC; do
    o=$OUT/host/$(echo "${f#/}" | tr / _ | sed "s/\.cpp$/.$stamp.o/"); objs+=("$o")
    [ "$o" -nt "$f" ] && [ "$o" -nt "$newest" ] && continue
    echo "compile $f"
    rm -f "$o"
    $CXX $HOST -c "$f" -o "$o" &
    [ "$(jobs -r | wc -l)" -ge "$JOBS" ] && wait -n
done
wait
$CXX -o "$OUT/$EXE" "${objs[@]}" "$GEN_OBJ"/*.o -lpthread
echo "built $OUT/$EXE"

```

// harness only: Winsock names on POSIX sockets
#include <arpa/inet.h>

#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <thread>
typedef int SOCKET; typedef int BOOL; typedef uint32_t DWORD; typedef unsigned long u_long; typedef uint16_t WORD;
#define INVALID_SOCKET (-1)
#define FALSE 0
#define MAKEWORD(a, b) ((WORD)(((a) & 0xff) | (((b) & 0xff) << 8)))
struct WSADATA { int x; };
inline int WSAStartup(WORD, WSADATA*) { return 0; }
enum { WSAEWOULDBLOCK = 10035, WSAECONNRESET = 10054, WSAEINVAL = 10022, WSAENOTSOCK = 10038, WSAEAFNOSUPPORT = 10047,
       WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT = 10044, WSAETIMEDOUT = 10060, WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND = 11001, WSA_IO_PENDING = 997,
       WSA_IO_INCOMPLETE = 996, WSA_OPERATION_ABORTED = 995, WSAEINPROGRESS = 10036, WSAENOTCONN = 10057,
       WSAECONNREFUSED = 10061, WSAEADDRINUSE = 10048, WSAEMSGSIZE = 10040 };
inline int WSAGetLastError() {
    switch (errno) {
        case EAGAIN: case EINPROGRESS: return WSAEWOULDBLOCK;
        case ECONNRESET: return WSAECONNRESET; case ENOTCONN: return WSAENOTCONN; case ECONNREFUSED: return WSAECONNREFUSED;
        case EADDRINUSE: return WSAEADDRINUSE; case EINVAL: return WSAEINVAL; case EMSGSIZE: return WSAEMSGSIZE;
        default: return 10000 + errno;
    }
}
inline int closesocket(SOCKET s) { return close(s); }
// Winsock's FIONBIO and FIONREAD
#undef FIONBIO
#define FIONBIO long(0x8004667E)
inline int ioctlsocket(SOCKET s, long cmd, u_long* v) {
    if (cmd == 0x4004667F) cmd = FIONREAD_POSIX;
    if (cmd == (long)FIONBIO) { int f = fcntl(s, F_GETFL); return fcntl(s, F_SETFL, *v ? f | O_NONBLOCK : f & ~O_NONBLOCK); }
    int n = 0; int r = ioctl(s, cmd, &n); *v = (u_long)n; return r;
}
inline int WSAIoctl(SOCKET, DWORD, void*, DWORD, void*, DWORD, DWORD*, void*, void*) { return 0; }
inline void Sleep(DWORD ms) { std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(ms)); }
struct ws_fd_set { unsigned fd_count; SOCKET fd_array[64]; };
#define fd_set ws_fd_set
#undef FD_ZERO
#undef FD_SET
#undef FD_ISSET
#undef FD_SETSIZE
#define FD_SETSIZE 64
#define FD_ZERO(p) ((p)->fd_count = 0)
#define FD_SET(s, p) ((p)->fd_array[(p)->fd_count++] = (s))
inline bool ws_isset(SOCKET s, const ws_fd_set* p) { for (unsigned i = 0; i < p->fd_count; i++) if (p->fd_array[i] == s) return true; return false; }
#define FD_ISSET(s, p) ws_isset((s), (p))
inline int ws_select(int, ws_fd_set* r, ws_fd_set* w, ws_fd_set* e, timeval* tv) {
    pollfd fds[192]; int n = 0;
    ws_fd_set* sets[3] = {r, w, e}; short ev[3] = {POLLIN, POLLOUT, POLLPRI};
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) if (sets[k]) for (unsigned i = 0; i < sets[k]->fd_count; i++) fds[n++] = {sets[k]->fd_array[i], ev[k], 0};
    int ms = tv ? int(tv->tv_sec * 1000 + tv->tv_usec / 1000) : -1;
    int rc = poll(fds, n, ms);
    if (rc < 0) return rc;
    int total = 0, j = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        if (!sets[k]) continue;
        ws_fd_set out{}; for (unsigned i = 0; i < sets[k]->fd_count; i++, j++)
            if (fds[j].revents & (ev[k] | POLLERR | POLLHUP)) out.fd_array[out.fd_count++] = fds[j].fd;
        total += out.fd_count; *sets[k] = out;
    }
    return total;
}
#define select ws_select
inline int getsockname(SOCKET s, sockaddr* a, int* l) { socklen_t n = socklen_t(*l); int r = ::getsockname(s, a, &n); *l = int(n); return r; }
inline int getpeername(SOCKET s, sockaddr* a, int* l) { socklen_t n = socklen_t(*l); int r = ::getpeername(s, a, &n); *l = int(n); return r; }
inline ssize_t recvfrom(SOCKET s, char* b, int len, int f, sockaddr* a, int* l) { socklen_t n = socklen_t(*l); ssize_t r = ::recvfrom(s, b, size_t(len), f, a, &n); *l = int(n); return r; }
inline SOCKET accept(SOCKET s, sockaddr* a, int* l) { socklen_t n = l ? socklen_t(*l) : 0; SOCKET r = ::accept(s, a, l ? &n : nullptr); if (l) *l = int(n); return r; }
// Winsock option numbers to POSIX
inline void ws_opt(int& level, int& opt) {
    if (level != 0xFFFF) return;
    level = SOL_SOCKET;
    switch (opt) {
        case 4: opt = SO_REUSEADDR; break; case 0x20: opt = SO_BROADCAST; break; case 0x1001: opt = SO_SNDBUF; break;
        case 0x1002: opt = SO_RCVBUF; break; case 0x1007: opt = SO_ERROR; break; case 0x80: opt = SO_LINGER; break;
        case 8: opt = SO_KEEPALIVE; break; case 0x1008: opt = SO_TYPE; break;
    }
}
inline int setsockopt(SOCKET s, int lv, int o, const char* v, int l) { ws_opt(lv, o); return ::setsockopt(s, lv, o, static_cast<const void*>(v), socklen_t(l)); }
inline int getsockopt(SOCKET s, int lv, int o, char* v, int* l) { ws_opt(lv, o); socklen_t n = socklen_t(*l); int r = ::getsockopt(s, lv, o, v, &n); *l = int(n); return r; }

`sdk/harness/main_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// headless host: <exe> <game folder> [--instance N], run from the folder that gets logs, hdd and cap
// the game folder may come from GAME_DIR instead
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <fstream>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "image_symbols.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::string game;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (!std::strcmp(argv[i], "--instance") && i + 1 < argc) setenv("INSTANCE", argv[++i], 1);
        else game = argv[i];
    }
    // a relaunch into another image comes back without arguments
    if (game.empty() && std::getenv("GAME_DIR")) game = std::getenv("GAME_DIR");
    setenv("GAME_DIR", game.c_str(), 1);
    if (game.empty()) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <game folder> [--instance N]\n", argv[0]);
        return 2;
    }
    logx::Init((app::ExeDir() / "logs").string(), app::kGame.log);
    app::Load();
    if (app::kGame.init) app::kGame.init();
    if (app::kGame.window) app::kGame.window(nullptr);
    std::string hdd = app::Instance() > 1 ? "hdd" + std::to_string(app::Instance()) : "hdd";
    std::ifstream f(game + "/" + IMAGE_XBE, std::ios::binary);
    std::vector<uint8_t> xbe((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), {});
    if (!kernel::Boot(std::move(xbe), IMAGE_XBE, game, (app::ExeDir() / hdd).string())) return 1;
    for (;;) {
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::seconds(1));
        logx::Flush();
    }
}

```

`sdk/harness/null_audio.cpp`:

```cpp
// the mixer pulled every 10 ms by the clock, its output dropped
#include <chrono>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "audio/audio.h"

namespace audio {

void StartOutput(std::function<void(float*, uint32_t)> render) {
    std::thread([render] {
        std::vector<float> b(kRate / 100 * 2);
        for (;;) {
            render(b.data(), kRate / 100);
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
        }
    }).detach();
}

}  // namespace audio

```

`sdk/harness/null_backend.cpp`:

```cpp
// headless renderer: counts frames and draws, logs draw lists, draws chosen frames with the reference renderer
// REF=N: every Nth frame drawn on the CPU into guest memory and saved as cap/ref_<frame>.tga
// CAP=N: every Nth frame's draws listed in cap/draws_<frame>.txt
// snap in the run folder: the next two frames drawn and saved as snap_1.tga and snap_2.tga, then snap is removed
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "gpu/backend.h"
#include "gpu/texture.h"
#include "harness.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"
#include "reference_renderer.h"

namespace gpu {

namespace {

class NullBackend final : public Backend {
public:
    bool Init(uint32_t w, uint32_t h) override {
        LOGI("renderer: headless %ux%u", w, h);
        std::filesystem::create_directories(app::ExeDir() / "cap");
        return true;
    }
    void Clear(const State& s, uint32_t n, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color, float z, uint32_t stencil) override {
        if (drawing_) reference::Clear(s, n, rects, flags, color, z, stencil);
    }
    void Draw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) override {
        draws_++;
        if (drawing_) reference::Draw(s, prim, start, count, indices);
        if (list_) List(s, prim, start, count);
    }
    void Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t n, uint32_t rects, uint32_t points) override {
        if (drawing_) reference::Copy(src, dst, n, rects, points);
        else CopySurfaceMemory(src, dst, n, rects, points);
    }
    void Present(const Surface& front) override {
        if (list_) {
            std::fclose(list_);
            list_ = nullptr;
        }
        if (draws_ == last_draws_) empty_++;
        last_draws_ = draws_;
        if (drawing_ && !snap_) reference::WriteTga(front, File("cap/ref_%05llu.tga", frames_).c_str());
        // snap asks for the next two frames drawn
        std::string snap = (app::ExeDir() / "snap").string();
        if (snap_ == 2) {
            reference::WriteTga(front, (app::ExeDir() / "snap_2.tga").string().c_str());
            std::remove(snap.c_str());
            snap_ = 0;
        } else if (snap_ == 1) {
            reference::WriteTga(front, (app::ExeDir() / "snap_1.tga").string().c_str());
            snap_ = 2;
        } else if (FILE* f = std::fopen(snap.c_str(), "r")) {
            std::fclose(f);
            snap_ = 1;
        }
        static const long every = harness::Env("REF"), cap = harness::Env("CAP");
        drawing_ = snap_ || (every && (frames_ + 1) % every == 0);
        if (drawing_) reference::BeginFrame();
        harness::g_frames = frames_ + 1;
        if (++frames_ % 60 == 0) LOGI("renderer: frame %llu, %llu draws, %llu empty frames", frames_, draws_, empty_);
        if (cap && frames_ % cap == 0) list_ = std::fopen(File("cap/draws_%05llu.txt", frames_).c_str(), "w");
    }
    void Sync(uint32_t, uint32_t) override {}
    void SyncLate(uint32_t) override {}
    void Flush() override {}
    void SetGamma(const uint8_t*) override {}

private:
    static std::string File(const char* fmt, unsigned long long n) {
        char name[64];
        std::snprintf(name, sizeof name, fmt, n);
        return (app::ExeDir() / name).string();
    }

    // one draw's state, textures, transforms, declaration and first vertex
    void List(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count) {
        FILE* f = list_;
        std::fprintf(f, "DRAW prim=%u n=%u vs=%X ps=%X rt=%08X tex0=%08X light=%u blend=%u %X %X cw=%X at=%u z=%u\n", prim, count,
                     s.vs_handle, s.ps ? s.ps->handle : 0, s.rt.data, s.textures[0], s.rs[kRsLighting], s.simple[kMBlendEnable >> 2],
                     s.simple[kMSrcBlend >> 2], s.simple[kMDestBlend >> 2], s.simple[kMColorWriteEnable >> 2],
                     s.simple[kMAlphaTestEnable >> 2], s.rs[kRsZEnable]);
        const auto& t0 = s.tss[0];
        TextureDesc d;
        if (s.textures[0] && Describe(s.textures[0], d))
            std::fprintf(f, "  tex %ux%u fmt %X cop %u %X %X aop %u %X %X\n", d.width, d.height, d.format, t0[kTssColorOp],
                         t0[kTssColorArg1], t0[kTssColorArg2], t0[kTssAlphaOp], t0[kTssAlphaArg1], t0[kTssAlphaArg2]);
        std::fprintf(f, "  ttf %X tci %X addr %u %u t16", t0[kTssTextureTransformFlags], t0[kTssTexCoordIndex], t0[kTssAddressU],
                     t0[kTssAddressV]);
        auto matrix = [&](const char* name, uint32_t which) {
            std::fprintf(f, "%s", name);
            for (float v : s.transforms[which]) std::fprintf(f, " %g", v);
        };
        matrix("", 16);
        matrix("\n  world", 256);
        matrix("\n  view", 2);
        matrix("\n  proj", 3);
        std::fprintf(f, "\n");
        if (s.vs) {
            std::fprintf(f, "  decl");
            for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++) {
                const auto& in = s.vs->inputs[size_t(r)];
                if (in.stream >= 0) std::fprintf(f, " v%d:%d+%u/%X", r, in.stream, in.offset, in.type);
            }
            std::fprintf(f, "\n");
        }
        if (s.streams[0].vb) {
            // the vertex buffer's Data at +4 is a physical address
            uint32_t data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(kernel::R32(s.streams[0].vb + 4)) + start * s.streams[0].stride;
            std::fprintf(f, "  v0 stride %u:", s.streams[0].stride);
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < s.streams[0].stride / 4 && i < 10; i++) {
                uint32_t v = kernel::R32(data + i * 4);
                float x;
                std::memcpy(&x, &v, 4);
                std::fprintf(f, " %g(%08X)", x, v);
            }
            std::fprintf(f, "\n");
        }
    }

    unsigned long long frames_ = 0, draws_ = 0, last_draws_ = 0, empty_ = 0;
    bool drawing_ = false;
    int snap_ = 0;
    FILE* list_ = nullptr;
};

}  // namespace

std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateBackend() { return std::make_unique<NullBackend>(); }

}  // namespace gpu
