```cpp
// the settings file beside the exe
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

#include <toml++/toml.hpp>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"

namespace app {

namespace {

const char* kModes[] = {"fullscreen", "borderless", "windowed"};

std::filesystem::path File() { return ExeDir() / kGame.settings; }

}  // namespace

Settings& Get() {
    static Settings s;
    return s;
}

void Load() {
    Settings& s = Get();
    toml::table t;
    try {
        t = toml::parse_file(File().string());
    } catch (...) {
        return;
    }
    std::string mode = t["display_mode"].value_or(std::string(kModes[uint32_t(s.display_mode)]));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        if (mode == kModes[i]) s.display_mode = DisplayMode(i);
    s.width = t["width"].value_or(s.width);
    s.height = t["height"].value_or(s.height);
    s.render_percent = t["render_percent"].value_or(s.render_percent);
    s.fps_cap = t["fps_cap"].value_or(s.fps_cap);
    s.vsync = t["vsync"].value_or(s.vsync);
    s.aniso = t["anisotropic_filtering"].value_or(s.aniso);
    s.join_ip = t["join_ip"].value_or(s.join_ip);
    for (const Option& o : kGame.options) {
        if (o.flag) *o.flag = t[o.key].value_or(*o.flag);
        else *o.value = t[o.key].value_or(*o.value);
    }
    if (kGame.load) kGame.load(&t);
}

namespace {

toml::table Table() {
    const Settings& s = Get();
    toml::table t{{"display_mode", kModes[uint32_t(s.display_mode)]},
                  {"width", int64_t(s.width)},
                  {"height", int64_t(s.height)},
                  {"render_percent", int64_t(s.render_percent)},
                  {"fps_cap", int64_t(s.fps_cap)},
                  {"vsync", s.vsync},
                  {"anisotropic_filtering", int64_t(s.aniso)},
                  {"join_ip", s.join_ip}};
    for (const Option& o : kGame.options) {
        if (o.flag) t.insert(o.key, *o.flag);
        else t.insert(o.key, int64_t(*o.value));
    }
    if (kGame.save) kGame.save(&t);
    return t;
}

}  // namespace

void Save() {
    std::ofstream f(File());
    f << Table() << "\n";
}

void LogSettings() {
    std::ostringstream text;
    text << Table();
    std::istringstream lines(text.str());
    LOGR("Settings:");
    for (std::string line; std::getline(lines, line);)
        if (!line.empty()) LOGR("  %s", line.c_str());
}

Mode Desktop() {
    HMONITOR mon = MonitorFromWindow(static_cast<HWND>(Window()), MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY);
    MONITORINFOEXW mi{};
    mi.cbSize = sizeof(mi);
    DEVMODEW dm{};
    dm.dmSize = sizeof(dm);
    if (GetMonitorInfoW(mon, &mi) && EnumDisplaySettingsW(mi.szDevice, ENUM_REGISTRY_SETTINGS, &dm))
        return {dm.dmPelsWidth, dm.dmPelsHeight};
    return {uint32_t(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN)), uint32_t(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN))};
}

Mode Output() {
    const Settings& s = Get();
    if (s.width && s.height) return {s.width, s.height};
    return Desktop();
}

bool Widescreen() {
    // asked per frame and per HUD quad: the desktop mode lookup only runs when the resolution setting changes
    static std::atomic<uint64_t> key{~0ull};
    static std::atomic<bool> wide{true};
    const Settings& s = Get();
    uint64_t k = uint64_t(s.width) << 32 | s.height;
    if (key.exchange(k) != k) {
        Mode m = Output();
        wide = m.width * 2 >= m.height * 3;  // 3:2 or wider
    }
    return wide;
}

float RenderScale(uint32_t guest_height) {
    float h = Output().height * (Get().render_percent / 100.0f);
    return guest_height ? std::max(h / guest_height, 0.1f) : 1.0f;
}

}  // namespace app
```

`sdk/runtime/app/splash.cpp`:

```cpp
// The boot splash: GameInfo::splash .bmp or .png beside the exe, centred in a borderless window. The game boots behind
// it with its window hidden and waits at its first frame until the splash has been up kMinimum, since this boot takes
// a fraction of a second. No file, or a relaunch: no splash.
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <wincodec.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <cwchar>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"

using Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr;

namespace app {

namespace {

constexpr auto kMinimum = std::chrono::seconds(1);

HWND g_splash = nullptr;
std::atomic<bool> g_waiting{false};
std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point g_until;

// premultiplied BGRA, as UpdateLayeredWindow wants it; a picture without alpha comes out opaque
bool Read(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::vector<uint32_t>& pixels, UINT& w, UINT& h) {
    CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
    ComPtr<IWICImagingFactory> wic;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapDecoder> decoder;
    ComPtr<IWICBitmapFrameDecode> frame;
    ComPtr<IWICFormatConverter> converter;
    HRESULT hr = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_WICImagingFactory, nullptr, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_PPV_ARGS(&wic));
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = wic->CreateDecoderFromFilename(path.c_str(), nullptr, GENERIC_READ, WICDecodeMetadataCacheOnLoad, &decoder);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = decoder->GetFrame(0, &frame);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = wic->CreateFormatConverter(&converter);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr))
        hr = converter->Initialize(frame.Get(), GUID_WICPixelFormat32bppPBGRA, WICBitmapDitherTypeNone, nullptr, 0,
                                   WICBitmapPaletteTypeCustom);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr)) hr = converter->GetSize(&w, &h);
    if (SUCCEEDED(hr) && w && h) {
        pixels.resize(size_t(w) * h);
        hr = converter->CopyPixels(nullptr, w * 4, UINT(pixels.size() * 4), reinterpret_cast<BYTE*>(pixels.data()));
    }
    if (FAILED(hr) || !w || !h) {
        LOGW("splash: %s could not be read (%08X)", path.string().c_str(), unsigned(hr));
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool OpenSplash() {
    if (std::wcsstr(GetCommandLineW(), L"--relaunched")) return false;
    std::vector<uint32_t> pixels;
    UINT w = 0, h = 0;
    std::filesystem::path path;
    for (const wchar_t* ext : {L".bmp", L".png"}) {
        std::error_code ec;
        path = ExeDir() / (std::wstring(kGame.splash) + ext);
        if (std::filesystem::exists(path, ec) && Read(path, pixels, w, h)) break;
        pixels.clear();
    }
    if (pixels.empty()) return false;

    HINSTANCE inst = GetModuleHandleW(nullptr);
    WNDCLASSEXW wc{sizeof(wc)};
    wc.lpfnWndProc = DefWindowProcW;
    wc.hInstance = inst;
    wc.hIcon = LoadIconW(inst, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(1));
    wc.hCursor = LoadCursorW(nullptr, MAKEINTRESOURCEW(32514));  // IDC_WAIT
    std::wstring cls = std::wstring(kGame.name) + L"Splash";
    wc.lpszClassName = cls.c_str();
    RegisterClassExW(&wc);
    // centred on the primary screen at one image pixel per screen pixel
    POINT at{(GetSystemMetrics(SM_CXSCREEN) - int(w)) / 2, (GetSystemMetrics(SM_CYSCREEN) - int(h)) / 2};
    g_splash = CreateWindowExW(WS_EX_LAYERED, wc.lpszClassName, kGame.title, WS_POPUP,
                               at.x, at.y, int(w), int(h), nullptr, nullptr, inst, nullptr);
    if (!g_splash) return false;

    BITMAPINFO bi{};
    bi.bmiHeader = {sizeof(BITMAPINFOHEADER), LONG(w), -LONG(h), 1, 32, BI_RGB};
    void* bits = nullptr;
    HDC screen = GetDC(nullptr), dc = CreateCompatibleDC(screen);
    HBITMAP bitmap = CreateDIBSection(dc, &bi, DIB_RGB_COLORS, &bits, nullptr, 0);
    if (bitmap && bits) {
        std::memcpy(bits, pixels.data(), pixels.size() * 4);
        HGDIOBJ old = SelectObject(dc, bitmap);
        SIZE size{LONG(w), LONG(h)};
        POINT origin{0, 0};
        BLENDFUNCTION blend{AC_SRC_OVER, 0, 255, AC_SRC_ALPHA};
        UpdateLayeredWindow(g_splash, screen, &at, &size, dc, &origin, 0, &blend, ULW_ALPHA);
        SelectObject(dc, old);
    }
    if (bitmap) DeleteObject(bitmap);
    DeleteDC(dc);
    ReleaseDC(nullptr, screen);
    // to the front once, without staying on top
    SetWindowPos(g_splash, HWND_TOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE | SWP_SHOWWINDOW);
    SetWindowPos(g_splash, HWND_NOTOPMOST, 0, 0, 0, 0, SWP_NOMOVE | SWP_NOSIZE);
    g_until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + kMinimum;
    g_waiting = true;
    LOGI("splash: %s, %ux%u", path.string().c_str(), w, h);
    return true;
}

void SplashFirstFrame() {
    if (!g_waiting.exchange(false)) return;
    std::this_thread::sleep_until(g_until);
    OpenGameWindow();
}

void CloseSplash() {
    if (g_splash) DestroyWindow(g_splash);
    g_splash = nullptr;
}

}  // namespace app

```

```cpp
// the log's opening lines: what the game runs on and with which settings
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <intrin.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "image_symbols.h"

#pragma comment(lib, "advapi32.lib")

namespace app {

namespace {

std::string RegString(HKEY key, const char* name) {
    char text[256] = {};
    DWORD size = sizeof(text) - 1;
    if (RegQueryValueExA(key, name, nullptr, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>(text), &size) != ERROR_SUCCESS) return {};
    return text;
}

std::string OsVersion() {
    HKEY key = nullptr;
    if (RegOpenKeyExA(HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE, "SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion", 0, KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_64KEY,
                      &key) != ERROR_SUCCESS)
        return "unknown";
    std::string name = RegString(key, "ProductName"), display = RegString(key, "DisplayVersion"),
                build = RegString(key, "CurrentBuildNumber");
    DWORD ubr = 0, size = sizeof(ubr);
    RegQueryValueExA(key, "UBR", nullptr, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<LPBYTE>(&ubr), &size);
    RegCloseKey(key);
    // Windows 11 still names itself Windows 10 here, its build number tells
    if (auto ten = name.find("Windows 10"); ten != std::string::npos && std::atoi(build.c_str()) >= 22000)
        name.replace(ten, 10, "Windows 11");
    if (!display.empty()) name += " " + display;
    if (!build.empty()) name += " (build " + build + "." + std::to_string(ubr) + ")";
    using WineVersion = const char*(__cdecl*)();
    if (auto wine = reinterpret_cast<WineVersion>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"ntdll.dll"), "wine_get_version"))))
        name += std::string(" on Wine ") + wine();
    return name;
}

std::string CpuName() {
    int r[4] = {};
    __cpuid(r, int(0x80000000));
    if (uint32_t(r[0]) < 0x80000004) return "unknown";
    char brand[49] = {};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        __cpuid(r, int(0x80000002 + i));
        std::memcpy(brand + i * 16, r, 16);
    }
    std::string s = brand;
    s.erase(0, s.find_first_not_of(' '));
    s.erase(s.find_last_not_of(' ') + 1);
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

void LogSystem() {
    std::time_t now = std::time(nullptr);
    char date[32] = {};
    std::strftime(date, sizeof(date), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", std::localtime(&now));
    LOGR("%ls (%s), %s", kGame.title, IMAGE_XBE, date);
    LOGR("Path: %ls", ExeDir().c_str());
    LOGR("OS: %s", OsVersion().c_str());
    SYSTEM_INFO si{};
    GetNativeSystemInfo(&si);
    LOGR("CPU: %s (%lu threads)", CpuName().c_str(), si.dwNumberOfProcessors);
    MEMORYSTATUSEX mem{sizeof(mem)};
    GlobalMemoryStatusEx(&mem);
    LOGR("RAM: %.1f GB", mem.ullTotalPhys / 1073741824.0);
    // one line per adapter, each monitor reports its own
    std::vector<std::string> seen;
    for (DWORD i = 0;; i++) {
        DISPLAY_DEVICEA dd{sizeof(dd)};
        if (!EnumDisplayDevicesA(nullptr, i, &dd, 0)) break;
        if (std::find(seen.begin(), seen.end(), dd.DeviceString) != seen.end()) continue;
        seen.emplace_back(dd.DeviceString);
        LOGR("GPU %zu: %s%s", seen.size(), dd.DeviceString, (dd.StateFlags & DISPLAY_DEVICE_PRIMARY_DEVICE) ? " (primary)" : "");
    }
    Mode desk = Desktop();
    LOGR("Desktop: %ux%u", desk.width, desk.height);
    LogSettings();
}

}  // namespace app
```

`sdk/runtime/audio/xaudio2.cpp`:

```cpp
// mixer output through XAudio2
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <xaudio2.h>

#include <thread>
#include <vector>

#include "audio/audio.h"
#include "core/log.h"

namespace audio {

void StartOutput(std::function<void(float*, uint32_t)> render) {
    std::thread([render] {
        CoInitializeEx(nullptr, COINIT_MULTITHREADED);
        IXAudio2* xa = nullptr;
        IXAudio2MasteringVoice* master = nullptr;
        IXAudio2SourceVoice* voice = nullptr;
        WAVEFORMATEX wf{};
        wf.wFormatTag = WAVE_FORMAT_IEEE_FLOAT;
        wf.nChannels = 2;
        wf.nSamplesPerSec = kRate;
        wf.wBitsPerSample = 32;
        wf.nBlockAlign = 8;
        wf.nAvgBytesPerSec = kRate * 8;
        if (FAILED(XAudio2Create(&xa, 0, XAUDIO2_DEFAULT_PROCESSOR)) || FAILED(xa->CreateMasteringVoice(&master)) ||
            FAILED(xa->CreateSourceVoice(&voice, &wf))) {
            LOGE("audio: XAudio2 unavailable, no sound");
            return;
        }
        voice->Start();
        constexpr uint32_t kFrames = kRate / 100;
        constexpr uint32_t kMinQueued = 3;
        constexpr uint32_t kMaxQueued = 10;
        // one slot more than can be queued, so the one rendered is never one XAudio2 still reads
        constexpr uint32_t kSlots = kMaxQueued + 1;
        std::vector<float> bufs(kSlots * kFrames * 2);
        uint32_t depth = kMinQueued;
        for (uint32_t n = 0;;) {
            XAUDIO2_VOICE_STATE st;
            voice->GetState(&st, XAUDIO2_VOICE_NOSAMPLESPLAYED);
            // a starved voice crackles: queue one buffer more each time, up to kMaxQueued
            if (n && !st.BuffersQueued && depth < kMaxQueued) {
                depth++;
                LOGI("audio: output starved, queueing %u ms", depth * 10);
            }
            if (st.BuffersQueued >= depth) {
                Sleep(2);
                continue;
            }
            float* b = &bufs[(n % kSlots) * kFrames * 2];
            render(b, kFrames);
            XAUDIO2_BUFFER xb{};
            xb.AudioBytes = kFrames * 8;
            xb.pAudioData = reinterpret_cast<const BYTE*>(b);
            voice->SubmitSourceBuffer(&xb);
            n++;  // only a submitted buffer takes a slot, XAudio2 still reads the queued ones
        }
    }).detach();
}

}  // namespace audio

```

```h
// XBE_PERF set: perf log lines once a second and the read-backs named
```

`sdk/runtime/core/input.cpp`:

```cpp
// controllers through SDL: Xbox, PlayStation and Switch pads read into the console controller's report
#include "core/input.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <iterator>
#include <mutex>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/log.h"

namespace input {

namespace {

// a controller takes the lowest free port when it is plugged in and keeps it until it is unplugged
std::mutex g_lock;
bool g_sdl = false;
SDL_Gamepad* g_pads[4] = {};

void AddPad(SDL_JoystickID id) {
    for (SDL_Gamepad* pad : g_pads)
        if (pad && SDL_GetGamepadID(pad) == id) return;
    SDL_Gamepad** slot = std::find(std::begin(g_pads), std::end(g_pads), nullptr);
    if (slot == std::end(g_pads)) return;
    *slot = SDL_OpenGamepad(id);
    const char* name = *slot ? SDL_GetGamepadName(*slot) : SDL_GetError();
    LOGI("input: controller %d %s: %s", int(slot - g_pads) + 1, *slot ? "plugged in" : "failed to open", name ? name : "");
}

void RemovePad(SDL_JoystickID id) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (!g_pads[i] || SDL_GetGamepadID(g_pads[i]) != id) continue;
        SDL_CloseGamepad(g_pads[i]);
        g_pads[i] = nullptr;
        LOGI("input: controller %d unplugged", i + 1);
    }
}

// once a millisecond at most, however many ports and threads read
void UpdatePads() {
    static uint64_t last = 0;
    uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
    if (!g_sdl || now == last) return;
    last = now;
    SDL_PumpEvents();
    SDL_Event e;
    while (SDL_PeepEvents(&e, 1, SDL_GETEVENT, SDL_EVENT_FIRST, SDL_EVENT_LAST) == 1) {
        if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_ADDED) AddPad(e.gdevice.which);
        else if (e.type == SDL_EVENT_GAMEPAD_REMOVED) RemovePad(e.gdevice.which);
    }
}

}  // namespace

void Init() {
    // WGI reads the triggers apart and HIDAPI takes PlayStation and Switch pads. Reads come from the guest's threads,
    // so SDL's own thread takes the device notices.
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_THREAD, "1");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_ALLOW_BACKGROUND_EVENTS, "1");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_WGI, "1");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_RAWINPUT, "0");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_XINPUT_ENABLED, "0");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_JOYSTICK_DIRECTINPUT, "0");
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD)) {
        LOGE("input: SDL failed to start, no controllers: %s", SDL_GetError());
        return;
    }
    int v = SDL_GetVersion();
    LOGI("input: SDL %d.%d.%d", SDL_VERSIONNUM_MAJOR(v), SDL_VERSIONNUM_MINOR(v), SDL_VERSIONNUM_MICRO(v));
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    g_sdl = true;
    int count = 0;
    if (SDL_JoystickID* ids = SDL_GetGamepads(&count)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) AddPad(ids[i]);
        SDL_free(ids);
    }
}

Pad Poll(int port) {
    Pad p;
    {
        std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
        UpdatePads();
        if (SDL_Gamepad* pad = port >= 0 && port < 4 ? g_pads[port] : nullptr) {
            p.connected = true;
            constexpr SDL_GamepadButton kButtons[] = {
                SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP,   SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN,  SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT,
                SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START,     SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_BACK,
                SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_STICK, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_STICK};
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) p.buttons |= uint16_t(SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, kButtons[i]) << i);
            // A B X Y black white
            constexpr SDL_GamepadButton kAnalog[] = {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST,
                                                     SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_WEST,  SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_NORTH,
                                                     SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_SHOULDER, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_LEFT_SHOULDER};
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) p.analog[i] = SDL_GetGamepadButton(pad, kAnalog[i]) ? 0xFF : 0;
            auto axis = [&](SDL_GamepadAxis a) { return int(SDL_GetGamepadAxis(pad, a)); };
            // 0 to 32767 into 0 to 255
            p.analog[6] = uint8_t(std::max(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER), 0) >> 7);
            p.analog[7] = uint8_t(std::max(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER), 0) >> 7);
            // SDL's sticks have y down
            // not plain negation: -32768 has no positive
            p.lx = int16_t(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX));
            p.ly = int16_t(-1 - axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY));
            p.rx = int16_t(axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTX));
            p.ry = int16_t(-1 - axis(SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY));
        }
    }
    if (app::kGame.pad) app::kGame.pad(port, p);
    return p;
}

// the motors run until set again
void Rumble(int port, uint16_t left, uint16_t right) {
    if (app::kGame.rumble) app::kGame.rumble(port, left, right);
    std::lock_guard lock(g_lock);
    if (port >= 0 && port < 4 && g_pads[port]) SDL_RumbleGamepad(g_pads[port], left, right, 0);
}

}  // namespace input

```

`sdk/runtime/core/log.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "core/log.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <filesystem>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace logx {

static std::mutex g_mutex;
static FILE* g_file = nullptr;
static std::string g_path;
static std::string g_prev_path;  // the previous session's log, kept at startup so a crash survives a relaunch
static auto g_start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

constexpr int kKeep = 30;

// the run number of prefix_NNN.log, 0 for another name
static int RunNumber(const fs::path& file, const std::string& prefix) {
    std::string name = file.filename().string();
    if (file.extension() != ".log" || name.size() <= prefix.size() + 1 || name.compare(0, prefix.size() + 1, prefix + "_"))
        return 0;
    return std::atoi(name.c_str() + prefix.size() + 1);
}

void Init(const std::string& dir, const std::string& prefix, bool append) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    std::error_code ec;
    fs::create_directories(dir, ec);
    if (!kVerbose) {
        g_path = (fs::path(dir) / (prefix + ".log")).string();
        if (!append) {
            // keep the previous session before truncating: the crash handler appends to this file, and a
            // tester who reopens the app to export it would otherwise find it truncated away. Best effort:
            // no previous log on first launch, or an unwritable dir, just means there is nothing to keep
            fs::path prev = fs::path(dir) / (prefix + "-prev.log");
            std::error_code rec;
            fs::remove(prev, rec);
            rec.clear();
            fs::rename(fs::path(g_path), prev, rec);
            if (!rec) g_prev_path = prev.string();
        }
        g_file = std::fopen(g_path.c_str(), append ? "a" : "w");
        return;
    }
    std::vector<std::pair<int, fs::path>> runs;
    for (const auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(dir, ec))
        if (int n = RunNumber(e.path(), prefix)) runs.emplace_back(n, e.path());
    std::sort(runs.begin(), runs.end());
    for (size_t i = 0; i + kKeep <= runs.size(); i++) fs::remove(runs[i].second, ec);
    char name[256];
    std::snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%s_%03d.log", prefix.c_str(), runs.empty() ? 1 : runs.back().first + 1);
    g_path = (fs::path(dir) / name).string();
    g_file = std::fopen(g_path.c_str(), "w");
}

const std::string& Path() { return g_path; }

const std::string& PrevPath() { return g_prev_path; }

void Write(Level lv, const char* fmt, ...) {
    if (!kVerbose && lv < Level::Error) return;
    char msg[4096];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    std::vsnprintf(msg, sizeof(msg), fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    double t = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - g_start).count();
    static const char* names[] = {"debug", "info", "warn", "error", "info"};
    auto tid = std::hash<std::thread::id>()(std::this_thread::get_id()) & 0xFFFF;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    char line[4300];
    int n = kVerbose ? std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3f] [%s] [t%04zx] %s\n", t, names[int(lv)], size_t(tid), msg)
                     : std::snprintf(line, sizeof(line), "[%9.3f] %s%s\n", t, lv == Level::Error ? "error: " : "", msg);
    n = std::min(n, int(sizeof(line)) - 1);
    if (g_file) {
        std::fwrite(line, 1, size_t(n), g_file);
        if (lv >= Level::Warn) std::fflush(g_file);
    }
    std::fwrite(line, 1, size_t(n), stderr);
}

void Flush() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_mutex);
    if (g_file) std::fflush(g_file);
}

}  // namespace logx

```

`sdk/runtime/core/log.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>

namespace logx {

// a release build writes Report and Error lines only
enum class Level { Debug, Info, Warn, Error, Report };

// release: dir/prefix.log, carried on when append; debug: dir/prefix_NNN.log per run, newest 30 kept
void Init(const std::string& dir, const std::string& prefix, bool append = false);
// the previous session's log, rotated at startup (prefix-prev.log); empty when there was none to keep
const std::string& PrevPath();
void Write(Level lv, const char* fmt, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 2, 3)));
void Flush();
const std::string& Path();

#if defined(NDEBUG) && !defined(XBE_VERBOSE_LOG)
inline constexpr bool kVerbose = false;
#else
inline constexpr bool kVerbose = true;
#endif

}  // namespace logx

#define LOGD(...) ::logx::Write(::logx::Level::Debug, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGI(...) ::logx::Write(::logx::Level::Info, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGW(...) ::logx::Write(::logx::Level::Warn, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGE(...) ::logx::Write(::logx::Level::Error, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGR(...) ::logx::Write(::logx::Level::Report, __VA_ARGS__)

// logs only the first n times a call site is reached
#define LOG_FIRST(n, ...)                                  \
    do {                                                   \
        static std::atomic<int> _c{0};                     \
        if (_c.fetch_add(1, std::memory_order_relaxed) < (n)) LOGI(__VA_ARGS__); \
    } while (0)
```

`sdk/runtime/cpu/dispatch.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "core/log.h"
#include "cpu/x86_ops.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <intrin.h>
#else
#include <x86intrin.h>
#endif

namespace {

std::vector<X86Func*> g_table;  // one slot per code byte
std::vector<bool> g_continuation;
uint32_t g_lo = 0, g_hi = 0;

struct Export {
    const char* name = nullptr;
    kernel::KernelFn fn = nullptr;
    uint32_t data = 0;
};
Export g_exports[400];

}  // namespace

// synthetic guest addresses for kernel functions reached through a pointer
constexpr uint32_t kKernelThunkBase = 0xFE000000;

namespace dispatch {

void Init() {
    g_lo = X86CodeBase;
    g_hi = X86CodeEnd;
    g_table.assign(g_hi - g_lo, nullptr);
    size_t n = 0;
    for (const X86FuncMapping* m = X86FuncMappings; m->host; m++, n++)
        if (m->guest >= g_lo && m->guest < g_hi) g_table[m->guest - g_lo] = m->host;
    g_continuation.assign(g_hi - g_lo, false);
    for (const uint32_t* c = X86Continuations; *c; c++)
        if (*c >= g_lo && *c < g_hi) g_continuation[*c - g_lo] = true;
    LOGI("dispatch: %zu functions over %08X..%08X", n, g_lo, g_hi);
}

X86Func* Find(uint32_t guest) {
    if (guest >= g_lo && guest < g_hi) return g_table[guest - g_lo];
    return nullptr;
}

// host code the guest may call through a pointer gets an address in this range
constexpr uint32_t kHostThunkBase = 0xFD000000;
static std::vector<X86Func*> g_host_thunks;
static std::mutex g_host_lock;

uint32_t HostThunk(X86Func* fn) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_host_lock);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_host_thunks.size(); i++)
        if (g_host_thunks[i] == fn) return kHostThunkBase + uint32_t(i) * 4;
    g_host_thunks.push_back(fn);
    return kHostThunkBase + uint32_t(g_host_thunks.size() - 1) * 4;
}

uint32_t KernelThunkAddress(uint32_t ordinal) { return kKernelThunkBase + ordinal * 4; }

}  // namespace dispatch

void x86_icall(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t target) {
    ctx.last_icall = target;
    if (target >= g_lo && target < g_hi && g_continuation[target - g_lo]) throw X86Resume{target, ctx.esp};
    if (X86Func* f = dispatch::Find(target)) {
        f(ctx, base);
        return;
    }
    if (target >= kKernelThunkBase && target < kKernelThunkBase + 400 * 4) {
        x86_kernel(ctx, base, (target - kKernelThunkBase) / 4);
        return;
    }
    if (target >= dispatch::kHostThunkBase) {
        size_t i = (target - dispatch::kHostThunkBase) / 4;
        X86Func* f = nullptr;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(dispatch::g_host_lock);
            if (i < dispatch::g_host_thunks.size()) f = dispatch::g_host_thunks[i];
        }
        if (f) {
            f(ctx, base);
            return;
        }
    }
    uint32_t ret = kernel::R32(ctx.esp);
    LOGE("indirect call to %08X has no recompiled function (return address %08X, esp %08X)", target, ret, ctx.esp);
    LOGE("add 0x%X to [functions] in the image's config/*.toml and rebuild", target);
    x86_trap(ctx, ret, "indirect call to unknown code");
}

void x86_resume(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, const X86Resume& r) {
    ctx.esp = r.esp;
    dispatch::Find(r.target)(ctx, base);
}

void x86_kernel(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t ordinal) {
    if (ordinal < 400 && g_exports[ordinal].fn) {
        g_exports[ordinal].fn(ctx, base);
        return;
    }
    LOGE("kernel export %u (%s) is not implemented, return address %08X", ordinal, kernel::ExportName(ordinal),
         kernel::R32(ctx.esp));
    x86_trap(ctx, kernel::R32(ctx.esp), "unimplemented kernel export");
}

namespace kernel {

void RegisterExport(uint32_t ordinal, const char* name, KernelFn fn) {
    g_exports[ordinal].name = name;
    g_exports[ordinal].fn = fn;
}

static uint32_t g_kdata_next = mem::kKernelDataBase + 0x1000;

uint32_t RegisterData(uint32_t ordinal, const char* name, uint32_t size) {
    static std::mutex m;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m);
    if (g_exports[ordinal].data) return g_exports[ordinal].data;
    uint32_t a = (g_kdata_next + 15) & ~15u;
    g_kdata_next = a + ((size + 15) & ~15u);
    g_exports[ordinal].name = name;
    g_exports[ordinal].data = a;
    return a;
}

uint32_t DataAddress(uint32_t ordinal) { return ordinal < 400 ? g_exports[ordinal].data : 0; }
const char* ExportName(uint32_t ordinal) { return ordinal < 400 && g_exports[ordinal].name ? g_exports[ordinal].name : OrdinalName(ordinal); }
bool HasExport(uint32_t ordinal) { return ordinal < 400 && (g_exports[ordinal].fn || g_exports[ordinal].data); }

uint32_t CallGuest(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t fn, const uint32_t* args, size_t count) {
    // the D3D and DirectSound hooks call this several times a draw: no heap, only the registers put back are kept
    struct {
        uint32_t eax, ecx, edx, ebx, esi, edi, ebp;
    } saved{ctx.eax, ctx.ecx, ctx.edx, ctx.ebx, ctx.esi, ctx.edi, ctx.ebp};
    uint32_t esp = ctx.esp;
    for (const uint32_t* p = args + count; p != args;) {
        ctx.esp -= 4;
        W32(ctx.esp, *--p);
    }
    ctx.esp -= 4;
    W32(ctx.esp, 0xFFFFFFF0u);  // never used as a target, calls return through the host stack
    x86_icall(ctx, g_base, fn);
    uint32_t result = ctx.eax;
    ctx.eax = saved.eax;
    ctx.ecx = saved.ecx;
    ctx.edx = saved.edx;
    ctx.ebx = saved.ebx;
    ctx.esi = saved.esi;
    ctx.edi = saved.edi;
    ctx.ebp = saved.ebp;
    ctx.esp = esp;
    return result;
}

}  // namespace kernel

namespace kernel {
// return addresses found on the guest stack, the cheapest way to place a guest event
void LogGuestStack(X86Context& ctx, int words) {
    LOGE("  eax %08X ecx %08X edx %08X ebx %08X esp %08X ebp %08X esi %08X edi %08X", ctx.eax, ctx.ecx, ctx.edx, ctx.ebx,
         ctx.esp, ctx.ebp, ctx.esi, ctx.edi);
    for (int i = 0; i < words; i++) {
        uint32_t a = ctx.esp + uint32_t(i) * 4;
        if (!mem::IsCommitted(a)) break;
        uint32_t v = R32(a);
        if (v >= X86CodeBase && v < X86CodeEnd) LOGE("  [esp+%03X] %08X", i * 4, v);
    }
}
}  // namespace kernel

void x86_trap(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, const char* what) {
    LOGE("guest trap at %08X: %s", va, what);
    kernel::LogGuestStack(ctx, 64);
    logx::Flush();
#ifdef _WIN32
    __debugbreak();
#endif
    std::abort();
}

uint32_t x86_trace(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, uint32_t ret) {
    using kernel::R32;
    if (!ret) {
        ret = R32(ctx.esp);
        LOGI("trace %08X from %08X (%08X, %08X, %08X, %08X) ecx %08X", va, ret, R32(ctx.esp + 4), R32(ctx.esp + 8),
             R32(ctx.esp + 12), R32(ctx.esp + 16), ctx.ecx);
    } else {
        LOGI("trace %08X returned %08X to %08X", va, ctx.eax, ret);
    }
    return ret;
}

void x86_priv(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, const char* what) {
    static std::mutex m;
    static std::unordered_set<uint32_t> seen;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m);
    if (seen.insert(va).second) LOGW("privileged instruction %s at %08X ignored", what, va);
    (void)ctx;
}

// the guest measured time against a 733.33 MHz time stamp counter
uint64_t x86_rdtsc() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    static const auto start = steady_clock::now();
    auto ns = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now() - start).count();
    uint64_t sec = uint64_t(ns) / 1000000000ull, rem = uint64_t(ns) % 1000000000ull;
    return sec * 733333333ull + rem * 733333333ull / 1000000000ull;
}

void x86_cpuid(X86Context& ctx) {
    switch (ctx.eax) {
        case 0:
            ctx.eax = 2;
            ctx.ebx = 0x756E6547;  // GenuineIntel
            ctx.edx = 0x49656E69;
            ctx.ecx = 0x6C65746E;
            break;
        case 1:
            ctx.eax = 0x0000068A;  // family 6 model 8, Pentium III Coppermine
            ctx.ebx = 0;
            ctx.ecx = 0;
            ctx.edx = 0x0383F9FF;  // fpu tsc cx8 cmov mmx fxsr sse
            break;
        default:
            ctx.eax = ctx.ebx = ctx.ecx = ctx.edx = 0;
            break;
    }
}
```

`sdk/runtime/cpu/x86_context.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

union X86Xmm {
    float f[4];
    uint32_t u[4];
    int32_t i[4];
    uint64_t q[2];
};

struct alignas(64) X86Context {
    uint32_t eax, ecx, edx, ebx, esp, ebp, esi, edi;
    uint32_t cf, zf, sf, of, pf;  // only live across tail calls, functions keep flags in locals
    uint32_t df;
    uint32_t xflags;  // AC and ID, kept so feature probes see them toggle
    uint32_t fs_base;
    uint32_t top;  // x87 stack top
    uint16_t fcw, fsw;
    uint32_t mxcsr;
    double st[8];
    uint64_t mm[8];
    X86Xmm xmm[8];
    // runtime owned
    uint32_t thread_handle;
    uint32_t last_icall;
    void* host;
};

using X86Func = void(X86Context& __restrict ctx, uint8_t* base);

struct X86FuncMapping {
    uint32_t guest;
    X86Func* host;
};

// produced by the recompiler
extern const X86FuncMapping X86FuncMappings[];
extern const uint32_t X86Continuations[];  // zero terminated
extern const uint32_t X86CodeBase, X86CodeEnd, X86ImageBase, X86ImageEnd, X86EntryPoint, X86KernelThunk;
```

`sdk/runtime/cpu/x86_ops.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <type_traits>

#include "x86_context.h"

typedef uint16_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) x86_u16u;
typedef uint32_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) x86_u32u;
typedef uint64_t __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) x86_u64u;
typedef float __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) x86_f32u;
typedef double __attribute__((aligned(1), may_alias)) x86_f64u;

#define X86_MEM8(a) (*(uint8_t*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_MEM16(a) (*(x86_u16u*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_MEM32(a) (*(x86_u32u*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_MEM64(a) (*(x86_u64u*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_MEMF32(a) (*(x86_f32u*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_MEMF64(a) (*(x86_f64u*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))
#define X86_PTR(T, a) ((T*)(base + (uint32_t)(a)))

#define X86_FUNC(name) extern "C" void name(X86Context& __restrict ctx, uint8_t* base)
#define X86_EXTERN_FUNC(name) extern "C" void name(X86Context& __restrict ctx, uint8_t* base)
#define X86_WEAK_FUNC(name, impl) \
    extern "C" __attribute__((weak, noinline)) void name(X86Context& __restrict ctx, uint8_t* base) { impl(ctx, base); }
// [xbe] trace: logs the caller and arguments on entry, eax on return
#define X86_TRACED_FUNC(name, impl, va)                                                                    \
    extern "C" __attribute__((weak, noinline)) void name(X86Context& __restrict ctx, uint8_t* base) {      \
        uint32_t x86_ret = x86_trace(ctx, va, 0);                                                         \
        impl(ctx, base);                                                                                  \
        x86_trace(ctx, va, x86_ret);                                                                      \
    }

#define X86_PUSH32(v)            \
    do {                         \
        uint32_t _v = (v);       \
        ctx.esp -= 4;            \
        X86_MEM32(ctx.esp) = _v; \
    } while (0)

#define X86_SAVE_FLAGS() (ctx.cf = cf, ctx.zf = zf, ctx.sf = sf, ctx.of = of, ctx.pf = pf)
#define X86_LOAD_FLAGS() uint32_t cf = ctx.cf, zf = ctx.zf, sf = ctx.sf, of = ctx.of, pf = ctx.pf
#define X86_BARRIER() __asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory")
#define X86_PARITY(r) ((uint32_t)(__builtin_parity((uint32_t)(r)&0xFF) ^ 1))

#define X87_ST(i) ctx.st[(ctx.top + (i)) & 7]

// runtime services, implemented in src/cpu/dispatch.cpp
void x86_icall(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t target);
// a jump to a C++ catch continuation unwinds the host stack to the frame that resumes there (esp as the CRT set it)
struct X86Resume {
    uint32_t target, esp;
};
void x86_resume(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, const X86Resume& r);
void x86_kernel(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t ordinal);
[[noreturn]] void x86_trap(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, const char* what);
void x86_priv(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, const char* what);
uint32_t x86_trace(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t va, uint32_t ret);  // ret 0 on entry, returns the return address
uint64_t x86_rdtsc();
void x86_cpuid(X86Context& ctx);

inline void x87_push(X86Context& ctx, double v) {
    ctx.top = (ctx.top - 1) & 7;
    ctx.st[ctx.top] = v;
}
inline void x87_pop(X86Context& ctx) { ctx.top = (ctx.top + 1) & 7; }

// precision control: results round to 24 bits when the control word asks for it
inline double x87_prec(X86Context& ctx, double v) { return (ctx.fcw & 0x300) ? v : double(float(v)); }

// C0 bit 8, C2 bit 10, C3 bit 14
inline void x87_compare(X86Context& ctx, double a, double b) {
    uint16_t c;
    if (std::isnan(a) || std::isnan(b)) c = 0x4500;
    else if (a > b) c = 0;
    else if (a < b) c = 0x0100;
    else c = 0x4000;
    ctx.fsw = uint16_t((ctx.fsw & ~0x4500) | c);
}

// TOP lives in status word bits 11 to 13
inline uint16_t x87_status(X86Context& ctx) { return uint16_t((ctx.fsw & ~0x3800) | ((ctx.top & 7) << 11)); }

inline double x87_round(X86Context& ctx, double v) {
    switch ((ctx.fcw >> 10) & 3) {  // control word RC field
        case 0: return std::nearbyint(v);
        case 1: return std::floor(v);
        case 2: return std::ceil(v);
        default: return std::trunc(v);
    }
}

// out of range gives the integer indefinite value, as the FPU does
inline int32_t x87_to_i32(X86Context& ctx, double v) {
    double r = x87_round(ctx, v);
    if (!(r >= -2147483648.0 && r <= 2147483647.0)) return INT32_MIN;
    return int32_t(r);
}
inline int16_t x87_to_i16(X86Context& ctx, double v) {
    double r = x87_round(ctx, v);
    if (!(r >= -32768.0 && r <= 32767.0)) return INT16_MIN;
    return int16_t(r);
}
inline int64_t x87_to_i64(X86Context& ctx, double v) {
    double r = x87_round(ctx, v);
    if (!(r >= -9223372036854775808.0 && r < 9223372036854775808.0)) return INT64_MIN;
    return int64_t(r);
}

inline double x87_load80(const uint8_t* p) {
    uint64_t mant;
    uint16_t se;
    std::memcpy(&mant, p, 8);
    std::memcpy(&se, p + 8, 2);
    int sign = se >> 15;
    int exp = se & 0x7FFF;
    double v;
    if (exp == 0 && mant == 0) v = 0.0;
    else if (exp == 0x7FFF) v = (mant << 1) ? NAN : INFINITY;
    else v = std::ldexp(double(mant), exp - 16383 - 63);
    return sign ? -v : v;
}

inline void x87_store80(uint8_t* p, double v) {
    uint64_t mant = 0;
    uint16_t se = std::signbit(v) ? 0x8000 : 0;
    double a = std::fabs(v);
    if (std::isnan(v)) {
        se |= 0x7FFF;
        mant = 0xC000000000000000ull;
    } else if (std::isinf(v)) {
        se |= 0x7FFF;
        mant = 0x8000000000000000ull;
    } else if (a != 0.0) {
        int e;
        double m = std::frexp(a, &e);  // a = m * 2^e, m in [0.5,1)
        mant = uint64_t(std::ldexp(m, 64));
        se |= uint16_t(e - 1 + 16383);
    }
    std::memcpy(p, &mant, 8);
    std::memcpy(p + 8, &se, 2);
}

inline uint32_t x87_examine(X86Context& ctx) {
    // FXAM class into C3 C2 C0, C1 = sign
    double v = X87_ST(0);
    uint16_t c;
    if (std::isnan(v)) c = 0x0100;
    else if (std::isinf(v)) c = 0x0500;
    else if (v == 0.0) c = 0x4000;
    else if (std::fpclassify(v) == FP_SUBNORMAL) c = 0x4400;
    else c = 0x0400;
    if (std::signbit(v)) c |= 0x0200;
    ctx.fsw = uint16_t((ctx.fsw & ~0x4700) | c);
    return 0;
}

inline float sse_min(float a, float b) { return a < b ? a : b; }
inline float sse_max(float a, float b) { return a > b ? a : b; }

inline uint32_t sse_cmp(float a, float b, int pred) {
    bool r;
    switch (pred & 7) {
        case 0: r = a == b; break;
        case 1: r = a < b; break;
        case 2: r = a <= b; break;
        case 3: r = std::isnan(a) || std::isnan(b); break;
        case 4: r = !(a == b); break;
        case 5: r = !(a < b); break;
        case 6: r = !(a <= b); break;
        default: r = !(std::isnan(a) || std::isnan(b)); break;
    }
    return r ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0u;
}

inline int32_t sse_cvt(float v) {
    float r = std::nearbyint(v);
    if (!(r >= -2147483648.0f && r < 2147483648.0f)) return INT32_MIN;
    return int32_t(r);
}
inline int32_t sse_cvtt(float v) {
    if (!(v >= -2147483648.0f && v < 2147483648.0f)) return INT32_MIN;
    return int32_t(v);
}

template <typename T>
constexpr T sat(int64_t v) {
    constexpr int64_t lo = std::numeric_limits<T>::min(), hi = std::numeric_limits<T>::max();
    return T(v < lo ? lo : v > hi ? hi : v);
}
static_assert(sat<int16_t>(-300) == -300 && sat<int16_t>(40000) == 32767 && sat<int8_t>(-5) == -5);

// lane wise helpers on 64 bit MMX values
template <typename T, typename F>
inline uint64_t mmx_map2(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, F f) {
    constexpr int n = 8 / sizeof(T);
    T x[n], y[n], r[n];
    std::memcpy(x, &a, 8);
    std::memcpy(y, &b, 8);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) r[i] = T(f(x[i], y[i]));
    uint64_t out;
    std::memcpy(&out, r, 8);
    return out;
}

// rep movs: element by element semantics, fast path when the ranges cannot interfere
inline void x86_rep_movs(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t w) {
    uint32_t n = ctx.ecx;
    if (!n) return;
    uint32_t bytes = n * w;
    if (!ctx.df && (ctx.edi - ctx.esi >= bytes || ctx.edi <= ctx.esi)) {
        std::memmove(base + ctx.edi, base + ctx.esi, bytes);
        ctx.esi += bytes;
        ctx.edi += bytes;
        ctx.ecx = 0;
        return;
    }
    int32_t d = ctx.df ? -int32_t(w) : int32_t(w);
    for (; n; n--) {
        std::memcpy(base + ctx.edi, base + ctx.esi, w);
        ctx.esi += d;
        ctx.edi += d;
    }
    ctx.ecx = 0;
}

inline void x86_rep_stos(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base, uint32_t w) {
    uint32_t n = ctx.ecx;
    if (!n) return;
    if (!ctx.df && w == 1) {
        std::memset(base + ctx.edi, uint8_t(ctx.eax), n);
        ctx.edi += n;
        ctx.ecx = 0;
        return;
    }
    int32_t d = ctx.df ? -int32_t(w) : int32_t(w);
    uint32_t v = ctx.eax;
    for (; n; n--) {
        std::memcpy(base + ctx.edi, &v, w);
        ctx.edi += d;
    }
    ctx.ecx = 0;
}
```

```h
#pragma once
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>

#include "gpu/state.h"

namespace gpu {

// D3DCLEAR flags as the XDK defines them
enum : uint32_t {
    kClearTarget = 0xF0,  // ARGB channels
    kClearZ = 0x01,
    kClearStencil = 0x02,
};

class Backend {
public:
    virtual ~Backend() = default;
    // the title's back buffer size, the output window may differ
    virtual bool Init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) = 0;
    // rects: count D3DRECTs (4 x int32), null for the whole viewport
    virtual void Clear(const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color, float z,
                       uint32_t stencil) = 0;
    // indices: the title's 16 bit indices, null for non indexed draws, then start is the first vertex
    virtual void Draw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) = 0;
    virtual void Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t src_rects_va,
                      uint32_t dst_points_va) = 0;
    virtual void Present(const Surface& front) = 0;
    // the CPU is about to touch this resource's memory: write GPU results back first
    virtual void Sync(uint32_t data_va, uint32_t size) = 0;
    // a lock that does not wait for the GPU (NOOVERWRITE): a result a frame or two old is what the console gives too
    virtual void SyncLate(uint32_t data_va) = 0;
    // SyncLate in two for the render thread: DeliverLate (any thread) writes the newest finished copy to guest memory,
    // false when there is none recent; RecordLate (in order with the draws) starts a copy for a later lock
    virtual bool DeliverLate(uint32_t) { return false; }
    virtual void RecordLate(uint32_t) {}
    virtual void Flush() = 0;
    virtual void SetGamma(const uint8_t* ramp /*3 x 256*/) = 0;
    // visibility tests: draws count passing pixels while simple[kMCountEnable / 4] is set, ClearReport zeroes the
    // count, GetReport writes it to a 16 byte report once the GPU is past those draws; without them it stays pending
    virtual void ClearReport() {}
    virtual void GetReport(uint32_t /*report*/) {}

    // the XDK's fences and busy checks against the render thread; a backend that draws at once is never behind
    virtual uint32_t Fence() { return ++fence_; }
    virtual bool FencePending(uint32_t) { return false; }
    virtual void WaitFence(uint32_t) {}
    virtual bool Busy(uint32_t /*resource*/) { return false; }
    virtual void WaitResource(uint32_t /*resource*/) {}

private:
    uint32_t fence_ = 0;
};

std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateBackend();
// the same backend driven from a thread of its own: calls return once recorded
std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateThreadedBackend(std::unique_ptr<Backend> inner);

// perf diagnostic: the title's thread recording for the render thread, and waiting on it
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_perf_capture_ns{0}, g_perf_wait_ns{0}, g_perf_waits{0};
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_perf_wait_kind_ns[6];  // read-back, resource, fence, flush, copy, next frame
inline std::atomic<uint64_t> g_perf_sync_late{0}, g_perf_sync_block{0};  // read-backs the title waited for, by cause

// F3: save the next frame, every draw and target, under diag::CaptureDir
inline std::atomic<bool> g_capture{false};

}  // namespace gpu
```

```cpp
cbuffer B : register(b1) { float4 uvrect; float4 opts; };
Texture2D img : register(t0);
Texture2D lut : register(t1);
SamplerState ls : register(s0);
SamplerState ps : register(s1);
struct O { float4 p : SV_Position; float2 uv : TEXCOORD0; };
O vs(uint id : SV_VertexID) {
    O o;
    float2 t = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2);
    o.p = float4(t * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1);
    o.uv = uvrect.xy + t * uvrect.zw;

    float2 px = fwidth(i.uv);

    c /= n * n;
    c.rgb *= opts.w;

    return float4(c.rgb, opts.y > 0 ? c.a : 1);
}
)";

        case 0: return D3D12_BLEND_ZERO;
        case 1: return D3D12_BLEND_ONE;
        case 0x300: return alpha ? D3D12_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA : D3D12_BLEND_SRC_COLOR;
        case 0x301: return alpha ? D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_ALPHA : D3D12_BLEND_INV_SRC_COLOR;

        case 0x307: return alpha ? D3D12_BLEND_INV_DEST_ALPHA : D3D12_BLEND_INV_DEST_COLOR;
        case 0x308: return D3D12_BLEND_SRC_ALPHA_SAT;
        case 0x8001: case 0x8003: return D3D12_BLEND_BLEND_FACTOR;
        case 0x8002: case 0x8004: return D3D12_BLEND_INV_BLEND_FACTOR;

// MemSig hashes a surface up to kSigWholeMax bytes whole, a bigger one as evenly spaced samples
constexpr uint32_t kSigWholeMax = 65536;
constexpr uint32_t kSigSamples = 64;
constexpr uint32_t kSigSampleBytes = 64;

uint64_t MemSig(uint32_t data, uint32_t total) {
    const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(data));
    uint64_t sig = Hash(&total, sizeof(total));
    g_perf.sigs++;
    g_perf.sig_bytes += total <= kSigWholeMax ? total : kSigSamples * kSigSampleBytes;
    if (total <= kSigWholeMax) return Hash(p, total, sig);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < kSigSamples; i++) {
        const uint8_t* sample = p + uint64_t(total - kSigSampleBytes) * i / (kSigSamples - 1);
        sig = Hash(sample, kSigSampleBytes, sig);
    }
    return sig;
}

// MemSig samples a big surface and misses small writes (XFONT text): after a Sync every byte is compared
bool Changed(const Target& t) {
    if (t.drawn || t.read.empty()) return false;
    uint32_t row = t.gw * 4;
    uint32_t pitch = GuestPitch(t.gw);
    const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(t.data));
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < t.gh; y++) {
        if (std::memcmp(p + size_t(y) * pitch, &t.read[size_t(y) * row], row)) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// a lock alone proves nothing, reads lock too: only changed bytes mean the CPU wrote it
bool LatchCpuWrite(Target& t) {
    uint64_t e = DirtyEpoch(t.data);
    if (e <= t.epoch) return false;
    t.epoch = e;
    uint64_t sig = MemSig(t.data, t.bytes);
    if (sig == t.sig && !Changed(t)) return false;
    t.sig = sig;
    return true;
}

};

// Blit's settings past the source and its rectangle
struct BlitOptions {
    bool gamma = false;       // through the gamma lookup
    bool alpha = false;       // the source's alpha, else 1
    uint32_t taps = 1;        // n x n box filter per pixel
    float mul = 1;            // colour scale
    DXGI_FORMAT rtv = kBgra;  // the target's format
    bool over = false;        // premultiplied over the target, which keeps its alpha
};

// Shrink's settings past the source and the size
struct ShrinkOptions {
    uint32_t taps = 1;
    // into: a copy from an earlier call to draw over again, in state into_state
    ID3D12Resource* into = nullptr;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES into_state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
    float mul = 1;
};

// a draw's four texture stages: BindStageTexturesAndTargets fills them, the constants, views and samplers read them
struct DrawTextures {
    TexInfo info[4];
    D3D12_SHADER_RESOURCE_VIEW_DESC sv[4];
    ID3D12Resource* res[4];
    bool rt[4] = {};            // stage samples a render target
    float k[4] = {1, 1, 1, 1};  // Extension::Sample's k
    float wide[4] = {};         // host texels per console texel of a target read into a smaller one, 0 otherwise
};

// a draw's shaders: what they are made from, their cache keys, the hashes Compile returned and the compiled blobs
struct DrawShaders {
    bool prog = false;  // a vertex program, else the fixed function pipeline
    bool quad = false;
    bool fixed_transform = false;  // fixed function on untransformed vertices: the shader reads matrices and lights
    FixedKey fk;
    uint64_t vkey = 0;
    uint64_t vh = 0;
    uint64_t pkey = 0;
    uint64_t ph = 0;
    ID3DBlob* vs_code = nullptr;
    ID3DBlob* ps_code = nullptr;
};

// the render target's console size in pixels, or the depth buffer's without one
struct GuestExtent {
    uint32_t w;
    uint32_t h;
};

class D3D12Backend final : public Backend, public Context {
public:
    bool Init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) override;
    void Clear(const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color, float z,
               uint32_t stencil) override;
    void Draw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) override;
    void Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t src_rects, uint32_t dst_points) override;
    void Present(const Surface& front) override;
    void Sync(uint32_t data, uint32_t size) override;
    void SyncLate(uint32_t data) override;
    bool DeliverLate(uint32_t data) override;
    void RecordLate(uint32_t data) override;
    void Flush() override;
    void SetGamma(const uint8_t* ramp) override;
    void ClearReport() override { counted_.clear(); }
    // done once the list being recorded, the next fence value, has run
    void GetReport(uint32_t report) override { reports_.push_back({report, counted_, fence_value_ + 1}); }

    ID3D12Device* Device() override { return dev_.Get(); }
    ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* List() override { return cl_.Get(); }
    void Release(ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> r) override { CurrentFrame().garbage.push_back(std::move(r)); }
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE View(const Target& t) override { return Cpu(rtv_heap_.Get(), t.view, rtv_inc_); }
    void Unbind() override { bound_rt_ = bound_ds_ = nullptr; }
    void Capture(Target& t, const char* tag, float mul) override;
    float Scale() const override { return scale_; }
    void GuestSize(uint32_t& w, uint32_t& h) const override {
        w = guest_w_;
        h = guest_h_;
    }
    uint64_t Presents() const override { return presents_; }

private:
    struct Frame {
        ComPtr<ID3D12CommandAllocator> alloc;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> upload;
        uint8_t* map = nullptr;
        uint64_t used = 0;
        uint64_t fence = 0;
        std::vector<ComPtr<ID3D12Resource>> garbage;
        uint32_t srv = 0;
    };
    struct Alloc {
        ID3D12Resource* res;
        uint64_t off;
        uint8_t* cpu;
        D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS gpu;
    };

    Alloc Upload(uint64_t size, uint64_t align = 256);
    Frame& CurrentFrame() { return frames_[frame_ % kFrames]; }
    uint32_t AllocSrvSlots(uint32_t n);
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Cpu(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* h, uint32_t i, uint32_t inc) {
        auto c = h->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        c.ptr += size_t(i) * inc;
        return c;
    }
    D3D12_GPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE Gpu(ID3D12DescriptorHeap* h, uint32_t i, uint32_t inc) {
        auto g = h->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart();
        g.ptr += uint64_t(i) * inc;
        return g;
    }
    void Transition(ID3D12Resource* r, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& cur, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES want) override;
    void Begin();
    void Submit(bool wait);
    void WaitFence(uint64_t value);
    void SetFullViewport(uint32_t w, uint32_t h);
    void SetBlitTarget(D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv, uint32_t w, uint32_t h);
    void Blit(ID3D12Resource* src, DXGI_FORMAT fmt, const float uvrect[4], bool gamma, bool alpha, uint32_t taps = 1,
              float mul = 1, DXGI_FORMAT rtv = kBgra) override {
        Blit(src, fmt, uvrect, BlitOptions{.gamma = gamma, .alpha = alpha, .taps = taps, .mul = mul, .rtv = rtv});
    }
    void Blit(ID3D12Resource* src, DXGI_FORMAT fmt, const float uvrect[4], const BlitOptions& o);
    uint32_t EnsureBlitSamplers();
    void DrawFullScreen(ID3D12PipelineState* pso, D3D12_GPU_VIRTUAL_ADDRESS cb, uint32_t srv_slot,
                        std::optional<uint32_t> sampler_slot = {});
    ID3D12Resource* Feedback(Target& t) override;
    void Resolve(Target& t) {
        if (t.range != 1 && ext_) ext_->Resolve(*this, t);
    }
    // Pass, then its step
    void Pass(const char* hlsl, const char* entry, DXGI_FORMAT rtv, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rh, uint32_t w,
              uint32_t h, ID3D12Resource* const src[3], const DXGI_FORMAT fmt[3], const float p[8],
              float blend) override;
    ID3D12PipelineState* EnsurePassPipeline(const char* hlsl, const char* entry, DXGI_FORMAT rtv, float blend);
    // Draw, in call order, each callee right after its caller
    bool DepthCopy(const State& s);
    ID3D12PipelineState* EnsureDepthCopyPipeline();
    void DrawDepthCopy(Target& src, Target& dst, ID3D12PipelineState* pso);
    bool AssembleDraw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices,
                      Assembled& a);
    bool BindTargets(const State& s);
    void EnsureVertexShader(const State& s, const Assembled& a, DrawShaders& sh);
    bool BindStageTexturesAndTargets(const State& s, DrawTextures& stages);
    ID3D12Resource* BindTexture(const State& s, int stage, DrawTextures& stages);
    ID3D12Resource* BindTargetTexture(const State& s, int stage, const TextureDesc& d, Target& t, bool box,
                                      DrawTextures& stages);
    ID3D12Resource* BindGuestTexture(const State& s, int stage, const TextureDesc& d, const FormatInfo& fi,
                                     DrawTextures& stages);
    bool CreateTexture(Tex& tx, const TextureDesc& d, const FormatInfo& fi, uint64_t key);
    void UploadTexture(Tex& tx, const TextureDesc& d, const FormatInfo& fi, const uint8_t* p, const uint32_t* colours,
                       bool same);
    void UploadTextureLevel(Tex& tx, uint32_t f, uint32_t l, const std::vector<uint8_t>& px, uint32_t pitch);
    void EnsurePixelShader(const PixelKey& pk, DrawShaders& sh);
    void BuildPipelineKey(const State& s, const Assembled& a, uint64_t vh, uint64_t ph, PsoKey& k);
    void KeyDepthStencil(const State& s, const Assembled& a, PsoKey& k);
    ID3D12PipelineState* EnsurePipeline(const PsoKey& k, ID3DBlob* vs, ID3DBlob* ps);
    void FillPipelineDesc(const PsoKey& k, ID3DBlob* vs, ID3DBlob* ps, D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC& d) const;
    void ExpandPoints(D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC& d);
    float TargetScale() const;  // host pixels per console pixel of the bound target
    float RenderTargetShift(const State& s, const DrawShaders& sh) const;
    void UploadConstants(const State& s, const DrawShaders& sh, const PsoKey& k, const DrawTextures& stages,
                         GuestExtent size, DrawConstants& c);
    void FillTextureConstants(const State& s, const DrawShaders& sh, const DrawTextures& stages, DrawConstants& c);
    void FillTexelConstants(int i, const TextureDesc& d, const DrawTextures& stages, DrawConstants& c);
    void CaptureDraw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t count, const PsoKey& k, const DrawConstants& c,
                     const DrawTextures& stages);
    void CaptureTextures(const State& s, const DrawTextures& stages);
    void EndDrawCapture(const State& s, const Assembled& a, uint32_t count, const DrawConstants& c);
    void CaptureInputs(const State& s, const Assembled& a, const DrawConstants& c);
    void CaptureShaders(const State& s, const Assembled& a, const DrawShaders& sh, const PixelKey& pk);
    void CaptureShader(const char* kind, uint64_t key, const std::string& src);
    void SetTextureViewsAndSamplers(const State& s, const Assembled& a, DrawTextures& stages);
    uint32_t EnsureStageSamplers(const State& s, const DrawTextures& stages, bool clamp);
    void SetViewportScissor(const State& s, uint32_t gw);
    void SetBlendFactorStencilRef(const State& s);
    void DrawGeometry(const Assembled& a);
    void UploadVertexBuffers(const Assembled& a);
    // visibility tests
    bool EnsureQueries();
    uint32_t BeginCountedDraw(const State& s);
    void EndCountedDraw(uint32_t query);
    float SamplesPerPixel() const;
    void DeliverReports();
    // shaders by source hash: Compile returns the bytecode and sets hash
    ID3DBlob* Compile(const std::string& src, const char* entry, const char* profile, uint64_t& hash);
    // Blit's pipeline
    ID3D12PipelineState* EnsureBlitPipeline(DXGI_FORMAT rtv, bool over = false);
    D3D12_GRAPHICS_PIPELINE_STATE_DESC FullScreenPipelineDesc(ID3DBlob* vs, ID3DBlob* ps, DXGI_FORMAT rtv) const;
    // Init, in order, each callee right after its caller
    bool CreateDevice();
    bool CreateSwapChain(HWND hwnd);
    void CreateHeaps();
    uint32_t CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE t, uint32_t n, bool visible, ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap>& out);
    void CreateBackBufferViews();
    bool CreateRootSignature();
    void CreateFrames();
    void CreateGammaLut();
    void LoadSettings();
    // Present, in call order, each callee right after its caller; DrawFrame runs the two after it
    void FinishCapture(const Surface& front);
    void StartCapture();
    void ResizeSwap();
    void UploadGammaRamp();
    void DrawFrame(Target* t, uint32_t bi);
    void BlitFrame(Target& t);
    void RenderUi();
    void ReleaseOldTextures();
    void ResetFrame();
    void CountFps();
    void ApplySettings();
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> Shrink(ID3D12Resource* src, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& st, DXGI_FORMAT fmt, uint32_t w,
                                  uint32_t h, const ShrinkOptions& o = {});
    bool ReadBack(ID3D12Resource* res, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, std::vector<uint8_t>& out);
    void CapStep(const Surface& rt);
    // a resource CapSave shrinks to w x h and writes, in state *state, colour times mul
    struct CapImage {
        ID3D12Resource* res;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES* state;
        DXGI_FORMAT fmt;
        uint32_t w;
        uint32_t h;
        float mul = 1;
    };
    void CapSave(const CapImage& img, const char* name);
    void CapSave(Target& t, const char* name);
    // a surface's place in targets_: its key, console size and entry, end when it has none
    struct TargetSlot {
        uint32_t data;
        uint64_t key;
        uint32_t gw;
        uint32_t gh;
        std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Target>::iterator it;
        bool sized;  // the entry is there at the surface's size
    };
    Target* FindTarget(const Surface& s, bool depth);
    Target* EnsureTarget(const Surface& s, bool depth);
    // EnsureTarget's steps, in call order
    TargetSlot FindTargetSlot(const Surface& s, bool depth, uint64_t alt);
    uint64_t SizedTargetKey(uint32_t data, bool depth, uint32_t gw, uint32_t gh) const;
    bool TargetStale(uint32_t data) const;
    void ReleaseTarget(std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Target>::iterator it);
    bool CreateTargetResource(Target& t, const Surface& s);
    bool CreateTargetView(Target& t);
    // UploadTarget, then its step
    void UploadTarget(Target& t, const Surface& s);
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> CreatePixelTexture(const std::vector<uint8_t>& px, uint32_t pitch, uint32_t w, uint32_t h);
    // Clear's arguments past the state
    struct ClearArgs {
        uint32_t count;
        const uint8_t* rects;
        uint32_t flags;
        uint32_t color;
        float z;
        uint32_t stencil;
    };
    void ClearTarget(Target& t, const State& s, const ClearArgs& c, std::vector<D3D12_RECT>& rs);
    // Copy's guest lists: count src_rects, dst_points 0 or one per rect
    struct CopyList {
        uint32_t count;
        uint32_t src_rects;
        uint32_t dst_points;
    };
    void CopyByDraw(const Target& src_t, ID3D12Resource* src_res, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& src_state, Target& dst_t,
                    const CopyList& l);
    void CopyByRegion(const Target& src_t, ID3D12Resource* src_res, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& src_state, Target& dst_t,
                      const CopyList& l);
    // the target as a guest sized BGRA copy source, and the shrunk copy that holds it when it is not one already
    struct CopySource {
        ID3D12Resource* res;
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> down;
    };
    CopySource PrepareCopySource(Target& t, const ShrinkOptions& o);
    // RecordLate's steps, under late_lock_
    struct Late;
    void ResetLate(Late& l, const Target& t);
    ID3D12Resource* PrepareLateSource(Target& t, Late& l);
    void RecordLateCopy(Late& l, uint32_t slot, ID3D12Resource* src);

    ComPtr<IDXGIFactory4> factory_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Device> dev_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12CommandQueue> queue_;
    ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain3> swap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> bb_[kFrames];
    ComPtr<ID3D12Fence> fence_;
    HANDLE event_ = nullptr;
    uint64_t fence_value_ = 0;
    Frame frames_[kFrames];
    uint64_t frame_ = 0;
    ComPtr<ID3D12GraphicsCommandList> cl_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> srv_heap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> smp_heap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> rtv_heap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> dsv_heap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap> ui_heap_;
    uint32_t srv_inc_ = 0;
    uint32_t smp_inc_ = 0;
    uint32_t rtv_inc_ = 0;
    uint32_t dsv_inc_ = 0;
    std::vector<uint32_t> free_rtv_;
    std::vector<uint32_t> free_dsv_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12RootSignature> root_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, ComPtr<ID3DBlob>> blobs_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint64_t> shader_src_;  // vertex and pixel program keys to source hash
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>> psos_;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint32_t> samplers_;
    uint32_t smp_used_ = 0;
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Target> targets_;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint64_t> target_used_;  // target address to the frame it was last used
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Tex> textures_;  // by data address, a P8 texture's with its palette's above
    std::unordered_map<uint64_t, ComPtr<ID3D12PipelineState>> blit_psos_;
    Extension* ext_ = nullptr;
    // one frame capture: every draw in a text file, each target as the frame leaves it, the textures it read
    FILE* cap_ = nullptr;
    std::filesystem::path cap_dir_;
    uint32_t cap_i_ = 0;
    uint32_t cap_rt_ = 0;
    std::unordered_set<uint32_t> cap_seen_;
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> cap_sh_;
    struct CapTex {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> res;
        DXGI_FORMAT fmt;
        uint32_t data;
        uint32_t w;
        uint32_t h;
    };
    std::vector<CapTex> cap_tex_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> lut_;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES lut_state_ = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
    uint8_t ramp_[768] = {};
    bool ramp_dirty_ = false;
    bool gamma_ = false;
    Target* bound_rt_ = nullptr;
    Target* bound_ds_ = nullptr;
    Target* draw_rt_ = nullptr;  // the draw's targets, the bound ones go when a texture's copy is drawn
    Target* draw_ds_ = nullptr;
    uint32_t guest_w_ = 640;
    uint32_t guest_h_ = 480;
    uint32_t bb_w_ = 0;
    uint32_t bb_h_ = 0;
    float scale_ = 1.0f;
    // surfaces locked without a wait: copies in flight, the newest finished one goes to guest memory
    struct Late {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> rb[kFrames];
        ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> down;
        D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES down_state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
        uint64_t fence[kFrames] = {};
        uint64_t frame[kFrames] = {};
        uint64_t delivered = 0;
        uint32_t gw = 0;
        uint32_t gh = 0;
        uint32_t row_pitch = 0;
        uint32_t next = 0;
    };
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Late> late_;
    std::mutex late_lock_;                      // DeliverLate runs on the title's thread
    std::atomic<uint64_t> presents_seen_{0};    // presents_ for DeliverLate
    Assembled asm_;  // kept between draws for its buffers
    // visibility tests: an occlusion query per counted draw, summed into report memory once the GPU is done
    struct Query {
        uint32_t index;
        float samples_per_pixel;  // host samples one console pixel covers
    };
    struct Report {
        uint32_t va;
        std::vector<Query> queries;
        uint64_t fence;
    };
    ComPtr<ID3D12QueryHeap> query_heap_;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> query_rb_;
    const uint64_t* query_counts_ = nullptr;
    uint32_t query_next_ = 0;
    std::vector<Query> counted_;  // since the last ClearReport
    std::deque<Report> reports_;
    bool tearing_ = false;
    uint64_t presents_ = 0;
    double fps_ = 0;
    std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point fps_t_ = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    uint64_t fps_n_ = 0;
};

bool D3D12Backend::Init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) {
    guest_w_ = width;
    guest_h_ = height;
    HWND hwnd = static_cast<HWND>(app::Window());
    if (!CreateDevice()) return false;
    if (!CreateSwapChain(hwnd)) return false;
    CreateHeaps();
    CreateBackBufferViews();
    if (!CreateRootSignature()) return false;
    CreateFrames();
    CreateGammaLut();
    ImGui_ImplDX12_Init(dev_.Get(), kFrames, DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, ui_heap_.Get(),
                        ui_heap_->GetCPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart(), ui_heap_->GetGPUDescriptorHandleForHeapStart());
    LoadSettings();
    Begin();
    LOGI("d3d12: %ux%u guest, %ux%u window, render scale %.3f", width, height, bb_w_, bb_h_, scale_);
    return true;
}

bool D3D12Backend::CreateDevice() {
    if (GetEnvironmentVariableW(L"XBE_D3D12_DEBUG", nullptr, 0)) {
        ComPtr<ID3D12Debug> dbg;
        if (SUCCEEDED(D3D12GetDebugInterface(IID_PPV_ARGS(&dbg)))) dbg->EnableDebugLayer();
    }
    if (FAILED(CreateDXGIFactory2(0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&factory_)))) return false;
    // dedicated GPU first on hybrid laptops
    ComPtr<IDXGIFactory6> f6;
    ComPtr<IDXGIAdapter1> adapter;
    if (SUCCEEDED(factory_.As(&f6))) {
        f6->EnumAdapterByGpuPreference(0, DXGI_GPU_PREFERENCE_HIGH_PERFORMANCE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&adapter));
    }
    if (FAILED(D3D12CreateDevice(adapter.Get(), D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&dev_))) &&
        FAILED(D3D12CreateDevice((adapter = nullptr).Get(), D3D_FEATURE_LEVEL_11_0, IID_PPV_ARGS(&dev_)))) {
        LOGE("d3d12: no device");
        return false;
    }
    DXGI_ADAPTER_DESC1 ad{};
    if (adapter) adapter->GetDesc1(&ad);
    LOGR("D3D12 adapter: %ls", adapter ? ad.Description : L"default");
    D3D12_COMMAND_QUEUE_DESC qd{};
    qd.Type = D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT;
    dev_->CreateCommandQueue(&qd, IID_PPV_ARGS(&queue_));
    ComPtr<IDXGIFactory5> f5;
    BOOL tear = FALSE;
    if (SUCCEEDED(factory_.As(&f5))) f5->CheckFeatureSupport(DXGI_FEATURE_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING, &tear, sizeof(tear));
    tearing_ = tear;
    return true;
}

bool D3D12Backend::CreateSwapChain(HWND hwnd) {
    RECT rc;
    GetClientRect(hwnd, &rc);
    bb_w_ = std::max<LONG>(rc.right - rc.left, 1);
    bb_h_ = std::max<LONG>(rc.bottom - rc.top, 1);
    DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_DESC1 sd{};
    sd.Width = bb_w_;
    sd.Height = bb_h_;
    sd.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    sd.SampleDesc.Count = 1;
    sd.BufferUsage = DXGI_USAGE_RENDER_TARGET_OUTPUT;
    sd.BufferCount = kFrames;
    sd.SwapEffect = DXGI_SWAP_EFFECT_FLIP_DISCARD;
    sd.Flags = tearing_ ? DXGI_SWAP_CHAIN_FLAG_ALLOW_TEARING : 0;
    ComPtr<IDXGISwapChain1> sc1;
    if (FAILED(factory_->CreateSwapChainForHwnd(queue_.Get(), hwnd, &sd, nullptr, nullptr, &sc1))) {
        LOGE("d3d12: no swap chain");
        return false;
    }
    factory_->MakeWindowAssociation(hwnd, DXGI_MWA_NO_ALT_ENTER);
    sc1.As(&swap_);
    return true;
}

uint32_t D3D12Backend::CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE t, uint32_t n, bool visible,
                                  ComPtr<ID3D12DescriptorHeap>& out) {
    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_DESC hd{};
    hd.Type = t;
    hd.NumDescriptors = n;
    hd.Flags = visible ? D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE : D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_NONE;
    dev_->CreateDescriptorHeap(&hd, IID_PPV_ARGS(&out));
    return dev_->GetDescriptorHandleIncrementSize(t);
}

void D3D12Backend::CreateBackBufferViews() {
    for (int i = 0; i < kFrames; i++) {
        swap_->GetBuffer(i, IID_PPV_ARGS(&bb_[i]));
        dev_->CreateRenderTargetView(bb_[i].Get(), nullptr, Cpu(rtv_heap_.Get(), kRtvCount + i, rtv_inc_));
    }
}

void D3D12Backend::CreateHeaps() {
    srv_inc_ = CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV, kSrvCount, true, srv_heap_);
    smp_inc_ = CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_SAMPLER, kSamplerCount, true, smp_heap_);
    rtv_inc_ = CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_RTV, kRtvCount + kFrames, false, rtv_heap_);
    dsv_inc_ = CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_DSV, kDsvCount, false, dsv_heap_);
    CreateHeap(D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_TYPE_CBV_SRV_UAV, 1, true, ui_heap_);
    for (uint32_t i = kRtvCount; i-- > 0;) free_rtv_.push_back(i);
    for (uint32_t i = kDsvCount; i-- > 0;) free_dsv_.push_back(i);
}

bool D3D12Backend::CreateRootSignature() {
    D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE ranges[2] = {};
    ranges[0].RangeType = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SRV;
    ranges[0].NumDescriptors = 4;
    ranges[1].RangeType = D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_RANGE_TYPE_SAMPLER;
    ranges[1].NumDescriptors = 4;
    D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER params[4] = {};
    params[0].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_CBV;
    params[0].Descriptor.ShaderRegister = 0;
    params[1].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_CBV;
    params[1].Descriptor.ShaderRegister = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        params[2 + i].ParameterType = D3D12_ROOT_PARAMETER_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_TABLE;
        params[2 + i].DescriptorTable.NumDescriptorRanges = 1;
        params[2 + i].DescriptorTable.pDescriptorRanges = &ranges[i];
        params[2 + i].ShaderVisibility = D3D12_SHADER_VISIBILITY_PIXEL;
    }
    D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_DESC rsd{};
    rsd.NumParameters = 4;
    rsd.pParameters = params;
    rsd.Flags = D3D12_ROOT_SIGNATURE_FLAG_ALLOW_INPUT_ASSEMBLER_INPUT_LAYOUT;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> rs;
    ComPtr<ID3DBlob> err;
    if (FAILED(D3D12SerializeRootSignature(&rsd, D3D_ROOT_SIGNATURE_VERSION_1, &rs, &err))) return false;
    dev_->CreateRootSignature(0, rs->GetBufferPointer(), rs->GetBufferSize(), IID_PPV_ARGS(&root_));
    return true;
}

void D3D12Backend::CreateFrames() {
    for (auto& f : frames_) {
        dev_->CreateCommandAllocator(D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, IID_PPV_ARGS(&f.alloc));
        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD};
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = BufferDesc(kUploadSize);
        dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                      IID_PPV_ARGS(&f.upload));
        f.upload->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&f.map));
    }
    dev_->CreateFence(0, D3D12_FENCE_FLAG_NONE, IID_PPV_ARGS(&fence_));
    event_ = CreateEventW(nullptr, FALSE, FALSE, nullptr);
    dev_->CreateCommandList(0, D3D12_COMMAND_LIST_TYPE_DIRECT, frames_[0].alloc.Get(), nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&cl_));
}

// gamma ramp as a 256 x 1 lookup
void D3D12Backend::CreateGammaLut() {
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT};
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC td = Texture2DDesc(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, 256, 1);
    dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &td, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr,
                                  IID_PPV_ARGS(&lut_));
}

void D3D12Backend::LoadSettings() {
    scale_ = app::RenderScale(guest_h_);
    ext_ = g_extension.get();
    if (ext_) {
        ext_->Settings();
        ext_->Reset(*this);
    }
}

void D3D12Backend::Begin() {
    ID3D12DescriptorHeap* heaps[] = {srv_heap_.Get(), smp_heap_.Get()};
    cl_->SetDescriptorHeaps(2, heaps);
    cl_->SetGraphicsRootSignature(root_.Get());
    bound_rt_ = bound_ds_ = nullptr;
}

void D3D12Backend::Submit(bool wait) {
    cl_->Close();
    ID3D12CommandList* lists[] = {cl_.Get()};
    queue_->ExecuteCommandLists(1, lists);
    queue_->Signal(fence_.Get(), ++fence_value_);
    Frame& f = CurrentFrame();
    f.fence = fence_value_;
    if (wait) {
        WaitFence(fence_value_);
        f.alloc->Reset();
        f.garbage.clear();
        f.used = 0;
        f.srv = 0;
        cl_->Reset(f.alloc.Get(), nullptr);
        Begin();
    }
}

void D3D12Backend::Flush() { Submit(true); }

void D3D12Backend::WaitFence(uint64_t value) {
    fence_->SetEventOnCompletion(value, event_);
    WaitForSingleObject(event_, INFINITE);
}

void D3D12Backend::SetFullViewport(uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    D3D12_VIEWPORT vp{0, 0, float(w), float(h), 0, 1};
    D3D12_RECT scissor{0, 0, LONG(w), LONG(h)};
    cl_->RSSetViewports(1, &vp);
    cl_->RSSetScissorRects(1, &scissor);
}

// one w x h colour target for a Blit, the draw's bound targets forgotten
void D3D12Backend::SetBlitTarget(D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rtv, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    cl_->OMSetRenderTargets(1, &rtv, FALSE, nullptr);
    bound_rt_ = bound_ds_ = nullptr;
    SetFullViewport(w, h);
}

D3D12Backend::Alloc D3D12Backend::Upload(uint64_t size, uint64_t align) {
    Frame& f = CurrentFrame();
    g_perf.upload += size;
    uint64_t o = (f.used + align - 1) & ~(align - 1);
    if (o + size <= kUploadSize) {
        f.used = o + size;
        return {f.upload.Get(), o, f.map + o, f.upload->GetGPUVirtualAddress() + o};
    }
    // too big for the ring: a buffer of its own, released with the frame
    g_perf.overflow++;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> r;
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_UPLOAD};
    constexpr uint64_t kOwnAlign = 0x10000;  // a committed buffer's size granularity
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = BufferDesc((size + kOwnAlign - 1) & ~(kOwnAlign - 1));
    dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_GENERIC_READ, nullptr,
                                  IID_PPV_ARGS(&r));
    uint8_t* p = nullptr;
    r->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&p));
    f.garbage.push_back(r);
    return {r.Get(), 0, p, r->GetGPUVirtualAddress()};
}

uint32_t D3D12Backend::AllocSrvSlots(uint32_t n) {
    Frame& f = CurrentFrame();
    const uint32_t per = kSrvCount / kFrames;
    if (f.srv + n > per) {
        LOG_FIRST(4, "d3d12: descriptor ring wrapped within a frame");
        f.srv = 0;
    }
    uint32_t i = uint32_t(frame_ % kFrames) * per + f.srv;
    f.srv += n;
    return i;
}

void D3D12Backend::Transition(ID3D12Resource* r, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& cur, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES want) {
    if (cur == want) return;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER b{};
    b.Type = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_TYPE_TRANSITION;
    b.Transition.pResource = r;
    b.Transition.Subresource = D3D12_RESOURCE_BARRIER_ALL_SUBRESOURCES;
    b.Transition.StateBefore = cur;
    b.Transition.StateAfter = want;
    cl_->ResourceBarrier(1, &b);
    cur = want;
}

// a resized target gives back its view and its resources
void D3D12Backend::ReleaseTarget(std::unordered_map<uint64_t, Target>::iterator it) {
    if (bound_rt_ == &it->second || bound_ds_ == &it->second) bound_rt_ = bound_ds_ = nullptr;
    (it->second.depth ? free_dsv_ : free_rtv_).push_back(it->second.view);
    CurrentFrame().garbage.push_back(it->second.res);
    if (it->second.fb) CurrentFrame().garbage.push_back(it->second.fb);
    targets_.erase(it);
}

// the host texture of a new target, at render scale or the extension's
bool D3D12Backend::CreateTargetResource(Target& t, const Surface& s) {
    float sc = scale_;
    if (ext_) ext_->MakeTarget(s, t.depth, t.gw, t.gh, sc, t.fmt);
    t.w = std::max(1u, uint32_t(std::lround(t.gw * sc)));
    t.h = std::max(1u, uint32_t(std::lround(t.gh * sc)));
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT};
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC td = Texture2DDesc(DXGI_FORMAT_UNKNOWN, t.w, t.h);
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE cv{};
    if (t.depth) {
        td.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_R24G8_TYPELESS;
        td.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_DEPTH_STENCIL;
        cv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
        cv.DepthStencil.Depth = 1;
        t.state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_DEPTH_WRITE;
    } else {
        td.Format = t.fmt;
        td.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET;
        cv.Format = td.Format;
        t.state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    }
    return SUCCEEDED(dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &td, t.state, &cv,
                                                   IID_PPV_ARGS(&t.res)));
}

// a view from the free pool, cleared; false when the pool is empty
bool D3D12Backend::CreateTargetView(Target& t) {
    auto& pool = t.depth ? free_dsv_ : free_rtv_;
    if (pool.empty()) return false;
    t.view = pool.back();
    pool.pop_back();
    if (t.depth) {
        D3D12_DEPTH_STENCIL_VIEW_DESC dv{};
        dv.Format = DXGI_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;
        dv.ViewDimension = D3D12_DSV_DIMENSION_TEXTURE2D;
        dev_->CreateDepthStencilView(t.res.Get(), &dv, Cpu(dsv_heap_.Get(), t.view, dsv_inc_));
        float one = 1;
        cl_->ClearDepthStencilView(Cpu(dsv_heap_.Get(), t.view, dsv_inc_),
                                   D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_DEPTH | D3D12_CLEAR_FLAG_STENCIL, one, 0, 0, nullptr);
    } else {
        dev_->CreateRenderTargetView(t.res.Get(), nullptr, Cpu(rtv_heap_.Get(), t.view, rtv_inc_));
        float black[4] = {0, 0, 0, 0};
        cl_->ClearRenderTargetView(Cpu(rtv_heap_.Get(), t.view, rtv_inc_), black, 0, nullptr);
    }
    return true;
}

// targets_ key of a surface's colour or depth target
uint64_t TargetMapKey(uint32_t data, bool depth) { return uint64_t(data) << 1 | (depth ? 1 : 0); }
```
