    Transition(bb_[bi].Get(), bs, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PRESENT);
}

void D3D12Backend::ReleaseOldTextures() {
    constexpr uint64_t kSweepEvery = 60;    // presents between sweeps
    constexpr size_t kTexturesKept = 2048;  // no sweep below this many
    constexpr uint64_t kIdleFrames = 600;
    // textures unused for ten seconds go, levels stream theirs in and out
    if (presents_ % kSweepEvery != 0 || textures_.size() <= kTexturesKept) return;
    for (auto it = textures_.begin(); it != textures_.end();) {
        if (it->second.frame + kIdleFrames < presents_) {
            CurrentFrame().garbage.push_back(it->second.res);
            it = textures_.erase(it);
        } else {
            ++it;
        }
    }
}

void D3D12Backend::ResetFrame() {
    Frame& f = CurrentFrame();
    if (f.fence && fence_->GetCompletedValue() < f.fence) {
        auto perf_wait = PerfClock::now();
        WaitFence(f.fence);
        g_perf.wait += PerfMs(perf_wait);
    }
    f.alloc->Reset();
    f.garbage.clear();
    f.used = 0;
    f.srv = 0;
    cl_->Reset(f.alloc.Get(), nullptr);
    Begin();
}

void D3D12Backend::CountFps() {
    fps_n_++;
    auto now = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    double el = std::chrono::duration<double>(now - fps_t_).count();
    if (el >= 0.5) {
        fps_ = fps_n_ / el;
        fps_n_ = 0;
        fps_t_ = now;
    }
}

void LogPerf() {
    static PerfClock::time_point perf_start = PerfClock::now();
    static uint64_t perf_frames = 0;
    perf_frames++;
    double el = PerfMs(perf_start);
    if (el >= 1000.0) {
        Perf& p = g_perf;
        double n = double(perf_frames);
        double host = p.draw + p.clear + p.copy + p.present + p.sync;
        LOGI("perf: %.1f fps %.2f ms/frame | host %.2f (draw %.2f: assemble %.2f bind %.2f [check %.2f, upload %.2f] "
             "compile %.2f; clear %.2f copy %.2f sync %.2f present %.2f [swap %.2f wait %.2f]) other %.2f",
             n * 1000.0 / el, el / n, host / n, p.draw / n, p.assemble / n, p.bind / n, p.sig / n, p.texup / n,
             p.compile / n, p.clear / n, p.copy / n, p.sync / n, p.present / n, p.swap / n, p.wait / n,
             (el - host) / n);
        LOGI("perf: title thread per frame: recording %.2f ms, waiting %.2f ms (%.1f waits: read-back %.2f "
             "resource %.2f fence %.2f flush %.2f copy %.2f, next frame %.2f) | read-backs waited for: %.1f lock, "
             "%.1f NOOVERWRITE",
             g_perf_capture_ns.exchange(0) / n / 1e6, g_perf_wait_ns.exchange(0) / n / 1e6,
             g_perf_waits.exchange(0) / n, g_perf_wait_kind_ns[0].exchange(0) / n / 1e6,
             g_perf_wait_kind_ns[1].exchange(0) / n / 1e6, g_perf_wait_kind_ns[2].exchange(0) / n / 1e6,
             g_perf_wait_kind_ns[3].exchange(0) / n / 1e6, g_perf_wait_kind_ns[4].exchange(0) / n / 1e6,
             g_perf_wait_kind_ns[5].exchange(0) / n / 1e6, g_perf_sync_block.exchange(0) / n,
             g_perf_sync_late.exchange(0) / n);
        LOGI("perf: per frame %.0f draws (%.0f raw) %.0fk verts %.1f MB upload %.1f overflow | %.0f checks %.2f MB "
             "hashed | %.1f tex uploads %.2f MB, %.1f new tex, %.1f new targets, %.1f target uploads, %.1f shrinks, "
             "%.1f read-backs %.1f late | %llu shaders %llu psos this second",
             p.draws / n, p.raw / n, p.verts / n / 1000.0, p.upload / n / 1048576.0, p.overflow / n, p.sigs / n,
             p.sig_bytes / n / 1048576.0, p.texups / n, p.texup_bytes / n / 1048576.0, p.newtex / n,
             p.targets / n, p.rtups / n, p.shrinks / n, p.syncs / n, p.lates / n,
             (unsigned long long)p.shaders, (unsigned long long)p.psos);
        g_perf = Perf{};
        perf_start = PerfClock::now();
        perf_frames = 0;
    }
}

void D3D12Backend::Present(const Surface& front) {
    PerfScope perf_present{g_perf.present};
    if (cap_) {
        FinishCapture(front);
    } else if (g_capture.exchange(false) && CaptureOn()) {
        StartCapture();
    }
    ResizeSwap();
    Target* t = EnsureTarget(front, false);
    if (t && LatchCpuWrite(*t)) UploadTarget(*t, front);
    if (t) Resolve(*t);
    if (ramp_dirty_) UploadGammaRamp();
    Transition(lut_.Get(), lut_state_, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);

    uint32_t bi = swap_->GetCurrentBackBufferIndex();
    DrawFrame(t, bi);
    Submit(false);
    DeliverReports();
    bool vsync = app::Get().vsync;
    auto perf_swap = PerfClock::now();
    swap_->Present(vsync ? 1 : 0, !vsync && tearing_ ? DXGI_PRESENT_ALLOW_TEARING : 0);
    g_perf.swap += PerfMs(perf_swap);

    presents_++;
    presents_seen_.store(presents_);
    frame_++;
    ReleaseOldTextures();
    ResetFrame();
    CountFps();
    if (diag::Perf()) LogPerf();
    ApplySettings();
}

void D3D12Backend::ApplySettings() {
    float want = app::RenderScale(guest_h_);
    bool remake = ext_ && ext_->Settings();
    if (std::fabs(want - scale_) > 1e-4f || remake) {
        Flush();
        for (auto& [key, tg] : targets_) (tg.depth ? free_dsv_ : free_rtv_).push_back(tg.view);
        targets_.clear();
        scale_ = want;
        if (ext_) ext_->Reset(*this);
        bound_rt_ = bound_ds_ = nullptr;
    }
}

// the target resolved, then shrunk with o when it is not guest sized BGRA; res null on failure
D3D12Backend::CopySource D3D12Backend::PrepareCopySource(Target& t, const ShrinkOptions& o) {
    Resolve(t);
    CopySource out{t.res.Get(), nullptr};
    if (t.w != t.gw || t.h != t.gh || t.fmt != kBgra) {
        out.down = Shrink(t.res.Get(), t.state, t.fmt, t.gw, t.gh, o);
        out.res = out.down.Get();
    } else {
        Transition(t.res.Get(), t.state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
    }
    return out;
}

// long unused: the title freed it and other data is at this address now
bool D3D12Backend::TargetStale(uint32_t data) const {
    auto it = target_used_.find(data);
    uint64_t used = it == target_used_.end() ? 0 : it->second;
    return frame_ - used > kStaleFrames;
}

// the CPU reads a surface the GPU drew: bring the pixels back
void D3D12Backend::Sync(uint32_t data, uint32_t) {
    auto it = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(data, false));
    if (it == targets_.end() || !it->second.drawn || TargetStale(data)) return;
    PerfScope perf_sync{g_perf.sync};
    g_perf.syncs++;
    if (diag::Perf()) {
        LOG_FIRST(16, "perf: read-back of %08X (%ux%u guest, %ux%u host)", data, it->second.gw, it->second.gh,
                  it->second.w, it->second.h);
    }
    Target& t = it->second;
    // src.down, when there is one, stays alive until ReadBack is done
    CopySource src = PrepareCopySource(t, {});
    if (!src.res) return;
    std::vector<uint8_t> px;
    if (!ReadBack(src.res, t.gw, t.gh, px)) return;
    // color targets are 32 bit linear in guest memory, the pitch rounds to 64 bytes
    uint32_t pitch = GuestPitch(t.gw);
    uint8_t* guest = static_cast<uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(data));
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < t.gh; y++) std::memcpy(guest + size_t(y) * pitch, &px[size_t(y) * t.gw * 4], t.gw * 4);
    t.read = std::move(px);
    t.drawn = false;
    t.sig = MemSig(t.data, t.bytes);
}

// A NOOVERWRITE lock: the console reads whatever the GPU has finished, so a surface locked every frame gets the newest
// finished copy (a frame or two old) and the CPU never waits on the GPU; one locked now and then still waits in Sync
void D3D12Backend::SyncLate(uint32_t data) {
    if (!DeliverLate(data)) Sync(data, 0);
    RecordLate(data);
}

bool D3D12Backend::DeliverLate(uint32_t data) {
    std::lock_guard lock(late_lock_);
    auto it = late_.find(data);
    if (it == late_.end()) return false;
    Late& l = it->second;
    uint64_t done = fence_->GetCompletedValue();
    uint64_t now = presents_seen_.load();
    int best = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < kFrames; i++) {
        bool finished = l.fence[i] && l.fence[i] <= done;
        bool recent = now - l.frame[i] <= uint64_t(kFrames) + 1;
        bool newest = best < 0 || l.fence[i] > l.fence[best];
        if (finished && recent && newest) best = i;
    }
    if (best < 0) {
        if (diag::Perf()) {
            LOG_FIRST(16, "perf: late %08X nothing finished: done %llu now %llu, slots %llu/%llu %llu/%llu %llu/%llu",
                      data, (unsigned long long)done, (unsigned long long)now, (unsigned long long)l.fence[0],
                      (unsigned long long)l.frame[0], (unsigned long long)l.fence[1], (unsigned long long)l.frame[1],
                      (unsigned long long)l.fence[2], (unsigned long long)l.frame[2]);
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (l.fence[best] > l.delivered) {
        uint8_t* p = nullptr;
        // the last row is not padded to the pitch: a range to the end of the pitch fails to map
        D3D12_RANGE rr{0, size_t(l.row_pitch) * (l.gh - 1) + l.gw * 4};
        if (FAILED(l.rb[best]->Map(0, &rr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&p)))) return false;
        uint32_t pitch = GuestPitch(l.gw);
        uint8_t* dst = static_cast<uint8_t*>(kernel::HostPtr(data));
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < l.gh; y++) std::memcpy(dst + size_t(y) * pitch, p + size_t(y) * l.row_pitch, l.gw * 4);
        D3D12_RANGE none{0, 0};
        l.rb[best]->Unmap(0, &none);
        l.delivered = l.fence[best];
    }
    return true;
}

// a slot set for another size: its buffers go with the frame
void D3D12Backend::ResetLate(Late& l, const Target& t) {
    auto& garbage = CurrentFrame().garbage;
    for (auto& r : l.rb) {
        if (r) garbage.push_back(r);
    }
    if (l.down) garbage.push_back(l.down);
    l = Late{};
    l.gw = t.gw;
    l.gh = t.gh;
}

// the target as a guest sized BGRA copy source, shrunk into l.down when it is not one already
ID3D12Resource* D3D12Backend::PrepareLateSource(Target& t, Late& l) {
    ShrinkOptions reuse{.into = l.down.Get(), .into_state = l.down_state};
    CopySource src = PrepareCopySource(t, reuse);
    if (src.down) {
        l.down = src.down;
        l.down_state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE;
    }
    return src.res;
}

// src into the readback buffer of the slot, made on first use
void D3D12Backend::RecordLateCopy(Late& l, uint32_t slot, ID3D12Resource* src) {
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = src->GetDesc();
    D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT fp;
    UINT rows;
    UINT64 row_size;
    UINT64 bytes;
    dev_->GetCopyableFootprints(&rd, 0, 1, 0, &fp, &rows, &row_size, &bytes);
    if (!l.rb[slot]) {
        D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK};
        D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = BufferDesc(bytes);
        if (FAILED(dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST,
                                                 nullptr, IID_PPV_ARGS(&l.rb[slot])))) {
            return;
        }
    }
    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dl{l.rb[slot].Get(), D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT};
    dl.PlacedFootprint = fp;
    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION sl{src, D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX};
    cl_->CopyTextureRegion(&dl, 0, 0, 0, &sl, nullptr);
    l.row_pitch = fp.Footprint.RowPitch;
    l.fence[slot] = fence_value_ + 1;  // the next Submit carries it
    l.frame[slot] = presents_;
    l.next = (slot + 1) % kFrames;
}

void D3D12Backend::RecordLate(uint32_t data) {
    auto it = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(data, false));
    if (it == targets_.end() || TargetStale(data)) return;
    Target& t = it->second;
    PerfScope perf_sync{g_perf.sync};
    g_perf.lates++;
    // what DeliverLate or Sync left in guest memory is no CPU write to upload back
    t.sig = MemSig(t.data, t.bytes);
    t.read.clear();
    std::lock_guard lock(late_lock_);
    Late& l = late_[data];
    if (l.gw != t.gw || l.gh != t.gh) {
        if (diag::Perf()) LOG_FIRST(16, "perf: late %08X ring reset, %ux%u -> %ux%u", data, l.gw, l.gh, t.gw, t.gh);
        ResetLate(l, t);
    }
    // a copy for a later lock, unless the GPU is a whole ring behind
    uint32_t slot = l.next;
    if (l.fence[slot] > fence_->GetCompletedValue()) return;
    ID3D12Resource* src = PrepareLateSource(t, l);
    if (!src) return;
    RecordLateCopy(l, slot, src);
}

// filters src into a new w x h target, left as a copy source
ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> D3D12Backend::Shrink(ID3D12Resource* src, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& st, DXGI_FORMAT fmt,
                                            uint32_t w, uint32_t h, const ShrinkOptions& o) {
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_DEFAULT};
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC td = Texture2DDesc(DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, w, h);
    td.Flags = D3D12_RESOURCE_FLAG_ALLOW_RENDER_TARGET;
    D3D12_CLEAR_VALUE cv{};
    cv.Format = td.Format;
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> down = o.into;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES down_state = o.into ? o.into_state : D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET;
    g_perf.shrinks++;
    if (free_rtv_.empty()) return nullptr;
    if (down) {
        Transition(down.Get(), down_state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET);
    } else if (FAILED(dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &td,
                                                    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_RENDER_TARGET, &cv, IID_PPV_ARGS(&down)))) {
        return nullptr;
    }
    // borrows the next free view without taking it, only for this recording
    D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rh = Cpu(rtv_heap_.Get(), free_rtv_.back(), rtv_inc_);
    dev_->CreateRenderTargetView(down.Get(), nullptr, rh);
    Transition(src, st, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_PIXEL_SHADER_RESOURCE);
    SetBlitTarget(rh, w, h);
    float uv[4] = {0, 0, 1, 1};
    Blit(src, fmt, uv, {.alpha = true, .taps = o.taps, .mul = o.mul});
    Transition(down.Get(), down_state, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_SOURCE);
    return down;
}

// a BGRA copy source to the CPU, rows packed; waits for the GPU
bool D3D12Backend::ReadBack(ID3D12Resource* res, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC rd = res->GetDesc();
    D3D12_PLACED_SUBRESOURCE_FOOTPRINT fp;
    UINT rows;
    UINT64 row_size;
    UINT64 bytes;
    dev_->GetCopyableFootprints(&rd, 0, 1, 0, &fp, &rows, &row_size, &bytes);
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> rb;
    D3D12_HEAP_PROPERTIES hp{D3D12_HEAP_TYPE_READBACK};
    D3D12_RESOURCE_DESC bd = BufferDesc(bytes);
    if (FAILED(dev_->CreateCommittedResource(&hp, D3D12_HEAP_FLAG_NONE, &bd, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST, nullptr,
                                             IID_PPV_ARGS(&rb)))) {
        return false;
    }
    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION dl{rb.Get(), D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_PLACED_FOOTPRINT};
    dl.PlacedFootprint = fp;
    D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_LOCATION sl{res, D3D12_TEXTURE_COPY_TYPE_SUBRESOURCE_INDEX};
    cl_->CopyTextureRegion(&dl, 0, 0, 0, &sl, nullptr);
    Flush();
    uint8_t* p = nullptr;
    rb->Map(0, nullptr, reinterpret_cast<void**>(&p));
    out.resize(size_t(w) * h * 4);
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < h; y++) std::memcpy(&out[size_t(y) * w * 4], p + size_t(y) * fp.Footprint.RowPitch, w * 4);
    rb->Unmap(0, nullptr);
    return true;
}

// BMP file and info header: byte offsets of the fields CapSave writes
constexpr int kBmpHeaderBytes = 54;
constexpr int kBmpFileSize = 2;
constexpr int kBmpPixelOffset = 10;
constexpr int kBmpInfoSize = 14;
constexpr int kBmpWidth = 18;
constexpr int kBmpHeight = 22;  // negative: rows top down
constexpr int kBmpPlanes = 26;
constexpr int kBmpBitCount = 28;
constexpr int kBmpImageSize = 34;
constexpr uint32_t kBmpInfoBytes = 40;

void D3D12Backend::CapSave(const CapImage& img, const char* name) {
    ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> down = Shrink(img.res, *img.state, img.fmt, img.w, img.h, {.mul = img.mul});
    std::vector<uint8_t> px;
    if (!down || !ReadBack(down.Get(), img.w, img.h, px)) return;
    FILE* f = _wfopen((cap_dir_ / (std::string(name) + ".bmp")).c_str(), L"wb");
    if (!f) return;
    uint8_t hd[kBmpHeaderBytes] = {'B', 'M'};  // BITMAPFILEHEADER and BITMAPINFOHEADER, top down 32 bit
    auto put = [&](int o, uint32_t v) { std::memcpy(hd + o, &v, 4); };
    put(kBmpFileSize, kBmpHeaderBytes + uint32_t(px.size()));
    put(kBmpPixelOffset, kBmpHeaderBytes);
    put(kBmpInfoSize, kBmpInfoBytes);
    put(kBmpWidth, img.w);
    put(kBmpHeight, uint32_t(-int32_t(img.h)));
    hd[kBmpPlanes] = 1;
    hd[kBmpBitCount] = 32;
    put(kBmpImageSize, uint32_t(px.size()));
    fwrite(hd, 1, kBmpHeaderBytes, f);
    fwrite(px.data(), 1, px.size(), f);
    fclose(f);
}

void D3D12Backend::CapSave(Target& t, const char* name) {
    DXGI_FORMAT fmt = t.depth ? DXGI_FORMAT_R24_UNORM_X8_TYPELESS : t.fmt;
    float mul = t.depth ? 1 : t.range;
    CapSave({.res = t.res.Get(), .state = &t.state, .fmt = fmt, .w = t.gw, .h = t.gh, .mul = mul}, name);
}

// the frame moves to another target: save the one it leaves
void D3D12Backend::CapStep(const Surface& rt) {
    uint32_t d = rt.header ? mem::VirtualFromPhysical(rt.data) : 0;
    if (d == cap_rt_) return;
    auto it = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(cap_rt_, false));
    if (cap_rt_ && it != targets_.end()) {
        char name[32];
        snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%04u_%08X", cap_i_, cap_rt_);
        CapSave(it->second, name);
    }
    auto z = targets_.find(TargetMapKey(cap_rt_, true));
    if (cap_rt_ && z != targets_.end()) {
        char name[32];
        snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%04u_%08X_z", cap_i_, cap_rt_);
        CapSave(z->second, name);
    }
    cap_rt_ = d;
}

void D3D12Backend::Capture(Target& t, const char* tag, float mul) {
    if (!cap_) return;
    char name[32];
    snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "%04u_%s_%08X", cap_i_, tag, t.data);
    CapSave({.res = t.res.Get(), .state = &t.state, .fmt = t.fmt, .w = t.gw, .h = t.gh, .mul = mul}, name);
}

void D3D12Backend::SetGamma(const uint8_t* ramp) {
    std::memcpy(ramp_, ramp, sizeof(ramp_));
    ramp_dirty_ = true;
}

}  // namespace

std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateBackend() { return std::make_unique<D3D12Backend>(); }

}  // namespace gpu

#pragma once
// A game's additions to the D3D12 renderer: hooks at fixed points of the console path, none of which run without one
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <d3d12.h>
#include <wrl/client.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <memory>
#include <vector>

#include "gpu/shaders.h"
#include "gpu/state.h"
#include "gpu/texture.h"

namespace gpu {

// a console surface the renderer draws into
struct Target {
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> res;
    bool depth = false;
    uint32_t gw = 0, gh = 0, w = 0, h = 0;
    uint32_t view = 0;
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COMMON;
    uint32_t data = 0, bytes = 0;
    uint64_t epoch = 0, sig = 0;  // last lock seen, guest memory as last matched
    bool drawn = false;           // the GPU wrote it since the last readback
    std::vector<uint8_t> read;    // what Sync left in guest memory
    Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> fb;  // copy read by draws that sample the target they render to
    D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES fb_state = D3D12_RESOURCE_STATE_COPY_DEST;
    DXGI_FORMAT fmt = DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;
    float range = 1;         // colour held divided by it until the extension resolves the target
    uint64_t tag = ~0ull;    // the extension's
};

// what the renderer lends an extension, on the render thread
class Context {
public:
    virtual ID3D12Device* Device() = 0;
    virtual ID3D12GraphicsCommandList* List() = 0;
    virtual void Transition(ID3D12Resource* r, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES& cur, D3D12_RESOURCE_STATES want) = 0;
    virtual void Release(Microsoft::WRL::ComPtr<ID3D12Resource> r) = 0;  // once the GPU is past this frame
    virtual D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE View(const Target& t) = 0;       // a colour target's RTV
    virtual void Unbind() = 0;                                           // the next draw binds its targets again
    virtual ID3D12Resource* Feedback(Target& t) = 0;                     // a copy of t to read while drawing to it
    // src over the bound viewport; taps per axis, colour times mul
    virtual void Blit(ID3D12Resource* src, DXGI_FORMAT fmt, const float uvrect[4], bool gamma, bool alpha, uint32_t taps, float mul,
                      DXGI_FORMAT rtv) = 0;
    // a full screen pass: hlsl holds vs and entry, src is t0 to t2, p is b1, blend >= 0 blends by that factor
    virtual void Pass(const char* hlsl, const char* entry, DXGI_FORMAT rtv, D3D12_CPU_DESCRIPTOR_HANDLE rh, uint32_t w, uint32_t h,
                      ID3D12Resource* const src[3], const DXGI_FORMAT fmt[3], const float p[8], float blend) = 0;
    virtual void Capture(Target& t, const char* tag, float mul) = 0;  // F3: saves t as NNNN_tag_data
    virtual float Scale() const = 0;                                  // render scale
    virtual void GuestSize(uint32_t& w, uint32_t& h) const = 0;       // the title's back buffer
    virtual uint64_t Presents() const = 0;
};

class Extension {
public:
    virtual ~Extension() = default;
    virtual const ShaderHooks* Shaders() const { return nullptr; }
    // settings at init and each present; true remakes every target
    virtual bool Settings() { return false; }
    // after Init, and after the targets were dropped for a remake
    virtual void Reset(Context&) {}
    // a surface looked up as a target: false leaves it unbound, key picks another copy of it
    virtual bool TargetKey(const Surface&, bool /*depth*/, uint64_t& /*key*/) { return true; }
    // a new target: scale from the render scale, fmt of a colour target
    virtual void MakeTarget(const Surface&, bool /*depth*/, uint32_t /*gw*/, uint32_t /*gh*/, float& /*scale*/, DXGI_FORMAT& /*fmt*/) {}
    virtual void BeginDraw(const State&) {}
    virtual void EndDraw() {}
    // targets bound for a draw; true binds them again
    virtual bool Bound(Context&, const State&, Target* /*rt*/, Target* /*ds*/, bool /*pretransformed*/) { return false; }
    // stage samples surface data: key picks the copy, k its texels per render scale texel, box allows the spread taps
    virtual void Sample(uint32_t /*data*/, bool /*depth*/, int /*stage*/, uint64_t& /*key*/, float& /*k*/, bool& /*box*/) {}
    // bound: the target, or a texture with the flags Decoded gave it
    virtual void Sampled(const TextureDesc&, const Target*, uint8_t /*flags*/, TexInfo&) {}
    // a texture level decoded for upload
    virtual void Decoded(const TextureDesc&, const FormatInfo&, uint32_t /*face*/, uint32_t /*level*/, const std::vector<uint8_t>& /*px*/,
                         uint32_t /*pitch*/, uint8_t& /*flags*/) {}
    // a draw's constants: the vertex registers as uploaded, DrawConstants::ext; src_blend 1 without blending
    virtual void Constants(float (*/*vsc*/)[4], float* /*ext*/, const Target* /*rt*/, uint32_t /*src_blend*/) {}
    // a target with range other than 1 is read, copied or presented
    virtual void Resolve(Context&, Target&) {}
};

inline std::unique_ptr<Extension> g_extension;

// before the backend is made
inline void SetExtension(std::unique_ptr<Extension> e) {
    g_extension = std::move(e);
    g_shader_hooks = g_extension ? g_extension->Shaders() : nullptr;
}

}  // namespace gpu

`sdk/runtime/gpu/render_thread.cpp`:

```cpp
// The Direct3D 12 backend on a thread of its own. The title's render thread records each call with what the console
// takes at call time (state changes, resource headers, indices, rects) and goes on; vertex, texture and surface memory
// are read when the draw runs, as the console's GPU reads them after the call returns. The XDK's fences, busy checks
// and locks wait for that.
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#include <smmintrin.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <condition_variable>
#include <cstring>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <vector>

#include "core/diag.h"
#include "core/log.h"
#include "gpu/backend.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"
#include "kernel/memory.h"

namespace gpu {

namespace {

// commands handed over at once, so the render thread keeps close behind and a wait is short
constexpr uint32_t kBatchCommands = 64;

// resource headers the render thread reads: common, data, lock, format, size
constexpr uint32_t kHeaderBytes = 20, kHeaderSlot = 32;
constexpr uint32_t kHeaderRing = 1u << 20;  // guest memory for header copies; a copy is renewed after half a ring

enum class WaitFor : uint8_t { ReadBack, Resource, Fence, Flush, Copy, Frame, Count };

enum class Op : uint8_t { State, Draw, Clear, Copy, Present, Sync, RecordLate, Flush, Gamma, ClearReport, GetReport };

struct Cmd {
    Op op;
    uint32_t a = 0, b = 0, c = 0, d = 0;
    float f = 0;
    uint32_t data = 0, size = 0;  // bytes in Batch::bytes
    int32_t vs = -1, ps = -1;     // index in Batch::vs / ps: the shader changed
    Surface s1, s2;
};

struct Batch {
    uint64_t id = 0;
    std::vector<Cmd> cmds;
    std::vector<uint8_t> bytes;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<VertexShader>> vs;
    std::vector<std::shared_ptr<PixelShader>> ps;
};

// the plain data in State, around its shader pointers and the resource headers (sent as copies); of the transforms only
// view, projection, texture and world are drawn with
struct Range {
    size_t off, len;
};
size_t At(const State& s, const void* p) { return size_t(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(p) - reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&s)); }
std::vector<Range> StateRanges() {
    static const State s;
    return {
        {At(s, &s.simple), At(s, &s.textures) - At(s, &s.simple)},
        {At(s, &s.index_buffer), At(s, &s.vs) - At(s, &s.index_buffer)},
        {At(s, &s.vsc), At(s, &s.rt) - At(s, &s.vsc)},
        {At(s, &s.scissor_count), At(s, &s.transforms) - At(s, &s.scissor_count)},
        {At(s, &s.transforms[2]), 2 * sizeof(s.transforms[0])},
        {At(s, &s.transforms[16]), 4 * sizeof(s.transforms[0])},
        {At(s, &s.transforms[256]), sizeof(s.transforms[0])},
        {At(s, &s.material), sizeof(State) - At(s, &s.material)},
    };
}

// equal bytes, 16 at a time: most of the state is compared on every draw
bool Same(const uint8_t* a, const uint8_t* b, size_t n) {
    size_t i = 0;
    __m128i diff = _mm_setzero_si128();
    for (; i + 16 <= n; i += 16)
        diff = _mm_or_si128(diff, _mm_xor_si128(_mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(a + i)),
                                                _mm_loadu_si128(reinterpret_cast<const __m128i*>(b + i))));
    if (!_mm_testz_si128(diff, diff)) return false;
    return i == n || !std::memcmp(a + i, b + i, n - i);
}

using Clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
uint64_t Ns(Clock::time_point t) { return uint64_t(std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(Clock::now() - t).count()); }

class Threaded final : public Backend {
public:
    explicit Threaded(std::unique_ptr<Backend> inner) : inner_(std::move(inner)), ranges_(StateRanges()) {
        ring_ = mem::AllocSystem(kHeaderRing, 64);
        cur_ = NewBatch();
        std::thread([this] { Run(); }).detach();
    }
    ~Threaded() override {
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_);
            stop_ = true;
        }
        cv_.notify_all();
        std::unique_lock lock(m_);
        // at exit the worker may be gone mid-batch: then the inner backend is left, not freed under it
        if (!done_cv_.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(500), [&] { return exited_; })) (void)inner_.release();
    }

    bool Init(uint32_t width, uint32_t height) override { return inner_->Init(width, height); }

    void Draw(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices) override {
        auto t = Clock::now();
        SendState(s);
        Cmd c{Op::Draw};
        c.a = prim;
        c.b = start;
        c.c = count;
        if (indices) {
            c.d = 1;
            c.data = Put(indices, size_t(count) * 2);
        }
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
        for (uint32_t tex : s.textures) Use(tex);
        for (uint32_t pal : s.palettes) Use(pal);
        for (const auto& st : s.streams) Use(st.vb);
        Use(s.rt.header);
        Use(s.zs.header);
        Written(s.rt);
        if (cur_->cmds.size() >= kBatchCommands) Submit();
        g_perf_capture_ns += Ns(t);
    }

    void Clear(const State& s, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* rects, uint32_t flags, uint32_t color, float z, uint32_t stencil) override {
        auto t = Clock::now();
        SendState(s);
        Cmd c{Op::Clear};
        c.a = count;
        c.b = flags;
        c.c = color;
        c.d = stencil;
        c.f = z;
        if (count && rects) {
            c.data = Put(rects, size_t(count) * 16);
            c.size = count * 16;
        }
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
        Use(s.rt.header);
        Use(s.zs.header);
        if (flags & kClearTarget) Written(s.rt);
        g_perf_capture_ns += Ns(t);
    }

    // rects and points are taken now; the copy itself, CPU or GPU, runs in order like the console's
    void Copy(const Surface& src, const Surface& dst, uint32_t count, uint32_t src_rects, uint32_t dst_points) override {
        auto t = Clock::now();
        Cmd c{Op::Copy};
        c.a = count;
        c.b = count && src_rects ? Scratch(kernel::HostPtr(src_rects), count * 16) : 0;
        c.c = count && dst_points ? Scratch(kernel::HostPtr(dst_points), count * 8) : 0;
        c.s1 = src;
        c.s1.header = Header(src.header);
        c.s2 = dst;
        c.s2.header = Header(dst.header);
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
        Use(src.header);
        Use(dst.header);
        Written(dst);
        g_perf_capture_ns += Ns(t);
    }

    void Present(const Surface& front) override {
        auto t = Clock::now();
        Cmd c{Op::Present};
        c.s1 = front;
        c.s1.header = Header(front.header);
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
        Use(front.header);
        uint64_t id = Submit();
        g_perf_capture_ns += Ns(t);
        // the title records one frame while the one before it draws
        Wait(last_present_, WaitFor::Frame, nullptr);
        last_present_ = id;
    }

    void Sync(uint32_t data, uint32_t) override { ReadBack(data, false); }

    void SyncLate(uint32_t data) override {
        if (!inner_->DeliverLate(data)) {
            if (diag::Perf()) LOG_FIRST(16, "render thread: no finished copy of %08X for a NOOVERWRITE lock, reading it back now", data);
            written_.insert(data);
            ReadBack(data, true);
        }
        Cmd c{Op::RecordLate};
        c.a = data;
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
    }

    void Flush() override {
        cur_->cmds.push_back(Cmd{Op::Flush});
        Wait(Submit(), WaitFor::Flush, "flush");
    }

    void SetGamma(const uint8_t* ramp) override {
        Cmd c{Op::Gamma};
        c.data = Put(ramp, 768);
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
    }

    void ClearReport() override { cur_->cmds.push_back(Cmd{Op::ClearReport}); }
    void GetReport(uint32_t report) override {
        Cmd c{Op::GetReport};
        c.a = report;
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
    }

    uint32_t Fence() override { return uint32_t(cur_->id); }
    bool FencePending(uint32_t fence) override { return fence > done_.load(); }
    void WaitFence(uint32_t fence) override { Wait(fence, WaitFor::Fence, "fence"); }
    bool Busy(uint32_t resource) override {
        auto it = last_use_.find(resource);
        return it != last_use_.end() && it->second > done_.load();
    }
    void WaitResource(uint32_t resource) override {
        auto it = last_use_.find(resource);
        if (it != last_use_.end()) Wait(it->second, WaitFor::Resource, "resource");
    }

private:
    Batch* NewBatch() {
        Batch* b;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_);
            if (free_.empty()) {
                b = new Batch;
            } else {
                b = free_.back();
                free_.pop_back();
            }
        }
        b->id = ++next_id_;
        return b;
    }

    uint32_t Put(const void* p, size_t n) {
        size_t at = (cur_->bytes.size() + 3) & ~size_t(3);
        cur_->bytes.resize(at + n);
        std::memcpy(cur_->bytes.data() + at, p, n);
        return uint32_t(at);
    }

    void ReadBack(uint32_t data, bool late) {
        // only surfaces the GPU wrote since the last read-back hold anything newer than guest memory
        if (!written_.erase(data)) return;
        (late ? g_perf_sync_late : g_perf_sync_block)++;
        if (diag::Perf() && logged_.insert(uint64_t(data) << 1 | (late ? 1 : 0)).second)
            LOGI("render thread: read-back of %08X for %s", data, late ? "a NOOVERWRITE lock without a finished copy" : "a lock / BlockOnResource");
        Cmd c{Op::Sync};
        c.a = data;
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
        Wait(Submit(), WaitFor::ReadBack, "read-back");
    }

    // bytes the render thread reads through a guest address, in the header ring
    uint32_t Scratch(const void* p, uint32_t n) {
        uint32_t size = (n + kHeaderSlot - 1) & ~(kHeaderSlot - 1);
        if (ring_pos_ % kHeaderRing + size > kHeaderRing) ring_pos_ += kHeaderRing - ring_pos_ % kHeaderRing;
        uint32_t at = ring_ + uint32_t(ring_pos_ % kHeaderRing);
        ring_pos_ += size;
        std::memcpy(kernel::HostPtr(at), p, n);
        return at;
    }

    // A header as it is now. The console's push buffer takes a texture's format and address, and a surface's or vertex
    // buffer's address, when they are set; the title points the same header elsewhere before the GPU gets there.
    uint32_t Header(uint32_t header) {
        if (!header || !ring_) return header;
        // vertex buffer, index buffer and palette headers are 12 bytes: reading 20 can run off the end of the heap
        const uint32_t type = kernel::R32(header) & 0x70000;  // 0 vertex, 0x10000 index, 0x30000 palette
        uint8_t now[kHeaderBytes] = {};
        std::memcpy(now, kernel::HostPtr(header), type < 0x20000 || type == 0x30000 ? 12 : kHeaderBytes);
        Recent<HeaderCopy>& r = recent_headers_[(header >> 3) & 63];
        HeaderCopy& c = r.key == header ? *r.value : headers_[header];
        r = {header, &c};
        if (c.made && !std::memcmp(c.bytes, now, kHeaderBytes) && ring_pos_ - c.made < kHeaderRing / 2) return c.at;
        c.at = Scratch(now, kHeaderBytes);
        c.made = ring_pos_;
        std::memcpy(c.bytes, now, kHeaderBytes);
        return c.at;
    }

    // a field of the render thread's State, when it differs from what was sent
    void Delta(const void* field, const void* value, size_t n) {
        uint8_t* sent = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&sent_) + At(sent_, field);
        if (Same(sent, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(value), n)) return;
        std::memcpy(sent, value, n);
        uint32_t head[2] = {uint32_t(At(sent_, field)), uint32_t(n)};
        size_t at = cur_->bytes.size();
        cur_->bytes.resize(at + 8 + n);
        std::memcpy(cur_->bytes.data() + at, head, 8);
        std::memcpy(cur_->bytes.data() + at + 8, value, n);
    }

    // what changed since the last command, in 64 byte pieces
    void SendState(const State& s) {
        const uint8_t* now = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&s);
        Cmd c{Op::State};
        size_t first = cur_->bytes.size();
        for (const Range& r : ranges_)
            for (size_t off = r.off, end = r.off + r.len; off < end; off += 64)
                Delta(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&sent_) + off, now + off, std::min<size_t>(64, end - off));
        std::array<uint32_t, 4> textures;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) textures[i] = Header(s.textures[i]);
        Delta(&sent_.textures, &textures, sizeof(textures));
        std::array<uint32_t, 4> palettes;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) palettes[i] = Header(s.palettes[i]);
        Delta(&sent_.palettes, &palettes, sizeof(palettes));
        auto streams = s.streams;
        for (auto& st : streams) st.vb = Header(st.vb);
        Delta(&sent_.streams, &streams, sizeof(streams));
        Surface rt = s.rt, zs = s.zs;
        rt.header = Header(rt.header);
        zs.header = Header(zs.header);
        Delta(&sent_.rt, &rt, sizeof(rt));
        Delta(&sent_.zs, &zs, sizeof(zs));
        if (s.vs.get() != sent_.vs.get()) {
            sent_.vs = s.vs;
            c.vs = int32_t(cur_->vs.size());
            cur_->vs.push_back(s.vs);
        }
        if (s.ps.get() != sent_.ps.get()) {
            sent_.ps = s.ps;
            c.ps = int32_t(cur_->ps.size());
            cur_->ps.push_back(s.ps);
        }
        if (cur_->bytes.size() == first && c.vs < 0 && c.ps < 0) return;
        c.data = uint32_t(first);
        c.size = uint32_t(cur_->bytes.size() - first);
        cur_->cmds.push_back(c);
    }

    // resources by guest header: the batch that last read them
    void Use(uint32_t header) {
        if (!header) return;
        Recent<uint64_t>& r = recent_uses_[(header >> 3) & 63];
        if (r.key != header) r = {header, &last_use_[header]};
        *r.value = cur_->id;
    }
    void Written(const Surface& s) {
        if (s.header) written_.insert(mem::VirtualFromPhysical(s.data));
    }

    uint64_t Submit() {
        uint64_t id = cur_->id;
        {
            std::lock_guard lock(m_);
            queue_.push_back(cur_);
        }
        cv_.notify_one();
        cur_ = NewBatch();
        return id;
    }

    void Wait(uint64_t id, WaitFor kind, const char* why) {
        if (!id || done_.load() >= id) return;
        if (id >= cur_->id) id = Submit();
        auto t = Clock::now();
        {
            std::unique_lock lock(m_);
            done_cv_.wait(lock, [&] { return done_.load() >= id; });
        }
        uint64_t ns = Ns(t);
        g_perf_wait_ns += ns;
        g_perf_wait_kind_ns[size_t(kind)] += ns;
        if (why) {
            g_perf_waits++;
            if (diag::Perf()) LOG_FIRST(32, "render thread: the title waited %.2f ms for a %s", ns / 1e6, why);
        }
    }

    void Run() {
        using SetDescription = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR);
        if (auto set = reinterpret_cast<SetDescription>(
                reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription"))))
            set(GetCurrentThread(), L"render");
        for (;;) {
            Batch* b;
            {
                std::unique_lock lock(m_);
                cv_.wait(lock, [&] { return stop_ || !queue_.empty(); });
                if (queue_.empty()) break;
                b = queue_.front();
                queue_.pop_front();
            }
            for (const Cmd& c : b->cmds) Execute(*b, c);
            uint64_t id = b->id;
            b->cmds.clear();
            b->bytes.clear();
            b->vs.clear();
            b->ps.clear();
            {
                std::lock_guard lock(m_);
                free_.push_back(b);
                done_.store(id);
            }
            done_cv_.notify_all();
        }
        std::lock_guard lock(m_);
        exited_ = true;
        done_cv_.notify_all();
    }

    void Execute(const Batch& b, const Cmd& c) {
        const uint8_t* data = b.bytes.data() + c.data;
        switch (c.op) {
            case Op::State: {
                uint8_t* s = reinterpret_cast<uint8_t*>(&state_);
                for (const uint8_t* p = data; p < data + c.size;) {
                    uint32_t head[2];
                    std::memcpy(head, p, 8);
                    std::memcpy(s + head[0], p + 8, head[1]);
                    p += 8 + head[1];
                }
                if (c.vs >= 0) state_.vs = b.vs[size_t(c.vs)];
                if (c.ps >= 0) state_.ps = b.ps[size_t(c.ps)];
                break;
            }
            case Op::Draw: inner_->Draw(state_, c.a, c.b, c.c, c.d ? data : nullptr); break;
            case Op::Clear: inner_->Clear(state_, c.a, c.size ? data : nullptr, c.b, c.c, c.f, c.d); break;
            case Op::Copy: inner_->Copy(c.s1, c.s2, c.a, c.b, c.c); break;
            case Op::Present: inner_->Present(c.s1); break;
            case Op::Sync: inner_->Sync(c.a, 0); break;
            case Op::RecordLate: inner_->RecordLate(c.a); break;
            case Op::Flush: inner_->Flush(); break;
            case Op::Gamma: inner_->SetGamma(data); break;
            case Op::ClearReport: inner_->ClearReport(); break;
            case Op::GetReport: inner_->GetReport(c.a); break;
        }
    }

    std::unique_ptr<Backend> inner_;
    std::vector<Range> ranges_;

    // the title's thread
    struct HeaderCopy {
        uint32_t at = 0;
        uint64_t made = 0;  // ring_pos_ after it was written
        uint8_t bytes[kHeaderBytes];
    };
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, HeaderCopy> headers_;
    // the last few lookups, in front of the maps (their elements stay put)
    template <typename T>
    struct Recent {
        uint32_t key = 0;
        T* value = nullptr;
    };
    std::array<Recent<HeaderCopy>, 64> recent_headers_{};
    std::array<Recent<uint64_t>, 64> recent_uses_{};
    uint32_t ring_ = 0;
    uint64_t ring_pos_ = 0;
    Batch* cur_ = nullptr;
    State sent_;  // the state as the render thread will have it
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint64_t> last_use_;
    std::unordered_set<uint32_t> written_;  // surfaces drawn since their last read-back, by data address
    std::unordered_set<uint64_t> logged_;   // perf diagnostic: read-backs named once, by address and kind
    uint64_t next_id_ = 0, last_present_ = 0;

    // the render thread
    State state_;

    std::mutex m_;
    std::condition_variable cv_, done_cv_;
    std::deque<Batch*> queue_;
    std::vector<Batch*> free_;
    std::atomic<uint64_t> done_{0};
    bool stop_ = false, exited_ = false;
};

}  // namespace

std::unique_ptr<Backend> CreateThreadedBackend(std::unique_ptr<Backend> inner) { return std::make_unique<Threaded>(std::move(inner)); }

}  // namespace gpu

```

std::string F(const char* fmt, ...) {
    char buf[1024];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

const char* kCommonHead = R"(
struct VOut {
    float4 pos : SV_Position;
    float4 d0 : COLOR0;

    float4 b0 : COLOR2;

};

cbuffer DC : register(b1) {
