`sdk/runtime/gpu/vertex.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "gpu/vertex.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

#include <dxgiformat.h>

#include "core/log.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

namespace gpu {

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kTypeFloat2H = 0x72;  // FLOAT2H
// D3DVSDT_NONE: a FLOAT with no components, the register reads no stream data
constexpr uint32_t kTypeNone = 0x02;

// D3DVSDT: low nibble the kind, high nibble the component count
void Convert(uint32_t type, const uint8_t* p, float* o) {
    o[0] = 0;
    o[1] = 0;
    o[2] = 0;
    o[3] = 1;
    uint32_t kind = type & 15;
    uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>((type >> 4) & 15, 4);
    if (type == kTypeFloat2H) {
        float v[3];
        std::memcpy(v, p, 12);
        o[0] = v[0];
        o[1] = v[1];
        o[3] = v[2];
        return;
    }
    switch (kind) {
        case 0:  // D3DCOLOR, bytes B G R A
            o[0] = p[2] / 255.0f;
            o[1] = p[1] / 255.0f;
            o[2] = p[0] / 255.0f;
            o[3] = p[3] / 255.0f;
            break;
        case 1:  // NORMSHORT
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int16_t s;
                std::memcpy(&s, p + i * 2, 2);
                o[i] = std::max(s / 32767.0f, -1.0f);
            }
            break;
        case 2:  // FLOAT
            std::memcpy(o, p, n * 4);
            break;
        case 4:  // PBYTE
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) o[i] = p[i] / 255.0f;
            break;
        case 5:  // SHORT
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                int16_t s;
                std::memcpy(&s, p + i * 2, 2);
                o[i] = s;
            }
            break;
        case 6: {  // NORMPACKED3, 11 11 10 signed
            uint32_t v;
            std::memcpy(&v, p, 4);
            int32_t x = int32_t(v << 21) >> 21;
            int32_t y = int32_t(v << 10) >> 21;
            int32_t z = int32_t(v) >> 22;
            o[0] = std::max(x / 1023.0f, -1.0f);
            o[1] = std::max(y / 1023.0f, -1.0f);
            o[2] = std::max(z / 511.0f, -1.0f);
            break;
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
}

// A/B switch: 0 converts every vertex on the CPU, the older path
#ifndef XBE_RAW_VERTICES
#define XBE_RAW_VERTICES 1
#endif
constexpr bool kRawVertices = XBE_RAW_VERTICES;

// D3DVSDT type as the input assembler reads it: DXGI format, what the vertex shader does after, bytes the format reads
struct HostElement {
    uint8_t format = 0;
    uint8_t decode = kDecodeNone;
    uint8_t bytes = 0;
};
HostElement HostFormat(uint32_t type) {
    switch (type) {
        case 0x12: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x22: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 8};
        case 0x32: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 12};
        case 0x42: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, kDecodeNone, 16};
        case kTypeFloat2H: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32_FLOAT, kDecodeFloat2H, 12};
        case 0x40: return {DXGI_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};  // D3DCOLOR, bytes B G R A
        case 0x11: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 2};
        case 0x21: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x31: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, kDecodeW1, 8};
        case 0x41: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SNORM, kDecodeNone, 8};
        case 0x14: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 1};
        case 0x24: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 2};
        case 0x34: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kDecodeW1, 4};
        case 0x44: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM, kDecodeNone, 4};
        case 0x15: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 2};
        case 0x25: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 4};
        case 0x35: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, kDecodeIntW1, 8};
        case 0x45: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SINT, kDecodeInt, 8};
        case 0x16: return {DXGI_FORMAT_R32_UINT, kDecodePacked, 4};
        default: return {};
    }
}

// the index list for a primitive the input assembler has no topology for, or for converted vertices
template <typename F>
void ListIndices(uint32_t prim, uint32_t count, F local, std::vector<uint32_t>& ix, Topology& topology) {
    ix.reserve(size_t(count) * 3);
    topology = Topology::Triangles;
    switch (prim) {
        case 1:  // points
            topology = Topology::Points;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) ix.push_back(local(i));
            break;
        case 2:  // line list
            topology = Topology::Lines;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < count; i += 2) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1)});
            break;
        case 3:  // line loop
        case 4:  // line strip
            topology = Topology::Lines;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 1 < count; i++) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1)});
            if (prim == 3 && count > 2) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(count - 1), local(0)});
            break;
        case 5:  // triangle list
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 2 < count; i += 3) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2)});
            break;
        case 6:  // triangle strip
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 2 < count; i++) {
                if (i & 1) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i + 1), local(i), local(i + 2)});
                else ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2)});
            }
            break;
        case 7:   // fan
        case 10:  // polygon
            for (uint32_t i = 1; i + 1 < count; i++) ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(0), local(i), local(i + 1)});
            break;
        case 8:  // quad list
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 3 < count; i += 4) {
                ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2), local(i), local(i + 2), local(i + 3)});
            }
            break;
        case 9:  // quad strip
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i + 3 < count; i += 2) {
                ix.insert(ix.end(), {local(i), local(i + 1), local(i + 2), local(i + 1), local(i + 3), local(i + 2)});
            }
            break;
    }
}

uint32_t TypeBytes(uint32_t t) {
    if (t == kTypeFloat2H) return 12;
    uint32_t kind = t & 15;
    uint32_t n = (t >> 4) & 15;
    switch (kind) {
        case 0: return 4;
        case 1: case 5: return 2 * n;
        case 4: return n;
        case 6: return 4;
        default: return 4 * n;
    }
}

constexpr uint32_t kResData = 4;

void ResetAssembled(Assembled& out) {
    out.vertices.clear();
    out.indices.clear();
    out.regs = 0;
    out.vertex_count = 0;
    out.topology = Topology::Triangles;
    out.strip = false;
    out.decode = 0;
    out.buffer_count = 0;
    out.index_src = nullptr;
    out.index16 = false;
    out.draw_count = 0;
    out.index_count = 0;
    out.base_vertex = 0;
}

// the draw as Assemble got it, plus the vertex range it reads
struct DrawRange {
    uint32_t prim = 0;
    uint32_t start = 0;
    uint32_t count = 0;
    const uint8_t* ip = nullptr;
    uint32_t first = 0;         // lowest index
    uint32_t first_vertex = 0;  // first vertex read, base vertex applied
    uint32_t span = 0;
};

// the input registers fed by a bound stream and the layout they come from
struct Inputs {
    const VertexShader& layout;
    const int* regs;
    int nregs;
};

struct IndexBounds {
    uint32_t first = 0;
    uint32_t last = 0;
};

// the declaration's register layout, or the one an FVF handle stands for, built into fvf_layout
const VertexShader* PickLayout(const State& s, VertexShader& fvf_layout) {
    if (!(s.vs_handle & 1)) {
        FvfInputs(s.vs_handle, fvf_layout);
        return &fvf_layout;
    }
    return s.vs.get();
}

// D3DFVF: an FVF handle with position XYZRHW
bool Pretransformed(const State& s) {
    return !(s.vs_handle & 1) && (s.vs_handle & 0xE) == 0x4;
}

IndexBounds IndexRange(const uint8_t* ip, uint32_t count) {
    uint16_t lo16 = 0xFFFF;
    uint16_t hi16 = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        uint16_t v;
        std::memcpy(&v, ip + i * 2, 2);
        lo16 = std::min(lo16, v);
        hi16 = std::max(hi16, v);
    }
    return {lo16, hi16};
}

// logical vertex numbers in draw order
uint32_t DrawVertex(const State& s, const DrawRange& d, uint32_t i) {
    if (!d.ip) return d.start + i;
    uint16_t v;
    std::memcpy(&v, d.ip + i * 2, 2);
    return v + s.base_vertex;
}

// the input registers fed by a bound stream, also marked in out.regs
int CollectRegs(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, int* regs, Assembled& out) {
    int nregs = 0;
    for (int r = 0; r < 16; r++) {
        const auto& in = layout.inputs[size_t(r)];
        if (in.stream < 0 || !in.type || in.type == kTypeNone) continue;
        const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
        if (!st.vb) continue;
        regs[nregs++] = r;
        out.regs |= uint16_t(1u << r);
    }
    return nregs;
}

uint32_t StrideOf(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, const VertexShader::Input& in) {
    const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
    return st.stride ? st.stride : layout.stream_stride[size_t(in.stream)];
}

constexpr uint32_t kStrideAlign = 4;            // the input assembler reads strides in dwords
constexpr uint32_t kElementOffsetEnd = 0x10000;  // the element offset is stored as uint16_t

bool RawReadable(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs) {
    for (int k = 0; k < inputs.nregs; k++) {
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(inputs.regs[k])];
        HostElement he = HostFormat(in.type);
        uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, inputs.layout, in);
        bool readable = he.format && stride && stride % kStrideAlign == 0 && in.offset < kElementOffsetEnd &&
                        in.offset % std::min<uint32_t>(he.bytes, 4) == 0 && in.offset + he.bytes <= stride;
        if (!readable) {
            LOG_FIRST(32, "vertex: converted on the CPU: v%d type %02X offset %u stride %u", inputs.regs[k], in.type,
                      in.offset, stride);
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// sparse indices: the vertices they read, copied in draw order
void GatherVertices(const State& s, const DrawRange& d, const uint8_t* data, uint32_t stride,
                    std::vector<uint8_t>& g) {
    g.resize(size_t(d.count) * stride);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < d.count; i++) {
        std::memcpy(&g[size_t(i) * stride], data + size_t(DrawVertex(s, d, i)) * stride, stride);
    }
}

// returns the buffer slot the stream got
int AddRawBuffer(const State& s, const VertexShader& layout, const VertexShader::Input& in, const DrawRange& d,
                 bool dense, Assembled& out) {
    using namespace kernel;
    const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
    uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, layout, in);
    const uint8_t* data = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(st.vb + kResData))));
    int slot = int(out.buffer_count);
    if (dense) {
        out.buffers[out.buffer_count++] = {data + size_t(d.first_vertex) * stride, d.span * stride, stride};
    } else {
        auto& g = out.gathered[out.buffer_count];
        GatherVertices(s, d, data, stride, g);
        out.buffers[out.buffer_count++] = {g.data(), d.count * stride, stride};
    }
    return slot;
}

// primitives the input assembler draws without a rebuilt index list
bool NativePrimitive(uint32_t prim) {
    return prim == 1 || prim == 2 || prim == 4 || prim == 5 || prim == 6;
}

Topology NativeTopology(uint32_t prim) {
    if (prim == 1) return Topology::Points;
    if (prim <= 4) return Topology::Lines;
    return Topology::Triangles;
}

uint32_t MinVertices(uint32_t prim) {
    if (prim == 1) return 1u;
    if (prim <= 4) return 2u;
    return 3u;
}

bool DrawNative(const DrawRange& d, bool dense, Assembled& out) {
    out.strip = d.prim == 4 || d.prim == 6;
    out.topology = NativeTopology(d.prim);
    if (d.ip && dense) {
        out.index_src = d.ip;
        out.index16 = true;
        out.index_count = d.count;
        out.base_vertex = -int32_t(d.first);
    } else {
        out.draw_count = d.count;
    }
    return d.count >= MinVertices(d.prim);
}

bool UseIndexList(Assembled& out) {
    out.index_src = out.indices.data();
    out.index_count = uint32_t(out.indices.size());
    return out.index_count != 0;
}

// a vertex range at most this far over the draw's count is read in place, a sparser one gathered
constexpr uint64_t kDenseSpanPerVertex = 4;
constexpr uint64_t kDenseSpanSlack = 1024;

bool AssembleRaw(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs, const DrawRange& d, Assembled& out) {
    bool dense = uint64_t(d.span) <= uint64_t(d.count) * kDenseSpanPerVertex + kDenseSpanSlack;
    int slot[16];
    std::fill(std::begin(slot), std::end(slot), -1);
    for (int k = 0; k < inputs.nregs; k++) {
        int reg = inputs.regs[k];
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(reg)];
        if (slot[in.stream] < 0) {
            slot[in.stream] = AddRawBuffer(s, inputs.layout, in, d, dense, out);
        }
        HostElement he = HostFormat(in.type);
        out.elements[size_t(reg)] = {he.format, uint8_t(slot[in.stream]), uint16_t(in.offset)};
        out.decode |= uint64_t(he.decode) << (reg * 4);
    }
    out.vertex_count = dense ? d.span : d.count;
    if (NativePrimitive(d.prim)) return DrawNative(d, dense, out);
    auto local = [&](uint32_t i) { return dense ? DrawVertex(s, d, i) - d.first_vertex : i; };
    ListIndices(d.prim, d.count, local, out.indices, out.topology);
    return UseIndexList(out);
}

// a vertex range at most this far over the draw's count is converted whole, in range order
constexpr uint64_t kRangedSpanPerVertex = 2;
constexpr uint64_t kRangedSpanSlack = 64;

// converted on the CPU: each element to a float4, vertices in range order when the indices are dense
bool AssembleConverted(const State& s, const Inputs& inputs, const DrawRange& d, Assembled& out) {
    using namespace kernel;
    int nregs = inputs.nregs;
    std::vector<uint32_t> seq(d.count);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < d.count; i++) seq[i] = DrawVertex(s, d, i);
    bool ranged = uint64_t(d.span) <= uint64_t(d.count) * kRangedSpanPerVertex + kRangedSpanSlack;
    uint32_t n = ranged ? d.span : d.count;
    out.vertex_count = n;
    out.vertices.resize(size_t(n) * nregs * 4);
    for (int k = 0; k < nregs; k++) {
        const auto& in = inputs.layout.inputs[size_t(inputs.regs[k])];
        const auto& st = s.streams[size_t(in.stream)];
        uint32_t data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(st.vb + kResData));
        uint32_t stride = StrideOf(s, inputs.layout, in);
        const uint8_t* src = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(data + in.offset));
        for (uint32_t v = 0; v < n; v++) {
            uint32_t id = ranged ? d.first_vertex + v : seq[v];
            Convert(in.type, src + size_t(id) * stride, &out.vertices[(size_t(v) * nregs + k) * 4]);
        }
        out.elements[size_t(inputs.regs[k])] = {DXGI_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_FLOAT, 0, uint16_t(k * 16)};
    }
    out.buffer_count = 1;
    const uint8_t* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(out.vertices.data());
    out.buffers[0] = {bytes, uint32_t(out.vertices.size() * 4), uint32_t(nregs * 16)};
    auto local = [&](uint32_t i) { return ranged ? seq[i] - d.first_vertex : i; };
    ListIndices(d.prim, d.count, local, out.indices, out.topology);
    return UseIndexList(out);
}

}  // namespace

void FvfInputs(uint32_t fvf, VertexShader& vs) {
    vs.inputs.fill({});
    uint32_t off = 0;
    auto add = [&](int reg, uint32_t type) {
        vs.inputs[size_t(reg)] = {0, off, type};
        off += TypeBytes(type);
    };
    // D3DFVF: position 0xE, normal 0x10, point size 0x20, diffuse 0x40, specular 0x80, texture count bits 8 to 11,
    // sizes from bit 16
    switch (fvf & 0xE) {
        case 0x2: add(0, 0x32); break;
        case 0x4: add(0, 0x42); break;
        case 0x6: case 0x8: case 0xA: case 0xC: {
            add(0, 0x32);
            uint32_t weights = ((fvf & 0xE) - 0x4) / 2;
            add(1, 0x02 | (weights << 4));
            break;
        }
        default: break;
    }
    if (fvf & 0x10) add(2, 0x32);
    if (fvf & 0x20) add(6, 0x12);
    if (fvf & 0x40) add(3, 0x40);
    if (fvf & 0x80) add(4, 0x40);
    uint32_t tex = (fvf >> 8) & 15;
    static const uint32_t kTexType[4] = {0x22, 0x32, 0x42, 0x12};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < tex && i < 4; i++) add(int(9 + i), kTexType[(fvf >> (16 + i * 2)) & 3]);
    vs.stream_stride.fill(0);
    vs.stream_stride[0] = off;
}

bool Assemble(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* ip, Assembled& out) {
    ResetAssembled(out);
    if (!count || prim < 1 || prim > 10) return false;

    VertexShader fvf_layout;
    const VertexShader* layout = PickLayout(s, fvf_layout);
    out.pretransformed = Pretransformed(s);
    if (!layout) return false;

    // the vertex range the draw reads
    IndexBounds bounds = {0, count - 1};
    if (ip) bounds = IndexRange(ip, count);
    if (ip && int64_t(bounds.first) + int32_t(s.base_vertex) < 0) return false;
    DrawRange d;
    d.prim = prim;
    d.start = start;
    d.count = count;
    d.ip = ip;
    d.first = bounds.first;
    d.first_vertex = ip ? uint32_t(int64_t(bounds.first) + int32_t(s.base_vertex)) : start;
    d.span = bounds.last - bounds.first + 1;

    int regs[16];
    int nregs = CollectRegs(s, *layout, regs, out);
    if (!nregs) return false;
    Inputs inputs = {*layout, regs, nregs};

    // the guest's own vertices when the input assembler can read every element of them
    bool raw = kRawVertices && RawReadable(s, inputs);
    if (raw) return AssembleRaw(s, inputs, d, out);
    return AssembleConverted(s, inputs, d, out);
}

}  // namespace gpu
```

`sdk/runtime/gpu/vertex.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <array>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

#include "gpu/state.h"

namespace gpu {

enum class Topology : uint8_t { Points, Lines, Triangles };

// how the vertex shader finishes an element the input assembler reads raw, 4 bits per register in Assembled::decode
enum VertexDecode : uint8_t {
    kDecodeNone,
    kDecodeW1,       // 3 components read as 4: w = 1
    kDecodeInt,      // SHORT: integers to float
    kDecodeIntW1,    // SHORT3
    kDecodePacked,   // NORMPACKED3, 11:11:10 signed in a uint
    kDecodeFloat2H,  // x y w as 3 floats
};

// a buffer the draw reads: guest vertices as they are, or the float4 copy converted on the CPU
struct VertexBuffer {
    const uint8_t* src = nullptr;
    uint32_t bytes = 0, stride = 0;
};

// where input register r comes from: host vertex format (a DXGI_FORMAT), buffer, byte offset in the vertex
struct VertexElement {
    uint8_t format = 0, buffer = 0;
    uint16_t offset = 0;
};

// one draw's vertices and indices as the input assembler takes them
struct Assembled {
    std::vector<float> vertices;    // converted path: vertex_count * regs * 4
    std::vector<uint32_t> indices;  // converted path, or the list rebuilt for fans, quads and loops
    uint16_t regs = 0;              // input registers present, bit per v register
    uint32_t vertex_count = 0;
    Topology topology = Topology::Triangles;
    bool strip = false;             // line or triangle strip, drawn as a strip
    bool pretransformed = false;    // FVF XYZRHW
    uint64_t decode = 0;            // VertexDecode per register, 4 bits each
    std::array<VertexElement, 16> elements{};
    std::array<VertexBuffer, 16> buffers{};
    uint32_t buffer_count = 0;
    const void* index_src = nullptr;  // the title's 16 bit indices, or indices
    bool index16 = false;
    uint32_t index_count = 0;         // 0: an unindexed draw of draw_count vertices
    uint32_t draw_count = 0;
    int32_t base_vertex = 0;
    std::array<std::vector<uint8_t>, 16> gathered;  // raw vertices copied in draw order when the indices are sparse
};

// the FVF bits translated to the register layout the XDK's declarations use
void FvfInputs(uint32_t fvf, VertexShader& out);

// false when there is nothing to draw
// indices: the title's 16 bit indices, null for an unindexed draw
bool Assemble(const State& s, uint32_t prim, uint32_t start, uint32_t count, const uint8_t* indices, Assembled& out);

}  // namespace gpu
```

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <fstream>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <unistd.h>
#endif
#include "xbe/xbe.h"

namespace dispatch {
void Init();
uint32_t KernelThunkAddress(uint32_t ordinal);
}  // namespace dispatch

namespace xnet {
void CloseSockets();  // xdk/xnet.cpp
}

namespace kernel {

uint8_t* g_base = nullptr;
std::string g_launch_file;

namespace {
uint32_t g_saved_data = 0;
bool g_mark = false, g_kept_marked = false;
std::string g_picture, g_kept_picture;  // the last picture the title showed, raw path string with its terminator
constexpr uint32_t kPersistMagic = 0x50535044;  // "DPSP"

std::string PersistFile() { return g_launch_file.substr(0, g_launch_file.find_last_of("/\\") + 1) + "display.bin"; }

// surface header (Common, Data, Lock, Format, Size) then the pixels at +0x40, as the XDK lays out its persisted copy
void LoadPersistedDisplay() {
    std::ifstream f(PersistFile(), std::ios::binary);
    uint32_t head[7] = {};
    if (!f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(head), sizeof head) || head[0] != kPersistMagic || !head[4] || head[4] > 0x800000 ||
        head[6] > 1040)
        return;
    uint32_t block = mem::AllocContiguous(0x40 + head[4], 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1000);
    if (!block || !f.read(static_cast<char*>(HostPtr(block + 0x40)), head[4])) return;
    g_kept_picture.resize(head[6]);
    if (!f.read(g_kept_picture.data(), head[6])) g_kept_picture.clear();
    W32(block, (head[1] & 0xFFFF0000) | 1);
    W32(block + 4, mem::PhysicalFromVirtual(block + 0x40));
    W32(block + 8, 0);
    W32(block + 0xC, head[2]);
    W32(block + 0x10, head[3]);
    g_saved_data = block;
    g_kept_marked = head[5] != 0;
    LOGI("boot: display kept from the previous run, %u bytes%s", head[4], g_kept_marked ? ", marked" : "");
}
}  // namespace

void SavePersistedDisplay(uint32_t common, uint32_t format, uint32_t size, const void* pixels, uint32_t bytes) {
    if (FILE* f = std::fopen(PersistFile().c_str(), "wb")) {
        uint32_t head[7] = {kPersistMagic, common, format, size, bytes, g_mark, uint32_t(g_picture.size())};
        std::fwrite(head, sizeof head, 1, f);
        std::fwrite(pixels, 1, bytes, f);
        std::fwrite(g_picture.data(), 1, g_picture.size(), f);
        std::fclose(f);
    }
}

void MarkPersistedDisplay() { g_mark = true; }
bool KeptDisplayMarked() { return g_kept_marked; }
void SetShownPicture(std::string path) { g_picture = std::move(path); }
const std::string& KeptPicture() { return g_kept_picture; }

uint32_t SavedDataAddress() { return g_saved_data; }
void SetSavedDataAddress(uint32_t surface) { g_saved_data = surface; }
const xbe::Image* g_image = nullptr;
static xbe::Image g_xbe;

bool Boot(std::vector<uint8_t> xbe, const std::string& xbe_name, const std::string& game_dir, const std::string& data_dir) {
    if (!mem::Init()) return false;
    g_base = mem::Base();

    std::string err;
    if (!g_xbe.Parse(std::move(xbe), err)) {
        LOGE("boot: %s: %s", xbe_name.c_str(), err.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    g_image = &g_xbe;
    const xbe::Image& img = g_xbe;
    if (img.entry != X86EntryPoint) {
        LOGE("boot: %s entry %08X does not match the recompiled entry %08X, wrong executable", xbe_name.c_str(), img.entry,
             X86EntryPoint);
        return false;
    }
    LOGI("boot: title %08X, entry %08X, %zu sections", img.title_id, img.entry, img.sections.size());
    for (auto& l : img.libraries) LOGI("boot: library %-8s %u.%u.%u", l.name.c_str(), l.major, l.minor, l.build);

    mem::ReserveImage(img.base, img.image_size);
    std::memcpy(g_base + img.base, img.file.data(), std::min<size_t>(img.header_size, img.file.size()));
    // XBE header 0x120 points at the section headers, 56 bytes each, +0x18 is the reference count that marks one loaded
    uint32_t sec_hdr = img.U32(0x120);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < img.sections.size(); i++) {
        auto& s = img.sections[i];
        if (!(s.flags & xbe::kPreload)) continue;
        std::memcpy(g_base + s.va, img.file.data() + s.raw, std::min(s.rsize, s.vsize));
        W32(sec_hdr + uint32_t(i) * 56 + 0x18, 1);
    }
    if (app::kGame.loaded) app::kGame.loaded();

    InitKernelData();
    dispatch::Init();

    uint32_t missing = 0;
    for (uint32_t slot = img.kernel_thunk;; slot += 4) {
        uint32_t v = R32(slot);
        if (!v) break;
        uint32_t ord = v & 0x7FFFFFFF;  // high bit flags an import by ordinal
        uint32_t data = DataAddress(ord);
        W32(slot, data ? data : dispatch::KernelThunkAddress(ord));
        if (!HasExport(ord)) {
            LOGW("boot: kernel import %u (%s) has no implementation", ord, ExportName(ord));
            missing++;
        }
    }
    LOGI("boot: kernel imports resolved, %u missing", missing);

    MountDefaults(game_dir, data_dir);

    // a quick reboot into this title left its launch data page behind
    g_launch_file = data_dir + "/launch.bin";
    std::ifstream lf(g_launch_file, std::ios::binary);
    if (lf) {
        uint32_t page = mem::AllocContiguous(0x1000, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1000);
        lf.read(static_cast<char*>(HostPtr(page)), 0x1000);
        lf.close();
        std::remove(g_launch_file.c_str());
        W32(g_launch_data_page_va, page);
        LOGI("boot: launch data from the previous run, type %u", R32(page));
        LoadPersistedDisplay();
    }
    std::remove(PersistFile().c_str());

    uint32_t tls = 0;
    if (img.tls_addr) tls = ((img.tls.data_end - img.tls.data_start + img.tls.zero_fill + 15) & ~15u) + 4;
    ThreadRef t = CreateThread(std::max<uint32_t>(img.stack_commit, 0x10000), tls, 0, img.entry, 0, false);
    StartThread(t);
    return true;
}

const char* ImageExe(std::string xbe_path) {
    for (char& c : xbe_path) c = char(std::tolower(uint8_t(c)));
    for (auto& [xbe, exe] : app::kGame.images) {
        size_t n = std::strlen(xbe);
        if (xbe_path.size() >= n && xbe_path.compare(xbe_path.size() - n, n, xbe) == 0 &&
            (xbe_path.size() == n || xbe_path[xbe_path.size() - n - 1] == '\\' || xbe_path[xbe_path.size() - n - 1] == ';'))
            return exe;
    }
    return nullptr;
}

std::wstring HandoverEvent(unsigned long process) {
    return L"Local\\" + std::wstring(app::kGame.name) + L"Handover-" + std::to_wstring(process);
}

void Relaunch(const char* exe) {
    logx::Flush();
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t self[MAX_PATH];
    GetModuleFileNameW(nullptr, self, MAX_PATH);
    std::wstring path = self;
    path = path.substr(0, path.find_last_of(L'\\') + 1) + std::wstring(exe, exe + std::strlen(exe)) + L".exe";
    // the command line keeps its arguments (--instance) behind the new executable
    std::wstring line = GetCommandLineW();
    size_t args = line[0] == L'"' ? line.find(L'"', 1) + 1 : line.find(L' ');
    line = L"\"" + path + L"\"" + (args == std::wstring::npos ? L"" : line.substr(args));
    if (line.find(L"--relaunched") == std::wstring::npos) line += L" --relaunched";  // no boot splash again
    // this process lives on through the handover: the new one binds the same ports
    xnet::CloseSockets();
    STARTUPINFOW si{sizeof(si)};
    PROCESS_INFORMATION pi{};
    if (CreateProcessW(path.c_str(), line.data(), nullptr, nullptr, FALSE, CREATE_SUSPENDED, nullptr, nullptr, &si, &pi)) {
        // this window stays up until the new instance shows its first frames (HandoverEvent), so no gap shows
        HANDLE ready = CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, HandoverEvent(pi.dwProcessId).c_str());
        AllowSetForegroundWindow(pi.dwProcessId);
        g_relaunching = true;
        ResumeThread(pi.hThread);
        HANDLE wait[] = {ready, pi.hProcess};
        if (ready) WaitForMultipleObjects(2, wait, FALSE, 15000);
        if (ready) ::CloseHandle(ready);
        ::CloseHandle(pi.hThread);
        ::CloseHandle(pi.hProcess);
    } else {
        LOGE("relaunch: cannot start %s.exe (%lu)", exe, GetLastError());
    }
    std::_Exit(0);
#else
    char self[4096] = {};
    ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", self, sizeof(self) - 1);
    std::string path = std::string(self, n > 0 ? size_t(n) : 0);
    path = path.substr(0, path.find_last_of('/') + 1) + exe;
    execl(path.c_str(), path.c_str(), nullptr);
    std::_Exit(0);
#endif
}

void Shutdown(int code) {
    LOGR("Exit (%d)", code);
    logx::Flush();
    std::_Exit(code);
}

}  // namespace kernel
```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/crypto.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/crypto.h"

#include <cstring>
#include <utility>

namespace crypto {

namespace {

struct Sha {
    uint32_t h[5];
    uint64_t bytes;
    uint8_t buf[64];
};
static_assert(sizeof(Sha) <= 116, "must fit the console's SHA context");

uint32_t Rol(uint32_t v, int n) { return (v << n) | (v >> (32 - n)); }

void Block(Sha& s, const uint8_t* p) {
    uint32_t w[80];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) w[i] = uint32_t(p[i * 4]) << 24 | uint32_t(p[i * 4 + 1]) << 16 | uint32_t(p[i * 4 + 2]) << 8 | p[i * 4 + 3];
    for (int i = 16; i < 80; i++) w[i] = Rol(w[i - 3] ^ w[i - 8] ^ w[i - 14] ^ w[i - 16], 1);
    uint32_t a = s.h[0], b = s.h[1], c = s.h[2], d = s.h[3], e = s.h[4];
    for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
        uint32_t f, k;
        if (i < 20) f = (b & c) | (~b & d), k = 0x5A827999;
        else if (i < 40) f = b ^ c ^ d, k = 0x6ED9EBA1;
        else if (i < 60) f = (b & c) | (b & d) | (c & d), k = 0x8F1BBCDC;
        else f = b ^ c ^ d, k = 0xCA62C1D6;
        uint32_t t = Rol(a, 5) + f + e + k + w[i];
        e = d;
        d = c;
        c = Rol(b, 30);
        b = a;
        a = t;
    }
    s.h[0] += a;
    s.h[1] += b;
    s.h[2] += c;
    s.h[3] += d;
    s.h[4] += e;
}

}  // namespace

void ShaInit(void* ctx) {
    Sha s{};
    s.h[0] = 0x67452301;
    s.h[1] = 0xEFCDAB89;
    s.h[2] = 0x98BADCFE;
    s.h[3] = 0x10325476;
    s.h[4] = 0xC3D2E1F0;
    std::memcpy(ctx, &s, sizeof(s));
}

void ShaUpdate(void* ctx, const uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    Sha s;
    std::memcpy(&s, ctx, sizeof(s));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        s.buf[s.bytes % 64] = data[i];
        s.bytes++;
        if (s.bytes % 64 == 0) Block(s, s.buf);
    }
    std::memcpy(ctx, &s, sizeof(s));
}

void ShaFinal(void* ctx, uint8_t digest[20]) {
    Sha s;
    std::memcpy(&s, ctx, sizeof(s));
    uint64_t bits = s.bytes * 8;
    uint8_t pad = 0x80;
    ShaUpdate(&s, &pad, 1);
    uint8_t zero = 0;
    while (s.bytes % 64 != 56) ShaUpdate(&s, &zero, 1);
    uint8_t len[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) len[i] = uint8_t(bits >> (56 - i * 8));
    ShaUpdate(&s, len, 8);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) digest[i * 4 + j] = uint8_t(s.h[i] >> (24 - j * 8));
    std::memcpy(ctx, &s, sizeof(s));
}

void Hmac(const uint8_t* key, size_t key_len, const uint8_t* a, size_t a_len, const uint8_t* b, size_t b_len,
          uint8_t digest[20]) {
    uint8_t k[64] = {};
    Sha s;
    if (key_len > 64) {
        ShaInit(&s);
        ShaUpdate(&s, key, key_len);
        ShaFinal(&s, k);
    } else {
        std::memcpy(k, key, key_len);
    }
    uint8_t ipad[64], opad[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        ipad[i] = k[i] ^ 0x36;
        opad[i] = k[i] ^ 0x5C;
    }
    uint8_t inner[20];
    ShaInit(&s);
    ShaUpdate(&s, ipad, 64);
    if (a) ShaUpdate(&s, a, a_len);
    if (b) ShaUpdate(&s, b, b_len);
    ShaFinal(&s, inner);
    ShaInit(&s);
    ShaUpdate(&s, opad, 64);
    ShaUpdate(&s, inner, 20);
    ShaFinal(&s, digest);
}

void Rc4Key(void* ks, const uint8_t* key, size_t len) {
    auto* s = static_cast<uint8_t*>(ks);
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) s[i] = uint8_t(i);
    uint8_t j = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
        j = uint8_t(j + s[i] + key[i % len]);
        std::swap(s[i], s[j]);
    }
    s[256] = 0;  // the i and j indices live after the table
    s[257] = 0;
}

void Rc4Crypt(void* ks, uint8_t* data, size_t len) {
    auto* s = static_cast<uint8_t*>(ks);
    uint8_t i = s[256], j = s[257];
    for (size_t n = 0; n < len; n++) {
        i++;
        j = uint8_t(j + s[i]);
        std::swap(s[i], s[j]);
        data[n] ^= s[uint8_t(s[i] + s[j])];
    }
    s[256] = i;
    s[257] = j;
}

}  // namespace crypto

```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/disc.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/disc.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstring>

#ifdef _WIN32
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#endif

namespace kernel {

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kSector = 2048;
// the game partition: at the start of an xiso, past the video partition of a whole original Xbox disc dump
constexpr uint64_t kPartitions[] = {0, 0x18300000};
// volume descriptor, sector 32 of the partition: magic, root table sector and size, FILETIME, magic again at +0x7EC
constexpr uint32_t kVolume = 32 * kSector;
constexpr char kMagic[] = "MICROSOFT*XBOX*MEDIA";
constexpr size_t kMagicSize = sizeof(kMagic) - 1;
// A folder is a table of entries in a binary tree: +0 left and +2 right entry (in 4-byte units, 0 for none),
// +4 sector, +8 size, +0xC attributes (0x10 folder), +0xD name length, +0xE name. A table of 0xFF is empty.
constexpr uint32_t kEntryHead = 0xE;
constexpr uint8_t kFolder = 0x10;
constexpr uint32_t kMaxTable = 16 << 20;

std::unique_ptr<Disc> g_mounted;

bool SameName(std::string_view a, std::string_view b) {
    return a.size() == b.size() && std::equal(a.begin(), a.end(), b.begin(), [](char x, char y) {
               return std::toupper(uint8_t(x)) == std::toupper(uint8_t(y));
           });
}

std::string Upper(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) c = char(std::toupper(uint8_t(c)));
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

Disc::~Disc() {
    if (file_ == -1) return;
#ifdef _WIN32
    CloseHandle(HANDLE(file_));
#else
    close(int(file_));
#endif
}

// each read carries its own position, so threads reading at once do not queue on one handle
uint32_t Disc::ReadAt(uint64_t at, void* out, uint32_t len) const {
#ifdef _WIN32
    thread_local HANDLE event = CreateEventW(nullptr, TRUE, FALSE, nullptr);
    OVERLAPPED o{};
    o.Offset = DWORD(at);
    o.OffsetHigh = DWORD(at >> 32);
    o.hEvent = event;
    DWORD got = 0;
    if (!ReadFile(HANDLE(file_), out, len, nullptr, &o) && GetLastError() != ERROR_IO_PENDING) return 0;
    if (!GetOverlappedResult(HANDLE(file_), &o, &got, TRUE)) return 0;
    return got;
#else
    ssize_t got = pread(int(file_), out, len, off_t(at));
    return got > 0 ? uint32_t(got) : 0;
#endif
}

bool Disc::Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::string& error) {
    path_ = path;
#ifdef _WIN32
    file_ = intptr_t(CreateFileW(path.c_str(), GENERIC_READ, FILE_SHARE_READ, nullptr, OPEN_EXISTING, FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, nullptr));
#else
    file_ = open(path.c_str(), O_RDONLY);
#endif
    if (file_ == -1) {
        error = "cannot open the file";
        return false;
    }
    for (uint64_t base : kPartitions) {
        uint8_t volume[kSector];
        if (ReadAt(base + kVolume, volume, kSector) != kSector || std::memcmp(volume, kMagic, kMagicSize) != 0 ||
            std::memcmp(volume + 0x7EC, kMagic, kMagicSize) != 0)
            continue;
        base_ = base;
        uint32_t sector, size;
        std::memcpy(&sector, volume + 0x14, 4);
        std::memcpy(&size, volume + 0x18, 4);
        std::memcpy(&time_, volume + 0x1C, 8);
        root_ = {{}, base + uint64_t(sector) * kSector, size, true, {}};
        if (!ReadDir(root_, 0)) {
            error = "its folders cannot be read";
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    error = "no Xbox disc image";
    return false;
}

bool Disc::ReadDir(Entry& dir, int depth) {
    if (!dir.size) return true;
    if (depth > 32 || dir.size > kMaxTable) return false;
    std::vector<uint8_t> table(dir.size);
    if (ReadAt(dir.offset, table.data(), dir.size) != dir.size) return false;
    std::vector<bool> seen(dir.size / 4 + 1);
    std::vector<uint32_t> todo{0};
    while (!todo.empty()) {
        uint32_t at = todo.back();
        todo.pop_back();
        if (at + kEntryHead > dir.size || seen[at / 4]) continue;
        seen[at / 4] = true;
        uint16_t left, right;
        uint32_t sector, size;
        std::memcpy(&left, &table[at], 2);
        std::memcpy(&right, &table[at + 2], 2);
        if (left == 0xFFFF) continue;
        std::memcpy(&sector, &table[at + 4], 4);
        std::memcpy(&size, &table[at + 8], 4);
        uint8_t attributes = table[at + 0xC], length = table[at + 0xD];
        if (at + kEntryHead + length > dir.size) continue;
        if (left) todo.push_back(uint32_t(left) * 4);
        if (right) todo.push_back(uint32_t(right) * 4);
        dir.children.push_back({std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(&table[at + kEntryHead]), length),
                                base_ + uint64_t(sector) * kSector, size, (attributes & kFolder) != 0, {}});
    }
    std::sort(dir.children.begin(), dir.children.end(),
              [](const Entry& a, const Entry& b) { return Upper(a.name) < Upper(b.name); });
    for (Entry& child : dir.children)
        if (child.dir && !ReadDir(child, depth + 1)) return false;
    return true;
}

const Disc::Entry* Disc::Find(const std::vector<std::string>& parts) const {
    std::vector<const Entry*> path{&root_};
    for (const std::string& part : parts) {
        if (part.empty() || part == ".") continue;
        if (part == "..") {
            if (path.size() > 1) path.pop_back();
            continue;
        }
        const Entry* dir = path.back();
        auto it = std::find_if(dir->children.begin(), dir->children.end(), [&](const Entry& e) { return SameName(e.name, part); });
        if (it == dir->children.end()) return nullptr;
        path.push_back(&*it);
    }
    return path.back();
}

const Disc::Entry* Disc::Find(std::string_view path) const {
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    size_t s = 0;
    while (s <= path.size()) {
        size_t e = std::min(path.find('\\', s), path.size());
        parts.emplace_back(path.substr(s, e - s));
        s = e + 1;
    }
    return Find(parts);
}

uint32_t Disc::Read(const Entry& file, uint64_t pos, void* out, uint32_t len) const {
    if (file.dir || pos >= file.size) return 0;
    return ReadAt(file.offset + pos, out, uint32_t(std::min<uint64_t>(len, file.size - pos)));
}

bool Disc::Load(std::string_view path, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) const {
    const Entry* e = Find(path);
    if (!e || e->dir) return false;
    out.resize(e->size);
    return Read(*e, 0, out.data(), e->size) == e->size;
}

void MountDisc(std::unique_ptr<Disc> disc) { g_mounted = std::move(disc); }

const Disc* MountedDisc() { return g_mounted.get(); }

}  // namespace kernel
```

```h
#pragma once
// Xbox DVD file system images (.iso): a whole disc dump, its game partition behind the video one, or the game
// partition alone (xiso). Read only.
#include <cstdint>
#include <filesystem>
#include <memory>
#include <string>
#include <string_view>
#include <vector>

namespace kernel {

class Disc {
public:
    struct Entry {
        std::string name;
        uint64_t offset = 0;  // bytes into the image file; a folder's is its entry table
        uint32_t size = 0;
        bool dir = false;
        std::vector<Entry> children;  // folders, sorted by name
    };
    Disc() = default;
    Disc(const Disc&) = delete;
    Disc& operator=(const Disc&) = delete;
    ~Disc();
    // false with the reason when the file is no Xbox disc image
    bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& path, std::string& error);
    // from the root, any case, ".." steps up; null when missing
    const Entry* Find(const std::vector<std::string>& parts) const;
    const Entry* Find(std::string_view path) const;  // backslash separated
    // at a position in the file, from any thread; the count read, short at the file's end
    uint32_t Read(const Entry& file, uint64_t pos, void* out, uint32_t len) const;
    bool Load(std::string_view path, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) const;
    uint64_t Time() const { return time_; }  // the volume's FILETIME, the only time the disc keeps
    const std::filesystem::path& Path() const { return path_; }

private:
    uint32_t ReadAt(uint64_t at, void* out, uint32_t len) const;
    bool ReadDir(Entry& dir, int depth);

    intptr_t file_ = -1;  // HANDLE or fd
    std::filesystem::path path_;
    uint64_t base_ = 0;  // the game partition
    uint64_t time_ = 0;
    Entry root_;
};

// D: from a disc image instead of a folder, set before Boot
void MountDisc(std::unique_ptr<Disc> disc);
const Disc* MountedDisc();

}  // namespace kernel
```

```h
#pragma once
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

// stdcall export: the body returns eax, the wrapper pops the arguments
#define KERNEL_EXPORT(ord, name, nargs)                                                                   \
    static uint32_t kimpl_##name(X86Context& ctx, const ::kernel::Args& a);                              \
    static void kentry_##name(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {                                               \
        ::kernel::Args args{ctx};                                                                        \
        uint32_t r = kimpl_##name(ctx, args);                                                            \
        ::kernel::Return(ctx, r, nargs);                                                                 \
    }                                                                                                    \
    static const bool kreg_##name = (::kernel::RegisterExport(ord, #name, kentry_##name), true);         \
    static uint32_t kimpl_##name([[maybe_unused]] X86Context& ctx, [[maybe_unused]] const ::kernel::Args& a)

// fastcall export: arguments in ecx and edx, no stack arguments
#define KERNEL_FASTCALL(ord, name)                                                                        \
    static uint32_t kimpl_##name(X86Context& ctx);                                                       \
    static void kentry_##name(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {                                               \
        uint32_t r = kimpl_##name(ctx);                                                                  \
        ::kernel::Return(ctx, r, 0);                                                                     \
    }                                                                                                    \
    static const bool kreg_##name = (::kernel::RegisterExport(ord, #name, kentry_##name), true);         \
    static uint32_t kimpl_##name([[maybe_unused]] X86Context& ctx)

// kernel variable exported by address
#define KERNEL_DATA(ord, name, size) \
    static const uint32_t kdata_##name = ::kernel::RegisterData(ord, #name, size)
```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/files.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <map>

#include "kernel/disc.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"
#include "kernel/exports.h"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

namespace kernel {

namespace {

std::mutex g_links_lock;
std::map<std::string, std::string> g_links;    // upper case "\??\D:" -> "\Device\CdRom0"
std::map<std::string, fs::path> g_devices;     // upper case device -> host directory
constexpr char kCdRom[] = "\\DEVICE\\CDROM0";

std::string Upper(std::string s) {
    for (char& c : s) c = char(std::toupper(uint8_t(c)));
    return s;
}

std::string Normalize(std::string p) {
    std::replace(p.begin(), p.end(), '/', '\\');
    std::string out;
    for (char c : p) {
        if (c == '\\' && !out.empty() && out.back() == '\\') continue;
        out += c;
    }
    while (out.size() > 1 && out.back() == '\\') out.pop_back();
    return out;
}

// host lookup that ignores case on file systems that do not
fs::path MatchCase(const fs::path& dir, const std::vector<std::string>& parts) {
    fs::path cur = dir;
    for (auto& part : parts) {
        if (part.empty() || part == ".") continue;
        if (part == "..") {
            cur = cur.parent_path();
            continue;
        }
        fs::path direct = cur / part;
        std::error_code ec;
        if (fs::exists(direct, ec)) {
            cur = direct;
            continue;
        }
        bool found = false;
        std::string want = Upper(part);
        for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(cur, ec)) {
            if (Upper(e.path().filename().string()) == want) {
                cur = e.path();
                found = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!found) cur = direct;
    }
    return cur;
}

struct File : Object {
    fs::path host;
    std::string xbox;
    FILE* fp = nullptr;
    const Disc::Entry* entry = nullptr;  // on the disc image instead of a host path
    bool dir = false;
    uint64_t pos = 0;
    std::vector<fs::directory_entry> entries;
    std::vector<const Disc::Entry*> disc_entries;
    size_t next = 0;
    bool listed = false;
    bool delete_on_close = false;
    std::mutex io;  // threads sharing a handle: seek and transfer stay together
    File() : Object(ObjType::File) {}
    ~File() override {
        if (fp) std::fclose(fp);
        if (delete_on_close) {
            std::error_code ec;
            fs::remove(host, ec);
        }
    }
};

struct Link : Object {
    std::string target;
    Link() : Object(ObjType::SymLink) {}
};

uint64_t ToFileTime(fs::file_time_type t) {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    auto sys = time_point_cast<nanoseconds>(t - fs::file_time_type::clock::now() + system_clock::now());
    return uint64_t(sys.time_since_epoch().count() / 100 + 116444736000000000ll);
}

void FillNetworkInfo(uint32_t out, uint64_t t, uint64_t size, bool dir) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) W64(out + i * 8, t);
    W64(out + 0x20, (size + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull);
    W64(out + 0x28, size);
    W32(out + 0x30, dir ? 0x10 : 0x80);  // FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY or NORMAL
}

void FillNetworkInfo(uint32_t out, const fs::path& p) {
    std::error_code ec;
    bool dir = fs::is_directory(p, ec);
    FillNetworkInfo(out, ToFileTime(fs::last_write_time(p, ec)), dir ? 0 : fs::file_size(p, ec), dir);
}

void FillNetworkInfo(uint32_t out, const Disc::Entry& e) {
    FillNetworkInfo(out, MountedDisc()->Time(), e.dir ? 0 : e.size, e.dir);
}

bool WildMatch(const std::string& pat, const std::string& s) {
    size_t p = 0, i = 0, star = std::string::npos, mark = 0;
    while (i < s.size()) {
        if (p < pat.size() && (pat[p] == '?' || std::toupper(uint8_t(pat[p])) == std::toupper(uint8_t(s[i])))) {
            p++;
            i++;
        } else if (p < pat.size() && pat[p] == '*') {
            star = p++;
            mark = i;
        } else if (star != std::string::npos) {
            p = star + 1;
            i = ++mark;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    while (p < pat.size() && pat[p] == '*') p++;
    return p == pat.size();
}

// past 2 GB a long offset wraps on Windows
void Seek(FILE* fp, uint64_t pos) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    _fseeki64(fp, int64_t(pos), SEEK_SET);
#else
    fseeko(fp, off_t(pos), SEEK_SET);
#endif
}

void IoStatus(uint32_t iosb, uint32_t status, uint32_t info) {
    if (!iosb) return;
    W32(iosb, status);
    W32(iosb + 4, info);
}

std::shared_ptr<File> FileFromHandle(uint32_t h) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(h);
    if (!o || o->type != ObjType::File) return nullptr;
    return std::static_pointer_cast<File>(o);
}

std::string ObjectName(uint32_t attrs, uint32_t* root = nullptr) {
    if (root) *root = R32(attrs);
    return ReadAnsiString(R32(attrs + 4));
}

void Complete(uint32_t event, uint32_t apc, uint32_t apc_ctx, uint32_t iosb) {
    if (event)
        if (ObjectRef e = FromHandle(event)) SetEvent(*e);
    if (apc && Current()) QueueApc(*Current(), apc, apc_ctx, iosb, 0);
}

}  // namespace

std::string ReadAnsiString(uint32_t str) {
    if (!str) return {};
    uint16_t len = R16(str);
    uint32_t buf = R32(str + 4);
    if (!buf) return {};
    return std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(HostPtr(buf)), len);
}

std::string ReadCString(uint32_t va, size_t max) {
    std::string s;
    if (!va) return s;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < max; i++) {
        char c = char(G<uint8_t>(va + uint32_t(i)));
        if (!c) break;
        s += c;
    }
    return s;
}

void MountDefaults(const std::string& game_dir, const std::string& data_dir) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_links_lock);
    fs::path d = data_dir;
    g_devices[kCdRom] = game_dir;
    g_devices["\\DEVICE\\HARDDISK0\\PARTITION1"] = d / "E";
    g_devices["\\DEVICE\\HARDDISK0\\PARTITION2"] = d / "C";
    g_devices["\\DEVICE\\HARDDISK0\\PARTITION3"] = d / "X";
    g_devices["\\DEVICE\\HARDDISK0\\PARTITION4"] = d / "Y";
    g_devices["\\DEVICE\\HARDDISK0\\PARTITION5"] = d / "Z";
    for (auto& [k, v] : g_devices) {
        std::error_code ec;
        fs::create_directories(v, ec);
    }
    g_links["\\??\\D:"] = "\\Device\\CdRom0";
    const Disc* disc = MountedDisc();
    LOGI("files: D: is %s, hard disk under %s", disc ? disc->Path().string().c_str() : game_dir.c_str(), data_dir.c_str());
}

bool CreateSymbolicLink(const std::string& link, const std::string& target) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_links_lock);
    g_links[Upper(Normalize(link))] = Normalize(target);
    LOGI("files: link %s -> %s", link.c_str(), target.c_str());
    return true;
}

bool DeleteSymbolicLink(const std::string& link) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_links_lock);
    return g_links.erase(Upper(Normalize(link))) != 0;
}

std::string QuerySymbolicLink(const std::string& link) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_links_lock);
    auto it = g_links.find(Upper(Normalize(link)));
    return it == g_links.end() ? std::string() : it->second;
}

namespace {

struct Target {
    std::string host;                    // empty on the disc image or unmapped
    bool disc = false;                   // on the mounted disc image
    const Disc::Entry* entry = nullptr;  // there: the file or folder, null when missing
};

Target Resolve(const std::string& xbox_path, uint32_t root_handle) {
    std::string p = Normalize(xbox_path);
    if (root_handle) {
        if (auto f = FileFromHandle(root_handle)) p = Normalize(f->xbox + "\\" + p);
    }
    if (p.size() >= 2 && p[1] == ':') p = "\\??\\" + p;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_links_lock);
    for (int depth = 0; depth < 8; depth++) {
        std::string up = Upper(p);
        bool changed = false;
        for (auto& [k, v] : g_links) {
            if (up.compare(0, k.size(), k) == 0 && (up.size() == k.size() || up[k.size()] == '\\')) {
                p = v + p.substr(k.size());
                changed = true;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (!changed) break;
    }
    std::string up = Upper(p);
    const std::pair<const std::string, fs::path>* best = nullptr;
    for (auto& e : g_devices)
        if (up.compare(0, e.first.size(), e.first) == 0 && (up.size() == e.first.size() || up[e.first.size()] == '\\'))
            if (!best || e.first.size() > best->first.size()) best = &e;
    if (!best) return {};
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    std::string rest = p.substr(best->first.size());
    size_t s = 0;
    while (s < rest.size()) {
        size_t e = rest.find('\\', s);
        if (e == std::string::npos) e = rest.size();
        if (e > s) parts.push_back(rest.substr(s, e - s));
        s = e + 1;
    }
    // no Xbox name holds ':', and fs::path would take "D:" as a host drive
    for (auto& part : parts)
        if (part.find(':') != std::string::npos) return {};
    if (best->first == kCdRom)
        if (const Disc* disc = MountedDisc()) return {{}, true, disc->Find(parts)};
    return {MatchCase(best->second, parts).string()};
}

// the disc image is read only: nothing on it is created, replaced or written
uint32_t OpenOnDisc(const Disc::Entry* e, const std::string& name, uint32_t handle_out, uint32_t iosb, uint32_t disposition,
                    uint32_t options) {
    if (!e && (disposition == 1 || disposition == 4)) {  // FILE_OPEN or FILE_OVERWRITE need an existing file
        LOG_FIRST(200, "missing %s", name.c_str());
        IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameNotFound, 5);
        return kObjectNameNotFound;
    }
    if (!e || (disposition != 1 && disposition != 3)) {
        IoStatus(iosb, kAccessDenied, 0);
        return kAccessDenied;
    }
    if (e->dir && !(options & 1) && (options & 0x40)) {  // options 1 FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE, 0x40 FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE
        IoStatus(iosb, kFileIsADirectory, 0);
        return kFileIsADirectory;
    }
    auto f = std::make_shared<File>();
    f->xbox = Normalize(name);
    f->entry = e;
    f->dir = e->dir;
    W32(handle_out, NewHandle(f));
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 1);
    LOG_FIRST(400, "open %s", name.c_str());
    return kSuccess;
}

}  // namespace

std::string ResolvePath(const std::string& xbox_path, uint32_t root_handle) { return Resolve(xbox_path, root_handle).host; }

bool ReadGameFile(const std::string& xbox_path, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
    Target t = Resolve(xbox_path, 0);
    if (t.disc) {
        if (!t.entry || t.entry->dir) return false;
        out.resize(t.entry->size);
        return MountedDisc()->Read(*t.entry, 0, out.data(), t.entry->size) == t.entry->size;
    }
    std::ifstream f(t.host, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) return false;
    out.assign(std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f), {});
    return true;
}

// exports

KERNEL_EXPORT(190, NtCreateFile, 9) {
    uint32_t handle_out = a[0], access = a[1], attrs = a[2], iosb = a[3], disposition = a[7], options = a[8];
    (void)access;
    uint32_t root;
    std::string name = ObjectName(attrs, &root);
    Target t = Resolve(name, root);
    if (t.disc) return OpenOnDisc(t.entry, name, handle_out, iosb, disposition, options);
    const std::string& host = t.host;
    if (host.empty()) {
        LOGW("NtCreateFile: no mapping for %s", name.c_str());
        IoStatus(iosb, kObjectPathNotFound, 0);
        return kObjectPathNotFound;
    }
    std::error_code ec;
    bool exists = fs::exists(host, ec);
    bool is_dir = exists && fs::is_directory(host, ec);
    bool want_dir = options & 1;
    uint32_t info = 1;  // FILE_OPENED
    if (want_dir || is_dir) {
        if (!exists) {
            if (disposition == 1 || disposition == 4) {
                IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameNotFound, 5);
                return kObjectNameNotFound;
            }
            fs::create_directories(host, ec);
            info = 2;
        } else if (disposition == 2) {
            IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameCollision, 4);
            return kObjectNameCollision;
        }
        if (!want_dir && (options & 0x40)) {
            IoStatus(iosb, kFileIsADirectory, 0);
            return kFileIsADirectory;
        }
        auto f = std::make_shared<File>();
        f->host = host;
        f->xbox = Normalize(name);
        f->dir = true;
        W32(handle_out, NewHandle(f));
        IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, info);
        return kSuccess;
    }
    const char* mode = nullptr;
    switch (disposition) {
        case 0:  // supersede
        case 5:  // overwrite if
            mode = "w+b";
            info = exists ? 3 : 2;
            break;
        case 1:  // open
            if (!exists) {
                LOG_FIRST(200, "missing %s", name.c_str());
                IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameNotFound, 5);
                return kObjectNameNotFound;
            }
            mode = "r+b";
            break;
        case 2:  // create
            if (exists) {
                IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameCollision, 4);
                return kObjectNameCollision;
            }
            mode = "w+b";
            info = 2;
            break;
        case 3:  // open if
            mode = exists ? "r+b" : "w+b";
            info = exists ? 1 : 2;
            break;
        case 4:  // overwrite
            if (!exists) {
                IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameNotFound, 5);
                return kObjectNameNotFound;
            }
            mode = "w+b";
            info = 3;
            break;
        default:
            return kInvalidParameter;
    }
    // a file in a missing folder fails as on the console: XAPI probes saves with OPEN_ALWAYS
    if (!exists && !fs::is_directory(fs::path(host).parent_path(), ec)) {
        IoStatus(iosb, kObjectPathNotFound, 0);
        return kObjectPathNotFound;
    }
    FILE* fp = std::fopen(host.c_str(), mode);
    if (!fp && std::string(mode) == "r+b") fp = std::fopen(host.c_str(), "rb");  // read only media
    if (!fp) {
        LOGW("NtCreateFile: cannot open %s", host.c_str());
        IoStatus(iosb, kAccessDenied, 0);
        return kAccessDenied;
    }
    auto f = std::make_shared<File>();
    f->host = host;
    f->xbox = Normalize(name);
    f->fp = fp;
    f->delete_on_close = options & 0x1000;  // FILE_DELETE_ON_CLOSE
    W32(handle_out, NewHandle(f));
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, info);
    LOG_FIRST(400, "open %s", name.c_str());
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(202, NtOpenFile, 6) {
    // same as create with FILE_OPEN
    uint32_t handle_out = a[0], attrs = a[2], iosb = a[3], options = a[5];
    uint32_t root;
    std::string name = ObjectName(attrs, &root);
    Target t = Resolve(name, root);
    if (t.disc) return OpenOnDisc(t.entry, name, handle_out, iosb, 1, options);
    const std::string& host = t.host;
    std::error_code ec;
    if (host.empty() || !fs::exists(host, ec)) {
        LOG_FIRST(200, "missing %s", name.c_str());
        IoStatus(iosb, kObjectNameNotFound, 5);
        return host.empty() ? kObjectPathNotFound : kObjectNameNotFound;
    }
    auto f = std::make_shared<File>();
    f->host = host;
    f->xbox = Normalize(name);
    f->dir = fs::is_directory(host, ec);
    if (!f->dir) {
        f->fp = std::fopen(host.c_str(), "r+b");
        if (!f->fp) f->fp = std::fopen(host.c_str(), "rb");
        if (!f->fp) return kAccessDenied;
    }
    (void)options;
    W32(handle_out, NewHandle(f));
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 1);
    return kSuccess;
}

// I/O completes before the call returns: the status block is written, then the file object, the event and the
// APC are signalled (GetOverlappedResult without an event waits on the file handle)
static uint32_t Finish(File& f, uint32_t status, uint32_t n, uint32_t event, uint32_t apc, uint32_t apc_ctx, uint32_t iosb) {
    IoStatus(iosb, status, n);
    SetEvent(f);
    Complete(event, apc, apc_ctx, iosb);
    return status;
}

static uint64_t Offset(File& f, uint32_t off) {
    int64_t o = off ? int64_t(R64(off)) : -1;
    return o >= 0 ? uint64_t(o) : f.pos;
}

// pages is the FILE_SEGMENT_ELEMENT array for scatter and gather, 0 for one buffer
static uint32_t Transfer(const Args& a, bool write, uint32_t pages) {
    uint32_t h = a[0], event = a[1], apc = a[2], apc_ctx = a[3], iosb = a[4], buf = a[5], len = a[6], off = a[7];
    auto f = FileFromHandle(h);
    if (!f || (!f->fp && !f->entry)) return kInvalidHandle;
    if (write && f->entry) return kAccessDenied;
    ResetEvent(*f);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(f->io);
    uint64_t pos = Offset(*f, off);
    if (f->fp) Seek(f->fp, pos);
    uint32_t n = 0;
    while (n < len) {
        uint32_t at = pages ? R32(pages + n / 0x1000 * 8) + n % 0x1000 : buf + n;
        uint32_t chunk = pages ? std::min(len - n, 0x1000 - n % 0x1000) : len;
        size_t done = f->entry ? MountedDisc()->Read(*f->entry, pos + n, HostPtr(at), chunk)
                      : write  ? std::fwrite(HostPtr(at), 1, chunk, f->fp)
                               : std::fread(HostPtr(at), 1, chunk, f->fp);
        n += uint32_t(done);
        if (done < chunk) break;
    }
    f->pos = pos + n;
    if (write && n < len) return Finish(*f, 0xC000007F, n, event, apc, apc_ctx, iosb);  // disk full
    if (!write && len && !n) return Finish(*f, kEndOfFile, 0, event, apc, apc_ctx, iosb);
    return Finish(*f, kSuccess, n, event, apc, apc_ctx, iosb);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(219, NtReadFile, 8) { return Transfer(a, false, 0); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(236, NtWriteFile, 8) { return Transfer(a, true, 0); }
// the buffer argument is an array of one page per element
KERNEL_EXPORT(220, NtReadFileScatter, 8) { return Transfer(a, false, a[5]); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(237, NtWriteFileGather, 8) { return Transfer(a, true, a[5]); }

KERNEL_EXPORT(211, NtQueryInformationFile, 5) {
    uint32_t h = a[0], iosb = a[1], out = a[2], len = a[3], cls = a[4];
    auto f = FileFromHandle(h);
    if (!f) return kInvalidHandle;
    std::error_code ec;
    uint64_t size = f->dir ? 0 : f->entry ? f->entry->size : fs::file_size(f->host, ec);
    if (f->fp) {
        std::fflush(f->fp);
        size = fs::file_size(f->host, ec);
    }
    std::memset(HostPtr(out), 0, len);
    switch (cls) {
        case 4: {  // FileBasicInformation
            uint64_t t = f->entry ? MountedDisc()->Time() : ToFileTime(fs::last_write_time(f->host, ec));
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) W64(out + i * 8, t);
            W32(out + 0x20, f->dir ? 0x10 : 0x80);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x28);
            return kSuccess;
        }
        case 5:  // FileStandardInformation
            W64(out, (size + 0xFFF) & ~0xFFFull);
            W64(out + 8, size);
            W32(out + 0x10, 1);  // NumberOfLinks
            G<uint8_t>(out + 0x15) = f->dir;  // Directory, after DeletePending
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x18);
            return kSuccess;
        case 14:  // FilePositionInformation
            W64(out, f->pos);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 8);
            return kSuccess;
        case 34:  // FileNetworkOpenInformation
            if (f->entry) FillNetworkInfo(out, *f->entry);
            else FillNetworkInfo(out, f->host);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x38);
            return kSuccess;
        case 22:  // FileModeInformation
        case 16:
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 4);
            return kSuccess;
        default:
            LOG_FIRST(8, "NtQueryInformationFile: class %u", cls);
            return kInvalidParameter;
    }
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(226, NtSetInformationFile, 5) {
    uint32_t h = a[0], iosb = a[1], in = a[2], cls = a[4];
    auto f = FileFromHandle(h);
    if (!f) return kInvalidHandle;
    if (f->entry && cls != 14 && cls != 4) return kAccessDenied;
    std::error_code ec;
    switch (cls) {
        case 14:  // position
            f->pos = R64(in);
            break;
        case 19:  // allocation: only a size below the end of file cuts it
        case 20:  // end of file
            if (f->fp) {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(f->io);
                std::fflush(f->fp);
                uint64_t size = fs::file_size(f->host, ec);
                if (cls == 20 || R64(in) < size) fs::resize_file(f->host, R64(in), ec);
            }
            break;
        case 13:  // disposition
            f->delete_on_close = G<uint8_t>(in) != 0;
            break;
        case 10: {  // rename: ReplaceIfExists, RootDirectory, FileName (ANSI_STRING inline)
            uint32_t root = R32(in + 4);
            std::string target = ReadAnsiString(in + 8);
            std::string host = ResolvePath(target, root);
            if (host.empty()) return kObjectPathNotFound;
            if (f->fp) std::fflush(f->fp);
            fs::rename(f->host, host, ec);
            if (ec) return kAccessDenied;
            f->host = host;
            break;
        }
        case 4:  // basic, times and attributes are not kept
            break;
        default:
            LOG_FIRST(8, "NtSetInformationFile: class %u", cls);
            return kInvalidParameter;
    }
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(218, NtQueryVolumeInformationFile, 5) {
    uint32_t iosb = a[1], out = a[2], len = a[3], cls = a[4];
    std::memset(HostPtr(out), 0, len);
    switch (cls) {
        case 3:  // FileFsSizeInformation: 16 GiB total, 8 GiB free in 16 KiB units
            W64(out, 0x100000);
            W64(out + 8, 0x80000);
            W32(out + 0x10, 32);
            W32(out + 0x14, 512);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x18);
            return kSuccess;
        case 7:  // FileFsFullSizeInformation
            W64(out, 0x100000);
            W64(out + 8, 0x80000);
            W64(out + 0x10, 0x80000);
            W32(out + 0x18, 32);
            W32(out + 0x1C, 512);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x20);
            return kSuccess;
        case 1:  // FileFsVolumeInformation
            W32(out + 8, 0x12345678);  // VolumeSerialNumber
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 0x18);
            return kSuccess;
        case 5:  // FileFsAttributeInformation: attributes, max name, name length, "FATX"
            W32(out, 0);
            W32(out + 4, 42);
            W32(out + 8, 4);
            std::memcpy(HostPtr(out + 12), "FATX", 4);
            IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, 16);
            return kSuccess;
        default:
            LOG_FIRST(8, "NtQueryVolumeInformationFile: class %u", cls);
            return kInvalidParameter;
    }
}

// (file object, class, length, out, returned length): XAPI asks the file system's name of an object from
// ObReferenceObjectByHandle, then reads the FATX or GDFX device's own records through it, which a host file has
// none of. Failing is what a title's caller handles: a host file has no disc position, so it becomes 0.
KERNEL_EXPORT(76, IoQueryVolumeInformation, 5) {
    LOG_FIRST(4, "IoQueryVolumeInformation: class %u, no volume behind a host file", a[1]);
    return kInvalidParameter;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(207, NtQueryDirectoryFile, 10) {
    uint32_t h = a[0], event = a[1], apc = a[2], apc_ctx = a[3], iosb = a[4], out = a[5], len = a[6], cls = a[7],
             mask = a[8], restart = a[9];
    auto f = FileFromHandle(h);
    if (!f || !f->dir) return kInvalidHandle;
    if (cls != 1) {
        LOG_FIRST(8, "NtQueryDirectoryFile: class %u", cls);
        return kInvalidParameter;
    }
    std::string pat = mask ? ReadAnsiString(mask) : "*";
    if (!f->listed || (restart & 0xFF)) {
        f->entries.clear();
        f->disc_entries.clear();
        if (f->entry) {
            for (const Disc::Entry& e : f->entry->children)
                if (WildMatch(pat, e.name)) f->disc_entries.push_back(&e);
        } else {
            std::error_code ec;
            for (auto& e : fs::directory_iterator(f->host, ec))
                if (WildMatch(pat, e.path().filename().string())) f->entries.push_back(e);
            std::sort(f->entries.begin(), f->entries.end());
        }
        f->next = 0;
        f->listed = true;
    }
    if (f->next >= (f->entry ? f->disc_entries.size() : f->entries.size())) {
        IoStatus(iosb, kNoMoreFiles, 0);
        return f->next == 0 ? kNoSuchFile : kNoMoreFiles;
    }
    size_t i = f->next++;
    std::string fname = f->entry ? f->disc_entries[i]->name : f->entries[i].path().filename().string();
    uint32_t need = 0x40 + uint32_t(fname.size());
    if (len < need) return kBufferTooSmall;
    std::memset(HostPtr(out), 0, need);
    // times, sizes and attributes sit at the same place
    if (f->entry) FillNetworkInfo(out + 8, *f->disc_entries[i]);
    else FillNetworkInfo(out + 8, f->entries[i].path());
    // FILE_DIRECTORY_INFORMATION has EndOfFile before AllocationSize, the reverse of the network info
    W32(out + 0x38, R32(out + 8 + 0x30));
    uint64_t alloc = R64(out + 8 + 0x20), eof = R64(out + 8 + 0x28);
    W64(out + 0x28, eof);
    W64(out + 0x30, alloc);
    W32(out + 0x3C, uint32_t(fname.size()));
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(out + 0x40), fname.data(), fname.size());
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, need);
    Complete(event, apc, apc_ctx, iosb);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(210, NtQueryFullAttributesFile, 2) {
    std::string name = ReadAnsiString(R32(a[0] + 4));
    Target t = Resolve(name, R32(a[0]));
    std::error_code ec;
    if (t.disc ? !t.entry : t.host.empty() || !fs::exists(t.host, ec)) {
        LOG_FIRST(200, "missing %s", name.c_str());
        return kObjectNameNotFound;
    }
    if (t.disc) FillNetworkInfo(a[1], *t.entry);
    else FillNetworkInfo(a[1], t.host);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(195, NtDeleteFile, 1) {
    std::string host = ResolvePath(ReadAnsiString(R32(a[0] + 4)), R32(a[0]));
    std::error_code ec;
    if (host.empty() || !fs::remove(host, ec)) return kObjectNameNotFound;
    return kSuccess;
}

        if (f->fp) std::fflush(f->fp);

KERNEL_EXPORT(196, NtDeviceIoControlFile, 10) {
    uint32_t iosb = a[4], code = a[5], out = a[8], out_len = a[9];
    LOG_FIRST(16, "NtDeviceIoControlFile: code %08X", code);
    if (out && out_len) std::memset(HostPtr(out), 0, out_len);
    if (code == 0x70000 && out_len >= 0x18) {  // IOCTL_DISK_GET_DRIVE_GEOMETRY
        W64(out, 1000);
        W32(out + 8, 12);
        W32(out + 12, 255);
        W32(out + 16, 63);
        W32(out + 20, 512);
    }
    IoStatus(iosb, kSuccess, out_len);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(203, NtOpenSymbolicLinkObject, 2) {
    std::string name = ObjectName(a[1]);
    std::string target = QuerySymbolicLink(name);
    if (target.empty()) return kObjectNameNotFound;
    auto l = std::make_shared<Link>();
    l->target = target;
    W32(a[0], NewHandle(l));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(215, NtQuerySymbolicLinkObject, 3) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(a[0]);
    if (!o || o->type != ObjType::SymLink) return kInvalidHandle;
    auto& t = static_cast<Link&>(*o).target;
    uint32_t str = a[1];
    uint16_t maxlen = R16(str + 2);
    if (a[2]) W32(a[2], uint32_t(t.size()));
    if (t.size() > maxlen) return kBufferTooSmall;
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(R32(str + 4)), t.data(), t.size());
    W16(str, uint16_t(t.size()));
    return kSuccess;
}
```

```h
// NTSTATUS values the kernel hands back

    kSuccess = 0x00000000,
    kWait0 = 0x00000000,
    kAbandoned = 0x00000080,
    kUserApc = 0x000000C0,
    kAlerted = 0x00000101,

extern uint8_t* g_base;

template <typename T>
inline T& G(uint32_t va) {
    return *reinterpret_cast<T*>(g_base + va);
}
inline uint32_t R32(uint32_t va) {
    uint32_t v;
    std::memcpy(&v, g_base + va, 4);
    return v;
}
inline void W32(uint32_t va, uint32_t v) { std::memcpy(g_base + va, &v, 4); }
inline uint16_t R16(uint32_t va) {
    uint16_t v;
    std::memcpy(&v, g_base + va, 2);
    return v;
}
inline void W16(uint32_t va, uint16_t v) { std::memcpy(g_base + va, &v, 2); }
inline uint64_t R64(uint32_t va) {
    uint64_t v;
    std::memcpy(&v, g_base + va, 8);
    return v;
}
inline void W64(uint32_t va, uint64_t v) { std::memcpy(g_base + va, &v, 8); }
inline void* HostPtr(uint32_t va) { return g_base + va; }

// ANSI_STRING / OBJECT_STRING: USHORT Length, USHORT MaximumLength, PCHAR Buffer
std::string ReadAnsiString(uint32_t str);
std::string ReadCString(uint32_t va, size_t max = 4096);

// stdcall argument access for host implementations of guest functions
struct Args {
    X86Context& ctx;
    uint32_t operator[](int i) const { return R32(ctx.esp + 4 + 4 * uint32_t(i)); }
};
inline void Return(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t value, int stack_args) {
    ctx.eax = value;
    ctx.esp += 4 + 4 * uint32_t(stack_args);
}

// runs guest code from the host on the current guest thread
uint32_t CallGuest(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t fn, const uint32_t* args, size_t count);
inline uint32_t CallGuest(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t fn, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    return CallGuest(ctx, fn, args.begin(), args.size());
}

// objects
enum class ObjType : uint8_t { Event, Semaphore, Mutant, Timer, Thread, File, SymLink, Device, Queue, Other };

struct Object {
    ObjType type;
    uint32_t guest = 0;  // body in guest memory, dispatcher header first for waitables
    // dispatcher state, protected by the dispatcher lock
    int32_t signal = 0;
    int32_t limit = 0;
    bool notification = false;  // manual reset event or notification timer
    uint32_t owner = 0;         // mutant owner thread
    uint32_t recursion = 0;
    std::string name;
    explicit Object(ObjType t) : type(t) {}
    virtual ~Object() = default;
};
using ObjectRef = std::shared_ptr<Object>;

int32_t ResetEvent(Object& o);
int32_t PulseEvent(Object& o);

              uint32_t apc_routine = 0, uint32_t apc_context = 0);

// threads
struct Thread : Object {

};
```
