`sdk/runtime/kernel/memory.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "kernel/memory.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <vector>

#include "core/log.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <sys/mman.h>
#endif

namespace mem {

static uint8_t* g_base = nullptr;
static std::recursive_mutex g_lock;

uint8_t* Base() { return g_base; }

// physical memory shows at 0x80000000 and again at 0xF0000000 (write combined view)
static bool InPhysical(uint32_t va) {
    return (va >= kContiguousBase && va < kContiguousBase + kPhysicalSize) ||
           (va >= kWriteCombineBase && va < kWriteCombineBase + kPhysicalSize);
}

bool Init() {
    const uint64_t size = 1ull << 32;
#ifdef _WIN32
    HANDLE ram = CreateFileMappingW(INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE, nullptr, PAGE_READWRITE, 0, kPhysicalSize, nullptr);
    // a fixed base keeps crash dumps comparable between runs
    for (uint64_t hint : {0x100000000ull, 0x200000000ull, 0x300000000ull, 0ull}) {
        uint8_t* b = static_cast<uint8_t*>(VirtualAlloc(reinterpret_cast<void*>(hint), size, MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS));
        if (!b) continue;
        VirtualFree(b, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        // reserve around the two physical windows, then map the same memory into both
        const uint64_t cuts[][2] = {{0, kContiguousBase},
                                    {kContiguousBase + kPhysicalSize, kWriteCombineBase},
                                    {kWriteCombineBase + kPhysicalSize, size}};
        bool ok = ram != nullptr;
        for (auto& c : cuts)
            ok = ok && VirtualAlloc(b + c[0], size_t(c[1] - c[0]), MEM_RESERVE, PAGE_NOACCESS) == b + c[0];
        ok = ok && MapViewOfFileEx(ram, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, kPhysicalSize, b + kContiguousBase) == b + kContiguousBase;
        ok = ok && MapViewOfFileEx(ram, FILE_MAP_ALL_ACCESS, 0, 0, kPhysicalSize, b + kWriteCombineBase) == b + kWriteCombineBase;
        if (ok) {
            g_base = b;
            break;
        }
        for (auto& c : cuts) VirtualFree(b + c[0], 0, MEM_RELEASE);
        UnmapViewOfFile(b + kContiguousBase);
        UnmapViewOfFile(b + kWriteCombineBase);
    }
#else
    void* p = mmap(reinterpret_cast<void*>(0x100000000ull), size, PROT_NONE, MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    g_base = p == MAP_FAILED ? nullptr : static_cast<uint8_t*>(p);
    int fd = g_base ? memfd_create("ram", 0) : -1;
    if (fd < 0 || ftruncate(fd, kPhysicalSize) ||
        mmap(g_base + kContiguousBase, kPhysicalSize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd, 0) == MAP_FAILED ||
        mmap(g_base + kWriteCombineBase, kPhysicalSize, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FIXED, fd, 0) == MAP_FAILED)
        g_base = nullptr;
#endif
    if (!g_base) {
        LOGE("memory: could not reserve the 4 GB guest space");
        return false;
    }
    LOGI("memory: guest space at %p", static_cast<void*>(g_base));
    return true;
}

// page commit map, one byte per 4 KB page
static std::vector<uint8_t> g_committed(0x100000, 0);

bool Commit(uint32_t va, uint32_t size) {
    if (!size || InPhysical(va)) return true;
    uint32_t first = va & ~(kPage - 1);
    uint64_t end = (uint64_t(va) + size + kPage - 1) & ~uint64_t(kPage - 1);
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
#ifdef _WIN32
    if (!VirtualAlloc(g_base + first, size_t(end - first), MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE)) {
        LOGE("memory: commit %08X+%X failed", first, uint32_t(end - first));
        return false;
    }
#else
    if (mprotect(g_base + first, size_t(end - first), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE)) {
        LOGE("memory: commit %08X+%X failed", first, uint32_t(end - first));
        return false;
    }
#endif
    for (uint64_t p = first; p < end; p += kPage) g_committed[size_t(p >> 12)] = 1;
    return true;
}

void Decommit(uint32_t va, uint32_t size) {
    if (InPhysical(va)) return;
    uint32_t first = va & ~(kPage - 1);
    uint64_t end = (uint64_t(va) + size + kPage - 1) & ~uint64_t(kPage - 1);
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
#ifdef _WIN32
    VirtualFree(g_base + first, size_t(end - first), MEM_DECOMMIT);
#else
    madvise(g_base + first, size_t(end - first), MADV_DONTNEED);
    mprotect(g_base + first, size_t(end - first), PROT_NONE);
#endif
    for (uint64_t p = first; p < end; p += kPage) g_committed[size_t(p >> 12)] = 0;
}

bool IsCommitted(uint32_t va) { return InPhysical(va) || g_committed[va >> 12] != 0; }

// first fit allocator over a guest range
class Ranges {
public:
    void Init(uint32_t start, uint32_t size) { free_[start] = size; }

    void Remove(uint32_t start, uint32_t size) {
        // carve a fixed range out of the free list
        for (auto it = free_.begin(); it != free_.end(); ++it) {
            uint32_t fs = it->first, fz = it->second;
            if (start >= fs && uint64_t(start) + size <= uint64_t(fs) + fz) {
                free_.erase(it);
                if (start > fs) free_[fs] = start - fs;
                if (uint64_t(start) + size < uint64_t(fs) + fz) free_[start + size] = uint32_t(uint64_t(fs) + fz - start - size);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    uint32_t Alloc(uint32_t size, uint32_t align, uint32_t lo, uint32_t hi, bool top_down) {
        if (!align) align = 1;
        if (top_down) {
            for (auto it = free_.rbegin(); it != free_.rend(); ++it) {
                uint64_t fs = it->first, fe = fs + it->second;
                uint64_t e = std::min<uint64_t>(fe, uint64_t(hi) + 1);
                if (e < size) continue;
                uint64_t a = (e - size) & ~uint64_t(align - 1);
                if (a < fs || a < lo) continue;
                Take(uint32_t(a), size);
                return uint32_t(a);
            }
            return 0;
        }
        for (auto& [fs, fz] : free_) {
            uint64_t a = std::max<uint64_t>(fs, lo);
            a = (a + align - 1) & ~uint64_t(align - 1);
            if (a + size <= uint64_t(fs) + fz && a + size - 1 <= hi) {
                Take(uint32_t(a), size);
                return uint32_t(a);
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    bool IsFree(uint32_t start, uint32_t size) const {
        auto it = free_.upper_bound(start);
        if (it == free_.begin()) return false;
        --it;
        return uint64_t(start) + size <= uint64_t(it->first) + it->second;
    }

    bool Free(uint32_t a, uint32_t* size_out = nullptr) {
        auto it = used_.find(a);
        if (it == used_.end()) return false;
        uint32_t size = it->second;
        used_.erase(it);
        if (size_out) *size_out = size;
        Release(a, size);
        return true;
    }

    void Release(uint32_t a, uint32_t size) {
        auto n = free_.emplace(a, size).first;
        auto next = std::next(n);
        if (next != free_.end() && n->first + n->second == next->first) {
            n->second += next->second;
            free_.erase(next);
        }
        if (n != free_.begin()) {
            auto prev = std::prev(n);
            if (prev->first + prev->second == n->first) {
                prev->second += n->second;
                free_.erase(n);
            }
        }
    }

    void Forget(uint32_t a) { used_.erase(a); }

    uint32_t SizeOf(uint32_t a) const {
        auto it = used_.find(a);
        return it == used_.end() ? 0 : it->second;
    }

    uint64_t Used() const {
        uint64_t n = 0;
        for (auto& u : used_) n += u.second;
        return n;
    }

private:
    void Take(uint32_t a, uint32_t size) {
        Remove(a, size);
        used_[a] = size;
    }
    std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> free_;
    std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> used_;
};

static Ranges g_contig, g_system, g_stacks;
static std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> g_stack_tops;
static bool g_ranges_ready = false;

struct Reservation {
    uint32_t size;
    uint32_t protect;
    std::vector<uint8_t> commit;  // per page
};
static std::map<uint32_t, Reservation> g_reserved;
static Ranges g_user;

static void EnsureRanges() {
    if (g_ranges_ready) return;
    g_ranges_ready = true;
    g_contig.Init(kContiguousBase + kKernelDataSize, kPhysicalSize - kKernelDataSize);
    g_system.Init(kSystemBase, kSystemSize);
    g_stacks.Init(kStackBase, kStackSize);
    g_user.Init(kUserLow, kUserHigh - kUserLow);
    Commit(kKernelDataBase, kKernelDataSize);
}

void ReserveImage(uint32_t base, uint32_t size) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    EnsureRanges();
    uint32_t b = base & ~0xFFFFu;
    uint32_t e = (base + size + 0xFFFF) & ~0xFFFFu;
    g_user.Remove(b, e - b);
    Reservation r{e - b, 4, std::vector<uint8_t>((e - b) / kPage, 1)};  // 4 is PAGE_READWRITE
    g_reserved[b] = std::move(r);
    Commit(b, e - b);
}

static Reservation* FindReservation(uint32_t addr, uint32_t* start) {
    auto it = g_reserved.upper_bound(addr);
    if (it == g_reserved.begin()) return nullptr;
    --it;
    if (addr >= it->first + it->second.size) return nullptr;
    *start = it->first;
    return &it->second;
}

uint32_t AllocateVirtual(uint32_t& base, uint32_t& size, uint32_t type, uint32_t protect) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    EnsureRanges();
    if (!size) return 0xC000000D;  // STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER
    bool reserve = type & kMemReserve;
    bool commit = type & kMemCommit;
    if (!base && commit) reserve = true;
    if (reserve) {
        uint32_t sz = (size + 0xFFFF) & ~0xFFFFu;
        uint32_t a;
        if (base) {
            a = base & ~0xFFFFu;
            sz = ((base + size + 0xFFFF) & ~0xFFFFu) - a;
            if (!g_user.IsFree(a, sz)) return 0xC0000018;  // STATUS_CONFLICTING_ADDRESSES
            g_user.Remove(a, sz);
        } else {
            a = g_user.Alloc(sz, 0x10000, kUserLow, kUserHigh - 1, type & kMemTopDown);
            if (!a) return 0xC0000017;  // STATUS_NO_MEMORY
            g_user.Forget(a);
        }
        g_reserved[a] = Reservation{sz, protect, std::vector<uint8_t>(sz / kPage, 0)};
        base = a;
        size = sz;
    }
    if (commit) {
        uint32_t start;
        Reservation* r = FindReservation(base, &start);
        if (!r) return 0xC0000045;  // STATUS_INVALID_PAGE_PROTECTION stands in for not reserved
        uint32_t first = base & ~(kPage - 1);
        uint32_t end = (base + size + kPage - 1) & ~(kPage - 1);
        if (end > start + r->size) return 0xC0000018;  // STATUS_CONFLICTING_ADDRESSES
        Commit(first, end - first);
        for (uint32_t p = first; p < end; p += kPage) r->commit[(p - start) / kPage] = 1;
        base = first;
        size = end - first;
    }
    return 0;
}

uint32_t FreeVirtual(uint32_t& base, uint32_t& size, uint32_t type) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t start;
    Reservation* r = FindReservation(base, &start);
    if (!r) return 0xC000009F;  // STATUS_MEMORY_NOT_ALLOCATED
    if (type & kMemRelease) {
        uint32_t sz = r->size;
        Decommit(start, sz);
        g_reserved.erase(start);
        g_user.Release(start, sz);
        base = start;
        size = sz;
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t first = base & ~(kPage - 1);
    uint32_t end = size ? (base + size + kPage - 1) & ~(kPage - 1) : start + r->size;
    Decommit(first, end - first);
    for (uint32_t p = first; p < end; p += kPage) r->commit[(p - start) / kPage] = 0;
    base = first;
    size = end - first;
    return 0;
}

bool QueryVirtual(uint32_t addr, RegionInfo& out) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t start;
    Reservation* r = FindReservation(addr, &start);
    std::memset(&out, 0, sizeof(out));
    if (!r) {
        out.base = addr & ~(kPage - 1);
        auto it = g_reserved.upper_bound(addr);
        uint32_t next = it == g_reserved.end() ? kUserHigh : it->first;
        out.size = next > out.base ? next - out.base : kPage;
        out.state = 0x10000;  // MEM_FREE
        out.protect = 1;      // PAGE_NOACCESS
        return addr < kUserHigh;
    }
    uint32_t page = (addr - start) / kPage;
    uint8_t c = r->commit[page];
    uint32_t n = page;
    while (n < r->commit.size() && r->commit[n] == c) n++;
    out.base = start + page * kPage;
    out.alloc_base = start;
    out.alloc_protect = r->protect;
    out.size = (n - page) * kPage;
    out.state = c ? kMemCommit : kMemReserve;
    out.protect = c ? r->protect : 0;
    out.type = 0x20000;  // MEM_PRIVATE
    return true;
}

uint32_t AllocContiguous(uint32_t size, uint32_t lowest, uint32_t highest, uint32_t align) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    EnsureRanges();
    size = (size + kPage - 1) & ~(kPage - 1);
    if (!size) size = kPage;
    align = std::max<uint32_t>(align, kPage);
    uint32_t lo = kContiguousBase | (lowest & (kPhysicalSize - 1));
    uint32_t hi = highest >= kPhysicalSize - 1 ? kContiguousBase + kPhysicalSize - 1 : kContiguousBase | highest;
    // highest fit first: low memory stays free for requests limited to it (D3D report pages, first 16 MB)
    uint32_t a = g_contig.Alloc(size, align, lo, hi, true);
    if (!a) {
        LOGE("memory: contiguous allocation of %X bytes failed (%X..%X align %X), %llu KB in use", size, lowest, highest, align,
             (unsigned long long)(g_contig.Used() >> 10));
        return 0;
    }
    Commit(a, size);
    std::memset(g_base + a, 0, size);
    return a;
}

void FreeContiguous(uint32_t va) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t size;
    if (g_contig.Free(va, &size)) Decommit(va, size);
}

uint32_t AllocSystem(uint32_t size, uint32_t align) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    EnsureRanges();
    size = (size + 15) & ~15u;
    if (!size) size = 16;
    uint32_t a = g_system.Alloc(size, std::max<uint32_t>(align, 16), kSystemBase, kSystemBase + kSystemSize - 1, false);
    if (!a) return 0;
    Commit(a, size);
    std::memset(g_base + a, 0, size);
    return a;
}

void FreeSystem(uint32_t va) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    g_system.Free(va);
}

uint32_t AllocStack(uint32_t size) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    EnsureRanges();
    size = (size + 0xFFFF) & ~0xFFFFu;
    // one uncommitted guard page below the stack
    uint32_t a = g_stacks.Alloc(size + 0x10000, 0x10000, kStackBase, kStackBase + kStackSize - 1, false);
    if (!a) return 0;
    Commit(a + 0x10000, size);
    g_stack_tops[a + 0x10000 + size] = a;
    return a + 0x10000 + size;
}

void FreeStack(uint32_t top) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_stack_tops.find(top);
    if (it == g_stack_tops.end()) return;
    uint32_t size;
    if (g_stacks.Free(it->second, &size)) Decommit(it->second, size);
    g_stack_tops.erase(it);
}

uint32_t AllocationSize(uint32_t va) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    if (uint32_t s = g_contig.SizeOf(va)) return s;
    if (uint32_t s = g_system.SizeOf(va)) return s;
    uint32_t start;
    if (Reservation* r = FindReservation(va, &start)) return r->size - (va - start);
    return 0;
}

uint32_t PhysicalFromVirtual(uint32_t va) {
    if (InPhysical(va)) return va & (kPhysicalSize - 1);
    return va;
}

uint32_t VirtualFromPhysical(uint32_t pa) {
    if (pa < kPhysicalSize) return kContiguousBase | pa;
    return pa;
}

Stats Query() {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Stats s{};
    s.total_pages = kPhysicalSize / kPage;
    uint64_t vc = 0;
    for (auto& [a, r] : g_reserved)
        for (uint8_t c : r.commit) vc += c;
    s.virtual_committed = uint32_t(vc);
    s.contiguous_used = uint32_t(g_contig.Used() / kPage);
    s.system_used = uint32_t(g_system.Used() / kPage);
    uint64_t used = vc + s.contiguous_used + s.system_used;
    s.available_pages = used >= s.total_pages ? 0 : uint32_t(s.total_pages - used);
    return s;
}

}  // namespace mem

```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/memory.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>

namespace mem {

constexpr uint32_t kPage = 0x1000;
constexpr uint32_t kUserLow = 0x00010000;
constexpr uint32_t kUserHigh = 0x7FFE0000;
constexpr uint32_t kContiguousBase = 0x80000000;  // guest VA = kContiguousBase | physical
constexpr uint32_t kPhysicalSize = 128u << 20;
constexpr uint32_t kWriteCombineBase = 0xF0000000;
constexpr uint32_t kKernelDataBase = 0x80000000;   // first physical megabyte holds kernel variables
constexpr uint32_t kKernelDataSize = 0x00100000;
constexpr uint32_t kSystemBase = 0xB0000000;       // pool, system memory, thread blocks
constexpr uint32_t kSystemSize = 0x10000000;
constexpr uint32_t kStackBase = 0xD0000000;
constexpr uint32_t kStackSize = 0x10000000;

// NT allocation flags
constexpr uint32_t kMemCommit = 0x1000, kMemReserve = 0x2000, kMemDecommit = 0x4000, kMemRelease = 0x8000,
                   kMemTopDown = 0x100000, kMemNoZero = 0x800000;

bool Init();
uint8_t* Base();
bool Commit(uint32_t va, uint32_t size);
void Decommit(uint32_t va, uint32_t size);
bool IsCommitted(uint32_t va);

// user virtual space, NTSTATUS results
uint32_t AllocateVirtual(uint32_t& base, uint32_t& size, uint32_t type, uint32_t protect);
uint32_t FreeVirtual(uint32_t& base, uint32_t& size, uint32_t type);
struct RegionInfo {
    uint32_t base, alloc_base, alloc_protect, size, state, protect, type;
};
bool QueryVirtual(uint32_t addr, RegionInfo& out);
void ReserveImage(uint32_t base, uint32_t size);

uint32_t AllocContiguous(uint32_t size, uint32_t lowest, uint32_t highest, uint32_t align);
void FreeContiguous(uint32_t va);
uint32_t AllocationSize(uint32_t va);  // any allocator, 0 if unknown

uint32_t AllocSystem(uint32_t size, uint32_t align = 16);
void FreeSystem(uint32_t va);

uint32_t AllocStack(uint32_t size);  // returns the top, guard below the bottom
void FreeStack(uint32_t top);

uint32_t PhysicalFromVirtual(uint32_t va);
uint32_t VirtualFromPhysical(uint32_t pa);

struct Stats {
    uint32_t total_pages, available_pages, virtual_committed, contiguous_used, system_used;
};
Stats Query();

}  // namespace mem
```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/objects.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <map>
#include <queue>

#include "kernel/kernel.h"

namespace kernel {

namespace {

std::mutex g_dispatch;
std::condition_variable g_cv;

std::mutex g_handles_lock;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, ObjectRef> g_handles;
uint32_t g_next_handle = 0x1000;

std::mutex g_ptr_lock;
struct PtrEntry {
    ObjectRef obj;
    uint32_t serial;
};
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, PtrEntry> g_by_ptr;
uint32_t g_serial = 1;
constexpr uint32_t kStamp = 0x4A424F4Bu;  // written into WaitListHead.Blink of objects the host tracks

std::mutex g_names_lock;
std::unordered_map<std::string, std::weak_ptr<Object>> g_names;

}  // namespace

std::mutex& DispatchLock() { return g_dispatch; }
void SignalChanged() { g_cv.notify_all(); }

uint32_t NewHandle(ObjectRef obj) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_handles_lock);
    uint32_t h = g_next_handle;
    g_next_handle += 4;
    g_handles[h] = std::move(obj);
    return h;
}

ObjectRef FromHandle(uint32_t handle) {
    if (handle == 0xFFFFFFFE) return CurrentRef();  // NtCurrentThread pseudo handle
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_handles_lock);
    auto it = g_handles.find(handle);
    return it == g_handles.end() ? nullptr : it->second;
}

bool CloseHandle(uint32_t handle) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_handles_lock);
    return g_handles.erase(handle) != 0;
}

uint32_t DuplicateHandle(uint32_t handle) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(handle);
    return o ? NewHandle(o) : 0;
}

// serial in WaitListHead.Flink, stamp in Blink
static void Stamp(uint32_t guest, uint32_t serial) {
    W32(guest + 8, serial);
    W32(guest + 12, kStamp);
}

void Bind(ObjectRef obj, uint32_t guest) {
    obj->guest = guest;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ptr_lock);
    uint32_t serial = g_serial++;
    g_by_ptr[guest] = {obj, serial};
    Stamp(guest, serial);
}

ObjectRef FromPointer(uint32_t guest) {
    if (!guest) return nullptr;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ptr_lock);
    auto it = g_by_ptr.find(guest);
    if (it != g_by_ptr.end() && R32(guest + 12) == kStamp && R32(guest + 8) == it->second.serial) return it->second.obj;
    // first sight, or the guest reinitialised the structure: build from the header
    uint8_t type = G<uint8_t>(guest);
    int32_t state = int32_t(R32(guest + 4));
    ObjectRef o;
    switch (type) {
        case 0:
        case 1:
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Event);
            o->notification = type == 0;
            o->signal = state;
            break;
        case 2:
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Mutant);
            o->signal = state;
            break;
        case 5:
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Semaphore);
            o->signal = state;
            o->limit = int32_t(R32(guest + 0x10));
            break;
        case 8:
        case 9:
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Timer);
            o->notification = type == 8;
            o->signal = state;
            break;
        case 6:
            if (it != g_by_ptr.end()) return it->second.obj;  // threads keep their object
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Other);
            break;
        default:
            LOGW("objects: unknown dispatcher type %u at %08X", type, guest);
            if (Current()) LogGuestStack(*Current()->ctx, 64);
            o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Event);
            o->notification = true;
            o->signal = state;
            break;
    }
    o->guest = guest;
    uint32_t serial = g_serial++;
    g_by_ptr[guest] = {o, serial};
    Stamp(guest, serial);
    return o;
}

ObjectRef FindNamed(const std::string& name) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_names_lock);
    auto it = g_names.find(name);
    return it == g_names.end() ? nullptr : it->second.lock();
}

void AddNamed(const std::string& name, ObjectRef obj) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_names_lock);
    obj->name = name;
    g_names[name] = obj;
}

void SetSignal(Object& o, int32_t v) {
    o.signal = v;
    if (o.guest) W32(o.guest + 4, uint32_t(v));
}

static uint32_t Me() {
    Thread* t = Current();
    return t ? t->ethread : 1;
}

static bool Satisfied(Object& o, uint32_t me) {
    if (o.type == ObjType::Mutant) return o.signal > 0 || o.owner == me;
    return o.signal > 0;
}

static void Consume(Object& o, uint32_t me) {
    switch (o.type) {
        case ObjType::Event:
        case ObjType::Timer:
            if (!o.notification) SetSignal(o, 0);
            break;
        case ObjType::Semaphore:
            SetSignal(o, o.signal - 1);
            break;
        case ObjType::Mutant:
            if (o.owner == me) {
                o.recursion++;
            } else {
                o.owner = me;
                o.recursion = 1;
                SetSignal(o, 0);
            }
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
}

int64_t Now100ns() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    // 1601 to 1970 in 100 ns units
    auto t = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    return t / 100 + 116444736000000000ll;
}

int64_t ToDeadline(int64_t due) {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    int64_t now = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    if (due < 0) return now + (-due) * 100;  // negative due is relative, positive is absolute system time
    int64_t rel = due - Now100ns();
    return now + std::max<int64_t>(rel, 0) * 100;
}

static uint32_t WaitFor(const std::vector<ObjectRef>& objs, bool wait_all, int64_t timeout, bool alertable) {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    Thread* self = Current();
    uint32_t me = Me();
    bool infinite = timeout == INT64_MAX;
    int64_t deadline = infinite ? 0 : ToDeadline(timeout);
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    for (;;) {
        if (wait_all) {
            bool all = std::all_of(objs.begin(), objs.end(), [&](const ObjectRef& o) { return o && Satisfied(*o, me); });
            if (all) {
                for (auto& o : objs) Consume(*o, me);
                return kWait0;
            }
        } else {
            for (size_t i = 0; i < objs.size(); i++)
                if (objs[i] && Satisfied(*objs[i], me)) {
                    Consume(*objs[i], me);
                    return kWait0 + uint32_t(i);
                }
        }
        if (alertable && self) {
            bool pending;
            {
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> al(self->apc_lock);
                pending = !self->apcs.empty();
            }
            if (pending) {
                lock.unlock();
                RunApcs(*self);
                return kUserApc;
            }
        }
        if (!infinite) {
            int64_t now = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
            if (now >= deadline) return kTimeout;
            // bounded so alertable waits notice new APCs
            g_cv.wait_for(lock, nanoseconds(std::min<int64_t>(deadline - now, 50000000)));
        } else {
            g_cv.wait_for(lock, milliseconds(50));
        }
    }
}

uint32_t Wait(const std::vector<ObjectRef>& objs, bool wait_all, int64_t timeout, bool alertable) {
    SuspendPoint();
    uint32_t r = WaitFor(objs, wait_all, timeout, alertable);
    SuspendPoint();
    return r;
}

int32_t SetEvent(Object& o) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    int32_t old = o.signal;
    SetSignal(o, 1);
    g_cv.notify_all();
    return old;
}

int32_t ResetEvent(Object& o) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    int32_t old = o.signal;
    SetSignal(o, 0);
    return old;
}

int32_t PulseEvent(Object& o) {
    // waiters already blocked cannot be told apart here, so a pulse behaves like set for one pass
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    int32_t old = o.signal;
    SetSignal(o, 1);
    g_cv.notify_all();
    return old;
}

int32_t ReleaseSemaphore(Object& o, int32_t count, uint32_t& status) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    int32_t old = o.signal;
    if (o.limit && old + count > o.limit) {
        status = kSemaphoreLimitExceeded;
        return old;
    }
    SetSignal(o, old + count);
    status = kSuccess;
    g_cv.notify_all();
    return old;
}

int32_t ReleaseMutant(Object& o, uint32_t& status) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dispatch);
    uint32_t me = Me();
    if (o.owner != me) {
        status = kMutantNotOwned;
        return o.signal;
    }
    int32_t old = o.signal;
    if (--o.recursion == 0) {
        o.owner = 0;
        SetSignal(o, 1);
        g_cv.notify_all();
    }
    status = kSuccess;
    return old;
}

// timers and DPCs

namespace {

struct TimerEntry {
    int64_t deadline;
    uint64_t seq;
    ObjectRef timer;
    int32_t period_ms;
    uint32_t dpc;
    std::weak_ptr<Thread> apc_thread;
    uint32_t apc_routine, apc_context;
    bool operator>(const TimerEntry& o) const { return deadline > o.deadline; }
};

std::mutex g_timer_lock;
std::condition_variable g_timer_cv;
std::priority_queue<TimerEntry, std::vector<TimerEntry>, std::greater<TimerEntry>> g_timers;
std::unordered_map<Object*, uint64_t> g_timer_seq;  // latest arm per timer, older entries are stale
uint64_t g_seq = 1;
bool g_timer_thread = false;

std::mutex g_dpc_lock;
std::condition_variable g_dpc_cv;
std::deque<std::array<uint32_t, 3>> g_dpcs;
bool g_dpc_thread = false;

}  // namespace

void RunDpcs(X86Context& ctx) {
    for (;;) {
        std::array<uint32_t, 3> d;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_dpc_lock);
            g_dpc_cv.wait(lock, [] { return !g_dpcs.empty(); });
            d = g_dpcs.front();
            g_dpcs.pop_front();
        }
        uint32_t dpc = d[0];
        G<uint8_t>(dpc + 2) = 0;  // Inserted
        uint32_t routine = R32(dpc + 0x0C), context = R32(dpc + 0x10);  // KDPC.DeferredRoutine and DeferredContext
        if (routine) CallGuest(ctx, routine, {dpc, context, d[1], d[2]});
    }
}

void QueueDpc(uint32_t dpc, uint32_t arg1, uint32_t arg2) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_dpc_lock);
    W32(dpc + 0x14, arg1);  // KDPC.SystemArgument1 and 2
    W32(dpc + 0x18, arg2);
    g_dpcs.push_back({dpc, arg1, arg2});
    g_dpc_cv.notify_one();
    if (!g_dpc_thread) {
        g_dpc_thread = true;
        StartHostThread("dpc", [](X86Context& ctx) { RunDpcs(ctx); });
    }
}

static void TimerLoop() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_timer_lock);
    for (;;) {
        if (g_timers.empty()) {
            g_timer_cv.wait(lock);
            continue;
        }
        int64_t now = duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
        TimerEntry e = g_timers.top();
        if (e.deadline > now) {
            g_timer_cv.wait_for(lock, nanoseconds(e.deadline - now));
            continue;
        }
        g_timers.pop();
        auto it = g_timer_seq.find(e.timer.get());
        if (it == g_timer_seq.end() || it->second != e.seq) continue;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> dl(g_dispatch);
            SetSignal(*e.timer, 1);
            g_cv.notify_all();
        }
        if (e.dpc) QueueDpc(e.dpc, uint32_t(Now100ns()), uint32_t(Now100ns() >> 32));
        if (auto t = e.apc_thread.lock(); t && e.apc_routine)
            QueueApc(*t, e.apc_routine, e.apc_context, uint32_t(Now100ns()), uint32_t(Now100ns() >> 32));
        if (e.period_ms > 0) {
            e.deadline += int64_t(e.period_ms) * 1000000;
            g_timers.push(e);
        } else {
            g_timer_seq.erase(e.timer.get());
        }
    }
}

void SetTimer(ObjectRef timer, int64_t due, int32_t period_ms, uint32_t dpc, std::shared_ptr<Thread> apc_thread,
              uint32_t apc_routine, uint32_t apc_context) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_timer_lock);
    if (!g_timer_thread) {
        g_timer_thread = true;
        std::thread(TimerLoop).detach();
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> dl(g_dispatch);
        SetSignal(*timer, 0);
    }
    uint64_t seq = g_seq++;
    g_timer_seq[timer.get()] = seq;
    g_timers.push({ToDeadline(due), seq, timer, period_ms, dpc, apc_thread, apc_routine, apc_context});
    g_timer_cv.notify_all();
}

bool CancelTimer(Object& timer) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_timer_lock);
    return g_timer_seq.erase(&timer) != 0;
}

}  // namespace kernel
```

```cpp
// Kernel run time library exports: memory, counted strings, integer helpers, interlocked lists
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdio>
#include <mutex>

#include "kernel/exports.h"

namespace kernel {

namespace {

std::mutex g_slist;

uint16_t Upper16(uint16_t c) { return c < 0x80 ? uint16_t(std::toupper(c)) : c; }
uint16_t Lower16(uint16_t c) { return c < 0x80 ? uint16_t(std::tolower(c)) : c; }

// STRING and UNICODE_STRING: USHORT Length, USHORT MaximumLength, buffer; lengths in bytes
uint16_t Len(uint32_t s) { return R16(s); }
uint16_t Max(uint32_t s) { return R16(s + 2); }
uint32_t Buf(uint32_t s) { return R32(s + 4); }

void Copy(uint32_t d, uint32_t s, bool wide, uint16_t (*map)(uint16_t)) {
    if (!s) {
        W16(d, 0);
        return;
    }
    uint16_t n = std::min(Len(s), Max(d));
    if (wide) n &= ~1;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < n; i += wide ? 2 : 1) {
        if (wide) W16(Buf(d) + i, map(R16(Buf(s) + i)));
        else G<uint8_t>(Buf(d) + i) = uint8_t(map(G<uint8_t>(Buf(s) + i)));
    }
    W16(d, n);
    if (n + (wide ? 2 : 1) <= Max(d)) {
        if (wide) W16(Buf(d) + n, 0);
        else G<uint8_t>(Buf(d) + n) = 0;
    }
}

uint16_t Same(uint16_t c) { return c; }

int CompareWide(uint32_t s1, uint32_t s2, bool ci) {
    uint16_t n1 = Len(s1) / 2, n2 = Len(s2) / 2;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < std::min(n1, n2); i++) {
        uint16_t c1 = R16(Buf(s1) + i * 2u), c2 = R16(Buf(s2) + i * 2u);
        if (ci) c1 = Upper16(c1), c2 = Upper16(c2);
        if (c1 != c2) return int(c1) - int(c2);
    }
    return int(n1) - int(n2);
}

uint32_t Append(uint32_t d, uint32_t src, uint16_t bytes) {
    if (Len(d) + bytes > Max(d)) return kBufferTooSmall;
    std::memmove(HostPtr(Buf(d) + Len(d)), HostPtr(src), bytes);
    W16(d, uint16_t(Len(d) + bytes));
    return kSuccess;
}

// digits of a guest string after optional blanks, sign and a 0x/0o/0b prefix when base is 0
template <class At>
uint32_t ParseInt(At at, uint32_t n, uint32_t base, uint32_t out) {
    uint32_t i = 0;
    while (i < n && at(i) <= ' ') i++;
    bool neg = false;
    if (i < n && (at(i) == '-' || at(i) == '+')) neg = at(i++) == '-';
    if (!base) {
        base = 10;
        if (i + 1 < n && at(i) == '0') {
            char p = char(std::tolower(at(i + 1)));
            base = p == 'x' ? 16 : p == 'o' ? 8 : p == 'b' ? 2 : 10;
            if (base != 10) i += 2;
        }
    } else if (base != 2 && base != 8 && base != 10 && base != 16) {
        return kInvalidParameter;
    }
    uint32_t v = 0;
    for (; i < n; i++) {
        int c = std::tolower(at(i)), d = c >= '0' && c <= '9' ? c - '0' : c >= 'a' && c <= 'f' ? c - 'a' + 10 : 99;
        if (d >= int(base)) break;
        v = v * base + uint32_t(d);
    }
    W32(out, neg ? 0u - v : v);
    return kSuccess;
}

std::string Digits(uint32_t v, uint32_t base) {
    if (!base) base = 10;
    std::string s;
    do s.insert(s.begin(), "0123456789ABCDEF"[v % base]);
    while (v /= base);
    return s;
}

}  // namespace

// DbgPrint(format, ...): cdecl, the caller pops; the format goes to the log as it is, without its arguments
KERNEL_EXPORT(8, DbgPrint, 0) {
    std::string s;
    for (uint32_t p = a[0]; p && s.size() < 256; p++) {
        char c = *static_cast<const char*>(HostPtr(p));
        if (!c) break;
        if (c != '\n' && c != '\r') s += c;
    }
    LOG_FIRST(64, "DbgPrint: %s", s.c_str());
    return 0;
}

    std::memset(HostPtr(a[0]), 0, a[1]);
    return 0;
}

    std::memset(HostPtr(a[0]), int(a[2] & 0xFF), a[1]);
    return 0;

    for (uint32_t o = 0; o + 4 <= a[1]; o += 4) W32(a[0] + o, a[2]);
    return 0;

    std::memmove(HostPtr(a[0]), HostPtr(a[1]), a[2]);
    return 0;
}

    uint32_t n = 0;
    while (n < a[2] && G<uint8_t>(a[0] + n) == G<uint8_t>(a[1] + n)) n++;
    return n;
}

KERNEL_FASTCALL(307, RtlUlongByteSwap) { return __builtin_bswap32(ctx.ecx); }

// 64 bit helpers, results in edx:eax

KERNEL_EXPORT(281, RtlExtendedIntegerMultiply, 3) {
    int64_t r = int64_t(uint64_t(a[0]) | uint64_t(a[1]) << 32) * int32_t(a[2]);
    ctx.edx = uint32_t(uint64_t(r) >> 32);
    return uint32_t(r);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(282, RtlExtendedLargeIntegerDivide, 4) {
    uint64_t n = uint64_t(a[0]) | uint64_t(a[1]) << 32;
    uint32_t d = a[2];
    uint64_t q = d ? n / d : 0;
    if (a[3]) W32(a[3], d ? uint32_t(n % d) : 0);
    ctx.edx = uint32_t(q >> 32);
    return uint32_t(q);
}

// high 64 bits of |dividend| * magic, shifted, with the dividend's sign
KERNEL_EXPORT(283, RtlExtendedMagicDivide, 5) {
    int64_t n = int64_t(uint64_t(a[0]) | uint64_t(a[1]) << 32);
    uint64_t m = uint64_t(a[2]) | uint64_t(a[3]) << 32;
    uint64_t u = n < 0 ? 0 - uint64_t(n) : uint64_t(n);
    uint64_t q = uint64_t((unsigned __int128)u * m >> 64) >> (a[4] & 0xFF);
    if (n < 0) q = 0 - q;
    ctx.edx = uint32_t(q >> 32);
    return uint32_t(q);
}

static uint32_t CaseWide(uint32_t d, uint32_t s, bool alloc, uint16_t (*map)(uint16_t)) {
    if (alloc) {
        W32(d + 4, mem::AllocSystem(Len(s) + 2u));
        W16(d + 2, uint16_t(Len(s) + 2));
    } else if (Max(d) < Len(s)) {
        return kBufferTooSmall;
    }
    Copy(d, s, true, map);
    return kSuccess;
}
KERNEL_EXPORT(314, RtlUpcaseUnicodeString, 3) { return CaseWide(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF, Upper16); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(276, RtlDowncaseUnicodeString, 3) { return CaseWide(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF, Lower16); }

KERNEL_EXPORT(274, RtlCreateUnicodeString, 2) {
    uint32_t n = 0;
    while (R16(a[1] + n)) n += 2;
    uint32_t buf = mem::AllocSystem(n + 2);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(buf), HostPtr(a[1]), n + 2);
    W16(a[0], uint16_t(n));
    W16(a[0] + 2, uint16_t(n + 2));
    W32(a[0] + 4, buf);
    return 1;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(287, RtlFreeUnicodeString, 1) {
    if (uint32_t buf = Buf(a[0])) mem::FreeSystem(buf);
    W32(a[0], 0);
    W32(a[0] + 4, 0);
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(271, RtlCompareUnicodeString, 3) { return uint32_t(CompareWide(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF)); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(280, RtlEqualUnicodeString, 3) { return CompareWide(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF) == 0; }

KERNEL_EXPORT(261, RtlAppendStringToString, 2) { return Append(a[0], Buf(a[1]), Len(a[1])); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(262, RtlAppendUnicodeStringToString, 2) { return Append(a[0], Buf(a[1]), Len(a[1])); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(263, RtlAppendUnicodeToString, 2) {
    if (!a[1]) return kSuccess;
    uint32_t n = 0;
    while (R16(a[1] + n)) n += 2;
    uint32_t st = Append(a[0], a[1], uint16_t(n));
    if (st == kSuccess && Len(a[0]) + 2 <= Max(a[0])) W16(Buf(a[0]) + Len(a[0]), 0);
    return st;
}

// the console code page is Latin 1
KERNEL_EXPORT(299, RtlMultiByteToUnicodeN, 5) {
    uint32_t n = std::min(a[1] / 2, a[4]);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) W16(a[0] + i * 2, G<uint8_t>(a[3] + i));
    if (a[2]) W32(a[2], n * 2);
    return kSuccess;
}
KERNEL_EXPORT(310, RtlUnicodeToMultiByteN, 5) {

    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint16_t c = R16(a[3] + i * 2);
        G<uint8_t>(a[0] + i) = c < 0x100 ? uint8_t(c) : '?';
    }
    if (a[2]) W32(a[2], n);
    return kSuccess;
}

        uint16_t c = Upper16(R16(a[3] + i * 2));
        G<uint8_t>(a[0] + i) = c < 0x100 ? uint8_t(c) : '?';
    }

    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(292, RtlIntegerToChar, 4) {
    std::string s = Digits(a[0], a[1]);
    if (s.size() > a[2]) return 0x80000005;  // buffer overflow
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(a[3]), s.data(), s.size());
    if (s.size() < a[2]) G<uint8_t>(a[3] + uint32_t(s.size())) = 0;
    return kSuccess;
}
KERNEL_EXPORT(293, RtlIntegerToUnicodeString, 3) {
    std::string s = Digits(a[0], a[1]);
    uint32_t d = a[2];
    if (s.size() * 2 > Max(d)) return kBufferTooSmall;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) W16(Buf(d) + uint32_t(i) * 2, uint8_t(s[i]));
    W16(d, uint16_t(s.size() * 2));
    if (s.size() * 2 + 2 <= Max(d)) W16(Buf(d) + uint32_t(s.size()) * 2, 0);
    return kSuccess;
}

// interlocked, fastcall

KERNEL_FASTCALL(53, InterlockedIncrement) { return uint32_t(__atomic_add_fetch(&G<int32_t>(ctx.ecx), 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)); }
KERNEL_FASTCALL(52, InterlockedDecrement) { return uint32_t(__atomic_sub_fetch(&G<int32_t>(ctx.ecx), 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)); }
KERNEL_FASTCALL(54, InterlockedExchange) { return __atomic_exchange_n(&G<uint32_t>(ctx.ecx), ctx.edx, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
KERNEL_FASTCALL(55, InterlockedExchangeAdd) { return __atomic_fetch_add(&G<uint32_t>(ctx.ecx), ctx.edx, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }

// destination in ecx, exchange in edx, comparand on the stack
static void InterlockedCompareExchangeEntry(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {
    uint32_t expected = R32(ctx.esp + 4);
    __atomic_compare_exchange_n(&G<uint32_t>(ctx.ecx), &expected, ctx.edx, false, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    Return(ctx, expected, 1);
}
static const bool kreg_InterlockedCompareExchange =
    (RegisterExport(51, "InterlockedCompareExchange", InterlockedCompareExchangeEntry), true);

// SLIST_HEADER: first entry, depth, sequence
KERNEL_FASTCALL(58, InterlockedPushEntrySList) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_slist);
    uint32_t head = ctx.ecx, entry = ctx.edx, first = R32(head);
    W32(entry, first);
    W32(head, entry);
    W16(head + 4, uint16_t(R16(head + 4) + 1));
    W16(head + 6, uint16_t(R16(head + 6) + 1));
    return first;
}
KERNEL_FASTCALL(57, InterlockedPopEntrySList) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_slist);
    uint32_t head = ctx.ecx, first = R32(head);
    if (first) {
        W32(head, R32(first));
        W16(head + 4, uint16_t(R16(head + 4) - 1));
        W16(head + 6, uint16_t(R16(head + 6) + 1));
    }
    return first;
}
KERNEL_FASTCALL(56, InterlockedFlushSList) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_slist);
    uint32_t head = ctx.ecx, first = R32(head);
    W32(head, 0);
    W16(head + 4, 0);
    return first;
}

}  // namespace kernel
```

`sdk/runtime/kernel/threads.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <memory>

#include "kernel/kernel.h"

#ifdef _WIN32
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#include <windows.h>
#else
#include <pthread.h>
#endif

namespace kernel {

namespace {

thread_local ThreadRef t_current;
std::mutex g_threads_lock;
std::vector<ThreadRef> g_threads;
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_next_id{0x10};

// guest structures per thread
constexpr uint32_t kKpcrSize = 0x400;
constexpr uint32_t kEthreadSize = 0x200;

void SetupGuestBlocks(Thread& t, uint32_t stack_size, uint32_t tls_size) {
    stack_size = std::max<uint32_t>(stack_size, 0x10000);
    tls_size = (tls_size + 3) & ~3u;
    t.stack_top = mem::AllocStack(stack_size + tls_size + 0x1000);
    t.stack_size = stack_size;
    t.kpcr = mem::AllocSystem(kKpcrSize, 64);
    t.ethread = mem::AllocSystem(kEthreadSize, 64);
    // TLS sits at the top of the stack: StackBase + tls_index * 4 must equal TlsData
    t.tls = t.stack_top - tls_size;
    uint32_t k = t.kpcr;
    W32(k + 0x00, 0xFFFFFFFF);                  // NtTib.ExceptionList
    W32(k + 0x04, t.stack_top);                 // NtTib.StackBase
    W32(k + 0x08, t.stack_top - stack_size);    // NtTib.StackLimit
    W32(k + 0x18, k);                           // NtTib.Self
    W32(k + 0x1C, k);                           // SelfPcr
    W32(k + 0x20, k + 0x28);                    // Prcb
    G<uint8_t>(k + 0x24) = 0;                   // Irql
    W32(k + 0x28, t.ethread);                   // PrcbData.CurrentThread
    uint32_t e = t.ethread;
    G<uint8_t>(e + 0) = 6;                      // dispatcher type ThreadObject
    G<uint8_t>(e + 2) = uint8_t(kEthreadSize / 4);  // Header.Size in dwords
    W32(e + 0x1C, t.stack_top);                 // KTHREAD.StackBase
    W32(e + 0x20, t.stack_top - stack_size);    // KTHREAD.StackLimit
    W32(e + 0x28, t.tls);                       // KTHREAD.TlsData
    W32(e + 0x12C, t.id);                       // ETHREAD.UniqueThread
}

void InitContext(Thread& t, X86Context& ctx) {
    std::memset(&ctx, 0, sizeof(ctx));
    ctx.esp = (t.tls & ~15u) - 16;
    ctx.fs_base = t.kpcr;
    ctx.fcw = 0x27F;  // x87 53 bit precision, exceptions masked
    ctx.mxcsr = 0x1F80;  // SSE exceptions masked, round to nearest
    ctx.thread_handle = 0;
    t.ctx = &ctx;
}

void Register(const ThreadRef& t) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_lock);
    g_threads.push_back(t);
}

void Unregister(Thread* t) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_lock);
    g_threads.erase(std::remove_if(g_threads.begin(), g_threads.end(), [t](const ThreadRef& r) { return r.get() == t; }),
                    g_threads.end());
}

void MarkExited(Thread& t, uint32_t code) {
    t.exit_code = code;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(DispatchLock());
    SetSignal(t, 1);
    SignalChanged();
}

void NameHostThread(const char* name) {
#ifdef _WIN32
    wchar_t w[64];
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; name[i] && i < 63; i++) w[i] = wchar_t(name[i]);
    w[i] = 0;
    using Fn = HRESULT(WINAPI*)(HANDLE, PCWSTR);
    static Fn set = reinterpret_cast<Fn>(reinterpret_cast<void*>(GetProcAddress(GetModuleHandleW(L"kernel32.dll"), "SetThreadDescription")));
    if (set) set(GetCurrentThread(), w);
#else
    pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), name);
#endif
}

// recompiled code nests host frames as deep as the guest's calls, give it room
void Spawn(std::function<void()> fn) {
    auto* f = new std::function<void()>(std::move(fn));
#ifdef _WIN32
    auto entry = [](void* p) -> DWORD {
        std::unique_ptr<std::function<void()>> g(static_cast<std::function<void()>*>(p));
        (*g)();
        return 0;
    };
    HANDLE h = ::CreateThread(nullptr, 64u << 20, entry, f, STACK_SIZE_PARAM_IS_A_RESERVATION, nullptr);
    if (h) ::CloseHandle(h);
#else
    pthread_attr_t attr;
    pthread_attr_init(&attr);
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 64u << 20);
    pthread_t th;
    pthread_create(&th, &attr, [](void* p) -> void* {
        std::unique_ptr<std::function<void()>> g(static_cast<std::function<void()>*>(p));
        (*g)();
        return nullptr;
    }, f);
    pthread_detach(th);
    pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
#endif
}

}  // namespace

Thread* Current() { return t_current.get(); }
ThreadRef CurrentRef() { return t_current; }
X86Context& CurrentContext() { return *t_current->ctx; }

std::vector<ThreadRef> Threads() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_threads_lock);
    return g_threads;
}

struct StartInfo {
    uint32_t system_routine, start_routine, start_context;
};
static std::unordered_map<Thread*, StartInfo> g_start;
static std::mutex g_start_lock;

ThreadRef CreateThread(uint32_t stack_size, uint32_t tls_size, uint32_t system_routine, uint32_t start_routine,
                       uint32_t start_context, bool suspended) {
    auto t = std::make_shared<Thread>();
    t->id = g_next_id.fetch_add(4);
    SetupGuestBlocks(*t, stack_size, tls_size);
    Bind(t, t->ethread);
    if (suspended) t->suspend = 1;
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_start_lock);
    g_start[t.get()] = {system_routine, start_routine, start_context};
    return t;
}

void StartThread(ThreadRef t) {
    Register(t);
    Spawn([t] {
        t_current = t;
        char name[32];
        std::snprintf(name, sizeof(name), "guest %X", t->id);
        NameHostThread(name);
        X86Context ctx;
        InitContext(*t, ctx);
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(t->apc_lock);
            t->resume_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return t->suspend.load() <= 0; });
        }
        StartInfo si;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_start_lock);
            si = g_start[t.get()];
            g_start.erase(t.get());
        }
        LOGI("thread %X starts at %08X (%08X, %08X)", t->id, si.system_routine ? si.system_routine : si.start_routine,
             si.start_routine, si.start_context);
        uint32_t code;
        if (si.system_routine)
            code = CallGuest(ctx, si.system_routine, {si.start_routine, si.start_context});
        else
            code = CallGuest(ctx, si.start_routine, {si.start_context});
        LOGI("thread %X returned %08X", t->id, code);
        MarkExited(*t, code);
        Unregister(t.get());
        t_current.reset();
    });
}

void StartHostThread(const char* name, std::function<void(X86Context&)> fn) {
    auto t = std::make_shared<Thread>();
    t->id = g_next_id.fetch_add(4);
    SetupGuestBlocks(*t, 0x20000, 0x100);
    Bind(t, t->ethread);
    std::string n = name;
    Spawn([t, fn, n] {
        t_current = t;
        NameHostThread(n.c_str());
        X86Context ctx;
        InitContext(*t, ctx);
        fn(ctx);
        t_current.reset();
    });
}

void ExitThread(uint32_t code) {
    Thread* t = Current();
    if (t) {
        LOGI("thread %X exits with %08X", t->id, code);
        MarkExited(*t, code);
        Unregister(t);
    }
    t_current.reset();
#ifdef _WIN32
    ::ExitThread(code);
#else
    pthread_exit(nullptr);
#endif
}

void Resume(Thread& t) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(t.apc_lock);
    if (t.suspend > 0) t.suspend--;
    t.resume_cv.notify_all();
}

uint32_t Suspend(Thread& t) {
    uint32_t prev = uint32_t(t.suspend++);
    if (&t == Current()) SuspendPoint();
    return prev;
}

void SuspendPoint() {
    Thread* t = Current();
    if (!t || t->suspend.load() <= 0) return;
    std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(t->apc_lock);
    t->resume_cv.wait(lock, [&] { return t->suspend.load() <= 0; });
}

void QueueApc(Thread& t, uint32_t routine, uint32_t a1, uint32_t a2, uint32_t a3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(t.apc_lock);
    t.apcs.push_back({routine, a1, a2, a3});
    SignalChanged();
}

bool RunApcs(Thread& t) {
    bool ran = false;
    for (;;) {
        std::array<uint32_t, 4> a;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(t.apc_lock);
            if (t.apcs.empty()) break;
            a = t.apcs.front();
            t.apcs.pop_front();
        }
        CallGuest(*t.ctx, a[0], {a[1], a[2], a[3]});
        ran = true;
    }
    return ran;
}

}  // namespace kernel

```

```cpp
void PutAnsi(uint32_t str, const char* text) {
    uint32_t buf = str + 8;
    size_t n = std::strlen(text);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(buf), text, n + 1);
    W16(str, uint16_t(n));
    W16(str + 2, uint16_t(n + 1));
    W32(str + 4, buf);
}

uint8_t& Irql() { return G<uint8_t>(Current()->kpcr + 0x24); }

int64_t TimeoutArg(uint32_t ptr) { return ptr ? int64_t(R64(ptr)) : INT64_MAX; }

// KSYSTEM_TIME: readers retry until High1Time equals High2Time
void PutSystemTime(uint32_t va, uint64_t t) {
    W32(va + 8, uint32_t(t >> 32));
    W32(va, uint32_t(t));
    W32(va + 4, uint32_t(t >> 32));
}

uint64_t InterruptTime() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    static const auto start = steady_clock::now();
    return uint64_t(duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now() - start).count() / 100);
}

}  // namespace

uint32_t g_tick_count_va = 0;
uint32_t g_launch_data_page_va = 0;

void InitKernelData() {
    g_tick_count_va = DataAddress(156);
    g_launch_data_page_va = DataAddress(164);
    W32(DataAddress(164), 0);
    uint32_t hw = DataAddress(322);
    W32(hw, 0x00000020);
    G<uint8_t>(hw + 4) = 0xD3;  // GPU revision
    G<uint8_t>(hw + 5) = 0xB1;  // MCP revision
    uint32_t ver = DataAddress(324);
    W16(ver, 1);
    W16(ver + 2, 0);
    W16(ver + 4, 5838);
    W16(ver + 6, 1);
    PutAnsi(DataAddress(326), "\\Device\\CdRom0\\default.xbe");
    PutAnsi(DataAddress(41), "RECOMP HARD DISK");
    PutAnsi(DataAddress(42), "0000000000000000");
    W32(DataAddress(40), 3);
    W32(DataAddress(356), 0);
    // IDE_CHANNEL_OBJECT DeviceQueue.DeviceListHead, XAPI walks it to cancel file I/O
    uint32_t queue = DataAddress(357) + 0x28;
    W32(queue, queue);
    W32(queue + 4, queue);
    G<uint8_t>(DataAddress(89)) = 1;
    W32(DataAddress(157), 10000);  // 1 ms in 100 ns units
    // the start of the clock
    std::thread([] {
        auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
        for (;;) {
            auto ms = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count();
            W32(g_tick_count_va, uint32_t(ms));
            PutSystemTime(DataAddress(120), InterruptTime());
            PutSystemTime(DataAddress(154), uint64_t(Now100ns()));
            std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
        }
    }).detach();
}

// critical sections

KERNEL_EXPORT(291, RtlInitializeCriticalSection, 1) {
    uint32_t cs = a[0];
    G<uint8_t>(cs) = 1;  // SynchronizationEvent
    G<uint8_t>(cs + 1) = 0;
    G<uint8_t>(cs + 2) = 4;  // Header.Size in dwords
    G<uint8_t>(cs + 3) = 0;
    W32(cs + 4, 0);
    W32(cs + 8, cs + 8);  // empty WaitListHead
    W32(cs + 12, cs + 8);
    W32(cs + 0x10, 0xFFFFFFFF);  // LockCount
    W32(cs + 0x14, 0);           // RecursionCount
    W32(cs + 0x18, 0);           // OwningThread
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(277, RtlEnterCriticalSection, 1) {
    uint32_t cs = a[0];
    uint32_t me = Current()->ethread;
    auto* lock_count = reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(HostPtr(cs + 0x10));
    if (__atomic_add_fetch(lock_count, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) == 0) {
        W32(cs + 0x18, me);
        W32(cs + 0x14, 1);
        return 0;
    }
    if (R32(cs + 0x18) == me) {
        W32(cs + 0x14, R32(cs + 0x14) + 1);
        return 0;
    }
    ObjectRef ev = FromPointer(cs);
    Wait({ev}, false, INT64_MAX, false);
    W32(cs + 0x18, me);
    W32(cs + 0x14, 1);
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(294, RtlLeaveCriticalSection, 1) {
    uint32_t cs = a[0];
    auto* lock_count = reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(HostPtr(cs + 0x10));
    uint32_t rec = R32(cs + 0x14) - 1;
    W32(cs + 0x14, rec);
    if (rec) {
        __atomic_sub_fetch(lock_count, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
        return 0;
    }
    W32(cs + 0x18, 0);
    if (__atomic_sub_fetch(lock_count, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST) >= 0) SetEvent(*FromPointer(cs));
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(306, RtlTryEnterCriticalSection, 1) {
    uint32_t cs = a[0];
    uint32_t me = Current()->ethread;
    int32_t idle = -1;  // LockCount of a free section
    if (__atomic_compare_exchange_n(reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(HostPtr(cs + 0x10)), &idle, 0, false, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)) {
        W32(cs + 0x18, me);
        W32(cs + 0x14, 1);
        return 1;
    }
    if (R32(cs + 0x18) != me) return 0;
    __atomic_add_fetch(reinterpret_cast<int32_t*>(HostPtr(cs + 0x10)), 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    W32(cs + 0x14, R32(cs + 0x14) + 1);
    return 1;
}

// the console's ACPI timer
constexpr uint64_t kPerfFrequency = 3375000;

KERNEL_EXPORT(126, KeQueryPerformanceCounter, 0) {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    static const auto start = steady_clock::now();
    uint64_t ns = uint64_t(duration_cast<nanoseconds>(steady_clock::now() - start).count());
    uint64_t v = ns / 1000000000ull * kPerfFrequency + ns % 1000000000ull * kPerfFrequency / 1000000000ull;
    ctx.edx = uint32_t(v >> 32);
    return uint32_t(v);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(151, KeStallExecutionProcessor, 1) {
    auto until = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::microseconds(a[0]);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < until) std::this_thread::yield();
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(99, KeDelayExecutionThread, 3) {
    int64_t interval = int64_t(R64(a[2]));
    bool alertable = a[1] & 0xFF;
    Thread* t = Current();
    if (alertable && t && RunApcs(*t)) return kUserApc;
    int64_t deadline = ToDeadline(interval);
    auto now = [] {
        return std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(std::chrono::steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
    };
    SuspendPoint();
    if (interval == 0) {
        std::this_thread::yield();
        return kSuccess;
    }
    while (now() < deadline) {
        int64_t left = deadline - now();
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::nanoseconds(std::min<int64_t>(left, 2000000)));
        if (alertable && t && RunApcs(*t)) return kUserApc;
    }
    return kSuccess;
}

static int64_t DaysFromCivil(int64_t y, unsigned m, unsigned d) {
    y -= m <= 2;
    const int64_t era = (y >= 0 ? y : y - 399) / 400;
    const unsigned yoe = unsigned(y - era * 400);
    const unsigned doy = (153 * (m + (m > 2 ? -3 : 9)) + 2) / 5 + d - 1;
    const unsigned doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
    return era * 146097 + int64_t(doe) - 719468;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(304, RtlTimeFieldsToTime, 2) {
    uint32_t tf = a[0];
    int64_t days = DaysFromCivil(int16_t(R16(tf)), R16(tf + 2), R16(tf + 4));
    int64_t secs = days * 86400 + R16(tf + 6) * 3600 + R16(tf + 8) * 60 + R16(tf + 10);
    int64_t t = (secs + 11644473600ll) * 10000000ll + int64_t(R16(tf + 12)) * 10000;
    W64(a[1], uint64_t(t));
    return 1;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(305, RtlTimeToTimeFields, 2) {
    int64_t t = int64_t(R64(a[0]));
    int64_t ms = (t / 10000) % 1000;
    int64_t secs = t / 10000000 - 11644473600ll;
    int64_t days = secs >= 0 ? secs / 86400 : (secs - 86399) / 86400;
    int64_t rem = secs - days * 86400;
    // civil from days
    int64_t z = days + 719468;
    const int64_t era = (z >= 0 ? z : z - 146096) / 146097;
    const unsigned doe = unsigned(z - era * 146097);
    const unsigned yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146096) / 365;
    int64_t y = int64_t(yoe) + era * 400;
    const unsigned doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    const unsigned mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    const unsigned d = doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1;
    const unsigned m = mp + (mp < 10 ? 3 : -9);
    y += m <= 2;
    uint32_t tf = a[1];
    W16(tf, uint16_t(y));
    W16(tf + 2, uint16_t(m));
    W16(tf + 4, uint16_t(d));
    W16(tf + 6, uint16_t(rem / 3600));
    W16(tf + 8, uint16_t(rem / 60 % 60));
    W16(tf + 10, uint16_t(rem % 60));
    W16(tf + 12, uint16_t(ms));
    // weekday, 1 Jan 1970 was a Thursday
    W16(tf + 14, uint16_t((days + 4) % 7 < 0 ? (days + 4) % 7 + 7 : (days + 4) % 7));
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(181, MmQueryStatistics, 1) {

// sec is an XBE section header, +0x18 its reference count
KERNEL_EXPORT(327, XeLoadSection, 1) {
    uint32_t sec = a[0];
    uint32_t refs = R32(sec + 0x18);
    if (refs == 0) {
        uint32_t va = R32(sec + 4), vsize = R32(sec + 8), raw = R32(sec + 12), rsize = R32(sec + 16);
        mem::Commit(va, vsize);
        std::memset(HostPtr(va), 0, vsize);
        if (g_image && raw + rsize <= g_image->file.size())
            std::memcpy(HostPtr(va), g_image->file.data() + raw, std::min(rsize, vsize));
        LOGI("XeLoadSection %s at %08X", ReadCString(R32(sec + 0x14)).c_str(), va);
    }
    W32(sec + 0x18, refs + 1);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(328, XeUnloadSection, 1) {
    uint32_t sec = a[0];
    uint32_t refs = R32(sec + 0x18);
    if (!refs) return kInvalidParameter;
    W32(sec + 0x18, refs - 1);
    return kSuccess;
}

static ObjectRef Named(uint32_t attrs, std::string& name) {
    name = attrs ? ReadAnsiString(R32(attrs + 4)) : std::string();
    return name.empty() ? nullptr : FindNamed(name);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(189, NtCreateEvent, 4) {
    std::string name;
    if (ObjectRef existing = Named(a[1], name)) {
        W32(a[0], NewHandle(existing));
        return kObjectNameExists;
    }
    auto o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Event);
    o->notification = a[2] == 0;
    o->signal = (a[3] & 0xFF) ? 1 : 0;
    uint32_t body = mem::AllocSystem(16);
    G<uint8_t>(body) = uint8_t(a[2]);  // NotificationEvent or SynchronizationEvent
    G<uint8_t>(body + 2) = 4;
    W32(body + 4, uint32_t(o->signal));
    Bind(o, body);
    if (!name.empty()) AddNamed(name, o);
    W32(a[0], NewHandle(o));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(225, NtSetEvent, 2) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(a[0]);
    if (!o) return kInvalidHandle;
    int32_t prev = SetEvent(*o);
    if (a[1]) W32(a[1], uint32_t(prev));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(186, NtClearEvent, 1) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(a[0]);
    if (!o) return kInvalidHandle;
    ResetEvent(*o);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(192, NtCreateMutant, 3) {
    std::string name;
    if (ObjectRef existing = Named(a[1], name)) {
        W32(a[0], NewHandle(existing));
        return kObjectNameExists;
    }
    auto o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Mutant);
    uint32_t body = mem::AllocSystem(32);
    G<uint8_t>(body) = 2;  // MutantObject
    G<uint8_t>(body + 2) = 8;
    if (a[2] & 0xFF) {
        o->owner = Current()->ethread;
        o->recursion = 1;
        o->signal = 0;
    } else {
        o->signal = 1;
    }
    W32(body + 4, uint32_t(o->signal));
    Bind(o, body);
    if (!name.empty()) AddNamed(name, o);
    W32(a[0], NewHandle(o));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(221, NtReleaseMutant, 2) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(a[0]);
    if (!o) return kInvalidHandle;
    uint32_t st;
    int32_t prev = ReleaseMutant(*o, st);
    if (a[1]) W32(a[1], uint32_t(prev));
    return st;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(193, NtCreateSemaphore, 4) {
    int32_t count = int32_t(a[2]), limit = int32_t(a[3]);
    if (limit <= 0 || count < 0 || count > limit) return kInvalidParameter;
    std::string name;
    if (ObjectRef existing = Named(a[1], name)) {
        W32(a[0], NewHandle(existing));
        return kObjectNameExists;
    }
    auto o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Semaphore);
    o->signal = count;
    o->limit = limit;
    uint32_t body = mem::AllocSystem(20);
    G<uint8_t>(body) = 5;  // SemaphoreObject
    G<uint8_t>(body + 2) = 5;
    W32(body + 4, uint32_t(count));
    W32(body + 0x10, uint32_t(limit));
    Bind(o, body);
    if (!name.empty()) AddNamed(name, o);
    W32(a[0], NewHandle(o));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(222, NtReleaseSemaphore, 3) {
    ObjectRef o = FromHandle(a[0]);
    if (!o) return kInvalidHandle;
    if (o->type != ObjType::Semaphore) return kObjectTypeMismatch;
    uint32_t st;
    int32_t prev = ReleaseSemaphore(*o, int32_t(a[1]), st);
    if (a[2] && st == kSuccess) W32(a[2], uint32_t(prev));
    return st;
}

// dispatcher headers the guest owns: written like the console does, FromPointer rebuilds its object from them
static void InitHeader(uint32_t p, uint8_t type, uint8_t dwords, int32_t state) {
    std::memset(HostPtr(p), 0, dwords * 4u);
    G<uint8_t>(p) = type;
    G<uint8_t>(p + 2) = dwords;
    W32(p + 4, uint32_t(state));
    W32(p + 8, p + 8);
    W32(p + 12, p + 8);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(108, KeInitializeEvent, 3) {
    InitHeader(a[0], uint8_t(a[1]), 4, a[2] & 0xFF);
    return 0;
}

// signals by type: event set, semaphore released once, mutant released
KERNEL_EXPORT(230, NtSignalAndWaitForSingleObjectEx, 5) {
    ObjectRef s = FromHandle(a[0]), w = FromHandle(a[1]);
    if (!s || !w) return kInvalidHandle;
    uint32_t st = kSuccess;
    switch (s->type) {
        case ObjType::Event: SetEvent(*s); break;
        case ObjType::Semaphore: ReleaseSemaphore(*s, 1, st); break;
        case ObjType::Mutant: ReleaseMutant(*s, st); break;
        default: return kObjectTypeMismatch;
    }
    if (st != kSuccess) return st;
    return Wait({w}, false, TimeoutArg(a[4]), a[3] & 0xFF);
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(194, NtCreateTimer, 3) {
    std::string name;
    if (ObjectRef existing = Named(a[1], name)) {
        W32(a[0], NewHandle(existing));
        return kObjectNameExists;
    }
    auto o = std::make_shared<Object>(ObjType::Timer);
    o->notification = a[2] == 0;
    uint32_t body = mem::AllocSystem(0x28);
    InitHeader(body, uint8_t(8 + (a[2] & 1)), 10, 0);  // TimerNotificationObject or TimerSynchronizationObject

    W32(a[0], NewHandle(o));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(289, RtlInitAnsiString, 2) {
    uint32_t d = a[0], s = a[1];
    size_t n = s ? std::strlen(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(HostPtr(s))) : 0;
    W16(d, uint16_t(n));
    W16(d + 2, uint16_t(s ? n + 1 : 0));
    W32(d + 4, s);
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(290, RtlInitUnicodeString, 2) {
    uint32_t d = a[0], s = a[1];
    size_t n = 0;
    if (s)
        while (R16(s + uint32_t(n) * 2)) n++;
    W16(d, uint16_t(n * 2));
    W16(d + 2, uint16_t(s ? n * 2 + 2 : 0));
    W32(d + 4, s);
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(260, RtlAnsiStringToUnicodeString, 3) {
    uint32_t d = a[0], s = a[1];
    uint16_t n = R16(s);
    uint32_t src = R32(s + 4);
    if (a[2] & 0xFF) {
        uint32_t buf = mem::AllocSystem(n * 2u + 2);
        W32(d + 4, buf);
        W16(d + 2, uint16_t(n * 2 + 2));
    } else if (R16(d + 2) < n * 2) {
        return kBufferTooSmall;
    }
    uint32_t buf = R32(d + 4);
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < n; i++) W16(buf + i * 2u, G<uint8_t>(src + i));
    if (R16(d + 2) >= n * 2 + 2) W16(buf + n * 2u, 0);
    W16(d, uint16_t(n * 2));
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(308, RtlUnicodeStringToAnsiString, 3) {
    uint32_t d = a[0], s = a[1];
    uint16_t n = R16(s) / 2;
    uint32_t src = R32(s + 4);
    if (a[2] & 0xFF) {
        uint32_t buf = mem::AllocSystem(n + 1u);
        W32(d + 4, buf);
        W16(d + 2, uint16_t(n + 1));
    } else if (R16(d + 2) < n) {
        return kBufferTooSmall;
    }
    uint32_t buf = R32(d + 4);
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint16_t c = R16(src + i * 2u);
        G<uint8_t>(buf + i) = c < 0x100 ? uint8_t(c) : '?';
    }
    if (R16(d + 2) > n) G<uint8_t>(buf + n) = 0;
    W16(d, n);
    return kSuccess;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(286, RtlFreeAnsiString, 1) {
    uint32_t buf = R32(a[0] + 4);
    if (buf) mem::FreeSystem(buf);
    W32(a[0] + 4, 0);
    W16(a[0], 0);
    W16(a[0] + 2, 0);
    return 0;
}

static int CompareStrings(uint32_t s1, uint32_t s2, bool ci) {
    std::string a1 = ReadAnsiString(s1), a2 = ReadAnsiString(s2);
    size_t n = std::min(a1.size(), a2.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int c1 = uint8_t(a1[i]), c2 = uint8_t(a2[i]);
        if (ci) {
            c1 = std::toupper(c1);
            c2 = std::toupper(c2);
        }
        if (c1 != c2) return c1 - c2;
    }
    return int(a1.size()) - int(a2.size());
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(270, RtlCompareString, 3) { return uint32_t(CompareStrings(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF)); }
KERNEL_EXPORT(279, RtlEqualString, 3) { return CompareStrings(a[0], a[1], a[2] & 0xFF) == 0; }
KERNEL_EXPORT(316, RtlUpperChar, 1) { return uint32_t(std::toupper(int(a[0] & 0xFF))) & 0xFF; }
KERNEL_EXPORT(313, RtlUpcaseUnicodeChar, 1) {
    uint16_t c = uint16_t(a[0]);
    return c < 0x80 ? uint32_t(std::toupper(c)) : c;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(269, RtlCompareMemoryUlong, 3) {
    uint32_t src = a[0], len = a[1] & ~3u, pat = a[2], n = 0;
    while (n < len && R32(src + n) == pat) n += 4;
    return n;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(301, RtlNtStatusToDosError, 1) {
    switch (a[0]) {
        case kSuccess: return 0;
        case kPending: return 997;
        case kTimeout: return 1460;
        case kNoSuchFile:
        case kObjectNameNotFound: return 2;
        case kObjectPathNotFound: return 3;
        case kAccessDenied:
        case kCannotDelete:
        case kFileIsADirectory: return 5;
        case kInvalidHandle: return 6;
        case kNoMemory: return 8;
        case kNoMoreFiles: return 18;
        case kEndOfFile: return 38;
        case kNotSupported: return 50;
        case kInvalidParameter: return 87;
        case kNotImplemented: return 120;
        case kBufferTooSmall: return 122;
        case kObjectNameInvalid: return 123;
        case kObjectNameCollision: return 183;
        case kNotADirectory: return 267;
        case 0xC000007F: return 112;  // disk full
        case kDeviceNotConnected: return 1167;
        default: return (a[0] & 0xC0000000) ? 317 : 0;
    }
}

// exceptions, debug, shutdown

// Exceptions dispatch like NT on x86: each handler of the fs:[0] chain is called (record, frame, context,
// dispatcher context) until one returns ExceptionContinueExecution. A C++ catch never returns: the CRT jumps to the
// continuation, which unwinds the host stack (X86Resume).
namespace {
constexpr uint32_t kContextBytes = 0x400, kUnwinding = 2, kExitUnwind = 4, kContinueExecution = 0;

uint32_t CallHandler(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t rec, uint32_t frame, uint32_t scratch) {
    return CallGuest(ctx, R32(frame + 4), {rec, frame, scratch, scratch + kContextBytes - 8});
}
}  // namespace

KERNEL_EXPORT(302, RtlRaiseException, 1) {
    uint32_t rec = a[0];
    std::string text;
    // a C++ throw carrying a wide string: the text
    if (R32(rec) == 0xE06D7363 && R32(rec + 16) >= 2 && mem::IsCommitted(R32(rec + 24))) {
        for (uint32_t p = R32(R32(rec + 24)), n = 0; mem::IsCommitted(p) && n < 256; n++, p += 2) {
            uint16_t c = R16(p);
            if (!c) break;
            text += c < 0x80 ? char(c) : '?';
        }
        LOG_FIRST(64, "c++ throw: %s", text.c_str());
    }
    uint32_t esp = ctx.esp;
    ctx.esp = (ctx.esp - kContextBytes) & ~15u;
    uint32_t scratch = ctx.esp;
    std::memset(HostPtr(scratch), 0, kContextBytes);
    for (uint32_t frame = R32(ctx.fs_base); frame && frame != 0xFFFFFFFF; frame = R32(frame)) {
        if (CallHandler(ctx, rec, frame, scratch) == kContinueExecution) {
            ctx.esp = esp;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    ctx.esp = esp;
    LOGE("RtlRaiseException code %08X flags %X address %08X params %u, not handled", R32(rec), R32(rec + 4), R32(rec + 12),
         R32(rec + 16));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < std::min<uint32_t>(R32(rec + 16), 4); i++) LOGE("  param %u = %08X", i, R32(rec + 20 + i * 4));
    if (!text.empty()) LOGE("  thrown: %s", text.c_str());
    x86_trap(ctx, R32(ctx.esp), "guest raised an exception");
}

// RtlUnwind(target frame, target ip, record, return value): the handlers of the frames above the target run with
// the unwinding flag (destructors), each frame leaving the chain after its handler
KERNEL_EXPORT(312, RtlUnwind, 4) {
    uint32_t target = a[0], rec = a[2];
    uint32_t esp = ctx.esp;
    ctx.esp = (ctx.esp - kContextBytes - 0x60) & ~15u;
    uint32_t scratch = ctx.esp;
    std::memset(HostPtr(scratch), 0, kContextBytes + 0x60);
    if (!rec) {
        rec = scratch + kContextBytes;
        W32(rec, 0xC0000027);  // STATUS_UNWIND
    }
    W32(rec + 4, R32(rec + 4) | kUnwinding | (target ? 0 : kExitUnwind));
    for (uint32_t frame = R32(ctx.fs_base); frame && frame != 0xFFFFFFFF && frame != target; frame = R32(ctx.fs_base)) {
        CallHandler(ctx, rec, frame, scratch);
        W32(ctx.fs_base, R32(frame));
    }
    ctx.esp = esp;
    return a[3];
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(26, ExRaiseException, 1) { return kimpl_RtlRaiseException(ctx, a); }

static std::string FormatGuest(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t fmt_va, uint32_t args_va, bool trim = true) {
    std::string fmt = ReadCString(fmt_va), out;
    uint32_t ap = args_va;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < fmt.size(); i++) {
        if (fmt[i] != '%') {
            out += fmt[i];
            continue;
        }
        std::string spec = "%";
        i++;
        while (i < fmt.size() && std::strchr("-+ #0123456789.lhI", fmt[i])) spec += fmt[i++];
        if (i >= fmt.size()) break;
        char c = fmt[i];
        char buf[512];
        if (c == '%') {
            out += '%';
            continue;
        }
        if (c == 's') {
            out += ReadCString(R32(ap), 256);
            ap += 4;
            continue;
        }
        if (c == 'f' || c == 'g' || c == 'e') {
            double d;
            std::memcpy(&d, HostPtr(ap), 8);
            ap += 8;
            std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), (spec + c).c_str(), d);
            out += buf;
            continue;
        }
        std::string clean;
        for (char ch : spec)
            if (ch != 'l' && ch != 'h' && ch != 'I') clean += ch;
        std::snprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), (clean + (c == 'p' ? 'x' : c)).c_str(), R32(ap));
        ap += 4;
        out += buf;
    }
    (void)ctx;
    while (trim && !out.empty() && (out.back() == '\n' || out.back() == '\r')) out.pop_back();
    return out;
}

static void DbgPrintEntry(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {
    LOGI("DbgPrint: %s", FormatGuest(ctx, R32(ctx.esp + 4), ctx.esp + 8).c_str());
    ctx.eax = 0;
    ctx.esp += 4;  // cdecl
}
static const bool kreg_DbgPrint = (RegisterExport(8, "DbgPrint", DbgPrintEntry), true);

// cdecl: RtlSprintf(buffer, format, ...), RtlSnprintf(buffer, count, format, ...); a result longer than count
// fills count bytes unterminated and returns -1
static void SprintfEntry(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {
    std::string s = FormatGuest(ctx, R32(ctx.esp + 8), ctx.esp + 12, false);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(R32(ctx.esp + 4)), s.c_str(), s.size() + 1);
    ctx.eax = uint32_t(s.size());
    ctx.esp += 4;
}
static void SnprintfEntry(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t*) {
    std::string s = FormatGuest(ctx, R32(ctx.esp + 12), ctx.esp + 16, false);
    uint32_t count = R32(ctx.esp + 8);
    uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(uint32_t(s.size()) + 1, count);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(R32(ctx.esp + 4)), s.c_str(), n);
    ctx.eax = s.size() < count ? uint32_t(s.size()) : 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    ctx.esp += 4;
}
static const bool kreg_RtlSprintf = (RegisterExport(362, "RtlSprintf", SprintfEntry), true);
static const bool kreg_RtlSnprintf = (RegisterExport(361, "RtlSnprintf", SnprintfEntry), true);

KERNEL_EXPORT(6, DbgBreakPointWithStatus, 1) {
    LOGW("DbgBreakPointWithStatus %08X from %08X", a[0], R32(ctx.esp));
    return 0;
}

KERNEL_EXPORT(264, RtlAssert, 4) {
    LOGE("RtlAssert: %s at %s:%u %s", ReadCString(a[0]).c_str(), ReadCString(a[1]).c_str(), a[2],
         a[3] ? ReadCString(a[3]).c_str() : "");

KERNEL_EXPORT(352, RtlRip, 3) {

    uint32_t page = R32(g_launch_data_page_va);
    if (a[0] == 2 && page) {
        std::string path = ReadCString(page + 8, 520);
        if (const char* exe = ImageExe(path)) {
            if (FILE* f = std::fopen(g_launch_file.c_str(), "wb")) {
                std::fwrite(HostPtr(page), 1, 0x1000, f);
                std::fclose(f);
            }
            LOGI("relaunching into %s", path.c_str());
            Relaunch(exe);
        }
        LOGW("HalReturnToFirmware: %s is no recompiled image", path.c_str());
    }
    LogGuestStack(ctx, 256);
    Shutdown(0);
}

// widescreen (a 4:3 output plays the console's 4:3), 480p
static uint32_t VideoFlags() { return (app::Widescreen() ? 0x00010000 : 0) | 0x00080000; }

KERNEL_EXPORT(24, ExQueryNonVolatileSetting, 5) {
    uint32_t index = a[0], type_out = a[1], value = a[2], len = a[3], result_len = a[4];
    uint32_t v = 0;
    switch (index) {
        case 7: v = ::app::ConsoleLanguage(); break;  // XC_LANGUAGE
        case 8: v = VideoFlags(); break;          // XC_VIDEO_FLAGS
        case 9: v = 0; break;                      // XC_AUDIO_FLAGS stereo
        case 0x103: v = 0x00400100; break;         // XC_FACTORY_AV_REGION NTSC-M
        case 0x104: v = 1; break;                  // XC_FACTORY_GAME_REGION north america
        case 0x12: v = 1; break;                   // XC_DVD_REGION
        default: break;
    }
    if (value && len) std::memset(HostPtr(value), 0, len);
    if (index == 0xFFFF) {
        // the whole EEPROM image: user settings live at 0xC0 onwards
        if (type_out) W32(type_out, 3);  // REG_BINARY
        if (value && len >= 0x100) {
            W32(value + 0xE8, ::app::ConsoleLanguage());  // language
            W32(value + 0xEC, VideoFlags());          // video flags
            W32(value + 0xF0, 0);                     // audio flags, stereo
            W32(value + 0x58, 0x00400100);            // factory video standard
            W32(value + 0x2C, 1);                     // factory game region
        }
        if (result_len) W32(result_len, 0x100);
        return kSuccess;
    }
    if (type_out) W32(type_out, 4);  // REG_DWORD
    if (value && len >= 4) W32(value, v);
    if (result_len) W32(result_len, 4);
    LOG_FIRST(32, "ExQueryNonVolatileSetting %X -> %X", index, v);
    return kSuccess;
}
```
