`sdk/runtime/xbe/xbe.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace xbe {

// the header XORs the entry point and kernel thunk address with these
constexpr uint32_t kRetailEntryKey = 0xA8FC57AB;
constexpr uint32_t kDebugEntryKey = 0x94859D4B;
constexpr uint32_t kRetailThunkKey = 0x5B6D40B6;
constexpr uint32_t kDebugThunkKey = 0xEFB1F152;

enum SectionFlags : uint32_t {
    kWritable = 1,
    kPreload = 2,
    kExecutable = 4,
    kInsertedFile = 8,
};

struct Section {
    std::string name;
    uint32_t flags = 0;
    uint32_t va = 0, vsize = 0;
    uint32_t raw = 0, rsize = 0;
};

struct Library {
    std::string name;
    uint16_t major = 0, minor = 0, build = 0, flags = 0;
};

struct Tls {
    uint32_t data_start = 0, data_end = 0, index_addr = 0, callbacks = 0, zero_fill = 0, characteristics = 0;
};

struct Image {
    std::vector<uint8_t> file;
    uint32_t base = 0, header_size = 0, image_size = 0;
    uint32_t entry = 0, kernel_thunk = 0, tls_addr = 0;
    uint32_t stack_commit = 0, heap_reserve = 0, heap_commit = 0;
    uint32_t cert = 0, title_id = 0, init_flags = 0;
    bool debug = false;
    std::vector<Section> sections;
    std::vector<Library> libraries;
    Tls tls;

    uint32_t U32(uint32_t off) const {
        uint32_t v;
        std::memcpy(&v, file.data() + off, 4);
        return v;
    }

    // file offset for a virtual address, -1 if unmapped or in the zero filled tail
    int64_t Offset(uint32_t va) const {
        if (va >= base && va < base + header_size) return va - base;
        for (auto& s : sections)
            if (va >= s.va && va < s.va + s.rsize) return int64_t(s.raw) + (va - s.va);
        return -1;
    }

    const Section* SectionAt(uint32_t va) const {
        for (auto& s : sections)
            if (va >= s.va && va < s.va + s.vsize) return &s;
        return nullptr;
    }

    bool Read32(uint32_t va, uint32_t& out) const {
        int64_t o = Offset(va);
        if (o < 0 || o + 4 > int64_t(file.size())) return false;
        out = U32(uint32_t(o));
        return true;
    }

    std::string CStr(uint32_t va) const {
        int64_t o = Offset(va);
        if (o < 0) return {};
        std::string s;
        while (size_t(o) < file.size() && file[size_t(o)]) s += char(file[size_t(o++)]);
        return s;
    }

    bool Parse(std::vector<uint8_t> data, std::string& error) {
        file = std::move(data);
        if (file.size() < 0x180 || std::memcmp(file.data(), "XBEH", 4)) {
            error = "not an XBE";
            return false;
        }
        base = U32(0x104);
        header_size = U32(0x108);
        image_size = U32(0x10C);
        cert = U32(0x118);
        uint32_t nsec = U32(0x11C), sec_addr = U32(0x120);
        init_flags = U32(0x124);
        uint32_t ep = U32(0x128), kt = U32(0x158);
        tls_addr = U32(0x12C);
        stack_commit = U32(0x130);
        heap_reserve = U32(0x134);
        heap_commit = U32(0x138);
        auto inside = [&](uint32_t v) { return v >= base && v < base + image_size; };
        if (inside(ep ^ kRetailEntryKey) && inside(kt ^ kRetailThunkKey)) {
            entry = ep ^ kRetailEntryKey;
            kernel_thunk = kt ^ kRetailThunkKey;
        } else if (inside(ep ^ kDebugEntryKey) && inside(kt ^ kDebugThunkKey)) {
            entry = ep ^ kDebugEntryKey;
            kernel_thunk = kt ^ kDebugThunkKey;
            debug = true;
        } else {
            error = "entry point key not recognised";
            return false;
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nsec; i++) {
            uint32_t o = sec_addr - base + i * 56;
            Section s;
            s.flags = U32(o);
            s.va = U32(o + 4);
            s.vsize = U32(o + 8);
            s.raw = U32(o + 12);
            s.rsize = U32(o + 16);
            uint32_t name = U32(o + 20);
            if (name - base < header_size)
                s.name = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(file.data() + (name - base));
            sections.push_back(s);
        }
        uint32_t nlib = U32(0x160), lib_addr = U32(0x164);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nlib && lib_addr; i++) {
            uint32_t o = lib_addr - base + i * 16;
            Library l;
            char n[9] = {};
            std::memcpy(n, file.data() + o, 8);
            l.name = n;
            std::memcpy(&l.major, file.data() + o + 8, 8);  // major, minor, build and flags, four uint16 in order
            libraries.push_back(l);
        }
        if (cert - base + 12 <= file.size()) title_id = U32(cert - base + 8);  // certificate +8 is the title id
        if (tls_addr) {
            int64_t o = Offset(tls_addr);
            if (o >= 0) {
                tls.data_start = U32(uint32_t(o));
                tls.data_end = U32(uint32_t(o) + 4);
                tls.index_addr = U32(uint32_t(o) + 8);
                tls.callbacks = U32(uint32_t(o) + 12);
                tls.zero_fill = U32(uint32_t(o) + 16);
                tls.characteristics = U32(uint32_t(o) + 20);
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

}  // namespace xbe

```

`sdk/runtime/xdk/bink.cpp`:

```cpp
// BinkGetSummary divides bytes read * 1000 by the read time in ms + 1. Host reads take under a millisecond,
// the time stays 0 and the quotient of a large movie overflows the 32 bit div. Raise the time just enough.
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "xdk/hle.h"

using namespace kernel;

X86_EXTERN_FUNC(GUEST_ORIG(BinkGetSummary));
X86_FUNC(GUEST(BinkGetSummary)) {
    uint32_t bink = R32(ctx.esp + 4);
    if (bink) {
        // 0x134 bytes read, 0x13C read time in ms
        uint64_t scaled = uint64_t(R32(bink + 0x134)) * 1000;
        uint32_t time = R32(bink + 0x13C);
        if (scaled >> 32 > time) W32(bink + 0x13C, uint32_t(scaled >> 32));
    }
    GUEST_ORIG(BinkGetSummary)(ctx, base);
}

// Movies step one frame per game frame, timed by the console's 30 Hz present. Above 30 fps a frame is decoded
// and advanced only once BinkWait, which follows the movie's own rate and audio, says it is due.
namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kBinkWait = SYM(BinkWait);
std::mutex g_held_lock;
std::unordered_set<uint32_t> g_held;  // movies whose frame was not decoded this game frame

}  // namespace

X86_EXTERN_FUNC(GUEST_ORIG(BinkDoFrame));
X86_FUNC(GUEST(BinkDoFrame)) {
    uint32_t bink = R32(ctx.esp + 4);
    if (bink && CallGuest(ctx, kBinkWait, {bink})) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_held_lock);
        g_held.insert(bink);
        ctx.eax = 0;
        ctx.esp += 8;
        return;
    }
    GUEST_ORIG(BinkDoFrame)(ctx, base);
}

X86_EXTERN_FUNC(GUEST_ORIG(BinkNextFrame));
X86_FUNC(GUEST(BinkNextFrame)) {
    uint32_t bink = R32(ctx.esp + 4);
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_held_lock);
        if (g_held.erase(bink)) {
            ctx.esp += 8;
            return;
        }
    }
    GUEST_ORIG(BinkNextFrame)(ctx, base);
}

```

`sdk/runtime/xdk/crt_math.cpp`:

```cpp
// The CRT's x87 math checks its argument in a helper call and branches on the ZF that call returns. Recompiled code
// does not carry flags across call and ret, so the functions read stale flags and returned NaN at random. Computed on
// the host instead.
#include <cmath>

#include "xdk/hle.h"

// each function's body, shared by its stack entry (sin) and its register entry (_CIsin): x in st0, popped by its ret
#define CRT_MATH(name, fn)         \
    X86_FUNC(GUEST(name)) {        \
        (void)base;                \
        X87_ST(0) = fn(X87_ST(0)); \
        ctx.esp += 4;              \
    }
#ifndef SYM_crt_sin
#define SYM_crt_sin FFFFFD00
#define SYM_crt_cos FFFFFD01
#define SYM_crt_tan FFFFFD02
#define SYM_crt_asin FFFFFD03
#define SYM_crt_acos FFFFFD04
#define SYM_crt_atan FFFFFD05
#define SYM_crt_sqrt FFFFFD06
#define SYM_crt_log FFFFFD07
#define SYM_crt_log10 FFFFFD08
#define SYM_crt_pow FFFFFD09
#endif
CRT_MATH(crt_sin, std::sin)
CRT_MATH(crt_cos, std::cos)
CRT_MATH(crt_tan, std::tan)
CRT_MATH(crt_asin, std::asin)
CRT_MATH(crt_acos, std::acos)
CRT_MATH(crt_atan, std::atan)
CRT_MATH(crt_sqrt, std::sqrt)
CRT_MATH(crt_log, std::log)
CRT_MATH(crt_log10, std::log10)
#undef CRT_MATH

// x and y above the return address, y in st0
X86_FUNC(GUEST(crt_pow)) {
    X87_ST(0) = std::pow(double(X86_MEMF64(ctx.esp + 4)), double(X86_MEMF64(ctx.esp + 12)));
    ctx.esp += 4;
}

// configs written before the bodies had names
X86_FUNC(GUEST(_CIacos)) {
    (void)base;
    X87_ST(0) = std::acos(X87_ST(0));
    ctx.esp += 4;
}

X86_FUNC(GUEST(_CIasin)) {
    (void)base;
    X87_ST(0) = std::asin(X87_ST(0));
    ctx.esp += 4;
}
```

```cpp
// Direct3D 8 (XDK 5849) entry points the title calls, implemented on the host renderer.
// Resource creation, locking and the XG helpers stay recompiled: they only manage memory.
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <map>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "core/diag.h"
#include "gpu/backend.h"
#include "gpu/texture.h"
#include "gpu/vertex.h"
#include "xdk/d3d8.h"
#include "xdk/hle.h"
#include "xdk/layout.h"

using namespace kernel;

// configs written before the SDK knew the name
#ifndef SYM_D3DDevice_BeginPush
#define SYM_D3DDevice_BeginPush FFFFFE00
#define HAS_D3DDevice_BeginPush 0
#endif
#ifndef SYM_D3DDevice_EndPush
#define SYM_D3DDevice_EndPush FFFFFE01
#define HAS_D3DDevice_EndPush 0
#endif
#ifndef HAS_D3D_FvfShader
#define HAS_D3D_FvfShader 0
#endif
#ifndef SYM_D3DDevice_SetPalette
#define SYM_D3DDevice_SetPalette FFFFFE02
#define HAS_D3DDevice_SetPalette 0
#endif
#ifndef SYM_D3DDevice_GetVertexShaderFunction
#define SYM_D3DDevice_GetVertexShaderFunction FFFFFE03
#define HAS_D3DDevice_GetVertexShaderFunction 0
#endif

namespace d3d {

namespace {

// A/B switch: 0 draws on the title's thread, as before
#ifndef XBE_RENDER_THREAD
#define XBE_RENDER_THREAD 1
#endif
constexpr bool kRenderThread = XBE_RENDER_THREAD;

// D3D globals of this build
constexpr uint32_t kDevice = SYM(D3D_Device);        // the static CDevice, g_pDevice points at it
constexpr uint32_t kDevicePtr = SYM(D3D_pDevice);
constexpr uint32_t kIndexData = SYM(D3D_IndexData);  // index data base the inline draws read
constexpr uint32_t kDirtyFlags = SYM(D3D_DirtyFlags);
constexpr uint32_t kTextureState = SYM(D3D_DeferredTextureState);  // [4][32]
constexpr uint32_t kRenderState = SYM(D3D_RenderState);            // [166]
constexpr uint32_t kStreams = SYM(D3D_Streams);                    // [16] stride, offset, buffer
constexpr uint32_t kSimpleEncode = SYM(D3D_SimpleRenderStateEncode);

// CDevice fields mirrored so the recompiled getters and resource code see what the XDK would
constexpr uint32_t kDevPush = XDK_CDevice_Push, kDevThreshold = XDK_CDevice_PushThreshold,
                   kDevBaseVertex = XDK_CDevice_BaseVertex, kDevIndexBuffer = XDK_CDevice_IndexBuffer,
                   kDevTextures = XDK_CDevice_Textures, kDevRenderTarget = XDK_CDevice_RenderTarget,
                   kDevDepth = XDK_CDevice_Depth, kDevSwapCount = XDK_CDevice_SwapCount,
                   kDevBackBuffer = XDK_CDevice_BackBuffer, kDevFrontBuffer = XDK_CDevice_FrontBuffer,
                   kDevZScale = XDK_CDevice_ZScale, kDevSuperX = XDK_CDevice_SuperSampleX,
                   kDevSuperY = XDK_CDevice_SuperSampleY, kDevTransforms = XDK_CDevice_Transforms,
                   kDevPalettes = XDK_CDevice_Palettes;
constexpr uint32_t kStageStates = XDK_TextureState_Stage, kStreamSize = XDK_Stream_Size;

gpu::State g_state;
std::unique_ptr<gpu::Backend> g_backend;
std::recursive_mutex g_lock;

std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<gpu::VertexShader>> g_vs;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<gpu::PixelShader>> g_ps;
std::array<uint32_t, 3> g_buffers{};  // front, back surfaces
uint32_t g_buffer_count = 2;
uint32_t g_depth = 0;
uint32_t g_scratch_push = 0, g_scratch_size = 0;
uint32_t g_walk = 0;  // first scratch command not read yet

uint32_t Dev(uint32_t off) { return R32(kDevice + off); }
void SetDev(uint32_t off, uint32_t v) { W32(kDevice + off, v); }

// The device's own references: a count in bits 19 to 22 of the resource's first dword. A surface's first one
// also holds its parent. The library's functions do it when the image has them, inlined ones are done here.
void AddRef(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t res) {
    if (!res) return;
#if HAS_D3D_InternalAddRef
    GUEST_CALL(D3D_InternalAddRef, ctx, {res});
#else
    (void)ctx;
    uint32_t common = R32(res);
    if (!(common & 0x780000) && (common & 0x70000) == 0x50000)
        if (uint32_t parent = R32(res + 0x14)) W32(parent, R32(parent) + 0x80000);
    W32(res, R32(res) + 0x80000);
#endif
}
void Release(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t res) {
    if (!res) return;
#if HAS_D3D_InternalRelease
    GUEST_CALL(D3D_InternalRelease, ctx, {res});
#else
    (void)ctx;
    // the library frees a resource nothing holds any more; without its function the memory stays
    auto drop = [](uint32_t r) {
        W32(r, R32(r) - 0x80000);
        if (!(R32(r) & 0x78FFFF)) LOG_FIRST(8, "d3d: resource %08X is not freed, the image has no D3D_InternalRelease", r);
    };
    uint32_t common = R32(res);
    if ((common & 0x780000) == 0x80000 && (common & 0x70000) == 0x50000)
        if (uint32_t parent = R32(res + 0x14)) drop(parent);
    drop(res);
#endif
}

void Walk(uint32_t end);

// Hardware commands a caller still pushes go to a scratch buffer, rewound at every request once Walk has read it
uint32_t ScratchPush(uint32_t bytes = 0) {
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));
    uint32_t need = std::max<uint32_t>(0x10000, (bytes + 0x1FFF) & ~0xFFFu);
    if (need > g_scratch_size) {
        if (g_scratch_push) mem::FreeContiguous(g_scratch_push);
        g_scratch_push = mem::AllocContiguous(need, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1000);
        g_scratch_size = need;
    }
    SetDev(kDevPush, g_scratch_push);
    SetDev(kDevThreshold, g_scratch_push + g_scratch_size - 0x1000);
    g_walk = g_scratch_push;
    return g_scratch_push;
}

gpu::Surface SurfaceOf(uint32_t header) {
    gpu::Surface s;
    s.header = header;
    if (header) {
        s.data = R32(header + 4);
        s.format = R32(header + 12);
        s.size = R32(header + 16);
    }
    return s;
}

uint32_t NewSurface(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t fmt, uint32_t bpp) {
    uint32_t pitch = (w * bpp + 63) & ~63u;
    uint32_t data = mem::AllocContiguous(pitch * h, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1000);
    uint32_t hdr = mem::AllocSystem(24);
    W32(hdr + 0, 0x000D0001);  // surface, one reference, one internal reference held by the device
    W32(hdr + 4, mem::PhysicalFromVirtual(data));
    W32(hdr + 8, 0);
    W32(hdr + 12, 0x00010021 | (fmt << 8));  // dma A, 2D, one level
    W32(hdr + 16, (w - 1) | (h - 1) << 12 | (pitch / 64 - 1) << 24);
    W32(hdr + 20, 0);
    return hdr;
}

void SyncDeferred() {
    // deferred states live in the title's memory, the inline SetRenderState and SetTextureStageState write them
    for (uint32_t i = gpu::kRsDeferredFirst; i < gpu::kRsComplexFirst; i++) g_state.rs[i] = R32(kRenderState + i * 4);
    for (int s = 0; s < 4; s++)
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < gpu::kTssBumpEnvMat00; i++) g_state.tss[s][i] = R32(kTextureState + (s * kStageStates + i) * 4);
}

float ZScale(const gpu::Surface& zs) {
    uint32_t f = zs.header ? (zs.format >> 8) & 0xFF : 0x2E;
    return f == 0x2C || f == 0x30 ? 65535.0f : 16777215.0f;
}

bool g_own_constants = false;  // D3DSCM_NORESERVEDCONSTANTS: c-38 and c-37 are the title's

// c-38 and c-37 hold the viewport scale and offset, as D3D_GetViewportOffsetAndScale computes them
void UpdateViewportConstants() {
    auto& v = g_state.viewport;
    g_state.zscale = ZScale(g_state.zs);
    float hw = v.w * 0.5f, hh = v.h * 0.5f;
    if (!g_own_constants) {
        g_state.vsc[58] = {hw, -hh, (v.max_z - v.min_z) * g_state.zscale, 0};
        g_state.vsc[59] = {v.x + g_state.ss_offset_x + hw, v.y + g_state.ss_offset_y + hh, v.min_z * g_state.zscale, 0};
    }
    // the viewport as the library's SetViewport stores it, for inlined readers
    if (XDK_CDevice_Viewport != xdk::kUnknown) {
        uint32_t p = kDevice + XDK_CDevice_Viewport;
        W32(p, v.x);
        W32(p + 4, v.y);
        W32(p + 8, v.w);
        W32(p + 12, v.h);
        std::memcpy(HostPtr(p + 16), &v.min_z, 4);
        std::memcpy(HostPtr(p + 20), &v.max_z, 4);
    }
}

void SetComplex(uint32_t rs, uint32_t v) {
    g_state.rs[rs] = v;
    W32(kRenderState + rs * 4, v);
}

// The library's default render and texture stage states; its pushes land in the scratch buffer
void ApplyDefaultStates(X86Context& ctx) {
#if HAS_D3D_InitDefaultState
    GUEST_CALL(D3D_InitDefaultState, ctx, {});
#else
    (void)ctx;
    LOG_FIRST(1, "d3d: the image has no D3D_InitDefaultState, default states were not applied");
#endif
}

constexpr bool kVBlank = XDK_CDevice_VBlankCount != xdk::kUnknown && XDK_CDevice_VBlankEvent != xdk::kUnknown &&
                         XDK_CDevice_VBlankCallback != xdk::kUnknown;

// what the library's vertical blank interrupt leaves for the title: count, event, callback
void VerticalBlank(X86Context& ctx) {
    using clock = std::chrono::steady_clock;
    uint32_t info = mem::AllocSystem(12), shown = 0;
    auto next = clock::now();
    for (;;) {
        next = std::max(next + std::chrono::microseconds(16667), clock::now());
        std::this_thread::sleep_until(next);
        uint32_t count = Dev(XDK_CDevice_VBlankCount) + 1, swaps = Dev(kDevSwapCount);
        SetDev(XDK_CDevice_VBlankCount, count);
        ObjectRef event = FromPointer(kDevice + XDK_CDevice_VBlankEvent);
        SetEvent(*event);
        if (uint32_t callback = Dev(XDK_CDevice_VBlankCallback)) {
            // blank count, swaps shown, 1 when this blank showed one
            W32(info, count);
            W32(info + 4, swaps);
            W32(info + 8, swaps != shown);
            CallGuest(ctx, callback, {info});
        }
        shown = swaps;
        // the title clears the event in its own memory before a wait, which the host object does not see
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1));
        ResetEvent(*event);
    }
}

gpu::State& State() { return g_state; }
std::recursive_mutex& Lock() { return g_lock; }

}  // namespace d3d

// device

HLE_STDCALL(Direct3D_CreateDevice, 6) {
    XDK_REQUIRE("d3d", XDK_DATA(D3D_Device), XDK_DATA(D3D_pDevice), XDK_DATA(D3D_DirtyFlags),
                XDK_DATA(D3D_DeferredTextureState), XDK_DATA(D3D_RenderState), XDK_DATA(D3D_Streams),
                XDK_DATA(D3D_SimpleRenderStateEncode));
    XDK_REQUIRE("d3d", XDK_KEY(CDevice_Push), XDK_KEY(CDevice_PushThreshold), XDK_KEY(CDevice_BaseVertex),
                XDK_KEY(CDevice_IndexBuffer), XDK_KEY(CDevice_ZScale), XDK_KEY(CDevice_SuperSampleX),
                XDK_KEY(CDevice_SuperSampleY), XDK_KEY(CDevice_Transforms), XDK_KEY(CDevice_Textures),
                XDK_KEY(CDevice_RenderTarget), XDK_KEY(CDevice_Depth), XDK_KEY(CDevice_BackBuffer),
                XDK_KEY(CDevice_FrontBuffer), XDK_KEY(CDevice_SwapCount), XDK_KEY(CDevice_Size),
                XDK_KEY(DirtyFlags_Texture), XDK_KEY(TextureState_Stage), XDK_KEY(Stream_Size),
                XDK_KEY(Stream_Stride), XDK_KEY(Stream_Buffer));
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t pp = a[4];  // D3DPRESENT_PARAMETERS
    uint32_t w = R32(pp), h = R32(pp + 4), fmt = R32(pp + 8), count = std::max<uint32_t>(R32(pp + 12), 1);
    uint32_t auto_depth = R32(pp + 0x20), depth_fmt = R32(pp + 0x24), interval = R32(pp + 0x30);
    if (!w) w = 640;
    if (!h) h = 480;
    LOGI("d3d: CreateDevice %ux%u format %X buffers %u depth %u format %X interval %X flags %X", w, h, fmt, count,
         auto_depth, depth_fmt, interval, R32(pp + 0x28));
    std::memset(HostPtr(kDevice), 0, XDK_CDevice_Size);
    W32(kDevicePtr, kDevice);
    ScratchPush();

    uint32_t color_fmt = gpu::LinearColorFormat(fmt);
    g_buffer_count = std::min<uint32_t>(count + 1, 3);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_buffer_count; i++) g_buffers[i] = NewSurface(w, h, color_fmt, 4);
    g_depth = 0;
    if (auto_depth) {
        uint32_t zf = gpu::LinearDepthFormat(depth_fmt);
        g_depth = NewSurface(w, h, zf, zf == 0x30 || zf == 0x31 ? 2 : 4);  // 0x30 LIN_D16, 0x31 LIN_F16
    }
    if (!g_backend) {
        g_backend = gpu::CreateBackend();
        if (!g_backend->Init(w, h)) LOGE("d3d: renderer init failed");
        if (kRenderThread) g_backend = gpu::CreateThreadedBackend(std::move(g_backend));
    }
    g_state = gpu::State{};
    g_state.viewport = {0, 0, w, h, 0.0f, 1.0f};
    SetDev(kDevRenderTarget, g_buffers[1]);
    SetDev(kDevDepth, g_depth);
    SetDev(kDevBackBuffer, g_buffers[1]);
    SetDev(kDevFrontBuffer, g_buffers[1]);
    float one = 1.0f, zs = g_depth && (R32(g_depth + 12) >> 8 & 0xFF) == 0x30 ? 65535.0f : 16777215.0f;
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + kDevSuperX), &one, 4);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + kDevSuperY), &one, 4);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + kDevZScale), &zs, 4);
    // fields the library's init sets that inlined library code and the default states read
    if (XDK_CDevice_AutoDepth != xdk::kUnknown) SetDev(XDK_CDevice_AutoDepth, g_depth);
    if (XDK_CDevice_BackBufferScale != xdk::kUnknown) {
        std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + XDK_CDevice_BackBufferScale), &one, 4);
        std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + XDK_CDevice_BackBufferScale + 4), &one, 4);
    }
    // 60 Hz, widescreen
    if (XDK_CDevice_DisplayFlags != xdk::kUnknown) SetDev(XDK_CDevice_DisplayFlags, 0x400000 | (app::Widescreen() ? 0x10000 : 0));
#if HAS_D3D_FvfShader
    if (XDK_CDevice_VertexShader != xdk::kUnknown) SetDev(XDK_CDevice_VertexShader, SYM(D3D_FvfShader));
#endif
    if (kVBlank) {
        // notification event, signalled
        SetDev(XDK_CDevice_VBlankEvent, 0x00040000);
        SetDev(XDK_CDevice_VBlankEvent + 4, 1);
        static bool started = false;
        if (!started) StartHostThread("vertical blank", VerticalBlank);
        started = true;
    }
    g_state.rt = SurfaceOf(g_buffers[1]);
    g_state.zs = SurfaceOf(g_depth);
    UpdateViewportConstants();
    ApplyDefaultStates(ctx);
    if (a[5]) W32(a[5], kDevice);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_Release, 0) { return 1; }

// synchronisation, the renderer never runs behind

HLE_STDCALL(D3D_BlockOnResource, 1) {
    uint32_t res = a[0];
    if (res && g_backend) {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
        uint32_t type = R32(res) & 0x70000;  // 0x40000 texture, 0x50000 surface
        if (type == 0x40000 || type == 0x50000) {
            uint32_t data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(res + 4));
            // perf diagnostic: who blocks on which surface, once each
            static std::unordered_set<uint32_t> seen;
            if (diag::Perf() && seen.insert(data).second) {
                uint32_t code[4] = {}, n = 0;
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32 && n < 4; i++) {
                    uint32_t v = R32(ctx.esp + i * 4);
                    if (v >= X86CodeBase && v < X86CodeEnd) code[n++] = v;
                }
                LOGI("d3d: BlockOnResource on surface %08X, stack %08X %08X %08X %08X", data, code[0], code[1], code[2], code[3]);
            }
            g_backend->Sync(data, 0);
        } else {
            g_backend->WaitResource(res);
        }
    }
    gpu::MarkDirty(res);
    return 0;
}
// lock(resource, face, level, locked, rect, flags): D3DLOCK_NOOVERWRITE skips the block above, yet a
// title may read what the GPU drew
HLE_WRAP(Lock2DSurface, 6) {
    uint32_t res = a[0];
    if ((a[5] & 0x20) && res && g_backend) {  // D3DLOCK_NOOVERWRITE
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
        g_backend->SyncLate(mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(res + 4)));
    }
}
HLE_STDCALL(D3DResource_BlockUntilNotBusy, 1) {
    if (a[0] && g_backend) {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
        g_backend->WaitResource(a[0]);
    }
    gpu::MarkDirty(a[0]);
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(D3DResource_IsBusy, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t res = a[0];
    if (!res) return 0;
    // set on the device, a surface also through its texture
    uint32_t common = R32(res), parent = (common & 0x70000) == 0x50000 ? R32(res + 0x14) : 0;
    if ((common & 0x780000) || (parent && (R32(parent) & 0x780000))) return 1;  // internal reference count
    return g_backend && g_backend->Busy(res) ? 1 : 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(D3D_BlockOnTime, 2) { return 0; }
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_BlockOnFence, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    if (g_backend) g_backend->WaitFence(a[0]);
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_InsertFence, 0) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    return g_backend ? g_backend->Fence() : 0;
}

    return g_backend && g_backend->FencePending(a[0]) ? 1 : 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(D3D_SetFence, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    return g_backend ? g_backend->Fence() : 0;
}

    return 0;

// the front buffer, read back at the guest size, is kept for the next instance after a quick reboot, which may
// fade from it at its first frames
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_PersistDisplay, 0) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t front = g_buffers[0], size = R32(front + 0x10);
    uint32_t pitch = ((size >> 24 & 0xFF) + 1) * 64, height = (size >> 12 & 0xFFF) + 1, bytes = pitch * height;
    uint32_t data = mem::VirtualFromPhysical(R32(front + 4));
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Sync(data, bytes);
    kernel::SavePersistedDisplay(R32(front), R32(front + 0xC), size, HostPtr(data), bytes);
    LOGI("d3d: PersistDisplay, %u bytes", bytes);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetGammaRamp, 2) {
    uint8_t ramp[768];
    std::memcpy(ramp, HostPtr(a[1]), 768);
    if (g_backend) g_backend->SetGamma(ramp);
    return 0;
}

// targets and presentation

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetRenderTarget, 2) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t rt = a[0] ? a[0] : Dev(kDevRenderTarget), zs = a[1];
    AddRef(ctx, rt);
    uint32_t old_rt = Dev(kDevRenderTarget), old_zs = Dev(kDevDepth);
    SetDev(kDevRenderTarget, rt);
    SetDev(kDevDepth, zs);
    AddRef(ctx, zs);
    Release(ctx, old_rt);
    Release(ctx, old_zs);
    g_state.rt = SurfaceOf(rt);
    g_state.zs = SurfaceOf(zs);
    // SetRenderTarget resets the viewport to the whole target
    uint32_t w, h;
    gpu::SurfaceSize(g_state.rt, w, h);
    g_state.viewport = {0, 0, w, h, 0.0f, 1.0f};
    UpdateViewportConstants();
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_GetBackBuffer2, 1) {
    int32_t i = int32_t(a[0]);
    uint32_t s = i < 0 ? g_buffers[0] : g_buffers[std::min<uint32_t>(uint32_t(i) + 1, g_buffer_count - 1)];
    W32(s, R32(s) + 1);
    return s;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_GetRenderTarget2, 0) {
    uint32_t s = Dev(kDevRenderTarget);
    if (s) W32(s, R32(s) + 1);
    return s;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_GetDepthStencilSurface2, 0) {
    uint32_t s = Dev(kDevDepth);
    if (s) W32(s, R32(s) + 1);
    return s;
}

namespace {
std::atomic<uint32_t> g_presents{0};
}  // namespace

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_Swap, 1) {
    app::SplashFirstFrame();
    // handed over from the previous instance: the window opens on the second frame, the first picture with
    // anything drawn over it right after
    if (app::HandingOver() && g_presents >= 2) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
            if (g_backend) g_backend->Flush();
        }
        app::FinishHandover();
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    g_presents++;
    // the kept display is shown until the title presents its own
    kernel::SetSavedDataAddress(0);
    // the ramp an inlined SetGammaRamp left for the vertical blank that shows this swap
    if (g_backend && XDK_CDevice_GammaPending != xdk::kUnknown && XDK_CDevice_GammaRamps != xdk::kUnknown) {
        uint32_t i = Dev(kDevSwapCount) & 1;
        if (Dev(XDK_CDevice_GammaPending + i * 4) == 1) {
            SetDev(XDK_CDevice_GammaPending + i * 4, 0);
            g_backend->SetGamma(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(kDevice + XDK_CDevice_GammaRamps + i * 0x300)));
        }
    }
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));  // reports asked for at the end of the frame
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Present(SurfaceOf(g_buffers[1]));
    app::Pace();
    // like the XDK, the surfaces stay put and their memory rotates: titles keep back buffer pointers and copy its data
    uint32_t last = g_buffers[g_buffer_count - 1], data = R32(last + 4), lk = R32(last + 8);
    for (uint32_t i = g_buffer_count - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        W32(g_buffers[i] + 4, R32(g_buffers[i - 1] + 4));
        W32(g_buffers[i] + 8, R32(g_buffers[i - 1] + 8));
    }
    W32(g_buffers[0] + 4, data);
    W32(g_buffers[0] + 8, lk);
    g_state.rt = SurfaceOf(Dev(kDevRenderTarget));
    uint32_t n = Dev(kDevSwapCount) + 1;
    SetDev(kDevSwapCount, n);
    return n;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_Clear, 6) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    const uint8_t* rects = a[0] && a[1] ? static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(a[1])) : nullptr;
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Clear(g_state, a[0], rects, a[2], a[3], ArgF(a, 4), a[5]);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_CopyRects, 5) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Copy(SurfaceOf(a[0]), SurfaceOf(a[3]), a[2], a[1], a[4]);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetViewport, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t v = a[0];
    g_state.viewport = {R32(v), R32(v + 4), R32(v + 8), R32(v + 12), GF(v + 16), GF(v + 20)};
    g_state.scissor_count = 0;
    UpdateViewportConstants();
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetScissors, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    g_state.scissor_count = std::min<uint32_t>(a[0], 8);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_state.scissor_count * 4; i++) g_state.scissors[i] = R32(a[2] + i * 4);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetScreenSpaceOffset, 2) {
    g_state.ss_offset_x = ArgF(a, 0);
    g_state.ss_offset_y = ArgF(a, 1);
    UpdateViewportConstants();
    return 0;
}

// render states

HLE_FASTCALL(D3DDevice_SetRenderState_Simple, 0) {
    uint32_t method = a[0] & 0x1FFC, value = a[1];
    g_state.simple[method >> 2] = value;
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetRenderStateNotInline, 2) {
    uint32_t rs = a[0], v = a[1];
    if (rs < gpu::kRsDeferredFirst) {
        uint32_t method = R32(kSimpleEncode + rs * 4) & 0x1FFC;
        g_state.simple[method >> 2] = v;
        W32(kRenderState + rs * 4, v);  // titles read their states back from the library's table
    } else if (rs < gpu::kRsMax) {
        SetComplex(rs, v);
    }
    return 0;
}

#define COMPLEX_STATE(name, rs)                       \
    HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetRenderState_##name, 1) { \
        SetComplex(rs, a[0]);                         \
        return 0;                                     \
    }

COMPLEX_STATE(VertexBlend, gpu::kRsVertexBlend)

COMPLEX_STATE(BackFillMode, gpu::kRsBackFillMode)

COMPLEX_STATE(NormalizeNormals, gpu::kRsNormalizeNormals)
COMPLEX_STATE(ZEnable, gpu::kRsZEnable)
COMPLEX_STATE(StencilEnable, gpu::kRsStencilEnable)
COMPLEX_STATE(StencilFail, gpu::kRsStencilFail)
COMPLEX_STATE(FrontFace, gpu::kRsFrontFace)
COMPLEX_STATE(CullMode, gpu::kRsCullMode)
COMPLEX_STATE(TextureFactor, gpu::kRsTextureFactor)
COMPLEX_STATE(LogicOp, gpu::kRsLogicOp)
COMPLEX_STATE(EdgeAntiAlias, gpu::kRsEdgeAntiAlias)
COMPLEX_STATE(MultiSampleAntiAlias, gpu::kRsMultiSampleAntiAlias)

// the XDK's transform types: view 0, projection 1, texture 2-5, world 6-9; the renderer keeps Direct3D 8's numbers
// (view 2, projection 3, texture 16, world 256). The device copy is what GetTransform reads.
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetTransform, 2) {
    uint32_t t = a[0];
    if (t >= 10) return 0;
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(kDevice + kDevTransforms + t * 64), HostPtr(a[1]), 64);
    uint32_t pc = t < 2 ? t + 2 : t < 6 ? t + 14 : t + 250;
    std::memcpy(g_state.transforms[pc].data(), HostPtr(a[1]), 64);
    return 0;
}

    return 0;
}

        std::memcpy(g_state.lights[i].data(), HostPtr(l), 26 * 4);
    }
}

    if (i < 8) {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
        g_state.light_enable = on ? g_state.light_enable | 1u << i : g_state.light_enable & ~(1u << i);
    }
}

// SwitchTexture(method, data, format), fastcall: a swizzled texture of the bound one's shape replaces it. It is
// bound through a header of the stage's own holding the bound texture's fields with the new data and format.
HLE_FASTCALL(D3DDevice_SwitchTexture, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    static uint32_t headers[4];
    // texture methods from 0x1B00, 0x40 per stage
    uint32_t stage = (((a[0] & 0x1FFC) - 0x1B00) >> 6) & 3, cur = g_state.textures[stage];
    uint32_t& h = headers[stage];
    if (!h) h = mem::AllocSystem(20);
    if (cur && cur != h) std::memcpy(HostPtr(h), HostPtr(cur), 20);
    W32(h + 4, a[1]);
    W32(h + 12, a[2]);
    g_state.textures[stage] = h;
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetStreamSource, 3) {

    uint32_t old = R32(kStreams + n * kStreamSize + XDK_Stream_Buffer);
    AddRef(ctx, vb);
    W32(kStreams + n * kStreamSize + XDK_Stream_Stride, stride);
    W32(kStreams + n * kStreamSize + XDK_Stream_Buffer, vb);
    Release(ctx, old);
    g_state.streams[n] = {vb, stride};
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetIndices, 2) {

    Release(ctx, old);

    g_state.base_vertex = a[1];
    return 0;
}

// shaders

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_CreateVertexShader, 4) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t decl = a[0], func = a[1], out = a[2];
    auto vs = std::make_shared<gpu::VertexShader>();
    if (decl) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
            uint32_t t = R32(decl + i * 4);
            vs->decl.push_back(t);
            if (t == 0xFFFFFFFF) break;
        }
    }
    if (func) {
        uint32_t hdr = R32(func);
        vs->program_type = hdr & 0xFFFF;
        uint32_t n = hdr >> 16;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n * 4; i++) vs->program.push_back(R32(func + 4 + i * 4));
    }
    gpu::ParseDeclaration(*vs);
    uint32_t rec = mem::AllocSystem(16, 16);
    vs->handle = rec | 1;
    g_vs[vs->handle] = vs;
    W32(out, vs->handle);
    LOG_FIRST(64, "d3d: vertex shader %08X, %zu decl tokens, %zu instructions, type %X", vs->handle, vs->decl.size(),
              vs->program.size() / 4, vs->program_type);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_DeleteVertexShader, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_vs.find(a[0]);
    if (it != g_vs.end()) {
        mem::FreeSystem(a[0] & ~1u);
        g_vs.erase(it);
    }
    return 0;
}

// (handle, data, size in and out): the program as it was given, the size alone without data or room
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_GetVertexShaderFunction, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_vs.find(a[0]);
    uint32_t words = it == g_vs.end() ? 0 : uint32_t(it->second->program.size());
    uint32_t need = words ? 4 + words * 4 : 0, room = R32(a[2]);
    W32(a[2], need);
    if (need > room) return a[1] ? 0x88760867 : 0;  // D3DERR_MOREDATA
    if (!a[1] || !need) return 0;
    W32(a[1], it->second->program_type | words / 4 << 16);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < words; i++) W32(a[1] + 4 + i * 4, it->second->program[i]);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetVertexShader, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t h = a[0];
    g_state.vs_handle = h;
    g_state.vs = nullptr;
    if (h & 1) {
        auto it = g_vs.find(h);
        if (it != g_vs.end()) {
            g_state.vs = it->second;
            // constants declared with the shader load when it is selected
            for (auto& [reg, v] : it->second->constants)
                if (reg < 192) g_state.vsc[reg] = v;
        } else {
            LOG_FIRST(8, "d3d: SetVertexShader with unknown handle %08X", h);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_CreatePixelShader, 2) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto ps = std::make_shared<gpu::PixelShader>();
    std::memcpy(ps->def, HostPtr(a[0]), sizeof(ps->def));
    uint32_t rec = mem::AllocSystem(16, 16);
    ps->handle = rec;
    g_ps[rec] = ps;
    W32(a[1], rec);
    return 0;

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_DeletePixelShader, 1) {

    if (g_ps.erase(a[0])) mem::FreeSystem(a[0]);
    return 0;

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetPixelShader, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    g_state.ps = nullptr;
    if (!a[0]) return 0;
    auto it = g_ps.find(a[0]);
    if (it != g_ps.end()) {
        g_state.ps = it->second;
    } else if (XDK_PixelShader_Definition != xdk::kUnknown) {
        // made by library code the title inlined: the object points at its definition, handles are reused
        static std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::shared_ptr<gpu::PixelShader>> made;
        const void* def = HostPtr(R32(a[0] + XDK_PixelShader_Definition));
        auto& ps = made[a[0]];
        if (!ps || std::memcmp(ps->def, def, sizeof(ps->def))) {
            ps = std::make_shared<gpu::PixelShader>();
            ps->handle = a[0];
            std::memcpy(ps->def, def, sizeof(ps->def));
        }
        g_state.ps = ps;
    } else {
        LOG_FIRST(8, "d3d: SetPixelShader with unknown handle %08X", a[0]);
        return 0;
    }
    // the definition loads the combiner state like the XDK pushes it
    const uint32_t* d = g_state.ps->def;
    auto put = [&](uint32_t method, uint32_t v) { g_state.simple[method >> 2] = v; };
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        put(gpu::kMPsAlphaInputs + i * 4, d[0 + i]);
        put(gpu::kMPsConstant0 + i * 4, d[10 + i]);
        put(gpu::kMPsConstant1 + i * 4, d[18 + i]);
        put(gpu::kMPsAlphaOutputs + i * 4, d[26 + i]);
        put(gpu::kMPsRgbInputs + i * 4, d[34 + i]);
        put(gpu::kMPsRgbOutputs + i * 4, d[45 + i]);
    }
    put(gpu::kMPsFinalAbcd, d[8]);
    put(gpu::kMPsFinalEfgh, d[9]);
    put(gpu::kMPsCompareMode, d[42]);
    put(gpu::kMPsFinalConstant0, d[43]);
    put(gpu::kMPsFinalConstant1, d[44]);
    put(gpu::kMPsCombinerCount, d[53]);
    put(gpu::kMPsDotMapping, d[55]);
    put(gpu::kMPsInputTexture, d[56]);
    SetComplex(gpu::kRsPsTextureModes, d[54]);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetPixelShaderConstant, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t reg = a[0], src = a[1], n = a[2];
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && reg + i < 16; i++) std::memcpy(g_state.psc[reg + i].data(), HostPtr(src + i * 16), 16);
    gpu::ApplyPixelConstants(g_state, reg, n);
    return 0;
}

// drawing

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_DrawVertices, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));  // a visibility test begun since the last draw counts this one
    SyncDeferred();
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Draw(g_state, a[0], a[1], a[2], nullptr);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_DrawIndexedVertices, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));
    SyncDeferred();
    const uint8_t* indices = a[2] ? static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(a[2])) : nullptr;
    if (g_backend) g_backend->Draw(g_state, a[0], 0, a[1], indices);
    return 0;
}

// DrawVerticesUP(prim, count, vertices, stride): the vertices are copied to a ring the render thread reads, stream 0
// points there through a vertex buffer header for the draw. A half of the ring is written again once the draws
// that read it are done.
namespace {
constexpr uint32_t kUpRing = 4u << 20, kUpHalf = kUpRing / 2;
uint32_t g_up_ring = 0, g_up_pos = 0, g_up_header = 0, g_up_fence[2] = {};

uint32_t UpVertices(const void* src, uint32_t bytes) {
    if (!g_up_ring) {
        g_up_ring = mem::AllocContiguous(kUpRing, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 0x1000);
        g_up_header = mem::AllocSystem(20);
        std::memset(HostPtr(g_up_header), 0, 20);
        W32(g_up_header, 1);  // a vertex buffer, one reference
    }
    bytes = std::min(bytes, kUpHalf);
    uint32_t room = (bytes + 63) & ~63u;
    uint32_t pos = g_up_pos + room > kUpRing ? 0 : g_up_pos;
    uint32_t from = g_up_pos ? (g_up_pos - 1) / kUpHalf : 1, to = (pos + room - 1) / kUpHalf;
    if (to != from) {
        g_up_fence[from] = g_backend->Fence();
        g_backend->WaitFence(g_up_fence[to]);
    }
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(g_up_ring + pos), src, bytes);
    g_up_pos = pos + room;
    W32(g_up_header + 4, mem::PhysicalFromVirtual(g_up_ring + pos));
    return g_up_header;
}

void DrawUp(uint32_t prim, uint32_t count, const void* vertices, uint32_t stride) {
    if (!g_backend || !count || !stride) return;
    SyncDeferred();
    auto stream = g_state.streams[0];
    g_state.streams[0] = {UpVertices(vertices, count * stride), stride};
    g_backend->Draw(g_state, prim, 0, count, nullptr);
    g_state.streams[0] = stream;
}

// bytes per vertex of the bound format: stream 0 of the FVF or of the shader's declaration
uint32_t VertexBytes() {
    if (g_state.vs_handle & 1) return g_state.vs ? g_state.vs->stream_stride[0] : 0;
    gpu::VertexShader fvf;
    gpu::FvfInputs(g_state.vs_handle, fvf);
    return fvf.stream_stride[0];
}

uint32_t g_push_begin = 0;
}  // namespace

// Begin/End immediate mode. Titles inline Begin and the vertex data calls, so their commands are read from the scratch buffer.
namespace d3d {
namespace {
uint32_t g_im_prim = 0, g_im_mask = 0;  // open primitive, slots it wrote
float g_im_attr[64];                    // 16 slots of x y z w
std::vector<float> g_im_vertices;       // every slot per vertex

// visibility tests: depth passing pixels are counted while enabled, a report gets the count since the clear,
// at a physical address in the first 16 MB
void ApplyVisibilityMethod(uint32_t m, uint32_t v) {
    constexpr uint32_t kReportAddressMask = 0xFFFFFF;
    if (m == gpu::kMCountEnable) g_state.simple[gpu::kMCountEnable >> 2] = v;
    if (!g_backend) return;
    if (m == gpu::kMClearReport) g_backend->ClearReport();
    if (m == gpu::kMGetReport) g_backend->GetReport(mem::VirtualFromPhysical(v & kReportAddressMask));
}

// draws the open primitive: the slots it wrote are FLOAT4 inputs of the bound program, or of the fixed pipeline
void EndPrimitive() {
    struct Made {
        std::shared_ptr<gpu::VertexShader> from, vs;
    };
    // the render thread tells shaders apart by pointer: one object per program and slot set, the program kept alive
    static std::map<std::pair<gpu::VertexShader*, uint32_t>, Made> made;
    static std::vector<float> packed;
    uint32_t prim = g_im_prim, count = uint32_t(g_im_vertices.size() / 64), handle = g_state.vs_handle;
    g_im_prim = 0;
    if (!prim || !count) return;
    if (!(handle & 1) && (handle & 0xE) == 4) LOG_FIRST(1, "d3d: pretransformed immediate mode vertices are not supported");
    auto bound = g_state.vs, from = handle & 1 ? bound : nullptr;
    Made& m = made[{from.get(), g_im_mask}];
    if (!m.vs) {
        m.from = from;
        m.vs = std::make_shared<gpu::VertexShader>();
        if (from) {
            m.vs->program = from->program;
            m.vs->program_type = from->program_type;
        }
        for (uint32_t s = 0; s < 16; s++)
            if (g_im_mask >> s & 1) {
                m.vs->inputs[s] = {0, m.vs->stream_stride[0], 0x42};
                m.vs->stream_stride[0] += 16;
            }
    }
    packed.clear();
    for (uint32_t v = 0; v < count; v++)
        for (uint32_t s = 0; s < 16; s++)
            if (g_im_mask >> s & 1) packed.insert(packed.end(), &g_im_vertices[v * 64 + s * 4], &g_im_vertices[v * 64 + s * 4] + 4);
    g_state.vs = m.vs;
    g_state.vs_handle = handle | 1;
    DrawUp(prim, count, packed.data(), m.vs->stream_stride[0]);
    g_state.vs = bound;
    g_state.vs_handle = handle;
}

// reads the commands pushed since the last call: vertex data between a begin and an end is drawn, visibility tests
// are run, the rest is skipped
void Walk(uint32_t end) {
    if (!g_walk || end < g_walk || end > g_scratch_push + g_scratch_size) return;
    for (uint32_t p = g_walk; p + 4 <= end;) {
        // count in bits 18 to 28, bit 30 keeps the method for every value
        uint32_t head = R32(p), method = head & 0x1FFC, n = (head >> 18) & 0x7FF;
        p += 4;
        if ((head & 0xA0030003) || n * 4 > end - p) break;  // anything but a method header
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++, p += 4) {
            uint32_t m = head & 0x40000000 ? method : method + i * 4, v = R32(p);
            float f, *a = g_im_attr;
            bool last = true;  // the slot's last component
            std::memcpy(&f, &v, 4);
            ApplyVisibilityMethod(m, v);
            if (m == 0x17FC) {  // begin/end, 0 ends
                if (v) {
                    g_im_prim = v;
                    g_im_mask = 0;
                    g_im_vertices.clear();
                } else {
                    EndPrimitive();
                }
                continue;
            } else if (m >= 0x1880 && m < 0x1900) {  // 2 floats, z = 0 and w = 1
                a += (m - 0x1880) / 8 * 4;
                last = (m - 0x1880) / 4 & 1;
                a[last] = f;
                a[2] = 0;
                a[3] = 1;
            } else if (m >= 0x1940 && m < 0x1980) {  // 4 bytes
                a += (m - 0x1940) / 4 * 4;
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) a[c] = (v >> c * 8 & 0xFF) / 255.0f;
            } else if (m >= 0x1A00 && m < 0x1B00) {  // 4 floats
                a += (m - 0x1A00) / 16 * 4;
                last = ((m - 0x1A00) / 4 & 3) == 3;
                a[(m - 0x1A00) / 4 & 3] = f;
            } else if (m >= 0x1500 && m < 0x150C) {  // position, 3 floats and w = 1
                last = m == 0x1508;
                a[(m - 0x1500) / 4] = f;
                a[3] = 1;
            } else if (m >= 0x1518 && m < 0x1528) {  // position, 4 floats
                last = m == 0x1524;
                a[(m - 0x1518) / 4] = f;
            } else {
                continue;
            }
            if (!g_im_prim) continue;
            g_im_mask |= 1u << (a - g_im_attr) / 4;
            if (a == g_im_attr && last) g_im_vertices.insert(g_im_vertices.end(), g_im_attr, g_im_attr + 64);
        }
    }
    g_walk = end;
}
}  // namespace
}  // namespace d3d

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_DrawVerticesUP, 4) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));
    DrawUp(a[0], a[1], HostPtr(a[2]), a[3]);
    return 0;
}

// BeginPush(dwords) hands out room for raw hardware commands, EndPush(end) runs what the title wrote there:
// a primitive between two begin/end writes with its vertices inline, any other method as a simple state.
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_BeginPush, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    g_push_begin = ScratchPush(a[0] * 4);
    return g_push_begin;
}

HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_EndPush, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    constexpr uint32_t kBeginEnd = 0x17FC, kInlineArray = 0x1818;
    static std::vector<uint32_t> vertices;
    uint32_t prim = 0;
    for (uint32_t p = g_push_begin, end = a[0]; g_push_begin && p + 4 <= end;) {
        // count in bits 18 to 28, bit 30 keeps the method for every value
        uint32_t head = R32(p), method = head & 0x1FFC, n = (head >> 18) & 0x7FF;
        p += 4;
        if ((head & 0xA0030003) || n * 4 > end - p) {  // anything but a method header
            LOG_FIRST(8, "d3d: EndPush stops at command %08X, %u bytes before the end", head, end - p);
            break;
        }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++, p += 4) {
            uint32_t m = head & 0x40000000 ? method : method + i * 4, v = R32(p);
            ApplyVisibilityMethod(m, v);
            if (m == kInlineArray) {
                if (prim) vertices.push_back(v);
            } else if (m != kBeginEnd) {
                if (m >> 2 < g_state.simple.size()) g_state.simple[m >> 2] = v;
            } else if (v) {
                prim = v;
                vertices.clear();
            } else if (prim) {
                uint32_t stride = VertexBytes(), bytes = uint32_t(vertices.size()) * 4;
                if (stride && bytes % stride == 0) DrawUp(prim, bytes / stride, vertices.data(), stride);
                else LOG_FIRST(8, "d3d: EndPush primitive %u dropped, %u bytes of vertices of %u", prim, bytes, stride);
                prim = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    g_push_begin = 0;
    ScratchPush();
    return a[0];
}

// frame buffer compression tiles are the console's memory controller's business
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_SetTile, 2) { return 0; }

// the library's Begin pushes the start of the primitive, here it is opened
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_Begin, 1) {
    XDK_REQUIRE("d3d", XDK_KEY(CDevice_Flags));
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));
    g_im_prim = a[0];
    g_im_mask = 0;
    g_im_vertices.clear();
    SetDev(XDK_CDevice_Flags, Dev(XDK_CDevice_Flags) | 0x800);
    return 0;
}
// the library's End pushes the end of the primitive, here it is drawn
HLE_STDCALL(D3DDevice_End, 0) {
    XDK_REQUIRE("d3d", XDK_KEY(CDevice_Flags));
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Walk(Dev(kDevPush));
    EndPrimitive();
    SetDev(XDK_CDevice_Flags, Dev(XDK_CDevice_Flags) & ~0x1800u);
    return 0;
}
```

```cpp
// DirectSound (XDK 5849) on a host software mixer. Buffers and streams are read from guest memory as they play.
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>

#include <vector>

#include "audio/audio.h"

using namespace kernel;

extern const xbe::Image* g_image;

namespace dispatch {
X86Func* Find(uint32_t guest);
}

// configs written before the SDK knew the name
#ifndef SYM_IDirectSound_SynchPlayback

namespace {

constexpr uint32_t kStreamVtable = SYM(DSound_StreamVtable);  // CDirectSoundStream XMediaObject vtable
constexpr uint32_t kStreamVtable2 = SYM(DSound_StreamVtable2);
constexpr uint32_t kPacketPending = 0x8000000A, kFlushed = 0x80004004;  // E_PENDING, E_ABORT

struct Packet {
    uint32_t data, size, completed_ptr, status_ptr, context;
    uint32_t used = 0;
};

struct Voice {
    uint32_t obj = 0;
    bool stream = false;
    int refs = 1;
    // format
    uint16_t tag = 1, channels = 1, bits = 16, align = 2;
    uint32_t rate = 48000;
    // buffer
    // play region in bytes from data, loop region in bytes from the play region
    uint32_t data = 0, bytes = 0, loop_start = 0, loop_len = 0, play_start = 0, play_len = 0;
    uint32_t owned = 0;  // memory the library made for the buffer
    bool playing = false, looping = false, paused = false;
    bool sync = false;  // held until IDirectSound_SynchPlayback
    bool active = false, ending = false;  // stream: took a packet since it went quiet, quiet again once they run out
    double pos = 0;  // frames
    uint32_t freq = 0;
    // stream
    uint32_t max_packets = 1, callback = 0, context = 0;
    std::deque<Packet> packets;
    // levels
    float volume = 1, headroom = 1;
    uint8_t nbins = 0, bin[8] = {};
    int32_t bin_mb[32] = {};  // by mix bin
    std::vector<float> curve;  // rolloff
    bool is3d = false;
    uint32_t mode = 0;  // DS3DMODE: 1 head relative, 2 disabled
    float p[3] = {}, min_dist = 1, max_dist = 1e9f;
    // ADPCM block cache
    int64_t block = -1;
    int16_t decoded[65 * 8];
};

struct Done {
    uint32_t voice, callback, context, packet_context, status;
};

std::recursive_mutex g_lock;
std::map<uint32_t, Voice> g_voices;
float g_listener[3] = {}, g_front[3] = {0, 0, 1}, g_top[3] = {0, 1, 0};
// Completed packets' callbacks, run as the XDK runs them: in DirectSoundDoWork on the title's thread, so they never
// overlap the title's own stream code. A stream flushed or released runs its own at once, before it is gone.
std::deque<Done> g_done;
std::condition_variable_any g_done_cv;
thread_local std::vector<Done> t_flushed;  // run by the STREAM call that flushed them, once g_lock is let go
std::atomic<int64_t> g_pumped{0};          // the last DirectSoundDoWork, steady ms
bool g_started = false;
uint32_t g_ds = 0;

float Db(int32_t hundredths) { return hundredths <= -10000 ? 0.0f : std::pow(10.0f, hundredths / 2000.0f); }

uint32_t FramesOf(const Voice& v, uint32_t bytes) {
    if (v.tag == 0x69) return bytes / (36u * v.channels) * 64;  // WAVE_FORMAT_XBOX_ADPCM
    return bytes / std::max<uint32_t>(v.align, 1);
}
uint32_t BytesOf(const Voice& v, uint32_t frames) {
    if (v.tag == 0x69) return frames / 64 * 36 * v.channels;
    return frames * v.align;
}

const int kIndex[16] = {-1, -1, -1, -1, 2, 4, 6, 8, -1, -1, -1, -1, 2, 4, 6, 8};
const int kStep[89] = {7,     8,     9,     10,    11,    12,    13,    14,    16,    17,    19,    21,    23,    25,    28,
                       31,    34,    37,    41,    45,    50,    55,    60,    66,    73,    80,    88,    97,    107,   118,
                       130,   143,   157,   173,   190,   209,   230,   253,   279,   307,   337,   371,   408,   449,   494,
                       544,   598,   658,   724,   796,   876,   963,   1060,  1166,  1282,  1411,  1552,  1707,  1878,  2066,
                       2272,  2499,  2749,  3024,  3327,  3660,  4026,  4428,  4871,  5358,  5894,  6484,  7132,  7845,  8630,
                       9493,  10442, 11487, 12635, 13899, 15289, 16818, 18500, 20350, 22385, 24623, 27086, 29794, 32767};

// one 36 byte per channel IMA block, the voice plays 64 of its 65 frames
void DecodeBlock(const uint8_t* b, int ch, int16_t* out) {
    for (int c = 0; c < ch; c++) {
        int pred = int16_t(b[c * 4] | b[c * 4 + 1] << 8), idx = std::min<int>(b[c * 4 + 2], 88);
        out[c] = int16_t(pred);
        const uint8_t* d = b + ch * 4;
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
                int n = (d[(k * ch + c) * 4 + j / 2] >> ((j & 1) * 4)) & 15;
                int step = kStep[idx], diff = step >> 3;
                if (n & 1) diff += step >> 2;
                if (n & 2) diff += step >> 1;
                if (n & 4) diff += step;
                pred = std::clamp(n & 8 ? pred - diff : pred + diff, -32768, 32767);
                idx = std::clamp(idx + kIndex[n], 0, 88);
                out[(1 + k * 8 + j) * ch + c] = int16_t(pred);
            }
    }
}

// sample of channel c at frame f of memory starting at data
float Sample(Voice& v, uint32_t data, uint32_t f, int c) {
    c = std::min<int>(c, v.channels - 1);
    const uint8_t* p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(data));
    if (v.tag == 0x69) {
        int64_t at = int64_t(data) + int64_t(f / 64) * 36 * v.channels;
        if (at != v.block) {
            DecodeBlock(static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(uint32_t(at))), std::min<int>(v.channels, 8), v.decoded);
            v.block = at;
        }
        return v.decoded[(f % 64) * v.channels + c] / 32768.0f;
    }
    if (v.bits == 8) return (p[f * v.align + c] - 128) / 128.0f;
    int16_t s;
    std::memcpy(&s, p + f * v.align + c * 2, 2);
    return s / 32768.0f;
}

void Complete(Voice& v, Packet& pk, uint32_t status) {
    if (pk.completed_ptr) W32(pk.completed_ptr, status == 0 ? pk.size : pk.used);
    if (pk.status_ptr) W32(pk.status_ptr, status);
    if (v.callback) {
        g_done.push_back({v.obj, v.callback, v.context, pk.context, status});
        g_done_cv.notify_one();
    } else if (pk.context) {
        if (ObjectRef e = FromHandle(pk.context)) SetEvent(*e);
    }
}

// the console's stereo downmix: centre, back pair and back crosstalk at -3 dB, the sub dropped
float StereoFold(uint32_t bin) {
    bool folded = bin == 2 || bin == 4 || bin == 5 || bin == 8 || bin == 9;
    return folded ? 0.707f : 1.0f;
}

// gain of voice channel c on host left and right. A hardware voice holds two channels and owns a run of slots,
// which alternate left and right.
void Levels(Voice& v, float g[2][2]) {
    static const uint8_t kFront[2] = {0, 1};
    const uint8_t* bin = v.nbins ? v.bin : kFront;
    uint32_t n = v.nbins ? v.nbins : 2, voices = (std::max<uint32_t>(v.channels, 1) - 1) / 2 + 1;
    uint32_t per = std::max<uint32_t>(n / voices, 2), step = v.channels == 1 ? 1 : 2;
    bool speakers = false;
    for (uint32_t s = 0; s < n; s++) speakers |= bin[s] < 10 && bin[s] != 3;
    for (uint32_t c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
        g[c][0] = g[c][1] = 0;
        for (uint32_t s = c; c < v.channels && s < per && s < n; s += step) {
            uint32_t b = bin[s];
            if (speakers && (b == 3 || b > 9)) continue;  // sub and effect sends
            float x = Db(v.bin_mb[b]) * v.volume * v.headroom * StereoFold(b);
            // even bins are left, odd right, 2 is the centre
            bool left = !speakers || b == 2 || !(b & 1);
            bool right = !speakers || b == 2 || (b & 1);
            // slots that reach one speaker add, as on the DSP; effect sends alone play the loudest
            if (speakers) {
                if (left) g[c][0] += x;
                if (right) g[c][1] += x;
            } else {
                g[c][0] = std::max(g[c][0], x);
                g[c][1] = std::max(g[c][1], x);
            }
        }
    }
    if (!v.is3d || v.mode == 2) return;
    bool rel = v.mode == 1;  // the position is already in listener space
    float d[3] = {v.p[0], v.p[1], v.p[2]};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && !rel; i++) d[i] -= g_listener[i];
    float dist = std::sqrt(d[0] * d[0] + d[1] * d[1] + d[2] * d[2]);
    float att = 1;
    if (dist > v.min_dist && v.curve.empty()) {
        att = v.min_dist / std::min(dist, v.max_dist);
    } else if (dist > v.min_dist && v.max_dist > v.min_dist) {
        // points spread evenly from min to max distance, 1.0 at min
        float at = (std::min(dist, v.max_dist) - v.min_dist) / (v.max_dist - v.min_dist) * v.curve.size();
        size_t i = std::min(size_t(at), v.curve.size() - 1);
        float from = i ? v.curve[i - 1] : 1.0f;
        att = from + (v.curve[i] - from) * (at - i);
    }
    float right[3] = {g_top[1] * g_front[2] - g_top[2] * g_front[1], g_top[2] * g_front[0] - g_top[0] * g_front[2],
                      g_top[0] * g_front[1] - g_top[1] * g_front[0]};
    float side = rel ? d[0] : d[0] * right[0] + d[1] * right[1] + d[2] * right[2];
    float pan = dist > 1e-3f ? side / dist : 0.0f;
    for (int c = 0; c < 2; c++) {
        g[c][0] *= att * std::min(1.0f, 1.0f - pan);
        g[c][1] *= att * std::min(1.0f, 1.0f + pan);
    }
}

// a stream goes quiet: the synch hold ends, a started one loses its pause as well
void Deactivate(Voice& v) {
    v.sync = false;
    if (v.active) v.active = v.paused = v.ending = false;
}

void Render(float* out, uint32_t frames) {
    std::memset(out, 0, frames * 2 * sizeof(float));
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    for (auto& [obj, v] : g_voices) {
        if (v.paused || v.sync || (!v.stream && !v.playing)) continue;
        float g[2][2];
        Levels(v, g);
        uint32_t base = v.data + v.play_start;
        double step = double(v.freq ? v.freq : v.rate) / audio::kRate;
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames; i++) {
            uint32_t f = uint32_t(v.pos);
            float a, b, a1, b1;  // this frame and the next, interpolated between
            if (v.stream) {
                while (!v.packets.empty() && f >= FramesOf(v, v.packets.front().size)) {
                    Packet pk = v.packets.front();
                    v.packets.pop_front();
                    pk.used = pk.size;
                    Complete(v, pk, 0);
                    v.pos -= FramesOf(v, pk.size);
                    f = uint32_t(v.pos);
                }
                if (v.packets.empty()) {
                    v.pos = 0;
                    if (v.ending) Deactivate(v);
                    break;
                }
                Packet& pk = v.packets.front();
                a = Sample(v, pk.data, f, 0);
                b = Sample(v, pk.data, f, 1);
                if (f + 1 < FramesOf(v, pk.size)) {
                    a1 = Sample(v, pk.data, f + 1, 0);
                    b1 = Sample(v, pk.data, f + 1, 1);
                } else if (v.packets.size() > 1) {
                    a1 = Sample(v, v.packets[1].data, 0, 0);
                    b1 = Sample(v, v.packets[1].data, 0, 1);
                } else {
                    a1 = a;
                    b1 = b;
                }
            } else {
                uint32_t start = v.looping ? FramesOf(v, v.loop_start) : 0;
                uint32_t end = FramesOf(v, v.looping ? v.loop_start + v.loop_len : v.play_len);
                if (f >= end) {
                    if (!v.looping || end <= start) {
                        v.playing = false;
                        v.pos = 0;
                        break;
                    }
                    v.pos = start + std::fmod(v.pos - start, double(end - start));
                    f = uint32_t(v.pos);
                }
                if (!v.data) break;
                a = Sample(v, base, f, 0);
                b = Sample(v, base, f, 1);
                uint32_t next = f + 1 < end ? f + 1 : v.looping ? start : f;
                a1 = Sample(v, base, next, 0);
                b1 = Sample(v, base, next, 1);
            }
            float t = float(v.pos - f);
            a += (a1 - a) * t;
            b += (b1 - b) * t;
            out[i * 2] += a * g[0][0] + b * g[1][0];
            out[i * 2 + 1] += a * g[0][1] + b * g[1][1];
            v.pos += step;
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < frames * 2; i++) out[i] = std::clamp(out[i], -1.0f, 1.0f);
}

int64_t NowMs() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    return duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
}

void Run(X86Context& ctx, const std::vector<Done>& done) {
    for (const Done& d : done) CallGuest(ctx, d.callback, {d.context, d.packet_context, d.status});
}

void Start() {
    if (g_started) return;
    g_started = true;
    audio::StartOutput(Render);
    // for a title that never calls DirectSoundDoWork: its callbacks come from here instead
    StartHostThread("dsound", [](X86Context& ctx) {
        constexpr int64_t kPumpMs = 250;
        for (;;) {
            std::vector<Done> done;
            {
                std::unique_lock<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
                g_done_cv.wait_for(lock, std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
                if (NowMs() - g_pumped < kPumpMs) continue;
                done.assign(g_done.begin(), g_done.end());
                g_done.clear();
            }
            Run(ctx, done);
        }
    });
}

// WAVEFORMATEX
void ReadFormat(Voice& v, uint32_t wfx) {
    if (!wfx) return;
    v.tag = R16(wfx);
    v.channels = std::max<uint16_t>(R16(wfx + 2), 1);
    v.rate = R32(wfx + 4);
    v.align = std::max<uint16_t>(R16(wfx + 12), 1);
    v.bits = R16(wfx + 14);
    if (v.tag != 1 && v.tag != 0x69) LOG_FIRST(8, "dsound: format tag %X not supported", v.tag);
}

// DSMIXBINS: the voice's bins and their volumes
void SetBins(Voice& v, uint32_t mixbins) {
    v.nbins = 0;  // none listed: front left and right
    if (!mixbins) return;
    uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(R32(mixbins), 8), pairs = R32(mixbins + 4);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        v.bin[i] = R32(pairs + i * 8) & 31;
        v.bin_mb[v.bin[i]] = int32_t(R32(pairs + i * 8 + 4));
    }
    v.nbins = uint8_t(n);
}
// volumes only, the bins stay
void SetBinVolumes(Voice& v, uint32_t mixbins) {
    if (!mixbins) return;
    uint32_t n = std::min<uint32_t>(R32(mixbins), 32), pairs = R32(mixbins + 4);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) v.bin_mb[R32(pairs + i * 8) & 31] = int32_t(R32(pairs + i * 8 + 4));
}
// 600 mB unless 3D or a mix in or effect in buffer
float DefaultHeadroom(uint32_t flags) { return flags & 0x382010 ? 1.0f : Db(-600); }

Voice* Find(uint32_t obj) {
    auto it = g_voices.find(obj);
    return it == g_voices.end() ? nullptr : &it->second;
}

uint32_t NewBuffer(uint32_t desc, uint32_t out) {
    std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock);
    Start();
    uint32_t obj = mem::AllocSystem(0x40);
    std::memset(HostPtr(obj), 0, 0x40);
    Voice& v = g_voices[obj];
    v.obj = obj;
    uint32_t flags = R32(desc + 4), bytes = R32(desc + 8);  // DSBUFFERDESC: size, flags, bytes, format, mix bins
    ReadFormat(v, R32(desc + 12));
    SetBins(v, R32(desc + 16));
    v.is3d = flags & 0x10;  // DSBCAPS_CTRL3D
    v.headroom = DefaultHeadroom(flags);
    if (bytes) {
        v.data = v.owned = mem::AllocContiguous(bytes, 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 4);
        v.bytes = v.play_len = v.loop_len = bytes;
    }
    W32(out, obj);
    return 0;
}

float F32(uint32_t v) {
    float f;
    std::memcpy(&f, &v, 4);
    return f;
}

}  // namespace

// device

// DSOUND objects are the host's; .XTLID names linked exports that would still run console code on them
static void AuditExports() {
    static const uint32_t handled[] = {
        SYM(DirectSoundCreate), SYM(IDirectSound_Release), SYM(DirectSoundUseFullHRTF), SYM(DirectSoundUseLightHRTF),
        SYM(IDirectSound_GetSpeakerConfig),
        SYM(IDirectSound_SetEffectData), SYM(IDirectSound_EnableHeadphones), SYM(IDirectSound_SetMixBinHeadroom),
        SYM(IDirectSound_CommitDeferredSettings), SYM(IDirectSound_SetDopplerFactor), SYM(IDirectSound_SetRolloffFactor),
        SYM(IDirectSound_SetDistanceFactor), SYM(IDirectSound_SetVelocity), SYM(IDirectSound_SetI3DL2Listener),
        SYM(IDirectSound_SetPosition), SYM(IDirectSound_SetOrientation), SYM(IDirectSound_SynchPlayback), SYM(DirectSoundDoWork),
        SYM(IDirectSound_DownloadEffectsImage), SYM(IDirectSound_GetEffectData), SYM(IDirectSound_CommitEffectData),
        SYM(IDirectSound_GetOutputLevels), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetPlayRegion), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetAllParameters),
        SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetFormat), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetOutputBuffer), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetRolloffCurve),
        SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_StopEx),
        SYM(XAudioDownloadEffectsImage), SYM(DirectSoundCreateBuffer), SYM(IDirectSound_CreateSoundBuffer),

        SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetPosition), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetVelocity), SYM(IDirectSoundBuffer_SetI3DL2Source),
        SYM(DirectSoundCreateStream), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_AddRef), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetFormat),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_Release), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_GetInfo), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_GetStatus),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_Process), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_Discontinuity), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_Flush),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_FlushEx), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_Pause), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetVolume),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetFrequency), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetFilter), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetHeadroom),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetMixBinVolumes), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetMixBins), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetMaxDistance),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetMinDistance), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetPosition), SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetVelocity),
        SYM(CDirectSoundStream_SetI3DL2Source), SYM(IDirectSoundStream_SetEG)};
    std::string left;
    // the library's own section: the WMA decoder shares the export ids and touches no DSOUND object
    uint32_t lo = 0, hi = 0;
    for (auto& s : g_image->sections)
        if (SYM(DirectSoundCreate) - s.va < s.vsize) lo = s.va, hi = s.va + s.vsize;
    for (auto& s : g_image->sections)
        for (uint32_t o = 0; s.name == ".XTLID" && o + 8 <= std::min(s.vsize, s.rsize); o += 8) {
            uint32_t id = g_image->U32(s.raw + o), va = g_image->U32(s.raw + o + 4);
            auto done = [&](uint32_t f) { return std::find(std::begin(handled), std::end(handled), f) != std::end(handled); };
            // a jmp to a host version is covered by it
            if (id >> 16 != 0xB || va < lo || va >= hi || !dispatch::Find(va) || done(va) ||  // 0xB: DSOUND's library id
                (G<uint8_t>(va) == 0xE9 && done(va + 5 + R32(va + 1))))
                continue;
            char b[24];
            std::snprintf(b, sizeof b, " %05X at %08X", id, va);
            left += b;
        }
    if (!left.empty()) LOGW("dsound: exports running their original code:%s", left.c_str());
}

// Effects run on the console's DSP and are not reproduced.
// the descriptor keeps the image's effect list so the title finds its indices, every segment points at zeroed memory
static uint32_t EffectsDesc(const std::vector<uint8_t>& img, const char* name) {
    XDK_REQUIRE("dsound", XDK_KEY(EffectsImage_Skip0), XDK_KEY(EffectsImage_Skip1), XDK_KEY(EffectsImage_Desc));
    auto u32 = [&](size_t o) { uint32_t v = 0; if (o + 4 <= img.size()) std::memcpy(&v, &img[o], 4); return v; };
    size_t t = XDK_EffectsImage_Desc + size_t(u32(XDK_EffectsImage_Skip0) + u32(XDK_EffectsImage_Skip1)) * 4;
    uint32_t count = std::min<uint32_t>(u32(t), 64);
    LOGI("dsound: effects image %s, %u effects", name, count);
    uint32_t desc = mem::AllocSystem(8 + std::max(count, 1u) * 32);
    W32(desc, count);
    W32(desc + 4, u32(t + 4));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        size_t m = t + 8 + i * 32;
        uint32_t d = desc + 8 + i * 32;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            uint32_t size = u32(m + k * 8 + 4);
            uint32_t seg = mem::AllocSystem(std::max(size, 0x40u));
            std::memset(HostPtr(seg), 0, std::max(size, 0x40u));
            W32(d + k * 8, seg);
            W32(d + k * 8 + 4, size);
        }
    }
    return desc;
}

    }
    uint32_t desc = EffectsDesc(img, name.c_str());

}

BUFFER(Release, 1) {
    if (--v.refs > 0) return uint32_t(v.refs);
    if (v.owned) mem::FreeContiguous(v.owned);
    uint32_t obj = v.obj;
    g_voices.erase(obj);
    mem::FreeSystem(obj);
    return 0;
}
BUFFER(Unlock, 5) { return 0; }
BUFFER(SetBufferData, 3) {
    if (a[1] == v.data && a[2] == v.bytes) return 0;
    // the library frees its own memory, and makes it again for a size with no data
    if (v.owned && v.owned != a[1]) {
        mem::FreeContiguous(v.owned);
        v.owned = 0;
    }
    v.data = a[1];
    if (!a[1] && a[2]) v.data = v.owned = mem::AllocContiguous(a[2], 0, 0xFFFFFFFF, 4);
    v.bytes = v.play_len = v.loop_len = a[2];
    v.play_start = v.loop_start = 0;
    v.pos = 0;
    v.block = -1;
    return 0;
}
BUFFER(Play, 4) {
    v.playing = true;
    v.looping = a[3] & 1;
    if (a[3] & 2) v.pos = 0;
    v.sync = a[3] & 4;
    return 0;

BUFFER(SetPlayRegion, 3) {
    if (a[1] > v.bytes || a[2] > v.bytes - a[1]) return 0x88780032u;  // DSERR_INVALIDCALL
    v.play_start = a[1];
    v.play_len = v.loop_len = a[2] ? a[2] : v.bytes - a[1];
    v.loop_start = 0;
    v.pos = 0;
    v.block = -1;
    return 0;
}
BUFFER(SetLoopRegion, 3) {
    if (a[1] > v.play_len || a[2] > v.play_len - a[1]) return 0x88780032u;

    v.loop_len = a[2] ? a[2] : v.play_len - a[1];
    return 0;
}

#define STREAM(name, nargs)                                     \
    static uint32_t str_##name(Voice& v, const Args& a);        \
    HLE_STDCALL(CDirectSoundStream_##name, nargs) {             \
        uint32_t r;                                             \
        std::vector<Done> flushed;                              \
        {                                                       \
            std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> lock(g_lock); \
            Voice* v = Find(a[0]);                              \
            r = v ? str_##name(*v, a) : 0x80004005u;            \
            flushed.swap(t_flushed);                            \
        }                                                       \
        Run(ctx, flushed);                                      \
        return r;                                               \
    }                                                           \
    static uint32_t str_##name([[maybe_unused]] Voice& v, [[maybe_unused]] const Args& a)

// the stream's callbacks still queued and those of its flushed packets, in order, go to the calling thread
static void FlushStream(Voice& v) {
    for (auto& pk : v.packets) Complete(v, pk, kFlushed);
    v.packets.clear();
    v.pos = 0;
    for (auto it = g_done.begin(); it != g_done.end();) {
        if (it->voice != v.obj) {
            ++it;
            continue;
        }
        t_flushed.push_back(*it);
        it = g_done.erase(it);
    }
    Deactivate(v);
}

STREAM(AddRef, 1) { return uint32_t(++v.refs); }
STREAM(SetFormat, 2) {
    FlushStream(v);
    ReadFormat(v, a[1]);
    v.freq = 0;  // the XDK sets the pitch back to the new format's own rate
    v.block = -1;
    return 0;
}
STREAM(Release, 1) {
    if (--v.refs > 0) return uint32_t(v.refs);
    FlushStream(v);
    uint32_t obj = v.obj;
    g_voices.erase(obj);
    mem::FreeSystem(obj);
    return 0;
}

    uint32_t info = a[1];
    W32(info, 0x3);  // fixed sample size, fixed packet alignment
    W32(info + 4, v.tag == 0x69 ? 36u * v.channels : v.align);
    W32(info + 8, 0);
    W32(info + 12, 0);
    return 0;
}
STREAM(GetStatus, 2) {
    W32(a[1], v.packets.size() < v.max_packets ? 1u : 0u);  // XMEDIASTATUS_ACCEPT_INPUT
    return 0;
}
STREAM(Process, 3) {
    uint32_t in = a[1];
    if (!in) return 0;
    Packet pk{R32(in), R32(in + 4), R32(in + 8), R32(in + 12), R32(in + 16)};
    if (pk.completed_ptr) W32(pk.completed_ptr, 0);
    if (pk.status_ptr) W32(pk.status_ptr, kPacketPending);
    v.packets.push_back(pk);
    v.active = true;
    v.ending = false;
    return 0;
}
STREAM(Discontinuity, 1) {
    if (!v.packets.empty()) v.ending = true;
    else if (v.active) FlushStream(v);
    return 0;
}
STREAM(Flush, 1) {
    FlushStream(v);
    return 0;
}
STREAM(FlushEx, 4) {
    if (a[3] && !v.active) return 0;
    FlushStream(v);
    return 0;
}
STREAM(Pause, 2) {

    v.sync = a[1] == 2;
    return 0;
}
```
