`sdk/runtime/xdk/hle.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <string_view>
#include <type_traits>

#include "image_symbols.h"
#include "kernel/kernel.h"

// Symbols are named in config/<image>.toml; the recompiler writes their addresses to image_symbols.h
#define X86_CAT_(a, b) a##b
#define X86_CAT(a, b) X86_CAT_(a, b)
#define SYM(name) X86_CAT(0x, SYM_##name)                 // address
#define GUEST(name) X86_CAT(sub_, SYM_##name)             // the function, a host override if there is one
#define GUEST_ORIG(name) X86_CAT(__imp__sub_, SYM_##name)  // the recompiled body

// Argument maps. A library built with link time code generation may take a function's arguments in registers. The
// config's [abi] says where each API argument of such a function is, image_symbols.h lists the maps as IMAGE_ABI,
// and the macros below read arguments and pop the stack by them. A name without a map keeps the declared convention.
#ifndef IMAGE_ABI
#define IMAGE_ABI(X)
#endif
namespace hle {
enum Loc : uint8_t { stack, eax, ecx, edx, ebx, esi, edi, ebp };
constexpr int kMaxArgs = 16;
struct Map {
    bool mapped = false;
    uint8_t n = 0, pops = 0;  // API arguments, stack slots the callee pops
    uint8_t loc[kMaxArgs] = {}, slot[kMaxArgs] = {};
};
constexpr Map Make(std::initializer_list<Loc> locs) {
    Map m;
    m.mapped = true;
    for (Loc l : locs) {
        m.loc[m.n] = l;
        m.slot[m.n++] = m.pops;
        if (l == stack) m.pops++;
    }
    return m;
}
struct Row {
    std::string_view name;
    Map map;
};
#define HLE_ABI_ROW(name, ...) {#name, Make({__VA_ARGS__})},
inline constexpr Row kRows[] = {IMAGE_ABI(HLE_ABI_ROW) {"", {}}};
#undef HLE_ABI_ROW
constexpr Map Find(std::string_view name, Map declared = {}) {
    for (const Row& r : kRows)
        if (r.name == name) return r.map;
    return declared;
}
// __fastcall: ecx, edx, then the stack
constexpr Map Fastcall(int stack_args) {
    Map m = Make({ecx, edx});
    for (int i = 0; i < stack_args; i++) {
        m.loc[m.n] = stack;
        m.slot[m.n++] = m.pops++;
    }
    return m;
}
// by Loc
inline constexpr uint32_t X86Context::* kReg[] = {nullptr, &X86Context::eax, &X86Context::ecx, &X86Context::edx,
                                                 &X86Context::ebx, &X86Context::esi, &X86Context::edi, &X86Context::ebp};
// API argument i at the function's entry, 0 past the map
inline uint32_t Read(const X86Context& ctx, const Map& m, int i) {
    if (i >= m.n) return 0;
    return m.loc[i] == stack ? ::kernel::R32(ctx.esp + 4 + 4 * uint32_t(m.slot[i])) : ctx.*kReg[m.loc[i]];
}
// S::map is the function's map
template <class S>
struct Args {
    X86Context& ctx;
    uint32_t operator[](int i) const { return Read(ctx, S::map, i); }
};
// calls a mapped guest function: registers loaded, stack arguments pushed, every register put back
inline uint32_t Call(X86Context& ctx, uint32_t fn, const Map& m, std::initializer_list<uint32_t> args) {
    if (args.size() != m.n) x86_trap(ctx, fn, "host call and [abi] map differ in argument count");
    uint32_t saved[8] = {0, ctx.eax, ctx.ecx, ctx.edx, ctx.ebx, ctx.esi, ctx.edi, ctx.ebp};
    uint32_t pushed[kMaxArgs] = {}, n = 0, i = 0;
    for (uint32_t v : args) {
        if (m.loc[i] == stack) pushed[n++] = v;
        else ctx.*kReg[m.loc[i]] = v;
        i++;
    }
    uint32_t r = ::kernel::CallGuest(ctx, fn, pushed, n);
    for (int k = 1; k < 8; k++) ctx.*kReg[k] = saved[k];
    return r;
}
}  // namespace hle

// S::map is the function's map and A its argument type: plain stack arguments unless the image maps the name
#define HLE_ABI_(S, A, text, declared, counted)                                                \
    struct S {                                                                                 \
        static constexpr ::hle::Map map = ::hle::Find(text, declared);                         \
    };                                                                                         \
    static_assert(counted, "[abi] " text " does not have the argument count of the function"); \
    using A = std::conditional_t<S::map.mapped, ::hle::Args<S>, ::kernel::Args>;

#define HLE_BODY_(fn, guest, A, pops)                    \
    static uint32_t fn(X86Context& ctx, const A& a);     \
    X86_FUNC(guest) {                                    \
        (void)base;                                      \
        A args{ctx};                                     \
        uint32_t r = fn(ctx, args);                      \
        ::kernel::Return(ctx, r, pops);                  \
    }                                                    \
    static uint32_t fn([[maybe_unused]] X86Context& ctx, [[maybe_unused]] const A& a)

// Host implementation of a guest function: the strong definition replaces the recompiled weak one.
// a[i] is API argument i.
#define HLE_STDCALL(name, nargs)                                                \
    HLE_ABI_(hle_abi_##name, hle_args_##name, #name, ::hle::Map{},              \
             !hle_abi_##name::map.mapped || hle_abi_##name::map.n == (nargs))   \
    HLE_BODY_(hle_##name, GUEST(name), hle_args_##name,                         \
              hle_abi_##name::map.mapped ? hle_abi_##name::map.pops : (nargs))

// __fastcall: first two arguments in ecx and edx, the rest on the stack
#define HLE_FASTCALL(name, stack_args)                                                                   \
    HLE_ABI_(hle_abi_##name, hle_args_##name, #name, ::hle::Fastcall(stack_args),                        \
             hle_abi_##name::map.n == 2 + (stack_args) || (hle_abi_##name::map.n == 1 && !(stack_args))) \
    HLE_BODY_(hle_##name, GUEST(name), hle_args_##name, hle_abi_##name::map.pops)

// __cdecl: the caller pops the arguments
#define HLE_CDECL(name)                                                       \
    HLE_ABI_(hle_abi_##name, hle_args_##name, #name, ::hle::Map{}, true)      \
    HLE_BODY_(hle_##name, GUEST(name), hle_args_##name, hle_abi_##name::map.mapped ? hle_abi_##name::map.pops : 0)

// Runs before the recompiled function, which then sees its arguments untouched
#define HLE_WRAP_(fn, guest, orig, A)                \
    X86_EXTERN_FUNC(orig);                           \
    static void fn(X86Context& ctx, const A& a);     \
    X86_FUNC(guest) {                                \
        fn(ctx, A{ctx});                             \
        orig(ctx, base);                             \
    }                                                \
    static void fn([[maybe_unused]] X86Context& ctx, [[maybe_unused]] const A& a)
#define HLE_WRAP(name, nargs)                                                   \
    HLE_ABI_(hle_abi_##name, hle_args_##name, #name, ::hle::Map{},              \
             !hle_abi_##name::map.mapped || hle_abi_##name::map.n == (nargs))   \
    HLE_WRAP_(hle_##name, GUEST(name), GUEST_ORIG(name), hle_args_##name)

// Calls a guest function by name with its API arguments: GUEST_CALL(name, ctx, {a, b})
#define GUEST_CALL(name, ctx, ...)                                                           \
    ([&]() -> uint32_t {                                                                     \
        static constexpr ::hle::Map map_ = ::hle::Find(#name);                               \
        if constexpr (!map_.mapped) return ::kernel::CallGuest(ctx, SYM(name), __VA_ARGS__); \
        else return ::hle::Call(ctx, SYM(name), map_, __VA_ARGS__);                          \
    }())

// float arguments
template <class A>
inline float ArgF(const A& a, int i) {
    uint32_t v = a[i];
    float f;
    std::memcpy(&f, &v, 4);
    return f;
}
inline float GF(uint32_t va) {
    float f;
    std::memcpy(&f, ::kernel::HostPtr(va), 4);
    return f;
}
```

```h
#pragma once
// XDK data layouts come from the image config (sdk/xdk/<build>/layout.toml), data addresses from its [data]. One the
// config lacks is unknown and traps where it is first needed rather than being guessed.
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iterator>

#include "core/log.h"
#include "image_symbols.h"

namespace xdk {
constexpr uint32_t kUnknown = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
struct LayoutKey {
    const char* name;
    uint32_t value;
};
template <size_t N>
constexpr bool AllKnown(const LayoutKey (&keys)[N]) {
    for (auto& k : keys)
        if (k.value == kUnknown) return false;
    return true;
}
[[noreturn]] inline void LayoutMissing(const char* lib, const LayoutKey* keys, size_t n) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (keys[i].value == kUnknown) LOGE("%s: %s is unknown for this image, add it to the config", lib, keys[i].name);
    logx::Flush();
    std::abort();
}
}  // namespace xdk

#define XDK_KEY(name) ::xdk::LayoutKey{#name, XDK_##name}
#define XDK_DATA(name) ::xdk::LayoutKey{#name, HAS_##name ? SYM(name) : ::xdk::kUnknown}
#define XDK_REQUIRE(lib, ...)                                                                  \
    do {                                                                                       \
        static constexpr ::xdk::LayoutKey keys_[] = {__VA_ARGS__};                             \
        if constexpr (!::xdk::AllKnown(keys_)) ::xdk::LayoutMissing(lib, keys_, std::size(keys_)); \
    } while (0)
```

`sdk/runtime/xdk/xapi.cpp`:

```cpp
// XAPI functions that talk to hardware: controller ports and the hard disk cache partition
#include <chrono>

#include "core/input.h"
#include "xdk/hle.h"
#include "xdk/layout.h"

using namespace kernel;

namespace {

// XPP device type records: CurrentConnected, ChangeConnected, PreviousConnected
constexpr uint32_t kGamepadType = SYM(XPP_GamepadType);
constexpr uint32_t kMemoryUnitType = SYM(XPP_MemoryUnitType);

std::mutex g_ports_lock;
bool g_poller = false;

void UpdatePorts() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
    uint32_t cur = 0;
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++)
        if (input::Poll(p).connected) cur |= 1u << p;
    uint32_t old = R32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Current);
    if (cur != old) {
        W32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Changed, R32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Changed) | (cur ^ old));
        W32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Current, cur);
        LOGI("xapi: controller ports now %X", cur);
    }
}

struct Handle {
    uint32_t port;
    uint32_t packet;
    input::Pad last;
};
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Handle> g_handles;

}  // namespace

HLE_STDCALL(XMountUtilityDrive, 1) {
    CreateSymbolicLink("\\??\\Z:", "\\Device\\Harddisk0\\Partition5");
    return 1;
}

HLE_STDCALL(XInitDevices, 2) {
    XDK_REQUIRE("xapi", XDK_KEY(XPP_Current), XDK_KEY(XPP_Changed), XDK_KEY(XPP_Previous), XDK_DATA(XPP_GamepadType));
    W32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Current, 0);
    W32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Changed, 0);
    W32(kGamepadType + XDK_XPP_Previous, 0);
    if constexpr (HAS_XPP_MemoryUnitType != 0) {  // titles without memory unit support have no record
        W32(kMemoryUnitType + XDK_XPP_Current, 0);
        W32(kMemoryUnitType + XDK_XPP_Changed, 0);
        W32(kMemoryUnitType + XDK_XPP_Previous, 0);
    }
    // no UpdatePorts here: on the console the pads enumerate after the init, and a title that takes the devices
    // XGetDevices finds then (none) opens the rest as XGetDeviceChanges reports them inserted (Shaolin Monks)
    if (!g_poller) {
        g_poller = true;
        std::thread([] {
            for (;;) {
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(250));
                UpdatePorts();
            }
        }).detach();
    }
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(XInputOpen, 4) {
    uint32_t type = a[0], port = a[1];
    LOG_FIRST(16, "xapi: XInputOpen type %08X port %u", type, port);
    if (type != kGamepadType || port > 3) return 0;
    uint32_t h = mem::AllocSystem(16);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
    g_handles[h] = {port, 0, {}};
    return h;
}

HLE_STDCALL(XInputClose, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
    g_handles.erase(a[0]);
    mem::FreeSystem(a[0]);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(XInputGetState, 2) {
    uint32_t port;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
        auto it = g_handles.find(a[0]);
        if (it == g_handles.end()) return 6;  // ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
        port = it->second.port;
    }
    input::Pad p = input::Poll(int(port));
    LOG_FIRST(8, "xapi: XInputGetState port %u connected %d", port, int(p.connected));
    if (p.buttons || p.analog[0]) LOG_FIRST(16, "xapi: port %u buttons %04X A %02X", port, p.buttons, p.analog[0]);
    if (!p.connected) return 1167;  // ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
    Handle& h = g_handles[a[0]];
    if (std::memcmp(&p, &h.last, sizeof(p))) h.packet++;
    h.last = p;
    uint32_t s = a[1];
    W32(s, h.packet);  // XINPUT_STATE: packet, buttons, 8 analog buttons, thumbs
    W16(s + 4, p.buttons);
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(s + 6), p.analog, 8);
    W16(s + 14, uint16_t(p.lx));
    W16(s + 16, uint16_t(p.ly));
    W16(s + 18, uint16_t(p.rx));
    W16(s + 20, uint16_t(p.ry));
    return 0;
}

// XINPUT_CAPABILITIES, packed to 25 bytes: SubType, Reserved (2), the gamepad's controls (wButtons, 8 analog
// buttons, 4 thumb axes) and the rumble's motors, each nonzero where the pad has it. The library's own reads its
// device extension, which a host handle has none of
#if HAS_XInputGetCapabilities
HLE_STDCALL(XInputGetCapabilities, 2) {
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
        if (!g_handles.count(a[0])) return 6;  // ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
    }
    uint32_t c = a[1];
    std::memset(HostPtr(c), 0, 25);
    *static_cast<uint8_t*>(HostPtr(c)) = 1;  // XINPUT_DEVSUBTYPE_GC_GAMEPAD
    W16(c + 3, 0x00FF);    // dpad, start, back, thumbs
    std::memset(HostPtr(c + 5), 0xFF, 8);
    std::memset(HostPtr(c + 13), 0xFF, 8);
    W16(c + 21, 0xFFFF);  // rumble, both motors
    W16(c + 23, 0xFFFF);
    return 0;
}
#endif

HLE_STDCALL(XInputSetState, 2) {
    uint32_t port;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_ports_lock);
        auto it = g_handles.find(a[0]);
        if (it == g_handles.end()) return 6;
        port = it->second.port;
    }
    uint32_t fb = a[1];
    // XINPUT_FEEDBACK_HEADER is dwStatus, hEvent and 58 reserved bytes, the rumble follows
    input::Rumble(int(port), R16(fb + 66), R16(fb + 68));
    W32(fb, 0);
    if (uint32_t ev = R32(fb + 4))
        if (ObjectRef o = FromHandle(ev)) SetEvent(*o);
    return 997;  // ERROR_IO_PENDING, already complete
}

// A recompiled image launches through the XAPI, then a process restart into its executable; any other
// (the dashboard, updates) is refused and the title stays in its menu.
X86_EXTERN_FUNC(GUEST_ORIG(XLaunchNewImageA));
X86_FUNC(GUEST(XLaunchNewImageA)) {
    std::string path = ReadCString(R32(ctx.esp + 4));
    if (ImageExe(path)) {
        GUEST_ORIG(XLaunchNewImageA)(ctx, base);
        return;
    }
    LOGW("xapi: launch of %s refused, it is not recompiled", path.c_str());
    Return(ctx, 2, 2);  // ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND
}
```

`sdk/runtime/xdk/xnet.cpp`:

```cpp
// System link on host Winsock. The game reaches the network only through the XNet winsock thunks, replaced
// here. The title's XNet object stays null, so the XNet calls not replaced (Live QoS and the like) fail with
// WSANOTINITIALISED on their own, and the XOnline calls with XONLINE_E_NOT_INITIALIZED.
// Addresses: an XNADDR's ina is the peer's real IPv4, so secure addresses map to IPs one to one.
// With --instance N the game binds 127.0.0.N and a broadcast goes to the other loopback instances.
// Join IP (a host past the LAN): the system link search's broadcasts also go to that address, and the host's
// broadcasts (a LAN discovery may answer every search with one, to 255.255.255.255) go to the public addresses
// that have reached it. With one peer (co-op) a LAN address in an XNADDR, which only means something on its
// owner's LAN, stands for the peer's public one: the join address on the client, the address its packets come
// from on the host. Ports a NAT rewrote are answered on the port the peer's packets came from.
#ifndef WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#define WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN
#endif
#ifndef NOMINMAX
#define NOMINMAX
#endif
#include <winsock2.h>
#include <ws2tcpip.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <random>

#include "app/app.h"
#include "xdk/hle.h"

using kernel::HostPtr;
using kernel::R32;
using kernel::W32;

namespace {

// XNADDR: ina, inaOnline, wPortOnline, abEnet[6], abOnline[20]
constexpr uint32_t kXnAddrSize = 0x24;
constexpr uint32_t kXnAddrEnet = 0x0A;
// WSAOVERLAPPED: Internal, InternalHigh, Offset, OffsetHigh, hEvent
constexpr uint32_t kOvlStatus = 0x00;
constexpr uint32_t kOvlBytes = 0x04;
constexpr uint32_t kOvlEvent = 0x10;
constexpr uint32_t kOvlPending = 0x103;
// XNDNS: iStatus, cina, aina[8]
constexpr uint32_t kXnDnsSize = 0x28;
// fd_set: fd_count, fd_array[64]
constexpr uint32_t kFdSetMax = 64;

constexpr uint32_t kSocketError = 0xFFFFFFFF;
constexpr uint32_t kLinkUp = 0x01 | 0x02 | 0x08;          // active, 100 Mbps, full duplex
constexpr uint32_t kXnAddrEthernet = 0x02 | 0x04;         // ethernet, static address
constexpr DWORD kUdpConnReset = 0x9800000C;  // SIO_UDP_CONNRESET: off, or a send to a closed port fails the next recv
constexpr int kLoopbackInstances = 8;

struct Socket {
    SOCKET s = INVALID_SOCKET;
    bool udp = false;
    bool nonblocking = false;  // the guest's FIONBIO; the host socket is always nonblocking
    uint16_t port = 0;         // bound, network order
};

struct Span {
    uint32_t ptr, len;
};

// the byte count and flags pointers are only written when the call completes at once, as in Winsock:
// a title may pass its flags on the stack
struct PendingRecv {
    uint32_t sock, ovl, from, fromlen;
    std::vector<Span> spans;  // copied: the title's WSABUF array may live on its stack
};

std::mutex g_lock;
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Socket> g_sockets;
uint32_t g_next_socket = 0x100;
std::vector<PendingRecv> g_pending;

std::once_flag g_init;
int g_instance = 0;
uint32_t g_local = 0;  // network order
std::array<uint8_t, 8> g_kid{};
std::unordered_map<uint32_t, std::array<uint8_t, kXnAddrSize>> g_peers;

thread_local uint32_t t_error = 0;

std::atomic<uint32_t> g_remote{0};  // the last public address a packet came from
std::mutex g_nat_lock;
std::unordered_map<uint64_t, uint16_t> g_nat;  // (peer address, our port) -> the port its packets come from
std::vector<uint32_t> g_public;                // public addresses packets came from, the latest last
constexpr size_t kMaxPublic = 8;

std::string Ip(uint32_t a) {
    char s[32];
    std::snprintf(s, sizeof(s), "%u.%u.%u.%u", a & 0xFF, (a >> 8) & 0xFF, (a >> 16) & 0xFF, a >> 24);
    return s;
}
std::string Addr(const sockaddr_in& a) { return Ip(a.sin_addr.s_addr) + ":" + std::to_string(ntohs(a.sin_port)); }

bool Private(uint32_t a) {
    uint8_t b0 = a & 0xFF, b1 = (a >> 8) & 0xFF;
    return b0 == 10 || b0 == 127 || (b0 == 172 && (b1 & 0xF0) == 16) || (b0 == 192 && b1 == 168) ||
           (b0 == 169 && b1 == 254);
}

uint64_t NatKey(uint32_t address, uint16_t port) { return uint64_t(address) << 16 | port; }

// the F10 join address, resolved when it changes; 0 for none
uint32_t JoinAddress() {
    static std::mutex m;
    static std::string last;
    static uint32_t address = 0;
    std::string text;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::recursive_mutex> ui(app::UiLock());
        text = app::Get().join_ip;
    }
    text.erase(0, text.find_first_not_of(" \t"));
    text.erase(text.find_last_not_of(" \t") + 1);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m);
    if (text == last) return address;
    last = text;
    address = 0;
    addrinfo hints{};
    hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
    addrinfo* res = nullptr;
    if (!text.empty() && getaddrinfo(text.c_str(), nullptr, &hints, &res) == 0) {
        address = reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in*>(res->ai_addr)->sin_addr.s_addr;
        freeaddrinfo(res);
    }
    if (!text.empty()) LOGI("xnet: join %s -> %s", text.c_str(), address ? Ip(address).c_str() : "not found");
    return address;
}

uint32_t PrimaryAddress() {
    uint32_t addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    SOCKET s = ::socket(AF_INET, SOCK_DGRAM, IPPROTO_UDP);
    sockaddr_in to{};
    to.sin_family = AF_INET;
    to.sin_port = htons(53);
    to.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(0x08080808);  // no packet is sent: connect only picks the route
    sockaddr_in me{};
    int len = sizeof(me);
    if (s != INVALID_SOCKET && ::connect(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&to), sizeof(to)) == 0 &&
        ::getsockname(s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&me), &len) == 0 && me.sin_addr.s_addr)
        addr = me.sin_addr.s_addr;
    if (s != INVALID_SOCKET) ::closesocket(s);
    return addr;
}

void Pump();

void Init() {
    std::call_once(g_init, [] {
        WSADATA wsa;
        WSAStartup(MAKEWORD(2, 2), &wsa);
        g_instance = app::Instance();
        g_local = g_instance ? htonl(0x7F000000u | uint32_t(g_instance)) : PrimaryAddress();
        LOGI("xnet: %s address %s", g_instance ? "loopback instance" : "LAN", Ip(g_local).c_str());
        std::thread(Pump).detach();
    });
}

uint32_t Fail(int err) {
    t_error = uint32_t(err);
    return kSocketError;
}
int HostError() {
    int e = WSAGetLastError();
    return e == WSAECONNRESET ? WSAEWOULDBLOCK : e;  // a port unreachable reply from an earlier send
}

Socket Find(uint32_t sock) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_sockets.find(sock);
    return it == g_sockets.end() ? Socket{} : it->second;
}

sockaddr_in GuestAddr(uint32_t va) {
    sockaddr_in a{};
    std::memcpy(&a, HostPtr(va), sizeof(a));
    return a;
}

void Signal(uint32_t event) {
    if (!event) return;
    if (auto o = kernel::FromHandle(event)) kernel::SetEvent(*o);
}

bool Wait(SOCKET s, bool write, int ms) {
    fd_set f;
    FD_ZERO(&f);
    FD_SET(s, &f);
    timeval tv{ms / 1000, (ms % 1000) * 1000};
    return ::select(0, write ? nullptr : &f, write ? &f : nullptr, nullptr, &tv) > 0;
}

std::vector<Span> Spans(uint32_t bufs, uint32_t count) {
    std::vector<Span> v;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; i++) v.push_back({R32(bufs + 8 * i + 4), R32(bufs + 8 * i)});
    return v;
}

// one datagram into guest buffers: bytes, or -1 with err
int Recv(uint32_t sock, SOCKET s, const std::vector<Span>& spans, uint32_t from, uint32_t fromlen, int& err) {
    thread_local std::vector<uint8_t> buf(65536);
    sockaddr_in src{};
    int sl = sizeof(src);
    int n = ::recvfrom(s, reinterpret_cast<char*>(buf.data()), int(buf.size()), 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&src), &sl);
    if (n < 0) {
        err = HostError();
        if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK) LOG_FIRST(20, "xnet: recv %X failed (%d)", sock, err);
        return -1;
    }
    int done = 0;
    for (const Span& sp : spans) {
        int c = std::min<int>(n - done, int(sp.len));
        if (c <= 0) break;
        std::memcpy(HostPtr(sp.ptr), buf.data() + done, size_t(c));
        done += c;
    }
    if (done < n) LOG_FIRST(10, "xnet: %d byte datagram cut to %d", n, done);
    uint32_t peer = src.sin_addr.s_addr;
    if (peer != g_local && !Private(peer)) {
        if (g_remote.exchange(peer) != peer) LOGI("xnet: peer %s", Addr(src).c_str());
        auto it = g_sockets.find(sock);
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_nat_lock);
        if (it != g_sockets.end() && it->second.port) g_nat[NatKey(peer, it->second.port)] = src.sin_port;
        std::erase(g_public, peer);
        g_public.push_back(peer);
        if (g_public.size() > kMaxPublic) g_public.erase(g_public.begin());
    }
    if (from) std::memcpy(HostPtr(from), &src, sizeof(src));
    if (fromlen) W32(fromlen, sizeof(src));
    return done;
}

int SendOnce(SOCKET s, const uint8_t* data, int len, const sockaddr_in* to) {
    if (!to) return ::send(s, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), len, 0);
    sockaddr_in d = *to;
    if (d.sin_addr.s_addr == INADDR_BROADCAST) {
        std::vector<sockaddr_in> also;
        if (uint32_t join = JoinAddress()) {
            also.push_back(d);
            also.back().sin_addr.s_addr = join;
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_nat_lock);
            for (uint32_t peer : g_public) {
                also.push_back(d);
                also.back().sin_addr.s_addr = peer;
                if (auto it = g_nat.find(NatKey(peer, d.sin_port)); it != g_nat.end()) also.back().sin_port = it->second;
            }
        }
        for (const sockaddr_in& a : also)
            ::sendto(s, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), len, 0, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&a), sizeof(a));
    } else {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_nat_lock);
        auto it = g_nat.find(NatKey(d.sin_addr.s_addr, d.sin_port));
        if (it != g_nat.end()) d.sin_port = it->second;
    }
    if (g_instance && d.sin_addr.s_addr == INADDR_BROADCAST) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= kLoopbackInstances; i++) {
            if (i == g_instance) continue;
            d.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(0x7F000000u | uint32_t(i));
            ::sendto(s, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), len, 0, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&d), sizeof(d));
        }
        return len;
    }
    return ::sendto(s, reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data), len, 0, reinterpret_cast<const sockaddr*>(&d), sizeof(d));
}

int Send(uint32_t sock, SOCKET s, const uint8_t* data, int len, const sockaddr_in* to) {
    int n = SendOnce(s, data, len, to);
    if (n < 0) LOG_FIRST(20, "xnet: send %X failed (%d)", sock, WSAGetLastError());
    return n;
}

std::vector<uint8_t> Gather(uint32_t bufs, uint32_t count) {
    std::vector<uint8_t> v;
    for (const Span& sp : Spans(bufs, count)) {
        auto p = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(sp.ptr));
        v.insert(v.end(), p, p + sp.len);
    }
    return v;
}

void Complete(uint32_t ovl, uint32_t status, uint32_t bytes) {
    W32(ovl + kOvlBytes, bytes);
    W32(ovl + kOvlStatus, status);
    Signal(R32(ovl + kOvlEvent));
}

// with g_lock held: false while no datagram is waiting
bool TryComplete(PendingRecv& p) {
    auto it = g_sockets.find(p.sock);
    if (it == g_sockets.end()) {
        Complete(p.ovl, WSAENOTSOCK, 0);
        return true;
    }
    int err = 0;
    int n = Recv(p.sock, it->second.s, p.spans, p.from, p.fromlen, err);
    if (n < 0 && err == WSAEWOULDBLOCK) return false;
    Complete(p.ovl, n < 0 ? uint32_t(err) : 0, n < 0 ? 0 : uint32_t(n));
    return true;
}

void Pump() {
    for (;;) {
        fd_set set;
        FD_ZERO(&set);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
            for (auto& p : g_pending) {
                auto it = g_sockets.find(p.sock);
                if (it != g_sockets.end() && set.fd_count < FD_SETSIZE) FD_SET(it->second.s, &set);
            }
        }
        if (!set.fd_count) {
            Sleep(1);
            continue;
        }
        timeval tv{0, 2000};
        if (::select(0, &set, nullptr, nullptr, &tv) <= 0) {
            Sleep(1);
            continue;
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
        for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pending.size();) {
            auto it = g_sockets.find(g_pending[i].sock);
            bool ready = it == g_sockets.end() || FD_ISSET(it->second.s, &set);
            if (ready && TryComplete(g_pending[i]))
                g_pending.erase(g_pending.begin() + ptrdiff_t(i));
            else
                i++;
        }
    }
}

void OwnXnAddr(uint8_t* x) {
    std::memset(x, 0, kXnAddrSize);
    std::memcpy(x, &g_local, 4);
    // Microsoft's OUI, then the address's last three bytes
    const uint8_t mac[6] = {0x00, 0x50, 0xF2, uint8_t(g_local >> 8), uint8_t(g_local >> 16), uint8_t(g_local >> 24)};
    std::memcpy(x + kXnAddrEnet, mac, 6);
}

void Random(uint32_t va, uint32_t n) {
    static std::mutex m;
    static std::mt19937 rng{std::random_device{}()};
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(m);
    auto p = static_cast<uint8_t*>(HostPtr(va));
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) p[i] = uint8_t(rng());
}

}  // namespace

namespace xnet {

void CloseSockets() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    for (auto& [id, socket] : g_sockets) ::closesocket(socket.s);
    g_sockets.clear();
    g_pending.clear();
}

HLE_STDCALL(XNetXnAddrToInAddr, 3) {
    uint32_t ina = R32(a[0]);
    if (!ina) return WSAEINVAL;
    if (ina != g_local && Private(ina) && !g_instance) {
        uint32_t join = JoinAddress(), remote = g_remote;
        if (join && !Private(join)) ina = join;
        else if (remote) ina = remote;
    }
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
        std::memcpy(g_peers[ina].data(), HostPtr(a[0]), kXnAddrSize);
    }
    W32(a[2], ina);
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(XNetInAddrToXnAddr, 3) {
    uint32_t ina = a[0];
    uint8_t x[kXnAddrSize];
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_peers.find(ina);
    if (!ina || ina == g_local) {
        OwnXnAddr(x);
    } else if (it != g_peers.end()) {
        std::memcpy(x, it->second.data(), kXnAddrSize);
    } else {
        std::memset(x, 0, kXnAddrSize);
        std::memcpy(x, &ina, 4);
    }
    if (a[1]) std::memcpy(HostPtr(a[1]), x, kXnAddrSize);
    if (a[2]) std::memcpy(HostPtr(a[2]), g_kid.data(), 8);
    return 0;
}

HLE_STDCALL(XNetDnsLookup, 3) {
    std::string name = kernel::ReadCString(a[0], 256);
    uint32_t dns = mem::AllocSystem(kXnDnsSize);
    std::memset(HostPtr(dns), 0, kXnDnsSize);
    addrinfo hints{};
    hints.ai_family = AF_INET;
    addrinfo* res = nullptr;
    uint32_t count = 0;
    if (getaddrinfo(name.c_str(), nullptr, &hints, &res) == 0) {
        for (addrinfo* r = res; r && count < 8; r = r->ai_next)
            W32(dns + 8 + 4 * count++, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr_in*>(r->ai_addr)->sin_addr.s_addr);
        freeaddrinfo(res);
    }
    W32(dns, count ? 0 : WSAHOST_NOT_FOUND);
    W32(dns + 4, count);
    W32(a[2], dns);
    LOGI("xnet: dns %s -> %u addresses", name.c_str(), count);
    Signal(a[1]);
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(XNetDnsRelease, 1) {
    if (a[0]) mem::FreeSystem(a[0]);
    return 0;
}

static uint32_t AddSocket(SOCKET s, bool udp) {
    u_long on = 1;
    ::ioctlsocket(s, FIONBIO, &on);
    if (udp) {
        BOOL off = FALSE;
        DWORD ret = 0;
        WSAIoctl(s, kUdpConnReset, &off, sizeof(off), nullptr, 0, &ret, nullptr, nullptr);
    }
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    uint32_t id = g_next_socket;
    g_next_socket += 4;
    g_sockets[id] = {s, udp, false, 0};
    return id;
}

HLE_STDCALL(socket, 3) {
    Init();
    uint32_t af = a[0], type = a[1];  // the protocol: UDP, or VDP, which is UDP between two copies of this
    if (af != AF_INET) return Fail(WSAEAFNOSUPPORT);
    bool udp = type == SOCK_DGRAM;
    if (!udp && type != SOCK_STREAM) return Fail(WSAESOCKTNOSUPPORT);
    SOCKET s = ::socket(AF_INET, int(type), udp ? IPPROTO_UDP : IPPROTO_TCP);
    if (s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(HostError());
    return AddSocket(s, udp);
}
HLE_STDCALL(closesocket, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_sockets.find(a[0]);
    if (it == g_sockets.end()) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pending.size();) {
        if (g_pending[i].sock == a[0])
            g_pending.erase(g_pending.begin() + ptrdiff_t(i));
        else
            i++;
    }
    ::closesocket(it->second.s);
    g_sockets.erase(it);
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(shutdown, 2) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    return ::shutdown(k.s, int(a[1])) == 0 ? 0 : Fail(HostError());
}
HLE_STDCALL(ioctlsocket, 3) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    auto it = g_sockets.find(a[0]);
    if (it == g_sockets.end()) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    if (a[1] == uint32_t(FIONBIO)) {
        it->second.nonblocking = R32(a[2]) != 0;
        return 0;
    }
    u_long v = R32(a[2]);
    if (::ioctlsocket(it->second.s, long(a[1]), &v) != 0) return Fail(HostError());
    W32(a[2], uint32_t(v));
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(setsockopt, 5) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    if (::setsockopt(k.s, int(a[1]), int(a[2]), static_cast<const char*>(HostPtr(a[3])), int(a[4])) == 0) return 0;
    LOG_FIRST(10, "xnet: setsockopt %X level %X option %X ignored (%d)", a[0], a[1], a[2], WSAGetLastError());
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(getsockopt, 5) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    int len = int(R32(a[4]));
    if (::getsockopt(k.s, int(a[1]), int(a[2]), static_cast<char*>(HostPtr(a[3])), &len) != 0) return Fail(WSAGetLastError());
    W32(a[4], uint32_t(len));
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(getsockname, 3) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    sockaddr_in me{};
    int len = sizeof(me);
    if (::getsockname(k.s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&me), &len) != 0) return Fail(HostError());
    std::memcpy(HostPtr(a[1]), &me, sizeof(me));
    W32(a[2], sizeof(me));
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(bind, 3) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    sockaddr_in at = GuestAddr(a[1]);
    if (g_instance && at.sin_addr.s_addr == INADDR_ANY) at.sin_addr.s_addr = g_local;
    if (::bind(k.s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&at), sizeof(at)) != 0) {
        int e = HostError();
        LOGW("xnet: bind %X to %s failed (%d)", a[0], Addr(at).c_str(), e);
        return Fail(e);
    }
    LOGI("xnet: bind %X to %s", a[0], Addr(at).c_str());
    sockaddr_in me{};
    int len = sizeof(me);
    ::getsockname(k.s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&me), &len);
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    if (auto it = g_sockets.find(a[0]); it != g_sockets.end()) it->second.port = me.sin_port;
    return 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(connect, 3) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    sockaddr_in to = GuestAddr(a[1]);
    if (::connect(k.s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&to), sizeof(to)) == 0) return 0;
    int e = HostError();
    if (e != WSAEWOULDBLOCK || k.nonblocking) return Fail(e);
    if (!Wait(k.s, true, 10000)) return Fail(WSAETIMEDOUT);
    int err = 0, len = sizeof(err);
    ::getsockopt(k.s, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ERROR, reinterpret_cast<char*>(&err), &len);
    return err ? Fail(err) : 0;
}
HLE_STDCALL(listen, 2) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    return ::listen(k.s, int(a[1])) == 0 ? 0 : Fail(WSAGetLastError());
}
HLE_STDCALL(accept, 3) {
    for (;;) {
        Socket k = Find(a[0]);
        if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
        sockaddr_in from{};
        int len = sizeof(from);
        SOCKET s = ::accept(k.s, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&from), &len);
        if (s != INVALID_SOCKET) {
            if (a[1]) std::memcpy(HostPtr(a[1]), &from, sizeof(from));
            if (a[2]) W32(a[2], sizeof(from));
            LOGI("xnet: accept %X from %s", a[0], Addr(from).c_str());
            return AddSocket(s, false);
        }
        int e = WSAGetLastError();
        if (e != WSAEWOULDBLOCK || k.nonblocking) return Fail(e);
        Wait(k.s, false, 50);
    }
}
HLE_STDCALL(select, 5) {
    uint32_t guest[3] = {a[1], a[2], a[3]};
    fd_set host[3];
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, SOCKET>> used[3];
    int total = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        FD_ZERO(&host[i]);
        if (!guest[i]) continue;
        uint32_t n = std::min(R32(guest[i]), kFdSetMax);
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            uint32_t id = R32(guest[i] + 4 + 4 * j);
            Socket k = Find(id);
            if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) continue;
            FD_SET(k.s, &host[i]);
            used[i].push_back({id, k.s});
            total++;
        }
    }
    timeval tv{};
    timeval* ptv = nullptr;
    if (a[4]) {
        tv.tv_sec = long(R32(a[4]));
        tv.tv_usec = long(R32(a[4] + 4));
        ptv = &tv;
    }
    int r = 0;
    if (!total) {
        if (ptv) Sleep(DWORD(tv.tv_sec * 1000 + tv.tv_usec / 1000));
    } else {
        r = ::select(0, guest[0] ? &host[0] : nullptr, guest[1] ? &host[1] : nullptr, guest[2] ? &host[2] : nullptr, ptv);
        if (r < 0) return Fail(HostError());
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (!guest[i]) continue;
        uint32_t k = 0;
        for (auto& [id, s] : used[i])
            if (FD_ISSET(s, &host[i])) W32(guest[i] + 4 + 4 * k++, id);
        W32(guest[i], k);
    }
    return uint32_t(r);
}

HLE_STDCALL(recvfrom, 6) {
    std::vector<Span> spans{{a[1], a[2]}};
    for (;;) {
        Socket k = Find(a[0]);
        if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
        int err = 0;
        int n;
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
            n = Recv(a[0], k.s, spans, a[4], a[5], err);
        }
        if (n >= 0) return uint32_t(n);
        if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK || k.nonblocking) return Fail(err);
        Wait(k.s, false, 50);
    }
}
// stream sockets; a reset connection is an error here, not a stale port unreachable reply
HLE_STDCALL(recv, 4) {
    for (;;) {
        Socket k = Find(a[0]);
        if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
        int n = ::recv(k.s, static_cast<char*>(HostPtr(a[1])), int(a[2]), int(a[3]));
        if (n >= 0) return uint32_t(n);
        int e = WSAGetLastError();
        if (e != WSAEWOULDBLOCK || k.nonblocking) return Fail(e);
        Wait(k.s, false, 50);
    }
}
HLE_STDCALL(send, 4) {
    for (;;) {
        Socket k = Find(a[0]);
        if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
        int n = ::send(k.s, static_cast<const char*>(HostPtr(a[1])), int(a[2]), int(a[3]));
        if (n >= 0) return uint32_t(n);
        int e = WSAGetLastError();
        if (e != WSAEWOULDBLOCK || k.nonblocking) return Fail(e);
        Wait(k.s, true, 50);
    }
}
HLE_STDCALL(sendto, 6) {
    Socket k = Find(a[0]);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    sockaddr_in to{};
    if (a[4]) to = GuestAddr(a[4]);
    int n = Send(a[0], k.s, static_cast<const uint8_t*>(HostPtr(a[1])), int(a[2]), a[4] ? &to : nullptr);
    return n < 0 ? Fail(HostError()) : uint32_t(n);
}

namespace {

uint32_t SendOverlapped(uint32_t sock, uint32_t bufs, uint32_t count, uint32_t sent, uint32_t to_va, uint32_t ovl) {
    Socket k = Find(sock);
    if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
    auto data = Gather(bufs, count);
    sockaddr_in to{};
    if (to_va) to = GuestAddr(to_va);
    int n = Send(sock, k.s, data.data(), int(data.size()), to_va ? &to : nullptr);
    if (n < 0) return Fail(HostError());
    if (sent) W32(sent, uint32_t(n));
    if (ovl) Complete(ovl, 0, uint32_t(n));
    return 0;
}

uint32_t RecvOverlapped(uint32_t sock, uint32_t bufs, uint32_t count, uint32_t received, uint32_t flags, uint32_t from,
                        uint32_t fromlen, uint32_t ovl) {
    PendingRecv p{sock, ovl, from, fromlen, Spans(bufs, count)};
    for (;;) {
        Socket k = Find(sock);
        if (k.s == INVALID_SOCKET) return Fail(WSAENOTSOCK);
        std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
        int err = 0;
        int n = Recv(sock, k.s, p.spans, from, fromlen, err);
        if (n >= 0) {
            if (received) W32(received, uint32_t(n));
            if (flags) W32(flags, 0);
            if (ovl) Complete(ovl, 0, uint32_t(n));
            return 0;
        }
        if (err != WSAEWOULDBLOCK) return Fail(err);
        if (ovl) {
            W32(ovl + kOvlStatus, kOvlPending);
            if (auto o = kernel::FromHandle(R32(ovl + kOvlEvent))) kernel::ResetEvent(*o);
            g_pending.push_back(std::move(p));
            return Fail(WSA_IO_PENDING);
        }
        if (k.nonblocking) return Fail(err);
        lock.unlock();
        Wait(k.s, false, 50);
    }
}

}  // namespace

HLE_STDCALL(WSARecvFrom, 9) { return RecvOverlapped(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], a[5], a[6], a[7]); }
HLE_STDCALL(WSARecv, 7) { return RecvOverlapped(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[4], 0, 0, a[5]); }
HLE_STDCALL(WSASendTo, 9) { return SendOverlapped(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], a[5], a[7]); }
HLE_STDCALL(WSASend, 7) { return SendOverlapped(a[0], a[1], a[2], a[3], 0, a[5]); }

HLE_STDCALL(WSAGetOverlappedResult, 5) {
    uint32_t ovl = a[1];
    for (;;) {
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
            auto it = std::find_if(g_pending.begin(), g_pending.end(), [&](const PendingRecv& p) { return p.ovl == ovl; });
            if (it == g_pending.end() || TryComplete(*it)) {
                if (it != g_pending.end()) g_pending.erase(it);
                uint32_t status = R32(ovl + kOvlStatus);
                if (status == kOvlPending) {
                    t_error = WSA_IO_INCOMPLETE;
                    return 0;
                }
                if (a[2]) W32(a[2], R32(ovl + kOvlBytes));
                if (a[4]) W32(a[4], 0);
                if (status) {
                    t_error = status;
                    return 0;
                }
                return 1;
            }
        }
        if (!a[3]) {
            t_error = WSA_IO_INCOMPLETE;
            return 0;
        }
        Sleep(1);
    }
}
HLE_STDCALL(WSACancelOverlappedIO, 1) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(g_lock);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < g_pending.size();) {
        if (g_pending[i].sock == a[0]) {
            Complete(g_pending[i].ovl, WSA_OPERATION_ABORTED, 0);
            g_pending.erase(g_pending.begin() + ptrdiff_t(i));
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

```

```txt
# Game Title (original Xbox), statically recompiled

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)

    set(SDK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk)
elseif(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake)
    set(SDK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../..)
elseif(EXISTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../XboxXBE-Recomp/cmake/XbeRecomp.cmake)
    set(SDK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../XboxXBE-Recomp)

    include(FetchContent)
    FetchContent_Declare(xbe_sdk GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp.git GIT_TAG main)
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(xbe_sdk)

file(GLOB XBE_HOST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS src/*/*.cpp)
list(FILTER XBE_HOST_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "/src/game/")

# partitions as xbe_symbols wrote them into config/game.toml

    set(GAME_PARTITIONS 8)
```

`sdk/templates/game/README.md`:

```md
# Game Title - XBE Recomp

An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Game Title, with extended graphics options and other enhancements.

This port was created using the [Xbox XBE Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp) tool.

> [!NOTE]
> This project does not include any game assets. You must provide the files from your own legally acquired copy of the game to install or build.

## Installation

- Put your game files in the `assets` folder. This can be an ISO, or the extracted data files.
- Run `Game.exe`. The first start compiles the game's code for your PC, this only happens once.
- Recomp settings can be adjusted in `settings.toml` beside the exe.

## Features

### Display


### Graphics

### Controller
Supports Xbox, PlayStation and Switch controllers, with hot plugging and rumble.

### General

### Miscellaneous
- **Boot Splash** - Place a `splash.png` (or `.bmp`) beside the exe to display a splash screen at launch.

## System Requirements

### Minimum
- **OS**
  - Windows 10 64-bit
- **GPU** with support for Direct3D 12

## Building

### 1. Clone the Repository
Clone this repository using [Git](https://git-scm.com/).

### 2. Add the Required Game Files
Place your extracted game data files in the `assets` folder. `default.xbe` must be there, with the game's folders beside it.

### 3. Install Dependencies
Install Visual Studio 2022 with **Desktop development with C++**, **C++ Clang tools for Windows** and **C++ CMake tools for Windows** (`build.bat` offers to add the last two).

### 4. Build the Project
Run `build.bat`. The first build recompiles the game and takes a while. The exe is written to `out\build\release`.

## Credits

- [Xbox XBE Recomp](https://github.com/TGP482/XboxXBE-Recomp), the recompiler and runtime this is built on.
- [XenonRecomp](https://github.com/hedge-dev/XenonRecomp) for the overridable function layout and instruction hooks.
- [Zydis](https://github.com/zyantific/zydis) for decoding x86 instructions, [toml++](https://github.com/marzer/tomlplusplus) for the configs, [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) for the settings overlay and [SDL](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL) for the window, input and controllers.

```

```toml
# Placeholder. build.bat replaces it on the first build with the config xbe_symbols writes for the game's XBE:
#   out\build\release\xbe_symbols.exe assets\default.xbe <sdk>\xdk --out config\game.toml
# Names left at 0 become trapping stubs; find them in Ghidra
# (python <sdk>\tools\symbols\xbe2pe.py config\game.toml game.exe) and fill them in by hand.
[xbe]
path = "assets/default.xbe"
out = "generated/game"
partitions = 64

# Optional fixes, added by hand:
# data_ranges = [[0x00150000, 0x00150040]]  # in [xbe]: bytes in code sections that are never code, end exclusive
#
# [[hook]]                   # calls void FixSomething(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base), defined by the game
# at = 0x0012ABCD            # guest instruction inside a recompiled function
# call = "FixSomething"
# after = false              # true runs it after the instruction (not after jumps or ret)
# on_true = "ret"            # with on_true or on_false the hook returns bool: "ret" returns as the function's ret does,
# on_false = 0x0012AC00      # an address jumps to that instruction of the same function
#
# [[function]]               # entry the analysis missed or ran past
# at = 0x00123450
# end = 0x00123520           # optional, decode no further (exclusive)
#
# [[switch]]                 # indirect jmp whose table detection was wrong
# at = 0x00123480
# targets = [0x00123490, 0x001234A8]
#
# [abi]
# D3D_InternalRelease = ["esi"]            # argument locations in API order for a link time code generated library:
# D3D_MakeRequestedSpace = ["eax", "stack"]  # a register, or "stack" for the next stack slot
```

```bat
@echo off
set "GAME_EXE=Game"
cd /d "%~dp0"
set "OUT=out\build\release"
rem the Visual C++ runtime beside the executable, so a fresh Windows install needs nothing more
set "VSWHERE=%ProgramFiles(x86)%\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe"
for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%i in (`"%VSWHERE%" -latest -products * -property installationPath`) do set "VSDIR=%%i"
for /d %%v in ("%VSDIR%\VC\Redist\MSVC\1*") do for /d %%c in ("%%v\x64\Microsoft.VC*.CRT") do set "VCRUNTIME=%%c"
if not exist "%VCRUNTIME%\vcruntime140.dll" (echo Visual C++ runtime not found: install Visual Studio with the C++ workload & exit /b 1)
if not exist "%OUT%\%GAME_EXE%.exe" call build.bat || exit /b 1
rem the configure step writes where the SDK is
if not exist "%OUT%\sdk_dir.txt" cmake --preset release >nul || exit /b 1
if not exist "%OUT%\sdk_dir.txt" echo %OUT%\sdk_dir.txt was not written, update the SDK. && exit /b 1
set /p SDK=<out\build\release\sdk_dir.txt
del /q "%GAME_EXE%.zip" 2>nul
rem an empty assets folder beside the exe, where the game (files or .iso) goes
rd /s /q "%OUT%\release" 2>nul
mkdir "%OUT%\release\assets"
rem only the runtime DLLs the executables import; xbe_recomp.exe needs its own copy, Windows only looks beside the
rem exe it starts
del /q "%OUT%\compiler\*.dll" 2>nul
for %%f in (msvcp140 vcruntime140) do copy /y "%VCRUNTIME%\%%f.dll" "%OUT%\compiler\" >nul
rem the compiler folder without its work folder: no game code goes in the zip, the first start builds it
7z a "%GAME_EXE%.zip" ".\%OUT%\%GAME_EXE%.exe" ".\%OUT%\release\assets" ".\%OUT%\compiler" .\README.md "%SDK%\THIRD_PARTY.txt" "%VCRUNTIME%\msvcp140.dll" "%VCRUNTIME%\vcruntime140.dll" "%VCRUNTIME%\vcruntime140_1.dll" -xr!work
```
