`sdk/tools/recomp/analysis.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "analysis.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <deque>

Analysis::Analysis(const xbe::Image& image, const Config& config) : img(image), cfg(config) {
    ZydisDecoderInit(&dec_, ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, ZYDIS_STACK_WIDTH_32);
    auto is_code = [&](const xbe::Section& s) {
        for (auto& n : cfg.code_sections)
            if (s.name == n) return true;
        for (auto& p : cfg.code_prefixes)
            if (s.name.rfind(p, 0) == 0) return true;
        return false;
    };
    lo_ = 0xFFFFFFFF;
    for (auto& s : img.sections)
        if (is_code(s)) {
            lo_ = std::min(lo_, s.va);
            hi_ = std::max(hi_, s.va + s.rsize);
        }
    code_.assign(hi_ - lo_, 0);
    cover_.assign(hi_ - lo_, 0);
    for (auto& s : img.sections)
        if (is_code(s))
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < s.rsize; i++) code_[s.va - lo_ + i] = 1;
    for (auto& r : cfg.data_ranges)
        for (uint32_t a = r.first; a < r.second; a++)
            if (a >= lo_ && a < hi_) cover_[a - lo_] = 3;
}

const uint8_t* Analysis::Bytes(uint32_t va, uint32_t& avail) const {
    int64_t o = img.Offset(va);
    if (o < 0) return nullptr;
    const xbe::Section* s = img.SectionAt(va);
    uint32_t end = s ? s->va + s->rsize : va;
    avail = end > va ? end - va : 0;
    return img.file.data() + o;
}

bool Analysis::Decode(uint32_t va, ZydisDecodedInstruction& insn, ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) const {
    uint32_t avail = 0;
    const uint8_t* p = Bytes(va, avail);
    if (!p || !avail) return false;
    return ZYAN_SUCCESS(ZydisDecoderDecodeFull(&dec_, p, std::min<uint32_t>(avail, 15), &insn, ops));
}

bool Analysis::ReadTable(uint32_t jmp_va, const ZydisDecodedOperand& mem, JumpTable& jt) {
    jt.insn = jmp_va;
    jt.table = uint32_t(mem.mem.disp.value);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
        uint32_t t;
        if (!img.Read32(jt.table + i * 4, t)) break;
        if (!IsCode(t)) {
            if (i == 0 && jt.table == uint32_t(mem.mem.disp.value)) {
                // index 0 unused, its slot overlaps code: the table proper starts one entry later
                jt.table += 4;
                i = uint32_t(-1);
                continue;
            }
            break;
        }
        if (i && jt.table + i * 4 >= lo_ && jt.table + i * 4 < hi_ && cover_[jt.table + i * 4 - lo_] == 1) break;
        jt.targets.push_back(t);
        jt.slots.push_back(jt.table + i * 4);
    }
    // "neg idx; jmp [idx*4 + table]" indexes a table that ends at its base
    uint32_t avail = 0;
    const uint8_t* p = Bytes(jmp_va - 2, avail);
    bool neg = p && avail >= 2 && p[0] == 0xF7 && (p[1] & 0xF8) == 0xD8 && ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX + (p[1] & 7) == mem.mem.index;
    if (neg || jt.targets.empty()) {
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < 64; i++) {
            uint32_t t;
            if (!img.Read32(uint32_t(mem.mem.disp.value) - i * 4, t) || !IsCode(t) || (t > jmp_va ? t - jmp_va : jmp_va - t) > 0x1000) break;
            jt.targets.push_back(t);
            jt.slots.push_back(uint32_t(mem.mem.disp.value) - i * 4);
        }
    }
    return !jt.targets.empty();
}

static bool IsCond(ZydisMnemonic m) {
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNZ:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JZ:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JCXZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JECXZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPNE:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

bool Analysis::DecodeFlow(uint32_t va, Insn& out, JumpTable* jt) {
    ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
    ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
    if (!Decode(va, in, ops)) return false;
    out.len = in.length;
    out.flow = Flow::Normal;
    out.target = 0;
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CALL) {
        if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
            out.flow = Flow::Call;
            out.target = uint32_t(va + in.length + ops[0].imm.value.s);
        } else {
            out.flow = Flow::CallIndirect;
        }
    } else if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JMP) {
        if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
            out.flow = Flow::Jmp;
            out.target = uint32_t(va + in.length + ops[0].imm.value.s);
        } else {
            out.flow = Flow::JmpIndirect;
            if (jt && ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY && ops[0].mem.base == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE &&
                ops[0].mem.index != ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE && ops[0].mem.scale == 4 && ops[0].mem.disp.has_displacement)
                ReadTable(va, ops[0], *jt);
        }
    } else if (IsCond(m)) {
        out.flow = Flow::Jcc;
        out.target = uint32_t(va + in.length + ops[0].imm.value.s);
    } else if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RET) {
        out.flow = Flow::Ret;
    } else if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IRETD || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IRET || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INT3 ||
               m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_HLT || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UD2 || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UD0 ||
               m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UD1 || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INTO || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BOUND) {
        out.flow = Flow::Stop;
    } else if (in.meta.category == ZYDIS_CATEGORY_RET) {
        out.flow = Flow::Stop;  // far returns
    } else if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JMP || in.meta.category == ZYDIS_CATEGORY_UNCOND_BR) {
        out.flow = Flow::Stop;  // far jumps
    }
    return true;
}

// "and r, mask; neg r; add r, end; jmp r": a jump back into a run of one byte instructions ending at end, as the
// MSVC memcpy tail copies its last dwords with a sled of movsd
bool Analysis::SledTable(uint32_t jmp_va, const uint32_t* ring, int nring, JumpTable& jt) {
    ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
    ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
    if (!Decode(jmp_va, in, ops) || ops[0].type != ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER) return false;
    ZydisRegister r = ops[0].reg.value;
    // add right before the jump, then neg and and further back past instructions that leave r alone
    const ZydisMnemonic want[3] = {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADD, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_NEG, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_AND};
    uint32_t imm[3] = {};
    int k = 0;
    for (int back = 2; back <= std::min(nring, 8) && k < 3; back++) {
        if (!Decode(ring[(nring - back) & 7], in, ops)) return false;
        bool writes_r = ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER &&
                        ZydisRegisterGetLargestEnclosing(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, ops[0].reg.value) == r;
        if (in.mnemonic == want[k] && writes_r && (k == 1 || ops[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE)) {
            imm[k] = k == 1 ? 0 : uint32_t(ops[1].imm.value.u);
            k++;
        } else if (writes_r || k == 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (k < 3) return false;
    if (imm[2] > 255) return false;
    jt.insn = jmp_va;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i <= imm[2]; i++)
        if (IsCode(imm[0] - i)) jt.targets.push_back(imm[0] - i);
    return !jt.targets.empty();
}

bool Analysis::Walk(uint32_t entry, bool trusted, std::vector<uint32_t>* calls) {
    struct Pending {
        uint32_t va;
        Insn insn;
    };
    std::vector<Pending> local;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, uint8_t> seen;
    std::vector<JumpTable> tables;
    std::vector<uint32_t> found_calls;
    std::vector<uint32_t> work{entry};
    uint32_t stop = 0;
    if (auto e = cfg.function_ends.find(entry); e != cfg.function_ends.end()) stop = e->second;
    auto conflict = [&](uint32_t va, uint32_t len) {
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            uint32_t a = va + i;
            if (!IsCode(a)) return true;
            uint8_t c = cover_[a - lo_];
            if (c == 3 || (c == 1 && i) || (c == 2)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    };
    while (!work.empty()) {
        uint32_t va = work.back();
        work.pop_back();
        uint32_t ring[8] = {};
        int nring = 0;
        for (;;) {
            if (insns_.count(va) || seen.count(va)) break;
            if ((va != entry && cfg.function_ends.count(va)) || (stop && va >= stop)) break;
            if (!IsCode(va)) {
                if (trusted) break;
                return false;
            }
            if (cover_[va - lo_] != 0 && (!trusted || cover_[va - lo_] == 3)) {
                if (trusted) break;
                return false;
            }
            Insn insn;
            JumpTable jt;
            if (!DecodeFlow(va, insn, &jt)) {
                if (!trusted) return false;
                insn.len = 1;
                insn.flow = Flow::Invalid;
                local.push_back({va, insn});
                seen[va] = 1;
                break;
            }
            if (stop && va + insn.len > stop) break;
            if (conflict(va, insn.len)) {
                // real control flow wins over a guessed entry decoded across these bytes: both decodes are kept
                bool data = false;
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < insn.len; i++) data |= !IsCode(va + i) || cover_[va + i - lo_] == 3;
                if (!trusted) return false;
                if (data) break;
            }
            local.push_back({va, insn});
            seen[va] = 1;
            ring[nring++ & 7] = va;
            if (insn.flow == Flow::Call) {
                if (insn.target == va + insn.len) {
                    // call $+5 pushes eip only
                } else if (IsCode(insn.target)) {
                    found_calls.push_back(insn.target);
                } else if (!trusted) {
                    return false;
                }
            } else if (insn.flow == Flow::Jcc) {
                if (!IsCode(insn.target) && !trusted) return false;
                work.push_back(insn.target);
            } else if (insn.flow == Flow::Jmp) {
                if (!IsCode(insn.target) && !trusted) return false;
                work.push_back(insn.target);
                break;
            } else if (insn.flow == Flow::JmpIndirect) {
                if (auto s = cfg.switches.find(va); s != cfg.switches.end()) {
                    jt = JumpTable{va, 0, s->second, {}};
                    for (uint32_t t : jt.targets) work.push_back(t);
                    tables.push_back(jt);
                } else if (jt.targets.empty() && SledTable(va, ring, nring, jt)) {
                    for (uint32_t t : jt.targets) work.push_back(t);
                    tables.push_back(jt);
                } else if (!jt.targets.empty()) {
                    // bound the table from a preceding "cmp idx, n"
                    ZydisDecodedInstruction ji;
                    ZydisDecodedOperand jo[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
                    Decode(va, ji, jo);
                    ZydisRegister idx = jo[0].mem.index;
                    uint32_t bound = 0;
                    uint32_t byte_table = 0;
                    ZydisRegister byte_idx = ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE;
                    for (int k = 1; k < 4 && k < nring; k++) {
                        uint32_t pa = ring[(nring - 1 - k) & 7];
                        ZydisDecodedInstruction pi;
                        ZydisDecodedOperand po[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
                        if (!Decode(pa, pi, po)) break;
                        if (pi.mnemonic == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVZX && po[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER &&
                            ZydisRegisterGetLargestEnclosing(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, po[0].reg.value) == idx &&
                            po[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY && po[1].size == 8 &&
                            po[1].mem.base != ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE && po[1].mem.disp.has_displacement) {
                            byte_table = uint32_t(po[1].mem.disp.value);
                            byte_idx = po[1].mem.base;
                        }
                        if (pi.mnemonic == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMP && po[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER &&
                            po[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
                            ZydisRegister r = ZydisRegisterGetLargestEnclosing(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, po[0].reg.value);
                            if (r == idx || r == byte_idx) bound = uint32_t(po[1].imm.value.u) + 1;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (bound && bound < 4096) {
                        uint32_t n = bound;
                        if (byte_table) {
                            uint32_t mx = 0;
                            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bound; i++) {
                                int64_t o = img.Offset(byte_table + i);
                                if (o >= 0) mx = std::max<uint32_t>(mx, img.file[size_t(o)]);
                                if (byte_table + i >= lo_ && byte_table + i < hi_) cover_[byte_table + i - lo_] = 3;
                            }
                            n = mx + 1;
                        }
                        jt.targets.clear();
                        jt.slots.clear();
                        uint32_t base = uint32_t(ji.operand_count ? jo[0].mem.disp.value : jt.table);
                        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                            uint32_t t;
                            if (!img.Read32(base + i * 4, t)) break;
                            jt.targets.push_back(t);
                            jt.slots.push_back(base + i * 4);
                        }
                    }
                    if (!bound && byte_table) {
                        // unbounded index table: it runs while its bytes index the dword table
                        for (uint32_t a = byte_table; a >= lo_ && a < hi_ && a - byte_table < 4096 && cover_[a - lo_] == 0; a++) {
                            int64_t o = img.Offset(a);
                            if (o < 0 || img.file[size_t(o)] >= jt.targets.size()) break;
                            cover_[a - lo_] = 3;
                        }
                    }
                    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < jt.targets.size(); i++) {
                        uint32_t a = jt.slots[i];
                        if (a >= lo_ && a + 4 <= hi_)
                            for (int b = 0; b < 4; b++) cover_[a + b - lo_] = 3;
                        if (IsCode(jt.targets[i])) work.push_back(jt.targets[i]);
                    }
                    tables.push_back(jt);
                }
                break;
            } else if (insn.flow == Flow::Ret || insn.flow == Flow::Stop) {
                break;
            }
            va += insn.len;
            if (functions.count(va) && va != entry) break;  // fall into the next function
        }
    }
    for (auto& p : local) {
        insns_[p.va] = p.insn;
        if (p.va >= lo_ && p.va < hi_) {
            cover_[p.va - lo_] = 1;
            for (uint32_t i = 1; i < p.insn.len && p.va + i < hi_; i++) cover_[p.va + i - lo_] = 2;
        }
    }
    for (auto& t : tables) jump_tables[t.insn] = t;
    if (calls) calls->insert(calls->end(), found_calls.begin(), found_calls.end());
    return true;
}

// an untrusted entry must follow padding, a return or an unconditional jump
bool Analysis::PlausibleEntry(uint32_t va) const {
    const xbe::Section* sec = img.SectionAt(va);
    if (sec && sec->va == va) return true;
    auto byte = [&](uint32_t a) -> int {
        int64_t o = img.Offset(a);
        return o < 0 ? -1 : img.file[size_t(o)];
    };
    if (va >= lo_ && va < hi_ && cover_[va - lo_] == 1) {
        // inside decoded code: only right after a jmp, ret or padding
        int pb = byte(va - 1);
        if ((pb == 0xCC || pb == 0x90) && va > lo_ && cover_[va - 1 - lo_] == 0) return true;
        for (uint32_t n = 1; n <= 15 && va >= lo_ + n; n++) {
            auto it = insns_.find(va - n);
            if (it == insns_.end() || it->second.len != n) continue;
            Flow f = it->second.flow;
            if (f == Flow::Jmp || f == Flow::JmpIndirect || f == Flow::Ret || f == Flow::Stop) return true;
            int b = byte(va - n);
            return b == 0xCC || b == 0x90;
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (va > lo_ && cover_[va - 1 - lo_] == 3) return true;  // right after a jump table
    int p1 = byte(va - 1);
    if (p1 == 0xCC || p1 == 0x90 || p1 == 0xC3) return true;  // int3 or nop padding, ret
    if (byte(va - 3) == 0xC2 && byte(va - 1) == 0) return true;  // ret n, n below 256
    if (va >= lo_ + 5 && byte(va - 5) == 0xE9 && cover_[va - 5 - lo_] == 1) return true;  // jmp rel32
    if (va >= lo_ + 2 && byte(va - 2) == 0xEB && cover_[va - 2 - lo_] == 1) return true;  // jmp rel8
    if (byte(va - 6) == 0xFF && byte(va - 5) == 0x25) return true;  // jmp [import]
    if (byte(va - 2) == 0xFF && (byte(va - 1) & 0xF8) == 0xE0) return true;  // jmp reg
    for (uint32_t n = 1; n <= 15 && va >= lo_ + n; n++) {
        auto it = insns_.find(va - n);
        if (it == insns_.end() || it->second.len != n) continue;
        Flow f = it->second.flow;
        if (f == Flow::Jmp || f == Flow::JmpIndirect || f == Flow::Ret) return true;
    }
    return false;
}

void Analysis::Adopt(const std::vector<uint32_t>& calls, bool trusted) {
    std::deque<std::pair<uint32_t, bool>> q;
    for (uint32_t c : calls) q.push_back({c, trusted});
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [f, tr] = q.front();
        q.pop_front();
        if (functions.count(f)) continue;
        if (!IsCode(f)) continue;
        uint8_t cov = cover_[f - lo_];
        if (cov == 2 || cov == 3) continue;  // lands inside an instruction or data
        std::vector<uint32_t> more;
        if (cov == 1) {
            functions.insert(f);
            continue;
        }
        if (!Walk(f, tr, &more)) continue;
        functions.insert(f);
        for (uint32_t m : more) q.push_back({m, tr});
    }
}

void Analysis::SeedPointers(bool late) {
    std::vector<uint32_t> cands;
    std::set<uint32_t> vtable;  // runs of code pointers, entries even without padding before them
    for (auto& s : img.sections) {
        bool code = false;
        for (auto& n : cfg.code_sections) code |= s.name == n;
        for (auto& p : cfg.code_prefixes) code |= s.name.rfind(p, 0) == 0;
        uint32_t start = s.raw, end = s.raw + s.rsize;
        for (uint32_t o = start; o + 4 <= end; o += (code ? 1 : 4)) {
            uint32_t v = img.U32(o);
            if (!IsCode(v)) continue;
            if (code) continue;  // pointers inside code sections come only from jump tables
            cands.push_back(v);
            if ((o >= start + 4 && IsCode(img.U32(o - 4))) || (o + 8 <= end && IsCode(img.U32(o + 4)))) vtable.insert(v);
        }
    }
    std::sort(cands.begin(), cands.end());
    cands.erase(std::unique(cands.begin(), cands.end()), cands.end());
    size_t added = 0, rejected = 0;
    // late: seeds rejected before the code above them was decoded, then decoded as the tail of the function that
    // jumps to them. A conditional jump target is a label inside a function.
    std::set<uint32_t> labels;
    if (late)
        for (auto& [va, insn] : insns_)
            if (insn.flow == Flow::Jcc) labels.insert(insn.target);
    for (uint32_t c : cands) {
        if (functions.count(c)) continue;
        uint8_t cov = cover_[c - lo_];
        if (late) {
            if (cov == 1 && PlausibleEntry(c) && !labels.count(c)) {
                functions.insert(c);
                added++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        bool vt = vtable.count(c) != 0;
        if (cov == 1) {
            if (PlausibleEntry(c) || (vt && insns_.count(c))) {
                functions.insert(c);
                added++;
            } else {
                rejected++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if (cov != 0 || !PlausibleEntry(c)) {
            rejected++;
            continue;
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
        if (Walk(c, false, &calls)) {
            functions.insert(c);
            added++;
            Adopt(calls, false);
        } else {
            rejected++;
        }
    }
    if (late) std::fprintf(stderr, "late pointer seeds: %zu\n", added);
    else std::fprintf(stderr, "pointer seeds: %zu accepted, %zu rejected\n", added, rejected);
}

void Analysis::GapFill() {
    size_t added = 0;
    for (uint32_t va = lo_; va < hi_;) {
        if (!code_[va - lo_] || cover_[va - lo_] != 0) {
            va++;
            continue;
        }
        int64_t o = img.Offset(va);
        uint8_t b = o >= 0 ? img.file[size_t(o)] : 0;
        if (b == 0xCC || b == 0x90 || b == 0x00 || !PlausibleEntry(va)) {
            va++;
            continue;
        }
        std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
        if (Walk(va, false, &calls)) {
            functions.insert(va);
            added++;
            Adopt(calls, false);
        } else {
            va++;
        }
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "gap fill: %zu functions\n", added);
}

void Analysis::Run() {
    std::deque<uint32_t> q;
    q.push_back(img.entry);
    for (auto& f : cfg.functions) q.push_back(f.first);
    auto drain = [&] {
        while (!q.empty()) {
            uint32_t f = q.front();
            q.pop_front();
            if (functions.count(f) || !IsCode(f)) continue;
            functions.insert(f);
            std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
            Walk(f, true, &calls);
            q.insert(q.end(), calls.begin(), calls.end());
        }
    };
    drain();
    std::fprintf(stderr, "direct: %zu functions, %zu instructions\n", functions.size(), insns_.size());
    if (cfg.pointer_seeds) SeedPointers();
    if (cfg.gap_fill) GapFill();
    // immediates that point at code are callbacks: make sure they are entries
    size_t imm = 0;
    std::vector<uint32_t> extra;
    for (auto& [va, insn] : insns_) {
        if (insn.flow != Flow::Normal) continue;
        ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
        ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
        if (!Decode(va, in, ops)) continue;
        if (in.mnemonic != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUSH && in.mnemonic != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOV) continue;
        for (int i = 0; i < in.operand_count_visible; i++)
            if (ops[i].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
                uint32_t v = uint32_t(ops[i].imm.value.u);
                if (IsCode(v) && !functions.count(v) && PlausibleEntry(v)) extra.push_back(v);
            }
    }
    std::sort(extra.begin(), extra.end());
    extra.erase(std::unique(extra.begin(), extra.end()), extra.end());
    for (uint32_t v : extra) {
        if (functions.count(v)) continue;
        uint8_t cov = cover_[v - lo_];
        if (cov == 1) {
            functions.insert(v);
            imm++;
        } else if (cov == 0) {
            std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
            if (Walk(v, false, &calls)) {
                functions.insert(v);
                imm++;
                Adopt(calls, false);
            }
        }
    }
    EhContinuations();
    // every direct call from decoded code names a function
    for (bool changed = true; changed;) {
        changed = false;
        std::vector<uint32_t> targets;
        for (auto& [va, insn] : insns_)
            if (insn.flow == Flow::Call && IsCode(insn.target) && !functions.count(insn.target)) targets.push_back(insn.target);
        for (uint32_t t : targets) {
            if (functions.count(t)) continue;
            uint8_t cov = cover_[t - lo_];
            if (cov == 2 || cov == 3) continue;
            std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
            if (cov == 0) Walk(t, true, &calls);
            functions.insert(t);
            changed = true;
        }
    }
    if (cfg.pointer_seeds) SeedPointers(true);
    size_t bytes = 0, overlaps = 0;
    for (auto& [va, insn] : insns_) {
        bytes += insn.len;
        for (uint32_t i = 1; i < insn.len; i++)
            if (insns_.count(va + i)) overlaps++;
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "overlapping decodes: %zu\n", overlaps);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "total: %zu functions, %zu instructions, %zu code bytes of %u, %zu jump tables, %zu callback entries\n",
                 functions.size(), insns_.size(), bytes, hi_ - lo_, jump_tables.size(), imm);
}

void Analysis::MakeFunction(uint32_t va) {
    if (functions.count(va) || !IsCode(va)) return;
    uint8_t cov = cover_[va - lo_];
    if (cov == 2 || cov == 3) return;
    std::vector<uint32_t> calls;
    if (cov == 0) Walk(va, true, &calls);
    functions.insert(va);
}

// MSVC C++ EH: a frame's handler thunk is "mov eax, FuncInfo; jmp __CxxFrameHandler". Its catch blocks and unwind
// actions are called through pointers, and a catch block returns in eax where its function resumes.
void Analysis::EhContinuations() {
    std::vector<uint32_t> thunks(functions.begin(), functions.end());
    size_t catches = 0;
    for (uint32_t f : thunks) {
        ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
        ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
        if (!Decode(f, in, ops) || in.mnemonic != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOV || ops[0].type != ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER ||
            ops[0].reg.value != ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX || ops[1].type != ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE)
            continue;
        uint32_t info = uint32_t(ops[1].imm.value.u), magic = 0, max_state = 0, unwind = 0, tries = 0, map = 0;
        if (!Decode(f + in.length, in, ops) || in.mnemonic != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JMP) continue;
        // FuncInfo: magic, maxState, pUnwindMap, nTryBlocks, pTryBlockMap
        if (!img.Read32(info, magic) || magic < 0x19930520 || magic > 0x19930522) continue;
        img.Read32(info + 4, max_state);
        img.Read32(info + 8, unwind);
        img.Read32(info + 12, tries);
        img.Read32(info + 16, map);
        // unwind map entries are 8 bytes, the action at +4
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < max_state && i < 4096; i++) {
            uint32_t action = 0;
            if (img.Read32(unwind + i * 8 + 4, action) && action) MakeFunction(action);
        }
        // try blocks are 20 bytes, nCatches at +12, handler array at +16; handlers are 16 bytes, the address at +12
        for (uint32_t t = 0; t < tries && t < 1024; t++) {
            uint32_t count = 0, handlers = 0;
            img.Read32(map + t * 20 + 12, count);
            img.Read32(map + t * 20 + 16, handlers);
            for (uint32_t h = 0; h < count && h < 64; h++) {
                uint32_t block = 0;
                if (!img.Read32(handlers + h * 16 + 12, block) || !IsCode(block)) continue;
                MakeFunction(block);
                // the block's rets are "mov eax, continuation; ret"
                std::vector<uint32_t> body = Body(block);
                for (size_t k = 1; k < body.size(); k++) {
                    const Insn* r = InsnAt(body[k]);
                    if (!r || r->flow != Flow::Ret || !Decode(body[k - 1], in, ops) || body[k - 1] + in.length != body[k]) continue;
                    if (in.mnemonic == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOV && ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER &&
                        ops[0].reg.value == ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX && ops[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE &&
                        IsCode(uint32_t(ops[1].imm.value.u))) {
                        uint32_t c = uint32_t(ops[1].imm.value.u);
                        MakeFunction(c);
                        if (functions.count(c)) continuations.insert(c);
                    }
                }
                catches++;
            }
        }
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "c++ eh: %zu catch blocks, %zu continuations\n", catches, continuations.size());
}

std::vector<uint32_t> Analysis::Body(uint32_t entry) const {
    std::vector<uint32_t> out;
    std::set<uint32_t> seen;
    std::vector<uint32_t> work{entry};
    uint32_t stop = 0;
    if (auto e = cfg.function_ends.find(entry); e != cfg.function_ends.end()) stop = e->second;
    while (!work.empty()) {
        uint32_t va = work.back();
        work.pop_back();
        if (seen.count(va)) continue;
        if (va != entry && functions.count(va)) continue;
        auto it = insns_.find(va);
        if (it == insns_.end()) continue;
        if (stop && va + it->second.len > stop) continue;
        seen.insert(va);
        out.push_back(va);
        const Insn& in = it->second;
        uint32_t next = va + in.len;
        switch (in.flow) {
            case Flow::Normal:
            case Flow::Call:
            case Flow::CallIndirect:
                work.push_back(next);
                break;
            case Flow::Jcc:
                work.push_back(next);
                work.push_back(in.target);
                break;
            case Flow::Jmp:
                work.push_back(in.target);
                break;
            case Flow::JmpIndirect: {
                auto jt = jump_tables.find(va);
                if (jt != jump_tables.end())
                    for (uint32_t t : jt->second.targets) work.push_back(t);
                break;
            }
            default:
                break;
        }
    }
    std::sort(out.begin(), out.end());
    return out;
}

```

`sdk/tools/recomp/analysis.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <Zydis/Zydis.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <vector>

#include "xbe/xbe.h"

struct Hook {
    struct Exit {
        bool set = false, ret = false;
        uint32_t to = 0;
    };
    uint32_t at = 0;
    std::string call;
    bool after = false;
    Exit on_true, on_false;
    bool Returns() const { return on_true.set || on_false.set; }
};

struct Config {
    std::string xbe_path;
    uint32_t title = 0, entry = 0;  // the image xbe_symbols wrote the config for, 0 = unchecked
    std::set<uint32_t> trace;       // functions whose calls and results are logged
    std::string out_dir;
    std::vector<std::string> code_sections;
    std::vector<std::string> code_prefixes;
    uint32_t partitions = 128;
    std::map<uint32_t, std::string> functions;  // extra entry points
    // names the host binds to: functions it replaces and data it reads; 0 = not in this image
    std::map<std::string, uint32_t> symbols, data;
    std::map<std::string, uint32_t> layout;     // XDK data layout, emitted as XDK_<name>
    std::map<std::string, std::vector<std::string>> abi;  // where a symbol takes each argument, emitted as IMAGE_ABI
    std::set<uint32_t> no_gap_fill;             // section starts to skip in gap fill
    std::vector<std::pair<uint32_t, uint32_t>> data_ranges;  // data inside code sections
    bool gap_fill = true;
    bool pointer_seeds = true;
    std::multimap<uint32_t, Hook> hooks;
    std::map<uint32_t, uint32_t> function_ends;          // declared entries, exclusive decode limit or 0
    std::map<uint32_t, std::vector<uint32_t>> switches;  // indirect jmp to its targets
};

enum class Flow : uint8_t { Normal, Jcc, Jmp, JmpIndirect, Call, CallIndirect, Ret, Stop, Invalid };

struct Insn {
    uint8_t len = 0;
    Flow flow = Flow::Invalid;
    uint32_t target = 0;  // direct branch or call target
};

struct JumpTable {
    uint32_t insn = 0;   // the jmp
    uint32_t table = 0;  // dword table
    std::vector<uint32_t> targets;
    std::vector<uint32_t> slots;  // where each target was read
};

class Analysis {
public:
    Analysis(const xbe::Image& img, const Config& cfg);
    void Run();

    bool IsCode(uint32_t va) const { return va >= lo_ && va < hi_ && code_[va - lo_]; }
    bool Decode(uint32_t va, ZydisDecodedInstruction& insn, ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) const;
    const Insn* InsnAt(uint32_t va) const {
        auto it = insns_.find(va);
        return it == insns_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second;
    }

    const xbe::Image& img;
    const Config& cfg;
    uint32_t lo_ = 0, hi_ = 0;
    std::set<uint32_t> functions;
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, JumpTable> jump_tables;  // keyed by jmp address
    std::unordered_map<uint32_t, Insn> insns_;
    std::set<uint32_t> continuations;  // where C++ catch blocks resume, reached by the CRT's jmp eax

    // body of a function: instruction addresses reachable without entering other entries
    std::vector<uint32_t> Body(uint32_t entry) const;

private:
    bool DecodeFlow(uint32_t va, Insn& out, JumpTable* jt);
    bool Walk(uint32_t entry, bool trusted, std::vector<uint32_t>* calls);
    void SeedPointers(bool late = false);
    bool PlausibleEntry(uint32_t va) const;
    void Adopt(const std::vector<uint32_t>& calls, bool trusted);
    void GapFill();
    void EhContinuations();
    void MakeFunction(uint32_t va);
    bool ReadTable(uint32_t jmp_va, const ZydisDecodedOperand& mem, JumpTable& jt);
    bool SledTable(uint32_t jmp_va, const uint32_t* ring, int nring, JumpTable& jt);

    ZydisDecoder dec_;
    std::vector<uint8_t> code_;   // 1 = byte belongs to a code section
    std::vector<uint8_t> cover_;  // 0 unknown, 1 insn start, 2 insn body, 3 data
    const uint8_t* Bytes(uint32_t va, uint32_t& avail) const;
};

```

`sdk/tools/recomp/codegen.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "codegen.h"

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdarg>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

static std::string Fmt(const char* f, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
static std::string Fmt(const char* f, ...) {
    char buf[1024];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, f);
    std::vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), f, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

std::string CodeGen::Hex(uint32_t v) const { return Fmt("0x%Xu", v); }
std::string CodeGen::FuncName(uint32_t va) const { return Fmt("sub_%08X", va); }

std::string CodeGen::CType(unsigned bits, bool s) const {
    switch (bits) {
        case 8: return s ? "int8_t" : "uint8_t";
        case 16: return s ? "int16_t" : "uint16_t";
        case 64: return s ? "int64_t" : "uint64_t";
        default: return s ? "int32_t" : "uint32_t";
    }
}

static const char* Reg32Name(ZydisRegister r) {
    switch (r) {
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_AX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_AL: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_AH: return "ctx.eax";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_ECX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_CX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_CL: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_CH: return "ctx.ecx";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_EDX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_DX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_DL: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_DH: return "ctx.edx";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_EBX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_BX: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_BL: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_BH: return "ctx.ebx";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_ESP: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_SP: return "ctx.esp";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_EBP: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_BP: return "ctx.ebp";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_ESI: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_SI: return "ctx.esi";
        case ZYDIS_REGISTER_EDI: case ZYDIS_REGISTER_DI: return "ctx.edi";
        default: return nullptr;
    }
}

static bool IsHigh8(ZydisRegister r) {
    return r == ZYDIS_REGISTER_AH || r == ZYDIS_REGISTER_CH || r == ZYDIS_REGISTER_DH || r == ZYDIS_REGISTER_BH;
}

static int RegClassIndex(ZydisRegister r, ZydisRegister first) { return int(r - first); }

std::string CodeGen::RegRead(ZydisRegister r) const {
    if (const char* n = Reg32Name(r)) {
        unsigned w = ZydisRegisterGetWidth(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, r);
        if (w == 32) return n;
        if (w == 16) return Fmt("((uint16_t)%s)", n);
        if (IsHigh8(r)) return Fmt("((uint8_t)(%s >> 8))", n);
        return Fmt("((uint8_t)%s)", n);
    }
    if (r >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0 && r <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST7) return Fmt("X87_ST(%d)", RegClassIndex(r, ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0));
    if (r >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0 && r <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM7) return Fmt("ctx.mm[%d]", RegClassIndex(r, ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0));
    if (r >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM0 && r <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM7) return Fmt("ctx.xmm[%d]", RegClassIndex(r, ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM0));
    return "0u";
}

std::string CodeGen::RegWrite(ZydisRegister r, const std::string& v) const {
    if (const char* n = Reg32Name(r)) {
        unsigned w = ZydisRegisterGetWidth(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, r);
        if (w == 32) return Fmt("%s = (uint32_t)(%s);", n, v.c_str());
        if (w == 16) return Fmt("%s = (%s & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(%s);", n, n, v.c_str());
        if (IsHigh8(r)) return Fmt("%s = (%s & 0xFFFF00FFu) | ((uint32_t)(uint8_t)(%s) << 8);", n, n, v.c_str());
        return Fmt("%s = (%s & 0xFFFFFF00u) | (uint8_t)(%s);", n, n, v.c_str());
    }
    if (r >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0 && r <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST7)
        return Fmt("X87_ST(%d) = %s;", RegClassIndex(r, ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0), v.c_str());
    if (r >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0 && r <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM7)
        return Fmt("ctx.mm[%d] = %s;", RegClassIndex(r, ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0), v.c_str());
    return Fmt("/* write to segment or unknown register */ (void)(%s);", v.c_str());
}

std::string CodeGen::AddrExpr(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, bool seg) const {
    std::string e;
    if (o.mem.base != ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE) {
        const char* n = Reg32Name(o.mem.base);
        e = n ? n : "0u";
    }
    if (o.mem.index != ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE) {
        const char* n = Reg32Name(o.mem.index);
        if (!e.empty()) e += " + ";
        e += n ? n : "0u";
        if (o.mem.scale > 1) e += Fmt(" * %uu", o.mem.scale);
    }
    uint32_t disp = uint32_t(o.mem.disp.value);
    if (o.mem.disp.has_displacement && disp) {
        if (!e.empty()) e += " + ";
        e += Hex(disp);
    }
    if (e.empty()) e = "0u";
    if (seg && o.mem.segment == ZYDIS_REGISTER_FS) e = "ctx.fs_base + " + e;
    return "(uint32_t)(" + e + ")";
}

std::string CodeGen::Mem(unsigned bits, const std::string& ea) const {
    switch (bits) {
        case 8: return "X86_MEM8(" + ea + ")";
        case 16: return "X86_MEM16(" + ea + ")";
        case 64: return "X86_MEM64(" + ea + ")";
        default: return "X86_MEM32(" + ea + ")";
    }
}

std::string CodeGen::Read(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, const std::string& ea) const {
    switch (o.type) {
        case ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER: return RegRead(o.reg.value);
        case ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY: return Mem(o.size, ea);
        case ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE: {
            uint64_t v = o.imm.value.u;
            return Hex(uint32_t(v));
        }
        default: return "0u";
    }
}

std::string CodeGen::Write(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, const std::string& ea, const std::string& v) const {
    if (o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER) return RegWrite(o.reg.value, v);
    if (o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY) return Mem(o.size, ea) + " = (" + CType(o.size) + ")(" + v + ");";
    return "/* bad write */";
}

std::string CodeGen::Text(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) const {
    static ZydisFormatter fmt = [] {
        ZydisFormatter f;
        ZydisFormatterInit(&f, ZYDIS_FORMATTER_STYLE_INTEL);
        return f;
    }();
    char buf[256];
    ZydisFormatterFormatInstruction(&fmt, &in, ops, in.operand_count_visible, buf, sizeof(buf), va, nullptr);
    for (char* p = buf; *p; p++)
        if (*p == '*' && p[1] == '/') *p = 'x';
    return buf;
}

void CodeGen::Unimpl(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    std::string t = Text(va, in, ops);
    unimpl_[ZydisMnemonicGetString(in.mnemonic)]++;
    std::string esc;
    for (char c : t) esc += c == '"' ? '\'' : c;
    Line(Fmt("\tx86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"unimplemented: %s\");", va, esc.c_str()));
}

std::string CodeGen::Target(uint32_t t) {
    if (body_set_.count(t) && t != entry_) {
        labels_.insert(t);
        return Fmt("goto loc_%08X;", t);
    }
    if (t == entry_) {
        labels_.insert(t);
        return Fmt("goto loc_%08X;", t);
    }
    if (an_.functions.count(t)) return Fmt("{ X86_SAVE_FLAGS(); %s(ctx, base); return; }", FuncName(t).c_str());
    return Fmt("{ X86_SAVE_FLAGS(); x86_icall(ctx, base, 0x%Xu); return; }", t);
}

std::string CodeGen::Cond(ZydisMnemonic m) {
    if (pending_.valid) {
        unsigned w = pending_.bits;
        std::string U = "(" + CType(w) + ")", S = "(" + CType(w, true) + ")";
        std::string a = U + "ca", b = U + "cb", sa = S + "ca", sb = S + "cb";
        if (pending_.is_test) {
            std::string r = "(" + U + "(ca & cb))", sr = "(" + S + "(ca & cb))";
            switch (m) {
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVZ: return r + " == 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNZ: return r + " != 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVS:
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVL: return sr + " < 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNS:
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNL: return sr + " >= 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVLE: return sr + " <= 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNLE: return sr + " > 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVBE: return r + " == 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNBE: return r + " != 0";
                default: break;
            }
        } else {
            switch (m) {
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVZ: return a + " == " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNZ: return a + " != " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVB: return a + " < " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNB: return a + " >= " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVBE: return a + " <= " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNBE: return a + " > " + b;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVL: return sa + " < " + sb;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNL: return sa + " >= " + sb;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVLE: return sa + " <= " + sb;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNLE: return sa + " > " + sb;
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVS: return "(" + S + "(" + a + " - " + b + ")) < 0";
                case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNS: return "(" + S + "(" + a + " - " + b + ")) >= 0";
                default: break;
            }
        }
    }
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVO: return "of";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNO: return "!of";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVB: return "cf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNB: return "!cf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVE: return "zf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNZ: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNE: return "!zf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVBE: return "(cf | zf)";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNBE: return "!(cf | zf)";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVS: return "sf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNS: return "!sf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVU: return "pf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNU: return "!pf";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVL: return "(sf != of)";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNL: return "(sf == of)";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVLE: return "(zf | (sf != of))";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNLE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNLE: return "(!zf && sf == of)";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JCXZ: return "(uint16_t)ctx.ecx == 0";
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JECXZ: return "ctx.ecx == 0";
        default: return "false /* unknown condition */";
    }
}

void CodeGen::EmitInsn(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops, uint32_t next_body) {
    insn_count_++;
    bool keep_pending = false;
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    uint32_t next = va + in.length;

    // control flow first
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CALL: {
            if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
                uint32_t t = uint32_t(next + ops[0].imm.value.s);
                if (t == next) {  // call $+5 only pushes eip
                    Line(Fmt("\tX86_PUSH32(0x%Xu);", next));
                } else if (an_.functions.count(t)) {
                    Line(Fmt("\tX86_PUSH32(0x%Xu); %s(ctx, base);", next, FuncName(t).c_str()));
                } else {
                    Line(Fmt("\tX86_PUSH32(0x%Xu); x86_icall(ctx, base, 0x%Xu);", next, t));
                }
            } else if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY && ops[0].mem.base == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE &&
                       ops[0].mem.index == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE && ops[0].mem.segment != ZYDIS_REGISTER_FS &&
                       uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value) >= an_.img.kernel_thunk &&
                       uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value) < an_.img.kernel_thunk + 0x400) {
                uint32_t slot = uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value), ord = 0;
                an_.img.Read32(slot, ord);
                Line(Fmt("\tX86_PUSH32(0x%Xu); x86_kernel(ctx, base, %u);", next, ord & 0x7FFFFFFF));
            } else {
                std::string ea = ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY ? AddrExpr(ops[0]) : "";
                Line(Fmt("\t{ uint32_t t = %s; X86_PUSH32(0x%Xu); x86_icall(ctx, base, t); }", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), next));
            }
            pending_.valid = false;
            return;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_JMP: {
            if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
                uint32_t t = uint32_t(next + ops[0].imm.value.s);
                // backward jumps get a compiler barrier so spin loops reread memory other threads write
                if (t <= va) Line("\tX86_BARRIER();");
                Line("\t" + Target(t));
            } else {
                auto jt = an_.jump_tables.find(va);
                std::string ea = ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY ? AddrExpr(ops[0]) : "";
                if (jt != an_.jump_tables.end()) {
                    Line(Fmt("\tswitch (%s) {", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                    std::set<uint32_t> done;
                    for (uint32_t t : jt->second.targets) {
                        if (!done.insert(t).second) continue;
                        Line(Fmt("\tcase 0x%Xu: %s", t, Target(t).c_str()));
                    }
                    Line(Fmt("\tdefault: { X86_SAVE_FLAGS(); x86_icall(ctx, base, %s); return; }", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                    Line("\t}");
                } else if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY && ops[0].mem.base == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE &&
                           ops[0].mem.index == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE &&
                           uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value) >= an_.img.kernel_thunk &&
                           uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value) < an_.img.kernel_thunk + 0x400) {
                    uint32_t ord = 0;
                    an_.img.Read32(uint32_t(ops[0].mem.disp.value), ord);
                    Line(Fmt("\tx86_kernel(ctx, base, %u); return;", ord & 0x7FFFFFFF));
                } else {
                    Line(Fmt("\t{ uint32_t t = %s; X86_SAVE_FLAGS(); x86_icall(ctx, base, t); return; }", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                }
            }
            pending_.valid = false;
            return;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RET: {
            uint32_t n = in.operand_count_visible && ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE ? uint32_t(ops[0].imm.value.u) : 0;
            Line(Fmt("\tctx.esp += %u; return;", 4 + n));
            pending_.valid = false;
            return;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPNE: {
            uint32_t t = uint32_t(next + ops[0].imm.value.s);
            const char* extra = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPE ? " && zf" : m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LOOPNE ? " && !zf" : "";
            Line(Fmt("\tif (--ctx.ecx != 0%s) { X86_BARRIER(); %s }", extra, Target(t).c_str()));
            pending_.valid = false;
            return;
        }
        default:
            break;
    }
    if (in.meta.category == ZYDIS_CATEGORY_COND_BR) {
        uint32_t t = uint32_t(next + ops[0].imm.value.s);
        std::string c = Cond(m);
        Line(Fmt("\tif (%s) { %s%s }", c.c_str(), t <= va ? "X86_BARRIER(); " : "", Target(t).c_str()));
        pending_.valid = false;
        return;
    }

    bool ok = EmitInteger(va, in, ops) || EmitString(va, in, ops) || EmitX87(va, in, ops) || EmitSse(va, in, ops) ||
              EmitMmx(va, in, ops);
    if (!ok) Unimpl(va, in, ops);
    if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMP || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_TEST) keep_pending = true;
    else if (in.cpu_flags && !(in.cpu_flags->modified | in.cpu_flags->set_0 | in.cpu_flags->set_1 | in.cpu_flags->undefined))
        keep_pending = pending_.valid;
    if (!keep_pending) pending_.valid = false;
}

```

`sdk/tools/recomp/codegen.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <set>
#include <string>

#include "analysis.h"

class CodeGen {
public:
    CodeGen(const Analysis& an, std::filesystem::path out) : an_(an), out_(std::move(out)) {}
    bool Run();

private:
    struct Op {
        const ZydisDecodedOperand* o = nullptr;
        std::string ea;  // name of the address temp when memory
    };

    std::string EmitFunction(uint32_t entry);
    bool CheckHooks(const std::vector<uint32_t>& funcs) const;
    int RetBytes(const std::vector<uint32_t>& body) const;  // the one ret n of a body, or -1
    void EmitHooks(uint32_t va, bool after);
    void EmitInsn(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops, uint32_t next_body);

    // operand helpers
    std::string RegRead(ZydisRegister r) const;
    std::string RegWrite(ZydisRegister r, const std::string& v) const;
    std::string AddrExpr(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, bool with_segment = true) const;
    std::string Read(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, const std::string& ea) const;
    std::string Write(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o, const std::string& ea, const std::string& v) const;
    std::string Mem(unsigned bits, const std::string& ea) const;
    std::string CType(unsigned bits, bool is_signed = false) const;

    std::string Cond(ZydisMnemonic m);
    std::string Target(uint32_t t);  // goto or tail call
    std::string Hex(uint32_t v) const;
    std::string FuncName(uint32_t va) const;
    void Line(const std::string& s) { body_ += s; body_ += '\n'; }
    void Unimpl(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);
    std::string Text(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) const;

    // instruction groups
    bool EmitInteger(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);
    bool EmitString(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);
    bool EmitX87(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);
    bool EmitSse(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);
    bool EmitMmx(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops);

    const Analysis& an_;
    std::filesystem::path out_;
    std::string body_;
    uint32_t entry_ = 0;
    std::set<uint32_t> body_set_;
    std::set<uint32_t> labels_;
    // cmp/test peephole
    struct Pending {
        bool valid = false;
        bool is_test = false;
        unsigned bits = 32;
    } pending_;
    std::map<std::string, size_t> unimpl_;
    size_t insn_count_ = 0;
    int ret_bytes_ = -1;
};
```

`sdk/tools/recomp/codegen_emit.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>

#include "codegen.h"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

static std::string F(const char* f, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
static std::string F(const char* f, ...) {
    char buf[1024];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, f);
    std::vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), f, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

// rewriting identical files would force a full rebuild of the generated code
static void WriteIfChanged(const fs::path& p, const std::string& text) {
    std::ifstream in(p, std::ios::binary);
    if (in) {
        std::string old((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(in)), {});
        if (old == text) return;
    }
    std::ofstream out(p, std::ios::binary);
    out << text;
}

std::string CodeGen::EmitFunction(uint32_t entry) {
    entry_ = entry;
    pending_.valid = false;
    std::vector<uint32_t> body = an_.Body(entry);
    body_set_.clear();
    body_set_.insert(body.begin(), body.end());
    labels_.clear();
    // branch targets need labels, collect them before emitting so the peephole never spans one
    std::set<uint32_t> targets;
    for (uint32_t va : body) {
        const Insn* in = an_.InsnAt(va);
        if (!in) continue;
        if (in->flow == Flow::Jcc || in->flow == Flow::Jmp) targets.insert(in->target);
        if (in->flow == Flow::JmpIndirect) {
            auto jt = an_.jump_tables.find(va);
            if (jt != an_.jump_tables.end()) targets.insert(jt->second.targets.begin(), jt->second.targets.end());
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < body.size(); i++) {
        const Insn* in = an_.InsnAt(body[i]);
        if (!in) continue;
        uint32_t next = body[i] + in->len;
        bool falls = in->flow == Flow::Normal || in->flow == Flow::Call || in->flow == Flow::CallIndirect || in->flow == Flow::Jcc;
        if (falls && (i + 1 >= body.size() || body[i + 1] != next)) targets.insert(next);
    }
    if (!an_.cfg.hooks.empty()) {
        ret_bytes_ = RetBytes(body);
        for (uint32_t va : body)
            for (auto [it, e] = an_.cfg.hooks.equal_range(va); it != e; ++it)
                for (auto* x : {&it->second.on_true, &it->second.on_false})
                    if (x->set && !x->ret) targets.insert(x->to);
    }
    body_.clear();
    if (body.empty()) Line(F("\tx86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"function was not decoded\");", entry));
    for (size_t i = 0; i < body.size(); i++) {
        uint32_t va = body[i];
        if ((targets.count(va) && va != entry) || (va == entry && body.front() != entry)) {
            Line(F("loc_%08X:", va));
            pending_.valid = false;
        }
        if (!an_.cfg.hooks.empty()) EmitHooks(va, false);
        const Insn* info = an_.InsnAt(va);
        ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
        ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
        if (!info || info->flow == Flow::Invalid || !an_.Decode(va, in, ops)) {
            Line(F("\tx86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"undecodable instruction\");", va));
            pending_.valid = false;
            continue;
        }
        Line("\t// " + F("%08X ", va) + Text(va, in, ops));
        uint32_t next_body = i + 1 < body.size() ? body[i + 1] : 0;
        EmitInsn(va, in, ops, next_body);
        if (!an_.cfg.hooks.empty()) EmitHooks(va, true);
        bool falls = info->flow == Flow::Normal || info->flow == Flow::Call || info->flow == Flow::CallIndirect ||
                     info->flow == Flow::Jcc;
        uint32_t next = va + info->len;
        if (falls && next_body != next) {
            if (an_.InsnAt(next) || an_.functions.count(next))
                Line("\t" + Target(next));
            else
                Line(F("\tx86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"fell off decoded code\");", next));
        }
    }
    // a function that registers an SEH frame (mov fs:[0], ...) may be where a C++ catch resumes: the CRT's jump to
    // the continuation throws X86Resume, caught by the innermost such frame whose stack holds the resume esp
    bool seh = false;
    for (uint32_t va : body) {
        ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
        ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
        if (an_.Decode(va, in, ops) && in.mnemonic == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOV && ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY &&
            ops[0].mem.segment == ZYDIS_REGISTER_FS && ops[0].mem.base == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE &&
            ops[0].mem.index == ZYDIS_REGISTER_NONE && ops[0].mem.disp.value == 0)
            seh = true;
    }
    std::string out;
    out += F("X86_FUNC(__imp__%s) {\n", FuncName(entry).c_str());
    if (seh) out += "\tconst uint32_t x86_frame = ctx.esp;\n\ttry {\n";
    out += "\tX86_LOAD_FLAGS();\n\tuint32_t ca = 0, cb = 0;\n\t(void)ca; (void)cb;\n";
    // code below the entry (a shared tail reached by a jump) is emitted first, so enter by label
    bool entry_first = !body.empty() && body.front() == entry;
    if (!entry_first) out += F("\tgoto loc_%08X;\n", entry);
    if (labels_.count(entry) && entry_first) out += F("loc_%08X:;\n", entry);
    out += body_;
    if (seh) out += "\t} catch (const X86Resume& r) {\n\t\tif (r.esp >= x86_frame) throw;\n\t\tx86_resume(ctx, base, r);\n\t}\n";
    out += "}\n";
    if (an_.cfg.trace.count(entry))
        out += F("X86_TRACED_FUNC(%s, __imp__%s, 0x%XU)\n\n", FuncName(entry).c_str(), FuncName(entry).c_str(), entry);
    else  // weak, so a host function of the same name replaces it
        out += F("X86_WEAK_FUNC(%s, __imp__%s)\n\n", FuncName(entry).c_str(), FuncName(entry).c_str());
    return out;
}

int CodeGen::RetBytes(const std::vector<uint32_t>& body) const {
    int n = -1;
    for (uint32_t va : body) {
        const Insn* i = an_.InsnAt(va);
        ZydisDecodedInstruction in;
        ZydisDecodedOperand ops[ZYDIS_MAX_OPERAND_COUNT];
        if (!i || i->flow != Flow::Ret) continue;
        if (!an_.Decode(va, in, ops)) return -1;
        int k = in.operand_count_visible && ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE ? int(ops[0].imm.value.u) : 0;
        if (n >= 0 && n != k) return -1;
        n = k;
    }
    return n;
}

bool CodeGen::CheckHooks(const std::vector<uint32_t>& funcs) const {
    bool ok = true;
    auto fail = [&](const Hook& h, uint32_t f, const char* why) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "[[hook]] %s at %08X%s: %s\n", h.call.c_str(), h.at, f ? F(" in %s", FuncName(f).c_str()).c_str() : "",
                     why);
        ok = false;
    };
    std::set<uint32_t> placed;
    for (uint32_t f : funcs) {
        std::vector<uint32_t> body = an_.Body(f);
        std::set<uint32_t> in(body.begin(), body.end());
        for (uint32_t va : body)
            for (auto [it, e] = an_.cfg.hooks.equal_range(va); it != e; ++it) {
                const Hook& h = it->second;
                Flow flow = an_.InsnAt(va)->flow;
                placed.insert(va);
                if (h.after && flow != Flow::Normal && flow != Flow::Call && flow != Flow::CallIndirect)
                    fail(h, f, "after = true on a control transfer");
                for (auto* x : {&h.on_true, &h.on_false}) {
                    if (x->ret && RetBytes(body) < 0)
                        fail(h, f, "\"ret\" needs a function with one ret form, name an address instead");
                    if (x->set && !x->ret && !in.count(x->to)) fail(h, f, "jump target is not an instruction of the function");
                }
            }
    }
    std::map<std::string, bool> kind;
    for (auto& [va, h] : an_.cfg.hooks) {
        if (!placed.count(va)) fail(h, 0, "not an instruction in a recompiled function");
        bool ident = !h.call.empty() && !std::isdigit((unsigned char)h.call[0]);
        for (char c : h.call) ident &= std::isalnum((unsigned char)c) || c == '_';
        if (!ident) fail(h, 0, "call is not an identifier");
        if (auto [k, fresh] = kind.emplace(h.call, h.Returns()); !fresh && k->second != h.Returns())
            fail(h, 0, "call used both with and without on_true/on_false");
    }
    return ok;
}

// the hook sees guest flags in ctx and may change them, so they are stored before and reloaded after
void CodeGen::EmitHooks(uint32_t va, bool after) {
    for (auto [it, e] = an_.cfg.hooks.equal_range(va); it != e; ++it) {
        const Hook& h = it->second;
        if (h.after != after) continue;
        auto leave = [&](const Hook::Exit& x) {
            if (x.ret) return F("ctx.esp += %d; return;", 4 + ret_bytes_);  // return address plus the ret n bytes
            return (x.to <= va ? std::string("X86_BARRIER(); ") : std::string()) + Target(x.to);
        };
        Line("\tX86_SAVE_FLAGS();");
        std::string reload = "cf = ctx.cf; zf = ctx.zf; sf = ctx.sf; of = ctx.of; pf = ctx.pf;";
        if (!h.Returns()) {
            Line(F("\t%s(ctx, base); %s", h.call.c_str(), reload.c_str()));
        } else {
            std::string s = F("\t{ bool hook = %s(ctx, base); %s", h.call.c_str(), reload.c_str());
            if (h.on_true.set) s += " if (hook) { " + leave(h.on_true) + " }";
            if (h.on_false.set) s += (h.on_true.set ? " else { " : " if (!hook) { ") + leave(h.on_false) + " }";
            Line(s + " }");
        }
        pending_.valid = false;
    }
}

bool CodeGen::Run() {
    std::vector<uint32_t> funcs(an_.functions.begin(), an_.functions.end());
    std::sort(funcs.begin(), funcs.end());
    if (!an_.cfg.hooks.empty() && !CheckHooks(funcs)) return false;

    // symbols the host binds to by name; one missing from this image gets a placeholder address whose
    // recompiled body traps, so the host override still links
    std::string syms = "#pragma once\n";
    syms += F("#define IMAGE_XBE \"%s\"\n", fs::path(an_.cfg.xbe_path).filename().string().c_str());
    std::vector<uint32_t> absent;
    for (auto& [name, va] : an_.cfg.symbols) {
        uint32_t a = va ? va : 0xFFFF0000u + uint32_t(absent.size());
        if (!va) absent.push_back(a);
        syms += F("#define SYM_%s %08X\n#define HAS_%s %d\n", name.c_str(), a, name.c_str(), va ? 1 : 0);
    }
    for (auto& [name, va] : an_.cfg.data) syms += F("#define SYM_%s %08X\n#define HAS_%s %d\n", name.c_str(), va, name.c_str(), va ? 1 : 0);
    for (auto& [name, v] : an_.cfg.layout) syms += F("#define XDK_%s 0x%X\n", name.c_str(), v);
    // argument maps, one X(name, location...) row each; xdk/hle.h makes the table
    if (!an_.cfg.abi.empty()) {
        syms += "#define IMAGE_ABI(X)";
        for (auto& [name, locs] : an_.cfg.abi) {
            syms += " \\\n\tX(" + name;
            for (auto& l : locs) syms += ", " + l;
            syms += ")";
        }
        syms += "\n";
    }
    WriteIfChanged(out_ / "image_symbols.h", syms);

    // shared declarations
    std::string shared = "#pragma once\n#include \"cpu/x86_ops.h\"\n\n";
    for (uint32_t f : funcs) shared += F("X86_EXTERN_FUNC(%s);\n", FuncName(f).c_str());
    for (uint32_t f : absent) shared += F("X86_EXTERN_FUNC(%s);\n", FuncName(f).c_str());
    std::map<std::string, bool> hooks;
    for (auto& [va, h] : an_.cfg.hooks) hooks.emplace(h.call, h.Returns());
    for (auto& [name, returns] : hooks) shared += F("%s %s(X86Context& ctx, uint8_t* base);\n", returns ? "bool" : "void", name.c_str());
    WriteIfChanged(out_ / "x86_recomp_shared.h", shared);

    // partition by instruction count so the files compile in similar time
    size_t total = 0;
    std::vector<size_t> weight(funcs.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < funcs.size(); i++) {
        weight[i] = an_.Body(funcs[i]).size() + 8;
        total += weight[i];
    }
    uint32_t parts = std::max<uint32_t>(1, an_.cfg.partitions);
    size_t per = total / parts + 1;
    size_t fi = 0;
    for (uint32_t p = 0; p < parts; p++) {
        std::string text = "#include \"x86_recomp_shared.h\"\n\n";
        size_t acc = 0;
        while (fi < funcs.size() && (acc < per || p == parts - 1)) {
            text += EmitFunction(funcs[fi]);
            acc += weight[fi];
            fi++;
        }
        WriteIfChanged(out_ / F("x86_recomp.%u.cpp", p), text);
    }

    std::string map = "#include \"x86_recomp_shared.h\"\n\n";
    uint32_t lo = 0xFFFFFFFF, hi = 0;
    for (auto& s : an_.img.sections) {
        bool code = false;
        for (auto& n : an_.cfg.code_sections) code |= s.name == n;
        for (auto& pfx : an_.cfg.code_prefixes) code |= s.name.rfind(pfx, 0) == 0;
        if (!code) continue;
        lo = std::min(lo, s.va);
        hi = std::max(hi, s.va + s.rsize);
    }
    map += F("const uint32_t X86CodeBase = 0x%Xu;\nconst uint32_t X86CodeEnd = 0x%Xu;\n", lo, hi);
    map += F("const uint32_t X86ImageBase = 0x%Xu;\nconst uint32_t X86ImageEnd = 0x%Xu;\n", an_.img.base,
             an_.img.base + an_.img.image_size);
    map += F("const uint32_t X86EntryPoint = 0x%Xu;\nconst uint32_t X86KernelThunk = 0x%Xu;\n\n", an_.img.entry,
             an_.img.kernel_thunk);
    map += "const X86FuncMapping X86FuncMappings[] = {\n";
    for (uint32_t f : funcs) map += F("\t{0x%Xu, %s},\n", f, FuncName(f).c_str());
    map += "\t{0, nullptr},\n};\n";
    map += "\nconst uint32_t X86Continuations[] = {\n";
    for (uint32_t c : an_.continuations) map += F("\t0x%Xu,\n", c);
    map += "\t0,\n};\n";
    for (uint32_t f : absent) {
        map += F("\nX86_FUNC(__imp__%s) { x86_trap(ctx, 0x%Xu, \"not in this image\"); }\n", FuncName(f).c_str(), f);
        map += F("X86_WEAK_FUNC(%s, __imp__%s)\n", FuncName(f).c_str(), FuncName(f).c_str());
    }
    WriteIfChanged(out_ / "x86_func_mapping.cpp", map);

    std::string stats = F("functions %zu\ninstructions %zu\n", funcs.size(), insn_count_);
    for (auto& [k, v] : unimpl_) stats += F("unimplemented %s %zu\n", k.c_str(), v);
    WriteIfChanged(out_ / "x86_recomp_stats.txt", stats);
    std::fprintf(stderr, "%s", stats.c_str());
    return true;
}
```
