`sdk/tools/recomp/codegen_fp.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>

#include "codegen.h"

static std::string F(const char* f, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
static std::string F(const char* f, ...) {
    char buf[2048];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, f);
    std::vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), f, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

static int StIndex(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) {
    if (o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER && o.reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0 && o.reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST7)
        return int(o.reg.value - ZYDIS_REGISTER_ST0);
    return -1;
}

static int XmmIndex(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) {
    if (o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER && o.reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM0 && o.reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM7)
        return int(o.reg.value - ZYDIS_REGISTER_XMM0);
    return -1;
}

static int MmIndex(const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) {
    if (o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER && o.reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0 && o.reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM7)
        return int(o.reg.value - ZYDIS_REGISTER_MM0);
    return -1;
}

bool CodeGen::EmitX87(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    if (!ZydisMnemonicGetString(in.mnemonic) || ZydisMnemonicGetString(in.mnemonic)[0] != 'f') return false;
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    int vis = in.operand_count_visible;
    int mi = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < vis; i++)
        if (ops[i].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY) mi = i;
    std::string open = mi >= 0 ? "\t{ uint32_t ea = " + AddrExpr(ops[mi]) + "; " : "\t{ ";
    auto emit = [&](const std::string& s) { Line(open + s + " }"); };
    // value of a floating memory operand
    auto fmem = [&](const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) -> std::string {
        if (o.size == 32) return "(double)X86_MEMF32(ea)";
        if (o.size == 64) return "X86_MEMF64(ea)";
        return "x87_load80(X86_PTR(uint8_t, ea))";
    };
    auto imem = [&](const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) -> std::string {
        if (o.size == 16) return "(double)(int16_t)X86_MEM16(ea)";
        if (o.size == 64) return "(double)(int64_t)X86_MEM64(ea)";
        return "(double)(int32_t)X86_MEM32(ea)";
    };
    auto st = [&](int i) { return F("X87_ST(%d)", i); };

    struct Arith {
        ZydisMnemonic m;
        const char* op;
        bool rev, pop, integer;
    };
    static const Arith arith[] = {
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FADD, "+", false, false, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FADDP, "+", false, true, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIADD, "+", false, false, true},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSUB, "-", false, false, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSUBP, "-", false, true, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISUB, "-", false, false, true},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSUBR, "-", true, false, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSUBRP, "-", true, true, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISUBR, "-", true, false, true},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FMUL, "*", false, false, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FMULP, "*", false, true, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIMUL, "*", false, false, true},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FDIV, "/", false, false, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FDIVP, "/", false, true, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIDIV, "/", false, false, true},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FDIVR, "/", true, false, false},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FDIVRP, "/", true, true, false},   {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIDIVR, "/", true, false, true},
    };
    for (auto& a : arith) {
        if (a.m != m) continue;
        std::string dst, src;
        if (mi >= 0) {
            dst = st(0);
            src = a.integer ? imem(ops[mi]) : fmem(ops[mi]);
        } else if (vis >= 2) {
            dst = st(StIndex(ops[0]));
            src = st(StIndex(ops[1]));
        } else {
            dst = st(1);
            src = st(0);
        }
        std::string expr = a.rev ? "(s " + std::string(a.op) + " d)" : "(d " + std::string(a.op) + " s)";
        emit(F("double s = %s; double d = %s; %s = x87_prec(ctx, %s);%s", src.c_str(), dst.c_str(), dst.c_str(), expr.c_str(),
               a.pop ? " x87_pop(ctx);" : ""));
        return true;
    }

    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLD:
            if (mi >= 0) emit("x87_push(ctx, " + fmem(ops[mi]) + ");");
            else emit(F("double v = %s; x87_push(ctx, v);", st(StIndex(ops[0])).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FILD:
            emit("x87_push(ctx, " + imem(ops[mi]) + ");");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FST:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSTP: {
            const char* pop = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSTP ? " x87_pop(ctx);" : "";
            if (mi >= 0) {
                auto& o = ops[mi];
                if (o.size == 32) emit(F("X86_MEMF32(ea) = (float)X87_ST(0);%s", pop));
                else if (o.size == 64) emit(F("X86_MEMF64(ea) = X87_ST(0);%s", pop));
                else emit(F("x87_store80(X86_PTR(uint8_t, ea), X87_ST(0));%s", pop));
            } else {
                emit(F("%s = X87_ST(0);%s", st(StIndex(ops[0])).c_str(), pop));
            }
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIST:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISTP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISTTP: {
            const char* pop = m != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FIST ? " x87_pop(ctx);" : "";
            auto& o = ops[mi];
            std::string v = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISTTP ? "std::trunc(X87_ST(0))" : "X87_ST(0)";
            // fcw 0xC00 sets rounding to truncate for the store
            std::string pre = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISTTP ? "uint16_t cw = ctx.fcw; ctx.fcw |= 0xC00; " : "";
            std::string post = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FISTTP ? " ctx.fcw = cw;" : "";
            if (o.size == 16) emit(pre + "X86_MEM16(ea) = (uint16_t)x87_to_i16(ctx, " + v + ");" + post + pop);
            else if (o.size == 64) emit(pre + "X86_MEM64(ea) = (uint64_t)x87_to_i64(ctx, " + v + ");" + post + pop);
            else emit(pre + "X86_MEM32(ea) = (uint32_t)x87_to_i32(ctx, " + v + ");" + post + pop);
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FXCH: {
            int i = vis ? StIndex(ops[0]) : 1;
            emit(F("double t = X87_ST(0); X87_ST(0) = %s; %s = t;", st(i).c_str(), st(i).c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOM:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOM:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FICOM:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FICOMP: {
            bool pop = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMP || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMP || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FICOMP;
            bool integer = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FICOM || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FICOMP;
            std::string src = mi >= 0 ? (integer ? imem(ops[mi]) : fmem(ops[mi])) : vis ? st(StIndex(ops[0])) : st(1);
            emit(F("x87_compare(ctx, X87_ST(0), %s);%s", src.c_str(), pop ? " x87_pop(ctx);" : ""));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMPP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMPP:
            emit("x87_compare(ctx, X87_ST(0), X87_ST(1)); x87_pop(ctx); x87_pop(ctx);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMI:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMIP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMI:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMIP: {
            bool pop = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOMIP || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FUCOMIP;
            emit(F("double a = X87_ST(0), b = %s; bool u = a != a || b != b; zf = u || a == b; pf = u; cf = u || a < b; of = 0; sf = 0;%s",
                   st(StIndex(ops[1])).c_str(), pop ? " x87_pop(ctx);" : ""));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FTST:
            emit("x87_compare(ctx, X87_ST(0), 0.0);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FXAM:
            emit("x87_examine(ctx);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCHS: emit("X87_ST(0) = -X87_ST(0);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FABS: emit("X87_ST(0) = std::fabs(X87_ST(0));"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSQRT: emit("X87_ST(0) = x87_prec(ctx, std::sqrt(X87_ST(0)));"); return true;
        // clearing C2 (0x400) reports the argument in range
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSIN: emit("X87_ST(0) = std::sin(X87_ST(0)); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCOS: emit("X87_ST(0) = std::cos(X87_ST(0)); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSINCOS:
            emit("double v = X87_ST(0); X87_ST(0) = std::sin(v); x87_push(ctx, std::cos(v)); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FPTAN:
            emit("X87_ST(0) = std::tan(X87_ST(0)); x87_push(ctx, 1.0); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FPATAN:
            emit("double v = std::atan2(X87_ST(1), X87_ST(0)); x87_pop(ctx); X87_ST(0) = v;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_F2XM1: emit("X87_ST(0) = std::exp2(X87_ST(0)) - 1.0;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FYL2X:
            emit("double v = X87_ST(1) * std::log2(X87_ST(0)); x87_pop(ctx); X87_ST(0) = v;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FYL2XP1:
            emit("double v = X87_ST(1) * std::log2(X87_ST(0) + 1.0); x87_pop(ctx); X87_ST(0) = v;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FSCALE:
            emit("X87_ST(0) = std::ldexp(X87_ST(0), (int)std::trunc(X87_ST(1)));");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FRNDINT: emit("X87_ST(0) = x87_round(ctx, X87_ST(0));"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FPREM:
            emit("X87_ST(0) = std::fmod(X87_ST(0), X87_ST(1)); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FPREM1:
            emit("X87_ST(0) = std::remainder(X87_ST(0), X87_ST(1)); ctx.fsw &= ~0x400;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FXTRACT:
            emit("int e; double v = X87_ST(0); double mnt = std::frexp(v, &e); X87_ST(0) = (double)(e - 1); x87_push(ctx, mnt * 2.0);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLD1: emit("x87_push(ctx, 1.0);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDZ: emit("x87_push(ctx, 0.0);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDPI: emit("x87_push(ctx, 3.14159265358979323846);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDL2E: emit("x87_push(ctx, 1.44269504088896340736);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDL2T: emit("x87_push(ctx, 3.32192809488736234787);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDLN2: emit("x87_push(ctx, 0.693147180559945309417);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDLG2: emit("x87_push(ctx, 0.301029995663981195214);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDCW: emit("ctx.fcw = X86_MEM16(ea);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNSTCW: emit("X86_MEM16(ea) = ctx.fcw;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNSTSW:
            if (mi >= 0) emit("X86_MEM16(ea) = x87_status(ctx);");
            else emit("ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | x87_status(ctx);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNINIT: emit("ctx.fcw = 0x37F; ctx.fsw = 0; ctx.top = 0;"); return true;  // 0x37F is the power on control word
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNCLEX: emit("ctx.fsw &= 0x7F00;"); return true;  // keeps condition codes and TOP
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FFREE: return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FINCSTP: emit("ctx.top = (ctx.top + 1) & 7;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FDECSTP: emit("ctx.top = (ctx.top - 1) & 7;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNB:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVNU: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FCMOVU: {
            bool saved = pending_.valid;
            pending_.valid = false;
            std::string c = Cond(m);
            pending_.valid = saved;
            emit(F("if (%s) X87_ST(0) = %s;", c.c_str(), st(StIndex(ops[1])).c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNSTENV:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNSAVE:
            emit("X86_MEM32(ea) = ctx.fcw; X86_MEM32(ea + 4) = x87_status(ctx); X86_MEM32(ea + 8) = 0xFFFF;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FLDENV:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FRSTOR:
            emit("ctx.fcw = (uint16_t)X86_MEM32(ea); ctx.fsw = (uint16_t)X86_MEM32(ea + 4); ctx.top = (ctx.fsw >> 11) & 7;");
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

bool CodeGen::EmitSse(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    int mi = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < in.operand_count_visible; i++)
        if (ops[i].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY) mi = i;
    std::string open = mi >= 0 ? "\t{ uint32_t ea = " + AddrExpr(ops[mi]) + "; " : "\t{ ";
    auto emit = [&](const std::string& s) { Line(open + s + " }"); };
    int d = XmmIndex(ops[0]);
    int s = in.operand_count_visible > 1 ? XmmIndex(ops[1]) : -1;
    // 128 bit source as an X86Xmm expression
    auto src128 = [&]() -> std::string {
        if (s >= 0) return F("ctx.xmm[%d]", s);
        return "*X86_PTR(X86Xmm, ea)";
    };
    auto srcf0 = [&]() -> std::string {
        if (s >= 0) return F("ctx.xmm[%d].f[0]", s);
        return "X86_MEMF32(ea)";
    };
    struct Bin {
        ZydisMnemonic ps, ss;
        const char* expr;
    };
    static const Bin bins[] = {
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADDPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADDSS, "a + b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SUBPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SUBSS, "a - b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MULPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MULSS, "a * b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_DIVPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_DIVSS, "a / b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MINPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MINSS, "sse_min(a, b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MAXPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MAXSS, "sse_max(a, b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SQRTPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SQRTSS, "std::sqrt(b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RCPPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RCPSS, "1.0f / b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RSQRTPS, ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RSQRTSS, "1.0f / std::sqrt(b)"},
    };
    for (auto& b : bins) {
        if (m == b.ps) {
            emit(F("X86Xmm v = %s; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { float a = ctx.xmm[%d].f[i], b = v.f[i]; (void)a; ctx.xmm[%d].f[i] = %s; }",
                   src128().c_str(), d, d, b.expr));
            return true;
        }
        if (m == b.ss) {
            emit(F("float a = ctx.xmm[%d].f[0], b = %s; (void)a; ctx.xmm[%d].f[0] = %s;", d, srcf0().c_str(), d, b.expr));
            return true;
        }
    }
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVAPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVUPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVNTPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVAPD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVUPD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVDQA:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVDQU:
            if (d >= 0) emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d] = %s;", d, src128().c_str()));
            else emit(F("*X86_PTR(X86Xmm, ea) = ctx.xmm[%d];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVSS:
            if (d >= 0 && s >= 0) emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].f[0] = ctx.xmm[%d].f[0];", d, s));
            else if (d >= 0) emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] = X86_MEM32(ea); ctx.xmm[%d].u[1] = ctx.xmm[%d].u[2] = ctx.xmm[%d].u[3] = 0;", d, d, d, d));
            else emit(F("X86_MEM32(ea) = ctx.xmm[%d].u[0];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVLPS:
            if (d >= 0) emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].q[0] = X86_MEM64(ea);", d));
            else emit(F("X86_MEM64(ea) = ctx.xmm[%d].q[0];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVHPS:
            if (d >= 0) emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].q[1] = X86_MEM64(ea);", d));
            else emit(F("X86_MEM64(ea) = ctx.xmm[%d].q[1];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVLHPS: emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].q[1] = ctx.xmm[%d].q[0];", d, s)); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVHLPS: emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].q[0] = ctx.xmm[%d].q[1];", d, s)); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ANDPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ANDNPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ORPS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_XORPS: {
            const char* e = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ANDPS ? "a & b" : m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ANDNPS ? "~a & b" : m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ORPS ? "a | b" : "a ^ b";
            emit(F("X86Xmm v = %s; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { uint32_t a = ctx.xmm[%d].u[i], b = v.u[i]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[i] = %s; }",
                   src128().c_str(), d, d, e));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPPS:
            emit(F("X86Xmm v = %s; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ctx.xmm[%d].u[i] = sse_cmp(ctx.xmm[%d].f[i], v.f[i], %d);",
                   src128().c_str(), d, d, int(ops[2].imm.value.u)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPSS:
            emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] = sse_cmp(ctx.xmm[%d].f[0], %s, %d);", d, d, srcf0().c_str(), int(ops[2].imm.value.u)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_COMISS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UCOMISS:
            emit(F("float a = ctx.xmm[%d].f[0], b = %s; bool u = a != a || b != b; zf = u || a == b; pf = u; cf = u || a < b; of = 0; sf = 0;",
                   d, srcf0().c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTSI2SS:
            emit(F("ctx.xmm[%d].f[0] = (float)(int32_t)%s;", d, Read(ops[1], "ea").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTSS2SI:
            emit(RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, F("(uint32_t)sse_cvt(%s)", s >= 0 ? F("ctx.xmm[%d].f[0]", s).c_str() : "X86_MEMF32(ea)")));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTTSS2SI:
            emit(RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, F("(uint32_t)sse_cvtt(%s)", s >= 0 ? F("ctx.xmm[%d].f[0]", s).c_str() : "X86_MEMF32(ea)")));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTPI2PS: {
            std::string src = MmIndex(ops[1]) >= 0 ? F("ctx.mm[%d]", MmIndex(ops[1])) : "X86_MEM64(ea)";
            emit(F("uint64_t v = %s; ctx.xmm[%d].f[0] = (float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)v; ctx.xmm[%d].f[1] = (float)(int32_t)(uint32_t)(v >> 32);",
                   src.c_str(), d, d));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTPS2PI:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTTPS2PI: {
            const char* fn = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CVTPS2PI ? "sse_cvt" : "sse_cvtt";
            std::string src = s >= 0 ? F("ctx.xmm[%d]", s) : "*X86_PTR(X86Xmm, ea)";
            emit(F("X86Xmm v = %s; ctx.mm[%d] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)%s(v.f[0]) | ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)%s(v.f[1]) << 32);",
                   src.c_str(), MmIndex(ops[0]), fn, fn));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SHUFPS: {
            int imm = int(ops[2].imm.value.u);
            emit(F("X86Xmm a = ctx.xmm[%d], b = %s; ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] = a.u[%d]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[1] = a.u[%d]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[2] = b.u[%d]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[3] = b.u[%d];",
                   d, src128().c_str(), d, imm & 3, d, (imm >> 2) & 3, d, (imm >> 4) & 3, d, (imm >> 6) & 3));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UNPCKLPS:
            emit(F("X86Xmm a = ctx.xmm[%d], b = %s; ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] = a.u[0]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[1] = b.u[0]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[2] = a.u[1]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[3] = b.u[1];",
                   d, src128().c_str(), d, d, d, d));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UNPCKHPS:
            emit(F("X86Xmm a = ctx.xmm[%d], b = %s; ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] = a.u[2]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[1] = b.u[2]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[2] = a.u[3]; ctx.xmm[%d].u[3] = b.u[3];",
                   d, src128().c_str(), d, d, d, d));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVMSKPS:
            emit(RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, F("(ctx.xmm[%d].u[0] >> 31) | (ctx.xmm[%d].u[1] >> 31) << 1 | (ctx.xmm[%d].u[2] >> 31) << 2 | (ctx.xmm[%d].u[3] >> 31) << 3", s, s, s, s)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LDMXCSR: emit("ctx.mxcsr = X86_MEM32(ea);"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STMXCSR: emit("X86_MEM32(ea) = ctx.mxcsr;"); return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

bool CodeGen::EmitMmx(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    int mi = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < in.operand_count_visible; i++)
        if (ops[i].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY) mi = i;
    std::string open = mi >= 0 ? "\t{ uint32_t ea = " + AddrExpr(ops[mi]) + "; " : "\t{ ";
    auto emit = [&](const std::string& s) { Line(open + s + " }"); };
    int d = MmIndex(ops[0]);
    int s = in.operand_count_visible > 1 ? MmIndex(ops[1]) : -1;
    if (d < 0 && s < 0 && m != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVD && m != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVQ) return false;
    std::string src = s >= 0 ? F("ctx.mm[%d]", s) : mi >= 0 ? "X86_MEM64(ea)" : "0ull";
    if (in.operand_count_visible > 1 && ops[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) src = F("%lluull", (unsigned long long)ops[1].imm.value.u);
    std::string D = d >= 0 ? F("ctx.mm[%d]", d) : "";

    struct Lane {
        ZydisMnemonic m;
        const char* type;
        const char* expr;
    };
    static const Lane lanes[] = {
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDB, "uint8_t", "a + b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDW, "uint16_t", "a + b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDD, "uint32_t", "a + b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDSB, "int8_t", "sat<int8_t>((int)a + b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDSW, "int16_t", "sat<int16_t>((int)a + b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDUSB, "uint8_t", "sat<uint8_t>((int)a + b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PADDUSW, "uint16_t", "sat<uint16_t>((int)a + b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBB, "uint8_t", "a - b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBW, "uint16_t", "a - b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBD, "uint32_t", "a - b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBSB, "int8_t", "sat<int8_t>((int)a - b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBSW, "int16_t", "sat<int16_t>((int)a - b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBUSB, "uint8_t", "sat<uint8_t>((int)a - b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSUBUSW, "uint16_t", "sat<uint16_t>((int)a - b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMULLW, "int16_t", "(int16_t)((int)a * b)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMULHW, "int16_t", "(int16_t)(((int)a * b) >> 16)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMULHUW, "uint16_t", "(uint16_t)(((uint32_t)a * b) >> 16)"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPEQB, "uint8_t", "a == b ? 0xFF : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPEQW, "uint16_t", "a == b ? 0xFFFF : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPEQD, "uint32_t", "a == b ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPGTB, "int8_t", "a > b ? -1 : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPGTW, "int16_t", "a > b ? -1 : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PCMPGTD, "int32_t", "a > b ? -1 : 0"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PAVGB, "uint8_t", "(a + b + 1) >> 1"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PAVGW, "uint16_t", "(a + b + 1) >> 1"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMAXUB, "uint8_t", "a > b ? a : b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMINUB, "uint8_t", "a < b ? a : b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMAXSW, "int16_t", "a > b ? a : b"},
        {ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMINSW, "int16_t", "a < b ? a : b"},
    };
    for (auto& l : lanes)
        if (l.m == m) {
            emit(F("%s = mmx_map2<%s>(%s, %s, [](%s a, %s b) { return %s; });", D.c_str(), l.type, D.c_str(), src.c_str(),
                   l.type, l.type, l.expr));
            return true;
        }
    auto shift = [&](const char* type, const char* op, int bits) {
        bool arith = type[0] == 'i';
        if (arith)
            emit(F("uint64_t n = %s; if (n > %d) n = %d; %s = mmx_map2<%s>(%s, 0, [n](%s a, %s) { return (%s)(a >> n); });",
                   src.c_str(), bits - 1, bits - 1, D.c_str(), type, D.c_str(), type, type, type));
        else
            emit(F("uint64_t n = %s; %s = n >= %d ? 0 : mmx_map2<%s>(%s, 0, [n](%s a, %s) { return (%s)(a %s n); });", src.c_str(),
                   D.c_str(), bits, type, D.c_str(), type, type, type, op));
    };
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVQ:
            if (d >= 0) emit(F("%s = %s;", D.c_str(), src.c_str()));
            else emit(F("X86_MEM64(ea) = ctx.mm[%d];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVNTQ:
            emit(F("X86_MEM64(ea) = ctx.mm[%d];", s));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVD:
            if (d >= 0) emit(F("%s = (uint32_t)(%s);", D.c_str(), Read(ops[1], "ea").c_str()));
            else emit(Write(ops[0], "ea", F("(uint32_t)ctx.mm[%d]", s)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PAND: emit(F("%s &= %s;", D.c_str(), src.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PANDN: emit(F("%s = ~%s & %s;", D.c_str(), D.c_str(), src.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_POR: emit(F("%s |= %s;", D.c_str(), src.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PXOR: emit(F("%s ^= %s;", D.c_str(), src.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSLLW: shift("uint16_t", "<<", 16); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSLLD: shift("uint32_t", "<<", 32); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSRLW: shift("uint16_t", ">>", 16); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSRLD: shift("uint32_t", ">>", 32); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSRAW: shift("int16_t", ">>", 16); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSRAD: shift("int32_t", ">>", 32); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSLLQ: emit(F("uint64_t n = %s; %s = n >= 64 ? 0 : %s << n;", src.c_str(), D.c_str(), D.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSRLQ: emit(F("uint64_t n = %s; %s = n >= 64 ? 0 : %s >> n;", src.c_str(), D.c_str(), D.c_str())); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMADDWD:
            emit(F("int16_t a[4], b[4]; uint64_t x = %s, y = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); std::memcpy(b, &y, 8); "
                   "int32_t r0 = a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1], r1 = a[2] * b[2] + a[3] * b[3]; %s = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)r0 | ((uint64_t)(uint32_t)r1 << 32);",
                   D.c_str(), src.c_str(), D.c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSADBW:
            emit(F("uint8_t a[8], b[8]; uint64_t x = %s, y = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); std::memcpy(b, &y, 8); uint32_t s = 0; "
                   "for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) s += a[i] > b[i] ? a[i] - b[i] : b[i] - a[i]; %s = s;",
                   D.c_str(), src.c_str(), D.c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKLBW:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHBW:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKLWD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHWD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKLDQ:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHDQ: {
            int sz = (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKLBW || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHBW) ? 1
                     : (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKLWD || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHWD) ? 2 : 4;
            bool hi = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHBW || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHWD || m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUNPCKHDQ;
            emit(F("uint8_t a[8], b[8], r[8]; uint64_t x = %s, y = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); std::memcpy(b, &y, 8); "
                   "for (int i = 0; i < %d; i++) { std::memcpy(r + i * %d, a + %d + i * %d, %d); std::memcpy(r + i * %d + %d, b + %d + i * %d, %d); } "
                   "std::memcpy(&%s, r, 8);",
                   D.c_str(), src.c_str(), 4 / sz, 2 * sz, hi ? 4 : 0, sz, sz, 2 * sz, sz, hi ? 4 : 0, sz, sz, D.c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKSSWB:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKUSWB:
            emit(F("int16_t a[4], b[4]; %s r[8]; uint64_t x = %s, y = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); std::memcpy(b, &y, 8); "
                   "for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { r[i] = sat<%s>(a[i]); r[i + 4] = sat<%s>(b[i]); } std::memcpy(&%s, r, 8);",
                   m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKSSWB ? "int8_t" : "uint8_t", D.c_str(), src.c_str(),
                   m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKSSWB ? "int8_t" : "uint8_t", m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKSSWB ? "int8_t" : "uint8_t", D.c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PACKSSDW:
            emit(F("int32_t a[2], b[2]; int16_t r[4]; uint64_t x = %s, y = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); std::memcpy(b, &y, 8); "
                   "r[0] = sat<int16_t>(a[0]); r[1] = sat<int16_t>(a[1]); r[2] = sat<int16_t>(b[0]); r[3] = sat<int16_t>(b[1]); std::memcpy(&%s, r, 8);",
                   D.c_str(), src.c_str(), D.c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PSHUFW: {
            int imm = int(ops[2].imm.value.u);
            emit(F("uint16_t a[4], r[4]; uint64_t x = %s; std::memcpy(a, &x, 8); r[0] = a[%d]; r[1] = a[%d]; r[2] = a[%d]; r[3] = a[%d]; std::memcpy(&%s, r, 8);",
                   src.c_str(), imm & 3, (imm >> 2) & 3, (imm >> 4) & 3, (imm >> 6) & 3, D.c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PEXTRW:
            emit(RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, F("(uint16_t)(ctx.mm[%d] >> (16 * (%d & 3)))", s, int(ops[2].imm.value.u))));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PINSRW: {
            int sh = 16 * (int(ops[2].imm.value.u) & 3);
            emit(F("%s = (%s & ~(0xFFFFull << %d)) | ((uint64_t)(uint16_t)(%s) << %d);", D.c_str(), D.c_str(), sh,
                   Read(ops[1], "ea").c_str(), sh));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PMOVMSKB:
            emit(RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, F("[&] { uint32_t r = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) r |= ((ctx.mm[%d] >> (i * 8 + 7)) & 1) << i; return r; }()", s)));
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

```

`sdk/tools/recomp/codegen_int.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

#include "codegen.h"

static std::string F(const char* f, ...) __attribute__((format(printf, 1, 2)));
static std::string F(const char* f, ...) {
    char buf[2048];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, f);
    std::vsnprintf(buf, sizeof(buf), f, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    return buf;
}

static bool FindMem(const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops, int& idx) {
    for (int i = 0; i < in.operand_count_visible; i++)
        if (ops[i].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_MEMORY) {
            idx = i;
            return true;
        }
    idx = -1;
    return false;
}

static std::string Szp(unsigned w) {
    return F("zf = r == 0; sf = (uint32_t)(r >> %u) & 1; pf = X86_PARITY(r);", w - 1);
}

static bool IsCmov(ZydisMnemonic m) {
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVNZ:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMOVZ:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

static bool IsSetcc(ZydisMnemonic m) {
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNB: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNBE: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNL: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNLE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETNZ:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETO: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETP: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETS: case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SETZ:
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
}

bool CodeGen::EmitInteger(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    int mi;
    bool mem = FindMem(in, ops, mi);
    std::string ea = mem ? "ea" : "";
    std::string open = mem ? "\t{ uint32_t ea = " + AddrExpr(ops[mi]) + "; " : "\t{ ";
    bool lock = (in.attributes & ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_LOCK) && mem && mi == 0;
    unsigned W = ops[0].size == 8 || ops[0].size == 16 ? ops[0].size : 32;
    std::string T = CType(W), S = CType(W, true);
    auto rd = [&](int i) { return "(" + T + ")(" + Read(ops[i], ea) + ")"; };
    auto wr = [&](int i, const std::string& v) { return Write(ops[i], ea, v); };
    auto emit = [&](const std::string& s) { Line(open + s + " }"); };

    // read modify write through an atomic compare exchange loop when locked
    auto rmw = [&](const std::string& pre, const std::string& expr, const std::string& flags) {
        if (lock) {
            emit(F("%s* p = X86_PTR(%s, ea); %s a = __atomic_load_n(p, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); %s %s r; "
                   "do { r = (%s)(%s); } while (!__atomic_compare_exchange_n(p, &a, r, false, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)); %s",
                   T.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), pre.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), expr.c_str(), flags.c_str()));
        } else {
            emit(F("%s a = %s; %s %s r = (%s)(%s); %s %s", T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), pre.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(),
                   expr.c_str(), wr(0, "r").c_str(), flags.c_str()));
        }
    };

    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_NOP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PAUSE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PREFETCHNTA:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PREFETCHT0:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PREFETCHT1:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PREFETCHT2:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PREFETCHW:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FNOP:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_EMMS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_FWAIT:
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SFENCE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LFENCE:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MFENCE:
            Line("\t__atomic_thread_fence(__ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);");
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOV: {
            auto special = [](const ZydisDecodedOperand& o) {
                return o.type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER &&
                       ((o.reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ES && o.reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_GS) ||
                        (o.reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_CR0 && o.reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_DR15));
            };
            if (special(ops[0]) || (special(ops[1]) && ops[1].reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_CR0)) {
                Line(F("\tx86_priv(ctx, 0x%X, \"%s\");", va, ZydisMnemonicGetString(m)));
                return true;
            }
            emit(wr(0, Read(ops[1], ea)));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVZX:
            emit(wr(0, "(" + CType(ops[1].size) + ")(" + Read(ops[1], ea) + ")"));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVSX:
            emit(wr(0, "(" + T + ")(" + CType(ops[1].size, true) + ")(" + Read(ops[1], ea) + ")"));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LEA:
            Line("\t" + RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, AddrExpr(ops[1], false)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_XCHG:
            if (mem) {
                int r = mi == 0 ? 1 : 0;
                emit(F("%s old = __atomic_exchange_n(X86_PTR(%s, ea), (%s)(%s), __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); %s", T.c_str(), T.c_str(),
                       T.c_str(), Read(ops[r], ea).c_str(), RegWrite(ops[r].reg.value, "old").c_str()));
            } else {
                emit(F("%s t = %s; %s %s", T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), wr(0, Read(ops[1], ea)).c_str(), wr(1, "t").c_str()));
            }
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BSWAP:
            emit(wr(0, "__builtin_bswap32(" + Read(ops[0], ea) + ")"));
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADD:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a + b",
                F("cf = r < a; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s", W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_OR:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a | b", "cf = 0; of = 0; " + Szp(W));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_AND:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a & b", "cf = 0; of = 0; " + Szp(W));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_XOR:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a ^ b", "cf = 0; of = 0; " + Szp(W));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SUB:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a - b",
                F("cf = a < b; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s", W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ADC:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s; uint32_t c0 = cf;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a + b + c0",
                F("cf = ((uint64_t)a + b + c0) >> %u & 1; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s", W, W - 1,
                  Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SBB:
            rmw(F("%s b = %s; uint32_t c0 = cf;", T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str()), "a - b - c0",
                F("cf = (uint64_t)a < (uint64_t)b + c0; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s", W - 1,
                  Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMP:
            emit(F("%s a = %s, b = %s; %s r = (%s)(a - b); ca = a; cb = b; cf = a < b; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), rd(1).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            pending_ = {true, false, W};
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_TEST:
            emit(F("%s a = %s, b = %s; %s r = (%s)(a & b); ca = a; cb = b; cf = 0; of = 0; %s", T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(),
                   rd(1).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), Szp(W).c_str()));
            pending_ = {true, true, W};
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INC:
            rmw("", "a + 1", F("of = r == (%s)(1u << %u); %s", T.c_str(), W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_DEC:
            rmw("", "a - 1", F("of = a == (%s)(1u << %u); %s", T.c_str(), W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_NEG:
            rmw("", "0 - a", F("cf = a != 0; of = a == (%s)(1u << %u); %s", T.c_str(), W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_NOT:
            rmw("", "~a", "");
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SHL:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { %s r = (%s)((uint32_t)a << c); "
                   "cf = c <= %u ? ((uint32_t)a >> (%u - c)) & 1 : 0; of = ((uint32_t)(r >> %u) & 1) ^ cf; %s %s }",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W, W, W - 1,
                   Szp(W).c_str(), wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SHR:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { %s r = (%s)((uint32_t)a >> c); "
                   "cf = c <= %u ? ((uint32_t)a >> (c - 1)) & 1 : 0; of = (uint32_t)(a >> %u) & 1; %s %s }",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W, W - 1, Szp(W).c_str(),
                   wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SAR:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { %s r = (%s)((int32_t)(%s)a >> c); "
                   "cf = (uint32_t)((int32_t)(%s)a >> (c - 1)) & 1; of = 0; %s %s }",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), S.c_str(), S.c_str(),
                   Szp(W).c_str(), wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ROL:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { uint32_t n = c %% %u; "
                   "%s r = n ? (%s)(((uint32_t)a << n) | ((uint32_t)a >> (%u - n))) : a; cf = r & 1; "
                   "of = ((uint32_t)(r >> %u) & 1) ^ cf; %s }",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W, T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W, W - 1,
                   wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ROR:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { uint32_t n = c %% %u; "
                   "%s r = n ? (%s)(((uint32_t)a >> n) | ((uint32_t)a << (%u - n))) : a; cf = (uint32_t)(r >> %u) & 1; "
                   "of = ((uint32_t)(r >> %u) ^ (uint32_t)(r >> %u)) & 1; %s }",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W, T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W, W - 1, W - 1, W - 2,
                   wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RCL:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t n = ((uint32_t)(%s) & 31) %% %u; for (; n; n--) { uint32_t hi = (uint32_t)(a >> %u) & 1; "
                   "a = (%s)(((uint32_t)a << 1) | cf); cf = hi; } %s",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W + 1, W - 1, T.c_str(), wr(0, "a").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RCR:
            emit(F("%s a = %s; uint32_t n = ((uint32_t)(%s) & 31) %% %u; for (; n; n--) { uint32_t lo = a & 1; "
                   "a = (%s)(((uint32_t)a >> 1) | (cf << %u)); cf = lo; } %s",
                   T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W + 1, T.c_str(), W - 1, wr(0, "a").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SHLD:
            if (W != 32) return false;
            emit(F("uint32_t a = %s, b = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { uint32_t r = (uint32_t)((((uint64_t)a << 32) | b) << c >> 32); "
                   "cf = (a >> (32 - c)) & 1; of = ((r ^ a) >> 31) & 1; %s %s }",
                   Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), Read(ops[2], ea).c_str(), Szp(32).c_str(),
                   wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SHRD:
            if (W != 32) return false;
            emit(F("uint32_t a = %s, b = %s; uint32_t c = (uint32_t)(%s) & 31; if (c) { uint32_t r = (uint32_t)((((uint64_t)b << 32) | a) >> c); "
                   "cf = (a >> (c - 1)) & 1; of = ((r ^ a) >> 31) & 1; %s %s }",
                   Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), Read(ops[2], ea).c_str(), Szp(32).c_str(),
                   wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MUL:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IMUL: {
            bool sgn = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IMUL;
            int vis = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < in.operand_count_visible; i++)
                if (ops[i].visibility == ZYDIS_OPERAND_VISIBILITY_EXPLICIT) vis++;
            if (vis == 1) {
                unsigned w = ops[0].size;
                if (w == 8) {
                    if (sgn)
                        emit(F("int16_t p = (int16_t)((int8_t)ctx.eax * (int8_t)%s); ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)p; cf = of = p != (int8_t)p;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                    else
                        emit(F("uint16_t p = (uint16_t)((uint8_t)ctx.eax * (uint8_t)%s); ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | p; cf = of = (p >> 8) != 0;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                } else if (w == 16) {
                    if (sgn)
                        emit(F("int32_t p = (int32_t)(int16_t)ctx.eax * (int16_t)%s; ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)p; "
                               "ctx.edx = (ctx.edx & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(p >> 16); cf = of = p != (int16_t)p;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                    else
                        emit(F("uint32_t p = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)ctx.eax * (uint16_t)%s; ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)p; "
                               "ctx.edx = (ctx.edx & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(p >> 16); cf = of = (p >> 16) != 0;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                } else {
                    if (sgn)
                        emit(F("int64_t p = (int64_t)(int32_t)ctx.eax * (int32_t)%s; ctx.eax = (uint32_t)p; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)((uint64_t)p >> 32); cf = of = p != (int32_t)p;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                    else
                        emit(F("uint64_t p = (uint64_t)ctx.eax * (uint32_t)%s; ctx.eax = (uint32_t)p; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)(p >> 32); cf = of = ctx.edx != 0;",
                               Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
                }
                return true;
            }
            std::string a = vis == 3 ? Read(ops[1], ea) : Read(ops[0], ea);
            std::string b = vis == 3 ? Read(ops[2], ea) : Read(ops[1], ea);
            emit(F("int64_t p = (int64_t)(%s)(%s) * (int64_t)(%s)(%s); %s r = (%s)p; cf = of = p != (%s)r; %s", S.c_str(),
                   a.c_str(), S.c_str(), b.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), S.c_str(), wr(0, "r").c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_DIV:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IDIV: {
            bool sgn = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IDIV;
            unsigned w = ops[0].size;
            std::string trap = F("x86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"divide error\");", va);
            if (w == 8) {
                if (sgn)
                    emit(F("int16_t n = (int16_t)ctx.eax; int8_t d = (int8_t)%s; if (!d) %s int16_t q = n / d; if (q != (int8_t)q) %s "
                           "ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint8_t)q | ((uint32_t)(uint8_t)(n %% d) << 8);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
                else
                    emit(F("uint16_t n = (uint16_t)ctx.eax; uint8_t d = (uint8_t)%s; if (!d) %s uint16_t q = n / d; if (q > 0xFF) %s "
                           "ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint8_t)q | ((uint32_t)(uint8_t)(n %% d) << 8);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
            } else if (w == 16) {
                if (sgn)
                    emit(F("int32_t n = (int32_t)(((ctx.edx & 0xFFFFu) << 16) | (ctx.eax & 0xFFFFu)); int16_t d = (int16_t)%s; if (!d) %s "
                           "int32_t q = n / d; if (q != (int16_t)q) %s ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)q; ctx.edx = (ctx.edx & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(n %% d);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
                else
                    emit(F("uint32_t n = ((ctx.edx & 0xFFFFu) << 16) | (ctx.eax & 0xFFFFu); uint16_t d = (uint16_t)%s; if (!d) %s "
                           "uint32_t q = n / d; if (q > 0xFFFF) %s ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)q; ctx.edx = (ctx.edx & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(n %% d);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
            } else {
                if (sgn)
                    emit(F("int64_t n = (int64_t)(((uint64_t)ctx.edx << 32) | ctx.eax); int32_t d = (int32_t)%s; if (!d) %s "
                           "if (n == INT64_MIN && d == -1) %s int64_t q = n / d; if (q != (int32_t)q) %s ctx.eax = (uint32_t)q; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)(n %% d);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
                else
                    emit(F("uint64_t n = ((uint64_t)ctx.edx << 32) | ctx.eax; uint32_t d = (uint32_t)%s; if (!d) %s "
                           "uint64_t q = n / d; if (q > 0xFFFFFFFFull) %s ctx.eax = (uint32_t)q; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)(n %% d);",
                           Read(ops[0], ea).c_str(), trap.c_str(), trap.c_str()));
            }
            return true;
        }

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_XADD:
            if (lock)
                emit(F("%s b = %s; %s a = __atomic_fetch_add(X86_PTR(%s, ea), b, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); %s r = (%s)(a + b); %s "
                       "cf = r < a; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s",
                       T.c_str(), rd(1).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), wr(1, "a").c_str(), W - 1,
                       Szp(W).c_str()));
            else
                emit(F("%s a = %s, b = %s; %s r = (%s)(a + b); %s %s cf = r < a; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ r) & (b ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s",
                       T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), rd(1).c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), wr(1, "a").c_str(), wr(0, "r").c_str(),
                       W - 1, Szp(W).c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPXCHG: {
            std::string acc = W == 8 ? "(uint8_t)ctx.eax" : W == 16 ? "(uint16_t)ctx.eax" : "ctx.eax";
            ZydisRegister accr = W == 8 ? ZYDIS_REGISTER_AL : W == 16 ? ZYDIS_REGISTER_AX : ZYDIS_REGISTER_EAX;
            std::string flags = F("%s r = (%s)(x - a); cf = x < a; of = (uint32_t)(((x ^ a) & (x ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; %s",
                                  T.c_str(), T.c_str(), W - 1, Szp(W).c_str());
            if (mem)
                emit(F("%s x = %s; %s a = x; bool ok = __atomic_compare_exchange_n(X86_PTR(%s, ea), &a, (%s)(%s), false, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); "
                       "if (!ok) { %s } %s",
                       T.c_str(), acc.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(),
                       RegWrite(accr, "a").c_str(), flags.c_str()));
            else
                emit(F("%s x = %s; %s a = %s; if (x == a) { %s } else { %s } %s", T.c_str(), acc.c_str(), T.c_str(),
                       rd(0).c_str(), wr(0, Read(ops[1], ea)).c_str(), RegWrite(accr, "a").c_str(), flags.c_str()));
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPXCHG8B:
            emit("uint64_t x = ((uint64_t)ctx.edx << 32) | ctx.eax; uint64_t n = ((uint64_t)ctx.ecx << 32) | ctx.ebx; "
                 "bool ok = __atomic_compare_exchange_n(X86_PTR(uint64_t, ea), &x, n, false, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); "
                 "zf = ok; if (!ok) { ctx.eax = (uint32_t)x; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)(x >> 32); }");
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTS:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTR:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTC: {
            const char* op = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTS ? "a | bit" : m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTR ? "a & ~bit" : "a ^ bit";
            if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER) {
                std::string s = F("%s a = %s; uint32_t n = (uint32_t)(%s) & %u; %s bit = (%s)(1u << n); cf = (a >> n) & 1;",
                                  T.c_str(), rd(0).c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W - 1, T.c_str(), T.c_str());
                if (m != ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BT) s += " " + wr(0, op);
                emit(s);
                return true;
            }
            std::string addr, n;
            if (ops[1].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER) {
                addr = F("ea + (uint32_t)(((int32_t)%s >> %u) * %u)", RegRead(ZydisRegisterGetLargestEnclosing(ZYDIS_MACHINE_MODE_LEGACY_32, ops[1].reg.value)).c_str(),
                         W == 16 ? 4 : 5, W / 8);
                n = F("((uint32_t)%s & %u)", Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W - 1);
            } else {
                addr = "ea";
                n = F("((uint32_t)%s & %u)", Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(), W - 1);
            }
            std::string s = F("uint32_t a2 = %s; uint32_t n = %s; %s bit = (%s)(1u << n); ", addr.c_str(), n.c_str(),
                              T.c_str(), T.c_str());
            if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BT) {
                s += F("cf = (%s >> n) & 1;", Mem(W, "a2").c_str());
            } else if (in.attributes & ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_LOCK) {
                std::string ats = m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTS   ? std::string("__atomic_fetch_or(p, bit, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)")
                                  : m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BTR ? F("__atomic_fetch_and(p, (%s)~bit, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)", T.c_str())
                                                            : std::string("__atomic_fetch_xor(p, bit, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST)");
                s += F("%s* p = X86_PTR(%s, a2); %s a = %s; cf = (a >> n) & 1;", T.c_str(), T.c_str(), T.c_str(), ats.c_str());
            } else {
                s += F("%s a = %s; cf = (a >> n) & 1; %s = (%s)(%s);", T.c_str(), Mem(W, "a2").c_str(), Mem(W, "a2").c_str(),
                       T.c_str(), op);
            }
            emit(s);
            return true;
        }
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BSF:
            emit(F("uint32_t s = (%s)%s; zf = s == 0; if (s) { %s }", T.c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(),
                   wr(0, "__builtin_ctz(s)").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_BSR:
            emit(F("uint32_t s = (%s)%s; zf = s == 0; if (s) { %s }", T.c_str(), Read(ops[1], ea).c_str(),
                   wr(0, "31 - __builtin_clz(s)").c_str()));
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CBW:
            Line("\tctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | (uint16_t)(int16_t)(int8_t)ctx.eax;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CWDE:
            Line("\tctx.eax = (uint32_t)(int32_t)(int16_t)ctx.eax;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CWD:
            Line("\tctx.edx = (ctx.edx & 0xFFFF0000u) | ((ctx.eax & 0x8000u) ? 0xFFFFu : 0u);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CDQ:
            Line("\tctx.edx = (uint32_t)((int32_t)ctx.eax >> 31);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LAHF:
            Line("\tctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF00FFu) | ((sf << 7 | zf << 6 | pf << 2 | 2u | cf) << 8);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SAHF:
            Line("\t{ uint32_t h = (ctx.eax >> 8) & 0xFF; sf = (h >> 7) & 1; zf = (h >> 6) & 1; pf = (h >> 2) & 1; cf = h & 1; }");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CLC: Line("\tcf = 0;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STC: Line("\tcf = 1;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMC: Line("\tcf ^= 1;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CLD: Line("\tctx.df = 0;"); return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STD: Line("\tctx.df = 1;"); return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUSH:
            if (ops[0].size == 16 && ops[0].type != ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_IMMEDIATE) {
                emit(F("uint16_t v = (uint16_t)(%s); ctx.esp -= 2; X86_MEM16(ctx.esp) = v;", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
            } else {
                emit(F("uint32_t v = (uint32_t)(%s); X86_PUSH32(v);", Read(ops[0], ea).c_str()));
            }
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_POP:
            if (ops[0].type == ZYDIS_OPERAND_TYPE_REGISTER && ops[0].reg.value >= ZYDIS_REGISTER_ES && ops[0].reg.value <= ZYDIS_REGISTER_GS) {
                Line("\tctx.esp += 4;");
                return true;
            }
            if (mem)
                Line(F("\t{ uint32_t v = X86_MEM32(ctx.esp); ctx.esp += 4; uint32_t ea = %s; %s }", AddrExpr(ops[0]).c_str(),
                       Write(ops[0], "ea", "v").c_str()));
            else if (ops[0].size == 16)
                Line(F("\t{ uint16_t v = X86_MEM16(ctx.esp); ctx.esp += 2; %s }", RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, "v").c_str()));
            else
                Line(F("\t{ uint32_t v = X86_MEM32(ctx.esp); ctx.esp += 4; %s }", RegWrite(ops[0].reg.value, "v").c_str()));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUSHAD:
            Line("\t{ uint32_t s = ctx.esp; X86_PUSH32(ctx.eax); X86_PUSH32(ctx.ecx); X86_PUSH32(ctx.edx); X86_PUSH32(ctx.ebx); "
                 "X86_PUSH32(s); X86_PUSH32(ctx.ebp); X86_PUSH32(ctx.esi); X86_PUSH32(ctx.edi); }");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_POPAD:
            Line("\t{ uint32_t s = ctx.esp; ctx.edi = X86_MEM32(s); ctx.esi = X86_MEM32(s + 4); ctx.ebp = X86_MEM32(s + 8); "
                 "ctx.ebx = X86_MEM32(s + 16); ctx.edx = X86_MEM32(s + 20); ctx.ecx = X86_MEM32(s + 24); ctx.eax = X86_MEM32(s + 28); ctx.esp = s + 32; }");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_PUSHFD:  // bit 1 always reads 1, IF (0x200) always set, AC and ID kept in xflags
            Line("\tX86_PUSH32(cf | 2u | pf << 2 | zf << 6 | sf << 7 | 0x200u | ctx.df << 10 | of << 11 | ctx.xflags);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_POPFD:
            Line("\t{ uint32_t f = X86_MEM32(ctx.esp); ctx.esp += 4; cf = f & 1; pf = (f >> 2) & 1; zf = (f >> 6) & 1; sf = (f >> 7) & 1; "
                 "ctx.df = (f >> 10) & 1; of = (f >> 11) & 1; ctx.xflags = f & 0x240000u; }");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LEAVE:
            Line("\tctx.esp = ctx.ebp; ctx.ebp = X86_MEM32(ctx.esp); ctx.esp += 4;");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_ENTER:
            if (ops[1].imm.value.u != 0) return false;
            Line(F("\tX86_PUSH32(ctx.ebp); ctx.ebp = ctx.esp; ctx.esp -= %uu;", uint32_t(ops[0].imm.value.u)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_XLAT:
            Line("\tctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFFFF00u) | X86_MEM8(ctx.ebx + (uint8_t)ctx.eax);");
            return true;

        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RDTSC:
            Line("\t{ uint64_t t = x86_rdtsc(); ctx.eax = (uint32_t)t; ctx.edx = (uint32_t)(t >> 32); }");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CPUID:
            Line("\tx86_cpuid(ctx);");
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INT3:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_UD2:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_HLT:
            Line(F("\tx86_trap(ctx, 0x%X, \"%s\");", va, ZydisMnemonicGetString(m)));
            return true;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IN:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_OUT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CLI:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STI:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_WBINVD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INVD:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SGDT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SIDT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LGDT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LIDT:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_RDMSR:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_WRMSR:
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_INVLPG:
            if (m == ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_IN) Line("\tctx.eax = 0;");
            Line(F("\tx86_priv(ctx, 0x%X, \"%s\");", va, ZydisMnemonicGetString(m)));
            return true;
        default:
            break;
    }
    if (IsSetcc(m)) {
        emit(wr(0, "(" + Cond(m) + ") ? 1u : 0u"));
        return true;
    }
    if (IsCmov(m)) {
        emit(F("if (%s) { %s }", Cond(m).c_str(), wr(0, Read(ops[1], ea)).c_str()));
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool CodeGen::EmitString(uint32_t va, const ZydisDecodedInstruction& in, const ZydisDecodedOperand* ops) {
    if (in.meta.category != ZYDIS_CATEGORY_STRINGOP) return false;
    auto m = in.mnemonic;
    unsigned w = 0;
    const char* kind = nullptr;
    switch (m) {
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVSB: w = 1; kind = "movs"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVSW: w = 2; kind = "movs"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_MOVSD: w = 4; kind = "movs"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STOSB: w = 1; kind = "stos"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STOSW: w = 2; kind = "stos"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_STOSD: w = 4; kind = "stos"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LODSB: w = 1; kind = "lods"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LODSW: w = 2; kind = "lods"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_LODSD: w = 4; kind = "lods"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPSB: w = 1; kind = "cmps"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPSW: w = 2; kind = "cmps"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_CMPSD: w = 4; kind = "cmps"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SCASB: w = 1; kind = "scas"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SCASW: w = 2; kind = "scas"; break;
        case ZYDIS_MNEMONIC_SCASD: w = 4; kind = "scas"; break;
        default: return false;
    }
    bool rep = in.attributes & (ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_REP | ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_REPE | ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_REPNE);
    bool repe = in.attributes & ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_REPE;
    bool repne = in.attributes & ZYDIS_ATTRIB_HAS_REPNE;
    std::string T = CType(w * 8);
    std::string M = w == 1 ? "X86_MEM8" : w == 2 ? "X86_MEM16" : "X86_MEM32";
    std::string step = F("int32_t d = ctx.df ? -%u : %u;", w, w);
    std::string acc = w == 1 ? "(uint8_t)ctx.eax" : w == 2 ? "(uint16_t)ctx.eax" : "ctx.eax";
    std::string cmpflags = F("%s r = (%s)(a - b); cf = a < b; of = (uint32_t)(((a ^ b) & (a ^ r)) >> %u) & 1; "
                             "zf = r == 0; sf = (uint32_t)(r >> %u) & 1; pf = X86_PARITY(r);",
                             T.c_str(), T.c_str(), w * 8 - 1, w * 8 - 1);
    std::string s;
    if (!std::strcmp(kind, "movs")) {
        if (rep) s = F("x86_rep_movs(ctx, base, %u);", w);
        else s = F("%s %s(ctx.edi) = %s(ctx.esi); ctx.esi += d; ctx.edi += d;", step.c_str(), M.c_str(), M.c_str());
    } else if (!std::strcmp(kind, "stos")) {
        if (rep) s = F("x86_rep_stos(ctx, base, %u);", w);
        else s = F("%s %s(ctx.edi) = (%s)ctx.eax; ctx.edi += d;", step.c_str(), M.c_str(), T.c_str());
    } else if (!std::strcmp(kind, "lods")) {
        std::string wr = w == 1 ? "ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFFFF00u) | v;" : w == 2 ? "ctx.eax = (ctx.eax & 0xFFFF0000u) | v;" : "ctx.eax = v;";
        std::string body = F("%s v = %s(ctx.esi); %s ctx.esi += d;", T.c_str(), M.c_str(), wr.c_str());
        s = rep ? step + " while (ctx.ecx) { " + body + " ctx.ecx--; }" : step + " " + body;
    } else if (!std::strcmp(kind, "cmps")) {
        std::string body = F("%s a = %s(ctx.esi), b = %s(ctx.edi); ctx.esi += d; ctx.edi += d; %s", T.c_str(), M.c_str(),
                             M.c_str(), cmpflags.c_str());
        if (rep) s = step + " while (ctx.ecx) { " + body + " ctx.ecx--; if (" + (repne ? "zf" : "!zf") + ") break; }";
        else s = step + " " + body;
    } else {
        std::string body = F("%s a = %s, b = %s(ctx.edi); ctx.edi += d; %s", T.c_str(), acc.c_str(), M.c_str(), cmpflags.c_str());
        if (rep) s = step + " while (ctx.ecx) { " + body + " ctx.ecx--; if (" + (repne ? "zf" : "!zf") + ") break; }";
        else s = step + " " + body;
    }
    (void)repe;
    Line("\t{ " + s + " }");
    return true;
}
```

`sdk/tools/recomp/main.cpp`:

```cpp
#include <toml++/toml.hpp>

#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <filesystem>
#include <fstream>
#include <optional>

#include "analysis.h"
#include "codegen.h"

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

static uint32_t ParseAddr(std::string_view s) { return uint32_t(std::stoul(std::string(s), nullptr, 0)); }

static std::optional<int64_t> Num(const toml::table* t, const char* key) {
    return t ? (*t)[key].value<int64_t>() : std::nullopt;
}

// "ret" or an address, as a number or a string
static bool ParseExit(const toml::node* n, Hook::Exit& e) {
    if (!n) return true;
    e.set = true;
    if (auto i = n->value<int64_t>()) {
        e.to = uint32_t(*i);
        return true;
    }
    auto s = n->value<std::string>();
    if (!s) return false;
    if (*s == "ret") {
        e.ret = true;
        return true;
    }
    try {
        e.to = ParseAddr(*s);
    } catch (...) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Keys beyond [xbe], [functions], [symbols], [data] and [layout]:
//   [xbe] data_ranges = [[lo, hi], ...]  bytes in code sections that are never code, hi exclusive
//   [xbe] trace = [address, ...]  log each call of these functions (caller, arguments) and its eax
//   [[hook]] at, call, after, on_true, on_false  call a host function before or after a guest instruction;
//     on_true/on_false make it return bool and name "ret" or an instruction of the same function to jump to
//   [[function]] at, end  an entry decoded no further than end (exclusive); it also stops other walks
//   [[switch]] at, targets  the targets of an indirect jmp, replacing table detection
//   [xbe] xdk = build  includes <--xdk folder>/<build>/layout.toml
//   [abi] name = ["esi", "stack", ...]  where a [symbols] function takes each API argument when the image does not
//     use the convention the host declares: a register, or "stack" for the next stack slot, which the callee pops
static bool LoadConfig(const fs::path& path, Config& cfg, const fs::path& xdk_dir) {
    toml::table t;
    try {
        t = toml::parse_file(path.string());
    } catch (const toml::parse_error& e) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", path.string().c_str(), std::string(e.description()).c_str());
        return false;
    }
    fs::path dir = path.parent_path();
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["xdk"].value<int64_t>()) {
        if (xdk_dir.empty()) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: [xbe] xdk = %lld needs --xdk <the SDK's xdk folder>\n", path.string().c_str(), (long long)*v);
            return false;
        }
        fs::path layout = xdk_dir / std::to_string(*v) / "layout.toml";
        if (!fs::exists(layout)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: [xbe] xdk = %lld: %s does not exist\n", path.string().c_str(), (long long)*v,
                         layout.string().c_str());
            return false;
        }
        if (!LoadConfig(layout, cfg, xdk_dir)) return false;
    }
    auto includes = t["includes"].as_array();
    if (includes)
        for (auto& i : *includes)
            if (auto s = i.value<std::string>())
                if (!LoadConfig(dir / *s, cfg, xdk_dir)) return false;
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["path"].value<std::string>()) cfg.xbe_path = *v;
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["title"].value<int64_t>()) cfg.title = uint32_t(*v);
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["entry"].value<int64_t>()) cfg.entry = uint32_t(*v);
    if (auto a = t["xbe"]["trace"].as_array())
        for (auto& i : *a) cfg.trace.insert(uint32_t(i.value_or(int64_t(0))));
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["out"].value<std::string>()) cfg.out_dir = *v;
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["partitions"].value<int64_t>()) cfg.partitions = uint32_t(*v);
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["gap_fill"].value<bool>()) cfg.gap_fill = *v;
    if (auto v = t["xbe"]["pointer_seeds"].value<bool>()) cfg.pointer_seeds = *v;
    if (auto a = t["xbe"]["code_sections"].as_array())
        for (auto& i : *a)
            if (auto s = i.value<std::string>()) cfg.code_sections.push_back(*s);
    if (auto a = t["xbe"]["code_prefixes"].as_array())
        for (auto& i : *a)
            if (auto s = i.value<std::string>()) cfg.code_prefixes.push_back(*s);
    if (auto a = t["xbe"]["data_ranges"].as_array())
        for (auto& i : *a)
            if (auto r = i.as_array(); r && r->size() == 2)
                cfg.data_ranges.push_back({uint32_t(r->get(0)->value<int64_t>().value_or(0)),
                                           uint32_t(r->get(1)->value<int64_t>().value_or(0))});
    if (auto f = t["functions"].as_table())
        for (auto& [k, v] : *f) cfg.functions[ParseAddr(k.str())] = v.value<std::string>().value_or("");
    for (auto [key, out] : {std::pair{"symbols", &cfg.symbols}, std::pair{"data", &cfg.data}})
        if (auto f = t[key].as_table())
            for (auto& [k, v] : *f) (*out)[std::string(k.str())] = uint32_t(v.value<int64_t>().value_or(0));
    if (auto f = t["layout"].as_table())
        for (auto& [k, v] : *f)
            if (auto i = v.value<int64_t>()) cfg.layout[std::string(k.str())] = uint32_t(*i);
    if (auto f = t["abi"].as_table())
        for (auto& [k, v] : *f) {
            std::string name(k.str());
            auto fail = [&](const std::string& why) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: [abi] %s: %s\n", path.string().c_str(), name.c_str(), why.c_str());
                return false;
            };
            auto a = v.as_array();
            if (!a) return fail("not an array of argument locations");
            if (a->size() > 16) return fail("more than 16 arguments");
            std::vector<std::string> locs;
            for (auto& x : *a) {
                std::string s = x.value<std::string>().value_or("");
                static const std::set<std::string> known{"stack", "eax", "ebx", "ecx", "edx", "esi", "edi", "ebp"};
                if (!known.count(s)) return fail("\"" + s + "\" is not stack, eax, ebx, ecx, edx, esi, edi or ebp");
                if (s != "stack" && std::count(locs.begin(), locs.end(), s)) return fail(s + " holds two arguments");
                locs.push_back(s);
            }
            cfg.abi[name] = locs;
        }
    auto bad = [&](const char* key) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: bad [[%s]] entry\n", path.string().c_str(), key);
        return false;
    };
    if (auto a = t["hook"].as_array())
        for (auto& e : *a) {
            auto h = e.as_table();
            auto at = Num(h, "at");
            auto call = h ? (*h)["call"].value<std::string>() : std::nullopt;
            Hook k;
            if (!at || !call || !ParseExit(h->get("on_true"), k.on_true) || !ParseExit(h->get("on_false"), k.on_false))
                return bad("hook");
            k.at = uint32_t(*at);
            k.call = *call;
            k.after = (*h)["after"].value_or(false);
            cfg.hooks.emplace(k.at, k);
        }
    if (auto a = t["function"].as_array())
        for (auto& e : *a) {
            auto at = Num(e.as_table(), "at");
            if (!at) return bad("function");
            cfg.functions.emplace(uint32_t(*at), "");
            cfg.function_ends[uint32_t(*at)] = uint32_t(Num(e.as_table(), "end").value_or(0));
        }
    if (auto a = t["switch"].as_array())
        for (auto& e : *a) {
            auto h = e.as_table();
            auto at = Num(h, "at");
            auto ts = h ? (*h)["targets"].as_array() : nullptr;
            if (!at || !ts || ts->empty()) return bad("switch");
            auto& v = cfg.switches[uint32_t(*at)];
            v.clear();
            for (auto& x : *ts) {
                auto i = x.value<int64_t>();
                if (!i) return bad("switch");
                v.push_back(uint32_t(*i));
            }
        }
    for (auto& [name, va] : cfg.symbols)
        if (va) cfg.functions.emplace(va, name);
    return true;
}

// overrides that analysis could not apply are config mistakes
static bool CheckOverrides(const Analysis& an) {
    bool ok = true;
    for (auto& [at, end] : an.cfg.function_ends)
        if (!an.functions.count(at) || (end && end <= at)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[[function]] %08X: not decodable code or end not above it\n", at);
            ok = false;
        }
    for (auto& [at, targets] : an.cfg.switches) {
        const Insn* i = an.InsnAt(at);
        if (!i || i->flow != Flow::JmpIndirect) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "[[switch]] %08X: not a decoded indirect jmp\n", at);
            ok = false;
        }
        for (uint32_t t : targets)
            if (!an.InsnAt(t)) {
                std::fprintf(stderr, "[[switch]] %08X: target %08X is not a decoded instruction\n", at, t);
                ok = false;
            }
    }
    return ok;
}

int main(int argc, char** argv) {
    std::vector<std::string> args;
    fs::path xdk_dir;
    bool usage = false;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (std::strcmp(argv[i], "--xdk")) args.push_back(argv[i]);
        else if (++i < argc) xdk_dir = argv[i];
        else usage = true;
    }
    if (args.empty() || usage) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "usage: xbe_recomp <config.toml> [xbe override] [out override] [--xdk <SDK xdk folder>]\n");
        return 1;
    }
    Config cfg;
    fs::path cfg_path = args[0];
    if (!LoadConfig(cfg_path, cfg, xdk_dir)) return 1;
    for (auto& [name, locs] : cfg.abi)
        if (!cfg.symbols.count(name)) {
            std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: [abi] %s is not a [symbols] name\n", args[0].c_str(), name.c_str());
            return 1;
        }
    fs::path root = cfg_path.parent_path().parent_path();  // the config sits in <game>/config
    fs::path xbe_path = args.size() > 1 ? fs::path(args[1]) : root / cfg.xbe_path;
    fs::path out_dir = args.size() > 2 ? fs::path(args[2]) : root / cfg.out_dir;

    std::ifstream f(xbe_path, std::ios::binary);
    if (!f) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "cannot open %s\n", xbe_path.string().c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    std::vector<uint8_t> data((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)), {});
    xbe::Image img;
    std::string err;
    if (!img.Parse(std::move(data), err)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: %s\n", xbe_path.string().c_str(), err.c_str());
        return 1;
    }
    std::fprintf(stderr, "%s: title %08X entry %08X kernel thunk %08X\n", xbe_path.filename().string().c_str(),
                 img.title_id, img.entry, img.kernel_thunk);
    if ((cfg.title && cfg.title != img.title_id) || (cfg.entry && cfg.entry != img.entry)) {
        std::fprintf(stderr, "%s was written for title %08X entry %08X, not this image: delete it so build.bat writes a new one\n",
                     args[0].c_str(), cfg.title, cfg.entry);
        return 1;
    }

    Analysis an(img, cfg);
    an.Run();
    if (!CheckOverrides(an)) return 1;
    fs::create_directories(out_dir);
    CodeGen gen(an, out_dir);
    return gen.Run() ? 0 : 1;
}
```

```toml
name = "SCDoubleAgent-V2Recomp"
```
